chapters.title: Chapter 4101: Clay Figure
paragraphs: Chapter 4101: Clay Figure
“Humph, you still want to flee?” Liu Fang said balefully.
Ling Han smiled, “What is it? Are you guys planning to kill me and snatch my treasure?”
“So what if I am?” Liu Fang said, “This is not the marketplace!”
In the marketplace, they indeed did not dare make a move. No one could ignore the words of a Saint, but there was no rule that said they could not make a move here.

A Core Formation Tier cultivator and a True Self Tier cultivator, and one at the consummate level of the True Self Tier at that, how could it be that they would not be able to suppress two Core Formation Tier cultivators?
Humph, there was no need for Tu Yang to make a move. He alone would be able to deal with it.
“How do the two of you want to die?” Liu Fang asked.
Ling Han shook his head, “Just because of this little bit of conflict, you guys want to commit murder?”
“Two pieces of trash, so what if I kill you?” Liu Fang said proudly, appearing to be completely unconcerned.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I’ll remember you.”
Liu Fang smirked coldly. So what if you remembered? Do you still want to make a comeback?
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said. With a wave of his hand, he and the large black dog disappeared into thin air.
Yi, where was he?

Tu Yang was startled. Even though he looked like he had fallen asleep, he had actually already used the power of Regulations to seal off the surrounding space. It was impossible for a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier to escape.
What was going on here?
“An Escape Seal?” Liu Fang looked over.
Tu Yang frowned slightly, “Someone who can use the Escape Seal should have an extraordinary background.”

Liu Fang hesitated slightly, then said proudly, “At most, they would be the same as us, and similarly come from the Holy Land. However, they are clearly far from being our match, and that is why they fled at the first instant. When the True Dragon Abyss opens, I will crush them to death.”

Tu Yang pondered for a moment before frowning. Liu Fang was ranked in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network, and there were truly only a handful of people at the same cultivation level that was stronger than him. Moreover, the two people from before definitely weren’t among them.
In the distance, Ling Han and the large black dog’s figures appeared. Just now, it was naturally Ling Han who had used the ley lines to transport them away.
After so many days, how could it be that Ling Han still hadn’t mastered the ley lines here?

This was, after all, once a great planet. In fact, it had even given birth to the True Dragon before. Even if it had been shattered, a portion of the ley lines had still been preserved. However, the Earth Qi was already very weak.
“These two b*stards actually want to kill Grandpa Dog!” the large black dog said angrily. “When the True Dragon Abyss opens, we’ll catch that guy called Liu Fang and beat him up.”
“All right.” Ling Han smiled faintly.

“What the hell is this clay figurine?” The large black dog took out the clay figurine, but when he swept his gaze over it, this did not seem to be any kind of treasure. It did not have any complicated veined patterns, nor did it exude a captivating pressure.

It injected mystical power into the clay figurine, but the clay figurine didn’t change at all. It wasn’t like ordinary Spirit Tools that would glow. It injected its Spiritual Power into the clay figurine, and there was also no change.
“Yi, it’s completely useless?” The large black dog was angered. Pa, he threw the clay figurine onto the ground, but still, nothing happened.
Ling Han said calmly, “This thing should be extraordinary. Just think, if it was an ordinary item, would it be able to withstand your torment?”𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚

“That’s right.” The large black dog grabbed the clay figurine again, but after studying it left and right, he couldn’t find anything strange. He looked at Ling Han and said, “Say, could this thing be for kids to play with?”
It moved the right arm of the clay figurine, and a strange scene appeared. Its right front leg involuntarily moved, as if it was twitching.
“F***, what’s going on here?” The large black dog was shocked, then came to a sudden realization, “Grandpa Dog discovered what this clay figurine was playing at!”
It fiddled with it again. As long as it moved the clay figurine, correspondingly, its limbs would also move.
After playing for a while, the large black dog was enraged, and he smashed the clay figurine onto the ground again, “This is screwing me over!”
This clay figurine could only torment him. Could it be that it wanted to screw him over in a
battle?
Which b@stard had created this thing?
Was he bored?
His imagination was running wild. How could one torture himself like this?

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. He picked up the clay figurine, and lightly moved the right arm of the clay figurine. As expected, his right arm also involuntarily raised. He looked towards the large black dog again, and used his divine sense to lock onto it. Then, he moved the right arm of the clay figurine.
Pa! The large black dog’s paw immediately slammed into his face.

“Woof!” The large black dog jumped up. What the hell? Why had it slapped itself? “Little Han, is this your doing?” It immediately turned to look at Ling Han. After all, it had just played with the clay figurine, and it was completely unable to resist this kind of power. No, that was not power, but a kind of Regulations, so it could only do as the clay figure did. Ling Han laughed loudly, and moved the clay figurine a few more times. The large black dog immediately began to dance, his posture incredibly bewitching.
“Woof, woof, woof, woof, stop!”
“Little Han!”
“Grandpa Dog will fight you to the death!”
In the end, Ling Han still stopped. He shared his insights on how to use this clay figurine with the large black dog.

If he were to fiddle with the clay figurine, it would be corresponding to himself. He would also be dancing with joy. However, if he first locked onto someone with his divine sense, and then fiddled with the clay figurine, it would be that person that would be moving like the clay
figurine.
“Hiss, this is good stuff!” The large black dog immediately became excited.
Ling Han also nodded. If one suddenly danced around in battle, then what was the point of continuing the battle?
“You have to first know the upper limit of cultivation level that this thing targets,” he said
solemnly.
“Let’s go, let’s go, let’s go and do the experiment!” the large black dog said excitedly. In the eyes of a rascal like him, this clay figurine could become the best treasure for screwing people
over.
The man and dog went to the marketplace again. There were many people here, so it was best
to experiment.
After a round, they had more or less figured out the effects of the clay figurines, but there
were also a great many people that were unlucky. For some inexplicable reason, they were waving their hands and feet, as if they had gone crazy.
“Theoretically speaking, there is no upper limit to cultivation level for the clay figurine’s effects.”
“However, above the True Self Tier, there’s no way to lock onto one with divine sense at all. The gap in cultivation level is too wide.”
“Though you can control the other party through the clay figurine, you can’t do any self- harming actions, such as blowing up your own head with a single punch.”
“At the same time, it can only target one person.”
Ling Han summarized his experience with the large black dog. Although the clay figure wasn’t
a deadly weapon, just the fact that it could control the actions of their enemies was already extremely awesome.
“Grandpa Dog really wants to know who made this.” The large black dog’s eyes were filled
with longing, “It suits Grandpa Dog’s tastes too well!”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “That’s collusion, right?”
“Get lost!”
The empress and Hu Niu also went out shopping. In this aspect, any woman was no exception.
Since they were free anyway, Ling Han and the large black dog decided to go out for a walk.
Who knows, they might be able to obtain something good like the clay figurine.
They set out, heading once more to the marketplace.
“Brother-in-law!” A delicate voice rang out from behind him.
Ling Han and the large black dog ignored this. This clearly wasn’t referring to them.
“Brother-in-law!” Unexpectedly, this voice sounded again, and it was even closer to them. “Little Han, that seems to be calling you,” the large black dog said.
“What kind of joke is that? We’re both in disguise now, so how can there be a sister-in-law for
me?” Ling Han shook his head, but he still turned around to take a look. Then, he was
dumbfounded.
Wasn’t this “sister-in-law” Chi Mengshan?

chapters.title: Chapter 4102: Love Appearing
paragraphs: Chapter 4102: Love Appearing
This silver-haired lolita was quite mischievous.
Ling Han naturally remembered his own persona. It wasn’t Ling Han now, nor was it Ding Yi. Thus, he “should not” recognize this little girl.

“Brother-in-law!” Chi Mengshan unexpectedly blocked Ling Han’s path. Crossing her arms behind her back, she shook her head, and said, “Brother-in-law, your attire is far too trashy.” “Little girl, you’ve got the wrong person, right?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Ling Han, Ding Yi!” Chi Mengshan counted on her fingers. She then looked at Ling Han, and said, “Brother-in-law, what’s your name now?”
Ling Han was surprised, and looked towards the large black dog. Meanwhile, the large black dog’s expression was also filled with shock.
This little girl could actually see through their disguises!
Gods, it should be known that if the Venerate Tier elites didn’t pay special attention, even they would very easily be deceived by their disguises.
What kind of f****** eyes do you have!
“Hehe, it’s impossible to fool me, Chi Mengshan, with my eyes!” the little girl said proudly. “Oh, that’s right, brother-in-law, my sister is hosting a banquet three days later. You have to come!”
“Heng, heng, if you dare not come, I will reveal your identity!”
Ling Han was speechless. He had only met this little loli once, but why did this little loli keep calling him brother-in-law so intimately? It was very easy for others to misunderstand, all right?
-If this thought was known to others, countless people would probably line up to beat him up.
That was the third most beautiful woman in the galaxy, and you are complaining?
“That’s all. Goodbye, brother-in-law.” The silver-haired little lolita skipped around, and very soon, disappeared from sight.
This was baffling.
The large black dog was slightly surprised, and nudged Ling Han, “Little Han, when did you sleep with her sister?”
“Get lost, don’t spout nonsense!”
On the other side, the silver-haired little lolita was smug.

“Chi Menghan, Chi Menghan, no matter what, I have to marry you off as soon as possible, so that I won’t always be under your control. One moment, you’ll tell me to cultivate, and the next, you’ll tell me to sit quietly. You’re even more annoying than my mother!”
“If I marry you off, I’ll become the Imperial Daughter!”
“Haha, when the time comes, I’ll point my finger here and there, and everyone will have to listen to me. Just thinking about it makes me feel good!”
“So, Brother-in-law, you have to work hard. Three days later, you can directly elope with my sister!”
Ling Han and the large black dog roamed around the market a few times, but the chances of picking up bargains were naturally pitifully small. How could they pick up treasures time and time again?
Thus, they returned empty-handed this time.

After returning, the empress and Hu Niu also returned. The empress was cold and aloof, and did not speak much. However, Hu Niu chattered on, talking about what they had encountered today, giggling as she talked.
The large black dog wanted nothing more than for the world to be in chaos. He hurriedly related their encounter with the silver-haired little lolita, and then anticipated the eruption of a battle.
As expected, Hu Niu immediately bared her canines, and rolled up her sleeves, “To dare snatch Niu’s Ling Han, Niu is going to kill her!”

Meanwhile, the empress was proud and tsundere. In her eyes, Ling Han was naturally the best man in the world, so it was very normal for any woman to like him. She said, “Since she is an Imperial Daughter, she would be of some use. Just marry her!”

Ling Han placed his hand on his forehead. His two beautiful wives were two complete opposites. One had the temperament of a child, yet wanted to monopolize him, while the other was incredibly proud. Though everything was for his own good, the ideas she came up with were very bad, all right?
Marrying the Imperial Daughter?

Hehe, putting aside whether he had such thoughts or not, the key was that even if he wanted to take her as wife, would she want to marry him? Furthermore, the Imperial Daughter was serving the same husband as other women, so how could this possibly be allowed?
Did the Imperial Clan not care about their pride?
But no matter what, with the persuasion of the empress and the large black dog, Ling Han still decided to attend that so-called banquet.

If he didn’t go, who knew what kind of trouble Chi Mengshan, this little loli, would cause. This little girl was actually able to see through the Soul Forming Technique. Could it be that the Great Emperor’s bloodline had suddenly awakened in her?
In the next few days, everything was peaceful.
Hu Niu also wanted to join in on the excitement, but was stopped by the empress. This time, he was going to court an Imperial Daughter. How could it be that Hu Niu would be allowed to cause trouble?
Meanwhile, Ling Han comforted Hu Niu. He definitely wouldn’t like that Chi Menghan. He only went because he didn’t want to expose his identity.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
After coaxing Hu Niu, Ling Han and the large black dog set off. The large black dog naturally didn’t want to miss this opportunity, so he shamelessly set off together with him.

The Chi Clan was an Imperial Clan, so they were naturally extravagant. They temporarily carved out a large area on the Heavenly Dragon Planet as their exclusive territory, and used their great power to construct a super large manor in a short amount of time.

Here, there were towers and pavilions, and a waterfall appeared out of thin air in the skies, crashing down with waves that gathered into a great lake. There were celestial clouds and celestial light, intertwining to form Regulations. Green trees provided shade, filled with
vitality.
Impressive. This had forcibly transformed a barren land into a paradise on earth.

Unfortunately, this was only temporary prosperity. When the Donglin Imperial Clan left, without the maintenance of elites, the waterfall would soon disappear, the lake would dry up, and the green trees would wilt.
“Hey, you two, are you also going to the banquet?” Before they had even reached their destination, they saw an ancient carriage suddenly stop when it passed by them. Then, they
saw a head poke out of the carriage window.
This was a young man, and he was quite handsome.
Ling Han smiled, “That’s right, I want to join in on the excitement.”
“Come, come, come, let me give you a ride.” This young man was very cordial, and personally opened the carriage door, welcoming Ling Han and the large black dog.
Yi?
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged a glance. They hadn’t exposed their identities, so how had they received such high-standard treatment?
“I am Zhao Kun,” this young man said. He was very familiar with them, “Do the two of you
have invitations?”
What invitation?
Ling Han shook his head, and replied, “No.” Yi, he hadn’t been tricked by Chi Mengshan, this
little girl, right?
“Then you two will be disappointed.” Zhao Kun shook his head, “The Imperial Clan is hosting
a banquet, and not everyone is qualified to attend. You either have to have an invitation, or
you can pass three stages.”
“Pass three stages?” the large black dog asked.
“It’s the test set by the Donglin Imperial Clan. As long as one can pass, they’ll be qualified to
attend the banquet,” Zhao Kun said. He then shook his head, and said, “I advise you people to
give up. It’s impossible to pass.”
“Going by that theory, you already have an invitation?” the large black dog asked. He was
already thinking of robbing him.
“I don’t either.” Zhao Kun spread out his hands.
Yi, aren’t you afraid of being beaten to death?
Zhao Kun laughed loudly, “Though I do not have an invitation, I have a distant relative who is
the Dao Child of the Azure Snow Holy Land. He can bring me in!”
As he said this, his expression was filled with pride.
Ling Han and the large black dog finally understood. No wonder this guy was so cordial. He

was not hospitable at all, but rather that this guy was incredibly fond of showing off, and deliberately pulled the two of them into the carriage. He would strike a blow on their pride first, and then show off his backer.
I can go in, but you guys can’t. Come and envy me!

Hu Niu also wanted to join in on the excitement, but was stopped by the empress.
This time, he was going to court an Imperial Daughter.
How could it be that Hu Niu would be allowed to cause trouble?

He definitely wouldn’t like that Chi Menghan.
He only went because he didn’t want to expose his identity.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
After coaxing Hu Niu, Ling Han and the large black dog set off.
The large black dog naturally didn’t want to miss this opportunity, so he shamelessly set off together with him.
The Chi Clan was an Imperial Clan, so they were naturally extravagant.
They temporarily carved out a large area on the Heavenly Dragon Planet as their exclusive territory, and used their great power to construct a super large manor in a short amount of time.
Here, there were towers and pavilions, and a waterfall appeared out of thin air in the skies, crashing down with waves that gathered into a great lake.
There were celestial clouds and celestial light, intertwining to form Regulations.
Green trees provided shade, filled with
vitality.
Impressive.
This had forcibly transformed a barren land into a paradise on earth.
Unfortunately, this was only temporary prosperity.
When the Donglin Imperial Clan left, without the maintenance of elites, the waterfall would soon disappear, the lake would dry up, and the green trees would wilt.
“Hey, you two, are you also going to the banquet?” Before they had even reached their destination, they saw an ancient carriage suddenly stop when it passed by them.
Then, they
saw a head poke out of the carriage window.
This was a young man, and he was quite handsome.
Ling Han smiled, “That’s right, I want to join in on the excitement.”
“Come, come, come, let me give you a ride.” This young man was very cordial, and personally opened the carriage door, welcoming Ling Han and the large black dog.
Yi?
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged a glance.
They hadn’t exposed their identities, so how had they received such high-standard treatment?
“I am Zhao Kun,” this young man said.
He was very familiar with them, “Do the two of you
have invitations?”
What invitation?
Ling Han shook his head, and replied, “No.” Yi, he hadn’t been tricked by Chi Mengshan, this
little girl, right?
“Then you two will be disappointed.” Zhao Kun shook his head, “The Imperial Clan is hosting
a banquet, and not everyone is qualified to attend.
You either have to have an invitation, or
you can pass three stages.”
“Pass three stages?” the large black dog asked.
“It’s the test set by the Donglin Imperial Clan.
As long as one can pass, they’ll be qualified to
attend the banquet,” Zhao Kun said.
He then shook his head, and said, “I advise you people to
give up.
It’s impossible to pass.”
“Going by that theory, you already have an invitation?” the large black dog asked.
He was
already thinking of robbing him.
“I don’t either.” Zhao Kun spread out his hands.
Yi, aren’t you afraid of being beaten to death?
Zhao Kun laughed loudly, “Though I do not have an invitation, I have a distant relative who is
the Dao Child of the Azure Snow Holy Land.
He can bring me in!”
As he said this, his expression was filled with pride.
Ling Han and the large black dog finally understood.
No wonder this guy was so cordial.
He
was not hospitable at all, but rather that this guy was incredibly fond of showing off, and deliberately pulled the two of them into the carriage.
He would strike a blow on their pride first, and then show off his backer.
I can go in, but you guys can’t.
Come and envy me!

chapters.title: Chapter 4103: Dazzling Dance
paragraphs: Chapter 4103: Dazzling Dance
Ling Han and the large black dog had seen many weirdos, but to show off to this extent, this Zhao Kun should be the one and only.
The large black dog secretly took out the clay figurine, then began to play tricks.
“Yi?” Zhao Kun exclaimed in surprise. He involuntarily stood up, and then swayed his behind in an incredibly showy manner.

“It wasn’t me! I didn’t!” he hurriedly said. He wanted to explain to Ling Han and the large black dog. He wasn’t such a coquettish person, but his body couldn’t help but twist into an enchanting dance.
The large black dog pretended to pale in shock, “What do you mean? Are you trying to flirt with me?”

Zhao Kun was also very helpless. He could not explain, and there was no one forcing him either, but he just couldn’t help but dance gracefully, as if there was Regulations in the heaven and earth that forced him to do this.
He was about to cry. If this matter spread out, how would he be able to face others?
The large black dog said, “Since Brother Zhao is in such high spirits, come, Grandpa will help you broadcast live on the Galaxy Network.”
“No!” Zhao Kun hurriedly exclaimed. Seeing that the large black dog was facing him, he hurriedly clapped his hands on the carriage. Peng, his whole person instantly shot out of the carriage.
His feet were no longer under his control, but as a mighty Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, he could completely move with his bare hands.
With this sudden change, the carriage instantly stopped. The coachman was shocked, “What did you guys do to Young Master?”
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged looks, then shrugged in unison, pretending to be innocent.

“This has nothing to do with them!” Zhao Kun said from afar, as he continued to gesticulate. He was so bewitching that the coachman broke out in a cold sweat. What was going on with this Young Master? Had he been bewitched?
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked towards the large black dog, and transmitted a message, “That’s about enough.”
Only then did the large black dog reluctantly put away the clay figurine. He hadn’t played enough yet.
However, it didn’t matter. There would definitely be a lot of insensible people at the banquet, and there would definitely be others for it to play with.
Zhao Kun walked back, bowed to Ling Han and the large black dog, and said, “Please keep today’s matter a secret for me!”
“Don’t worry.” The large black dog patted his chest, and said, “I’m a tight-lipped person. See, I’ve never told you that the Imperial Daughter of the Dong Lin Imperial Clan likes Ling Han, right?”
Zhao Kun couldn’t help but wipe away the cold sweat on his forehead. How could he be at ease with such a big mouth?
Ling Han smiled and said, “He loves to joke, so it’s fine.”
Only then did Zhao Kun breathe a sigh of relief. Ling Han looked much more reliable than the large black dog.
The carriage travelled for a while longer, and then entered into the territory of the Donglin Imperial Clan.
Though this was only temporarily allocated, who would dare not take the Imperial Clan seriously?
“Stop the carriage!” Immediately, someone flew down from the sky. This was a middle-aged man who was in the Core Formation Tier. After the carriage stopped, he said, “Show me your invitation.”
Zhao Kun hurriedly walked out, clasped his hands and said, “This Lord, I am Zhao Kun. I have a clan brother, whose name is-‘
“Invitation!” the middle-aged man said darkly, interrupting Zhao Kun’s words, “If you don’t have an invitation, withdraw immediately!”

Zhao Kun hurriedly had the coachman steer the carriage back a little. Then, he looked towards Ling Han and the large black dog, and said with a smile, “Don’t worry, don’t worry. I will immediately contact that distant clan brother of mine, and ask him to step out. Who knows, he may be able to bring the two of you in as well.”
Looking at the smug expression on his face, he wanted nothing more than to ascend to the heavens!
Ling Han and the large black dog both smiled. ‘Come, continue your performance.’
Zhao Kun opened the connection device, and conversed with that distant clan brother. This was divine sense-level, and there was no need to speak.
However, Ling Han and the large black dog could clearly see that this guy’s expression was becoming uglier and uglier, almost jumping up and down in anger.
Needless to say, they knew what was going on. Clearly, this guy could not enter.
After another while, Zhao Kun suddenly looked pleased. Then, he quickly hung up the connection device.
“My clan brother will be here soon,” he said.
“Distant clan brother,” the large black dog added.
This instantly caused Zhao Kun’s expression to darken. F***, there is no need for you to fill in
the blanks so clearly.
After a while, a figure flew over from the distance, then stopped by the side of the carriage.
Yi!
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged a look, both looking surprised.
This was too coincidental, wasn’t it?
Liu Fang.
This distant cousin of Zhao Kun was actually Liu Fang.
“Clan brother!” Zhao Kun immediately went up to greet him, his face all smiles.
Liu Fang, on the other hand, did not notice Ling Han and the large black dog. He was too conceited, so why would he deliberately pay attention to two nameless pawns?
“Follow me!” Liu Fang said.

“Clan brother, I still have two friends. Can I bring them along?” Zhao Kun was still very generous. Of course, it was also possible that his habit of showing off had taken effect again. After he brought Ling Han and the large black dog in, he wanted to admire the stunned
expressions of these two “people”.
En, he must like to show off.
Liu Fang frowned. He was only a disciple of the Holy Land. Though he was ranked highly on the Galaxy Network, but for the Imperial Clan, what was that worth?
For the sake of a distant relative, he shamelessly went to beg others, and only then did he manage to obtain a spot to bring Zhao Kun in. However, did he really think that the Imperial
Clan was his home? He could bring as many people as he wanted?
“Shut up!” he rebuked. Then, he turned to look at Ling Han and the large black dog. He
wanted to see who these two shameless people were.
“It’s you guys!” His eyes swept over them, and he couldn’t help but be startled.

“Are you surprised?” The large black dog spread his hands, “Are you shocked?” “Clan brother, you know them?” Zhao Kun approached, and asked cautiously. In his eyes, Liu Fang was like a god, ranked in the top 100 of Galaxy Network, and furthermore, taken as disciple by the Holy Land, what a kickass life.
Liu Fang smirked coldly, and completely ignored Zhao Kun. He said calmly, “You guys want to enter as well? Haha, what a joke, two country bumpkins that came from who knows
where!”
This was more or less the territory of the Donglin Imperial Clan, so he didn’t make a move.

Otherwise, it would be equivalent to not giving any face to the Imperial Clan. He would not dare to have this blame fall on himself. In any case, he had already decided that the moment the True Dragon Abyss opened, the first thing he would do would be to kill these two people. It didn’t matter if he waited for a few more days. He still had this bit of patience. “Sigh, where does this feeling of superiority come from? Aren’t you afraid of being slapped in𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
the face?” The large black dog shook his head.
Pa!
Right at this moment, a crisp sound was heard. Liu Fang had really sustained a slap, and the person who had slapped him… was actually himself.
“C-clan brother!” Zhao Kun couldn’t help but exclaim in shock. Then, he looked at the large
black dog in horror. Was this guy a jinx?
Liu Fang himself was also very confused. He looked blankly at his right hand. Just now, for some reason, his right hand had uncontrollably slapped his face without any warning. It was
as if he had gone mad.
However, what happened next was even more inconceivable. He actually stretched out a sinful hand, and immediately pressed it between Zhao Kun’s legs. In fact, he even pinched it
lightly.
This time, the middle-aged Core Formation cultivator from the Donglin Imperial Clan who
was hovering in midair fell down forcefully!
‘Holy f*ck! My eyes are hurting! I’m about to vomit!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4104: The Unfortunate Liu Fang
paragraphs: Chapter 4104: The Unfortunate Liu Fang
Zhao Kun was also dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Why had he been grabbed? Furthermore, if this was a beauty, then even if outsiders had seen this, he would only be “embarrassed” for a while, at most. But now, it was a man, a man!
All of a sudden, there was only one thought in his mind, and that was all his innocence was gone!
Heavens, he didn’t even want a beautiful woman. It was fine as long as they were women. Why was it a man?

Liu Fang was also stunned and speechless. He swore that his sexual orientation was extremely normal, but all of a sudden, for some reason, he was touching a man’s crotch. This made him practically doubt his life.
“Disgusting!” Donglin Imperial Clan’s Core Formation Tier finally roared. This was too f*cking blinding.
“No, no, no, this is a misunderstanding!” Liu Fang hurriedly said. He was really very innocent.
However, just as his words fell, pa, his demonic palm once again stretched out, and pressed down on Zhao Kun’s behind.
This!
“Shameless! Shameless!” The Core Formation Tier cultivator’s face flushed red, and he shouted, “All of you, get lost! You’re not welcome here!”

“No, it’s really not like that!” Liu Fang’s face was also pale. This banquet was a very good opportunity for him to get to know the other Holy Lands and even the Imperial Clan in fact, so he could expand his circle of friends.
But if he was chased out of the banquet, then if others asked, what? He was chased off because he had touched another man’s c*ck and behind? How would he be able to face others in future?
If he truly became a Saint in the future, would others also refer to him as the C*ck Touching Saint?
That would really be leaving his name for all eternity.
He looked towards Zhao Kun. Unexpectedly, Zhao Kun had also retreated continuously, maintaining a great distance from him, a hint of wariness in his expression.
“Zhao Kun, even you don’t trust me?” he asked angrily.
Zhao Kun smiled awkwardly, yet was unwilling to come any closer.
How am I supposed to believe you? You touched my c*ck first, then touched my behind. Pervert, pervert!

The large black dog was already rolling around in laughter. As the culprit, he was naturally extremely pleased. Unfortunately, this kind of pleasure could only be shared with Ling Han. Otherwise, he would be even happier.

Ling Han also shook his head. If this clay figurine was used properly, its might would really be even more terrifying than killing someone. Of course, only the large black dog would think of such an underhanded trick. This time, Liu Fang had really been tricked terribly.
“Don’t stand here anymore, leave quickly!” Donglin Imperial Clan’s Core Formation Tier began to chase them away.
He really didn’t want to see Liu Fang again. He felt extremely disgusted.
Liu Fang was naturally unwilling, and was just explaining away. However, this was naturally useless. With two “moves”, his image had already been completely destroyed.
“Hahaha!” The large black dog laughed heartily.
“What are you laughing at?” Liu Fang looked over. He had finally found a target to vent his fury.
“What are you being so arrogant for? I didn’t touch a man’s c*ck or behind,” the large black dog said in a mocking tone.
F***, you still dare to say it!

Liu Fang wanted to kill someone, but his reasoning was still present. This was the territory of the Donglin Imperial Clan. Killing someone here was equivalent to not giving face to the Donglin Imperial Clan. He was unafraid of this middle-aged man. He was only a servant, so his abilities were definitely inferior to his. However, if he offended the Donglin Imperial Clan, would there still be a place for him in the future?
He sneered as well, and said, “You speak as if you have the right to enter.”

The large black dog was proud, and he said, “Little Han, let’s pass the three stages.” “Haha!” Liu Fang laughed coldly. He knew what the three tests set by the Donglin Imperial Clan were. As he saw it, it was impossible to pass them. The difficulty was too high, and they would only be seeking their own humiliation.
“If you guys can pass three stages, I’ll cut off my head and hand it over to you.”
The large black dog looked towards Ling Han, “Little Han, this pervert seems to be looking down on us?”
“Sigh, have we both fallen to the extent of being looked down on by a pervert?” Ling Han shook his head cooperatively.
“You two!” Liu Fang said through gritted teeth. As long as these two people dared to enter the True Dragon Abyss, he would definitely find them and kill them.
However, he did not say it out loud, fearing that Ling Han and the large black dog would become afraid, and give up the idea of going to the True Dragon Abyss.
“This friend, bring us to pass the three stages,” Ling Han said.

The Donglin Imperial Clan’s Core Formation Tier also knew that Ling Han and the large black dog weren’t in the same group as Liu Fang after observing them for so long. This caused him to breathe a sigh of relief. Otherwise, just thinking about the demonic palm that had reached into the privates of a certain man caused goosebumps to rise all over his body.
“All right,” he nodded.
Just as he was about to bring Ling Han and the large black dog to pass the so-called three stages, he was taken aback. Then, he turned to Ling Han and asked, “Dare I ask if your name is
Ling Han, or Ding Yi?”
“That’s right. This is the second handsome man in the world, Ding Yi. I am the most handsome Ding Er in the world,” the large black dog interrupted.
The Core Formation Tier cultivator nodded, then said, “Please wait for a moment.”
Yi, what was going on here?
Liu Fang was stunned. Why didn’t you pass three stages? Could it be that you f****** wanted
to cover for these two people, and just bring the two of them to the banquet like that?
This was too brazen.
Yi, what had that person just said? Ling Han?
Was this Ling Han from the North Heavenly Realm?
That’s not right. The difference in appearance was too great.
“Brother-in-law!” A delicate voice was soon heard, and they saw a silver-haired little lolita rapidly rushing over from the distance at an astonishing speed.
This was naturally transmission of divine sense. The transmission of sound was far from
being as fast as her running speed.
Chi Mengshan.
When the Core Formation Tier cultivator heard the words “brother-in-law”, he was so scared𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
that he directly fell over.
Brother-in-law?

This little princess only had one sister, and that was the Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan. She was the Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan, and she was also the prodigy with the most natural talent in the last million years, Chi Menghan. In the future, not only would she have the chance to become a Saint, she could even attempt to become an
Emperor.
The Imperial Daughter was getting married? Heavens!
Liu Fang naturally knew Chi Mengshan as well. This was the little princess of the Donglin
Imperial Clan, and the Imperial Daughter Chi Menghan’s younger sister. Which of the guests here today didn’t know her?
It was precisely because of this that he was gaping widely, looking at Ling Han as if he was an
idiot.
How was this possible?
Chi Menghan was not only the Imperial Daughter, but also the third most beautiful woman in
the galaxy. Yet, she was already taken? Moreover, she was already married to the person he
hated the most?
No, no, no, he could not accept this!

The silver-haired lolita didn’t care how many people would be troubled by her screams. Her mind was filled with thoughts of marrying Chi Menghan off, and she didn’t care at all. “Brother-in-law, you’re really late!” she complained the moment she arrived. Then, she grabbed one of Ling Han’s hands, “Quick, quick, quick, don’t let others snatch Big Sister away! Sigh, you’re really too much. You’re not worried at all that your wife is about to be snatched away. Aren’t you afraid that there’s a grassy plain above your head!”
This little girl was too mature, wasn’t she?
The large black dog’s interest was instantly piqued, and he said, “Little girl, tell me about
your sister and Little Han.”
“Yi, stinky dog!” Chi Mengshan fanned her nose, “I don’t like dogs. They smell like poop all
the time, so detestable!”
The large black dog’s expression instantly turned dark. From the moment it gained intelligence, it had cast off most of its habits as a dog, all right?
“Let’s go, let’s go!”

That would really be leaving his name for all eternity.
He looked towards Zhao Kun.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Kun had also retreated continuously, maintaining a great distance from him, a hint of wariness in his expression.
“Zhao Kun, even you don’t trust me?” he asked angrily.
Zhao Kun smiled awkwardly, yet was unwilling to come any closer.
How am I supposed to believe you?
You touched my c*ck first, then touched my behind.
Pervert, pervert!

Otherwise, he would be even happier.

F***, you still dare to say it!

Killing someone here was equivalent to not giving face to the Donglin Imperial Clan.
He was unafraid of this middle-aged man.
He was only a servant, so his abilities were definitely inferior to his.
However, if he offended the Donglin Imperial Clan, would there still be a place for him in the future?

The large black dog was proud, and he said, “Little Han, let’s pass the three stages.” “Haha!” Liu Fang laughed coldly.

As he saw it, it was impossible to pass them.
The difficulty was too high, and they would only be seeking their own humiliation.

“That’s right.
This is the second handsome man in the world, Ding Yi.
I am the most handsome Ding Er in the world,” the large black dog interrupted.

That’s not right.

being as fast as her running speed.
Chi Mengshan.
When the Core Formation Tier cultivator heard the words “brother-in-law”, he was so scared𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
that he directly fell over.
Brother-in-law?

Emperor.
The Imperial Daughter was getting married?
Heavens!

This was the little princess of the Donglin
Imperial Clan, and the Imperial Daughter Chi Menghan’s younger sister.

idiot.

the galaxy.
Yet, she was already taken?
Moreover, she was already married to the person he
hated the most?
No, no, no, he could not accept this!

You’re not worried at all that your wife is about to be snatched away.
Aren’t you afraid that there’s a grassy plain above your head!”
This little girl was too mature, wasn’t she?
The large black dog’s interest was instantly piqued, and he said, “Little girl, tell me about
your sister and Little Han.”
“Yi, stinky dog!” Chi Mengshan fanned her nose, “I don’t like dogs.
They smell like poop all
the time, so detestable!”
The large black dog’s expression instantly turned dark.
From the moment it gained intelligence, it had cast off most of its habits as a dog, all right?
“Let’s go, let’s go!”

paragraphs: Chapter 4105: Brother-in-law is here
With Chi Mengshan leading the way, of course, no one dared to stop them. They didn’t need to pass any three stages, and directly went to the banquet venue.
Liu Fang watched as the two men and little girl disappeared, flames of fury bursting from his eyes.

He naturally had designs on Chi Menghan as well. Though this Imperial Daughter had not revealed her true appearance, her figure was really perfect, and she was definitely a supreme beauty. Furthermore, just from looking at Chi Mengshan, he knew that her Big Sister was naturally as beautiful as a celestial maiden.

“Whether you are Ding Yi or Ling Han, as long as you dare to enter into the True Dragon Abyss, I will definitely make it so that you will never return!” he said balefully in his heart. As for the near-invincible legend of Ling Han, he naturally scoffed.
He was merely in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so how powerful could he be?
Meanwhile, Zhao Kun’s expression was filled with envy. As it turned out, these two were the real awesome people. Without a sound, they had successfully courted the Imperial Daughter.
Sigh, he had still been showing off in front of the two of them. Now that he thought about it, it was too embarrassing.
He swept an eye over Liu Fang, and involuntarily, his a** tightened. This distant clan brother of his had a special fetish. Would he… instantly, he broke out in a cold sweat.
Liu Fang discovered his strange behavious, and hurriedly emphasized, “I am not a pervert!”
“Yes, yes, yes.” Zhao Kun nodded. Then why did you still grab my d***, and even touch my behind? It was clear that you were interested in my a**.
Liu Fang, “…”

Led by Chi Mengshan, Ling Han and the large black dog soon arrived at the banquet venue. It was located on the lake, and there were rocks floating on the water. There was a table placed on each floating rock. It was either for one person alone, or three to four people sitting together.

At the center of the lake, there was a waterfall that fell from the sky and rushed into the lake, creating splashes that were at least a few meters tall. Hua, hua, hua, hua sounds were deafening. However, for all the prodigies of the Core Formation Tier here, this was naturally no big deal, and would not cause any kind of effects to their hearing at all.

The Imperial Clan truly lived up to their name; they were still so unique in how they hosted a banquet. This was unlike other clans, which were either in the garden, or in the palace. They were all on solid ground. The banquet was placed on the surface of the water here, which was indeed a sight to behold.
“Sister, sister!” Chi Mengshan shouted loudly, “Look, who have I brought here!”
As she said this, she turned to Ling Han and said, “Hurry up and return to your original appearance!”
Fine.
Ling Han sighed upon seeing this. This little loli had a strong demeanor, and she was even ordering him around.
Forget it. Since he was already here, he was unafraid. In the territory of the Imperial Clan, who would dare make a move?

Ling Han returned to his original appearance, and the large black dog had long since grown tired of his human appearance. With a shake of his body, he also returned to his original form. A pair of iron underwear shone brightly, capable of blinding one’s eyes.
“Ling Han!” Immediately, someone recognized him and exclaimed in shock.

Recently, Ling Han was really too popular. With the cultivation level of Core Formation Tier, he had destroyed a True Self Tier. There were really pitifully few people who didn’t know about him on the Galaxy Network.

A man’s name was like the shadow of a tree. Regardless of whether Ling Han Han had borrowed the power of formations, he did indeed have the ability to crush a True Self Tier cultivator, which was incredibly stunning.

Of course, there were also those who were unconvinced by Ling Han, and thought that since he could not communicate with the ley lines in the True Dragon Abyss, Ling Han was still an ordinary Core Formation Tier cultivator, so what need was there for them to be afraid of him?
Meanwhile, Chi Menghan’s pretty face changed drastically. She hurriedly transmitted a message to Chi Mengshan, saying, “Don’t spout nonsense!”
If this little girl shouted in public, then it would be a big joke.
“Sister, I’ve brought my brother-in-law!” The little loli’s face was filled with innocence. Those who weren’t familiar with her would definitely be deceived by her.
Hiss, brother-in-law!
Instantly, a dead silence fell. No one spoke anymore. They looked towards Chi Menghan, then turned back to look at Ling Han.
Hua, hua, hua! Only the waterfall continued to flow downwards.

“Mengshan, don’t shoot your mouth off!” An old woman ran out and grabbed Chi Mengshan by the neck. Then, she smiled at everyone, “Children don’t know any better. Young friends, you don’t have to take it to heart.”
“That’s right, Senior.”
“Heh, she’s only a child, after all. Senior, you don’t have to reprimand her too much.”
Only then did everyone come back to their senses, and spoke one after another.

Chi Mengshan struggled continuously, but it would really be strange if she managed to break free. Furthermore, she still wanted to speak, but discovered that she could not open her mouth at all. She was sealed off by the power of Regulations, as if she did not have a mouth.

“Young friends, find a place to sit,” the old woman said to Ling Han and the large black dog. Then, she turned around and left with Chi Mengshan in tow. She was probably going to teach this mischievous brat a good lesson.
Ling Han and the large black dog found an empty floating rock and jumped onto it. They then poured some wine for themselves.

“Good wine!” The large black dog took a sip, and couldn’t help but widen his brows. “The Donglin Imperial Clan is truly rich and imposing. This wine was brewed from a considerable amount of Celestial medicine. If it can be ingested continuously, it would be of great help to the comprehension of Regulations.”
“Drink more,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Definitely!”

The people at the other tables all had small sips of wine. Even if they knew that this wine was very nutritious, for the sake of their image, they still restrained themselves very much. However, how could Ling Han and the large black dog be the type to care about vanity?
They drank like bulls, and soon finished the whole pot of wine.
The large black dog immediately picked up the empty wine pot, and called out loudly, “Waiter, fill it up! Bring it up!”

This caused the other prodigies to feel extremely disdainful. You guys want to be shameless? This banquet was hosted by the Imperial Clan, and there was even the Imperial Son attending. Galaxy Network’s top hundred prodigies, as well as some Holy Lands’ Dao Child and Holy Daughter, who kept an extremely low profile yet were very powerful, were the only ones qualified to attend. How did the two of you gluttons appear?
“What are you looking at? I didn’t eat your food!” The large black dog glared back at him. Who was afraid of who?
It wasn’t long before an attendant came over and fetched a new pot of wine for Ling Han and the large black dog. He then brought the empty pot away with him.
However, with Ling Han and the large black dog’s shameless drinking, how long could this pot of wine last? Very soon, it was empty again.

“Waiter, serve the wine!” the large black dog called out again. Then, he said to Ling Han, “Little Han, Grandpa Dog tells you, why don’t you really become the son-in-law of the Donglin Imperial Clan? Then, we’ll have such fine wine to drink every day.”
When these words fell, not only did the members of the Donglin Imperial Clan all have dark expressions, all the prodigies present also wanted to kill it and make it into a dog meat feast.
Did he think that he could become the son-in-law of the Imperial Clan just because he wanted
to?
He was really too shameless!

“A horse really doesn’t know its face!” Someone humphed coldly. As his eyes swept over, a cold light actually flickered, exuding a terrifying aura, as if it wanted to crush the heavens. Ling Han stretched out a hand to parry. Pa, this cold light was destroyed by him, but his heart also clenched. This attack was extremely terrifying.
More importantly, the other party had only cast a glance, and the might was already so terrifying. His true strength was naturally even more extraordinary.
Ling Han turned to look at the person who had “moved”. That was a young man. Though he was seated in a cross-legged position, he was like a dragon that had hibernated. The moment
he moved, it would definitely shake the heavens and earth.
Who the hell was this guy?
“Haha, he is too arrogant. He has finally provoked the Baili Imperial Son into making a
move!” someone said.
The Baili Imperial Son?
Realization dawned on Ling Han. The Imperial Clan with the surname Baili was the
descendant of the Great Emperor Ziwei.

chapters.title: Chapter 4106: Imperial Son, Baili
paragraphs: Chapter 4106: Imperial Son, Baili

“That Ling Han or whatever, seeing our Imperial Son, come and kneel to pay your respects!” On the floating rock that belonged to the Baili Imperial Son, there were a total of three people, but only the Baili Imperial Son was seated, while the other two were standing.
However, the two people standing here also had terrifying auras. Vaguely, they could see Regulations undulating on their bodies, but they were clearly only in the Core Formation Tier.
What did this signify?
They had already touched the threshold of the True Self Tier, and could cross over at any time.

The reason why they didn’t break through was probably related to the opening of the True Dragon Abyss. That was because cultivators could only enter the area corresponding to their cultivation level. Thus, the early stage of the True Self Tier was definitely not as useful as the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
The large black dog flew into a thunderous rage. Someone actually dared to sneak attack him? Hehe, Grandpa Dog was the true ancestor of screwing people over!
It quietly took out the clay figure, then used its divine sense to lock onto Baili Imperial Son, and began to control him.

However, the large black dog immediately looked surprised. That was because no matter how he fiddled with the clay figure, the Baili Imperial Son was still seated normally, and did not move in the slightest.
Yi?

The large black dog refused to give up, and locked his divine sense onto the person who was shouting. Then, with a wave of his clay figurine, shua, that person sent out a palm strike towards the Baili Imperial Son.

If this was any other person, they would definitely be hit. Firstly, they would not be able to expect it at all, and secondly, the person who had attacked was also very powerful. Though he was a servant, his abilities were enough to rank in the top hundred of the Galaxy Network.
However, how could an Imperial Son be ordinary?
To be bestowed the title of Imperial Son, that symbolized an aptitude that was invincible among his peers.
The Baili Imperial Son stretched out a hand to grab the servant’s wrist.

The servant was so scared that his face had turned green. Hurriedly, he explained, “Young Master, I, I, I, I, it was not me!” All of a sudden, he did not know how to explain at all. That was because he clearly had not wanted to do that, but his hand still slapped out disobediently, as if he had been possessed.
The Baili Imperial Son nodded, “I know.”
His voice was filled with magnetism, as well as a powerful confidence that would make others believe in him. Even if the sky collapsed, he would still have a way to resolve it.
The servant instantly breathed a sigh of relief, and was also filled with gratitude.
But right at this moment, the other servant also delivered a slap, aimed directly at Baili Imperial Son.
The Baili Imperial Son moved again, his other hand gripping onto the wrist of the second
servant.
“Young, Young Master!” The second servant was also scared silly, his voice trembling.

This time, everyone could tell that something was off. If it was claimed that the first servant had had a moment of madness, that was still acceptable, but for two servants to be like this, that was really extremely strange.
Right at this moment, the first servant took advantage of the situation and collapsed, leaning into the arms of the Baili Imperial Son.
The large black dog giggled, and immediately changed his divine sense to lock onto his target. The other servant also fell “softly and powerlessly” into the arms of the Baili Imperial
Son.
‘F*ck!’
All of a sudden, everyone gritted their teeth. This was too blinding.

Though the Baili Imperial Son had a steady temperament, and could be claimed to not frown even if the heavens collapsed in front of his eyes, his whole body was covered with goosebumps now. Hurriedly, with a wave of his hands, peng, peng, the two servants were both sent flying.
“Hahaha!” The large black dog laughed loudly. He had finally vented his anger.

The Baili Imperial Son stood up. Boom, a terrifying aura surged out. He was really very strong. He was clearly only a Core Formation Tier martial artist, yet was exuding an aura that could shatter the heavens. Probably, he could advance into True Self Tier at any time.
“How dare you!” His baleful gaze was baleful as he looked at the large black dog.
The large black dog spread out his paws, “Why are you looking at Grandpa Dog like that? Grandpa Dog isn’t gay, so don’t have any inappropriate thoughts about Grandpa Dog!”
The destructive power of these words was too strong. It was practically enough to confirm the inappropriate love affair between the Baili Imperial Son and his two servants!

The Baili Imperial Son was unmoved. Being able to become the Imperial Son, not only did he have excellent natural talent, his temperament was naturally capable of withstanding the test as well. How could he easily lose control? He asked calmly, “You should have some kind of treasure on you that can control the actions of others, right?”
His deduction was accurate enough!

The large black dog naturally wouldn’t admit this, and he said, “I don’t know what you’re talking about. You’re clearly having lewd thoughts in public, and you want to do ‘that’ with your two servants. Yet, you’re trying to turn the tables around on me!”

“You must have used it on me before, but unfortunately, it is useless on me!” Yet the Baili Imperial Son was completely unconcerned about the large black dog’s nonsense, “Your knowledge is too shallow. The Imperial Son has a similar treasure on him, that can resist all negative effects.”

F***, no wonder it was ineffective against him. That must be a power of a Great Emperor. The large black dog’s expression remained unchanged, and he continued to shake his head in denial. In any case, he wouldn’t admit it unless he was caught red-handed.

break out.

When one had reached his height, ordinary beauties were completely beneath his notice. No matter how beautiful they were, it was useless. They would only be slightly higher level playthings. However, Chi Menghan was different. Not only was she beautiful, but her status and natural talent was not inferior to his either.
Thus, from the first moment he saw Chi Menghan, he was already certain that this was the best candidate for his dao partner.

“Are you seeking death?” he said balefully. Boom! A terrifying aura surged, as if raging
flames were burning.
The large black dog did not cower in the slightest. Limited by his cultivation level, though he was no match for the Imperial Son, didn’t he still have Ling Han?

“Hehe, your sore spot has been pierced, right?” The large black dog laughed, “This is not just Grandpa Dog spouting nonsense. Just now, the little girl from the Chi Clan called Grandpa Dog’s brother as brother-in-law. Everyone here heard clearly, right?”
Er, everyone remained silent, and decided not to get involved in this messy situation.

This battle prowess was truly terrifying.

The Imperial Son moved, and not only was he unsuccessful, he was even wounded.
This, how could he believe this?
“Ling Han… is truly heaven-defying!”
“Baili Che is a consummate level elite of the Core Formation Tier, and he is also the Imperial
Son. Yet, he was actually wounded by Ling Han. This is unbelievable!”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock. F***!

chapters.title: Chapter 4107: True Dragon Abyss opens
paragraphs: Chapter 4107: True Dragon Abyss opens
Who could believe such a result?

Baili Che, the Dao Child of the Ziwei Imperial Clan, was ranked second. The other was already in the Spiritual Transformation Tier. He would enter another area of the True Dragon Abyss and participate in the battle for fortune of the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Thus, from the point of view of Core Formation Tier, Baili Che should be top-notch. In this place, the only one that could rival him should be Chi Menghan.
However, Ling Han had wounded Baili Che with a single strike. He was even more impressive than the Imperial Son.

At this moment, everyone forgot to pursue the matter of the large black dog. What tricks had The used to make those two servants do such an eye-piercing thing? They were all paying attention to Ling Han.
At present, he could be considered the most popular guy. Would he be able to defeat even the Imperial Son?
He didn’t use formations, but his true strength.

“Good, very good.” Baili Che stated calmly. He raised his right hand, and there was a wound on the palm of his hand. Vaguely, the power of lightning could be seen boiling, but it could be seen that the power of lightning had been forcefully expelled, and then the wound began to rapidly heal.

“After so many years, there are already very few that can cause me injury,” he said. There was not the slightest bit of anger in his voice. Instead, there was a hint of admiration, “Then, as repayment for your kindness, I will use my strongest battle prowess, and crush you into dust.”

“Stop!” Chi Menghan leaped out. She stood in the air, and with a slight breeze, the hem of her dress fluttered. It was clearly just a plain white dress, but it made her look like she was wearing something that could enchant millions of people.
“Both of you, please give me some face,” she said calmly, but a terrifying aura surged out, ready to turn into a goddess of war at any time.
Baili Che hesitated slightly, then nodded, and said, “I naturally have to give Meng Han some face.”
Meanwhile, Ling Han made a judgement in his mind. Chi Menghan was stronger than this Baili Che.

True, Chi Menghan was the most outstanding successor of the Donglin Imperial Clan. She was known as the strongest Imperial Daughter in millions of years. If she was only comparable to an ordinary Imperial Son, then she would really be letting down the word “strongest”.
Ling Han smiled, and sat down.
“Little Han, when the True Dragon Abyss opens, let’s work together to kill him!” the large black dog communicated through divine sense.

“All right.” Ling Han nodded. He could tell that Baili Che bore killing intent towards him. This was completely baffling. It should be known that they had not met at all before, but because of Chi Menghan, Baili Che felt a strong killing intent towards him.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t explain and say that in reality, he wasn’t interested in Chi Menghan at all.
This was equivalent to taking the initiative to show weakness, and did not match his character at all. Furthermore, he did not owe Baili Che anything, so what need was there for him to explain?

The banquet continued. Because the True Dragon Abyss was about to open, the main theme of this banquet naturally revolved around this. Everyone had reached a preliminary agreement on alliance, and wanted to work together in the True Dragon Abyss to overcome the difficulties together.
It was said that the True Dragon Abyss was incredibly dangerous. Every time, only one tenth of the people who entered would be able to come out!
Moreover, no one could say why.
Because after exiting the True Dragon Abyss, the relevant memories would be severed, and would no longer exist.

Thus, regarding the True Dragon Abyss, there were no strategies to study and make preparations in advance. They could only form more alliances, and if they encountered danger, they could also help each other.

Overall, the banquet’s atmosphere was quite harmonious. This place was filled with Core Formation Tier elites, and after entering into the True Dragon Abyss, these people could be considered the strongest battle prowess.
At midnight, the banquet ended.
Ling Han and the large black dog were still unsatisfied. They had been drinking all this while. This was something very nutritious, so they naturally drank as much as they could.
The others were not as shameless as them, and now it was too late for regrets.
Baili Che left with his two servants. Before he left, he glanced at Ling Han, his eyes cold and filled with killing intent.
Ling Han only smiled faintly. So what if he was the Imperial Son? What did he have to fear now?

When they returned to their residence, Hu Niu hurriedly asked about what had happened at the banquet, and couldn’t help but pout. That little loli was really too shameless, to actually dare to help her sister snatch Niu’s Ling Han!

Ling Han wanted to hand the clay figurine over to the two women to use, but after some thought, with their present cultivation level of Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, even Galaxy Network’s number one Cauldron Forging Tier was far from being their match, and if they encountered Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter… the clay figurine would be ineffective. “Unfortunately, I should have asked Chi Menghan about this.” He felt slightly regretful. “Isn’t it the same to call that little loli out for questioning?” The large black dog came up with an idea, “Why don’t you just marry the two sisters, so that that little loli would not bring
disaster to others.”
“Get lost!”
Day after day passed, and more and more people came here. According to statistics, even at least seven Imperial Clans came, and there were people that Ling Han knew among them.

Lin Lang was the Imperial Son of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, ranked third. Previously, he had lost to Ling Han, and now, he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier. Furthermore, he had reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. The moment he arrived, he began to shout, wanting to fight another battle with Ling Han.
Ling Han completely ignored him. This kind of battle was completely meaningless. Was he going to fight for others’ entertainment?
A whole three months had passed, and that crack on the Heavenly Dragon Planet was getting larger and larger, already swallowing the whole planet.

Everyone had no choice but to leave the Heavenly Dragon Planet, and float in midair. As this rip expanded, there was a frightening power of heaven and earth and Regulations circulating within. Even Saints would feel fear, and not dare to oppose it.
Finally, not only did this rip swallow the entire Heavenly Dragon Planet, it even spread out into the galaxy, turning this galaxy into a massive rip, and even the sun was swallowed
within.
After the sunlight completely disappeared, a Saint spoke up, “The True Dragon Abyss has completely opened, and we can enter now.”
Instantly, everyone threw themselves into it.
Ling Han bid farewell to the empress and Hu Niu, reminding them to be careful.
“Don’t worry, Niu is very strong now!” Hu Niu raised her arm, making a strong gesture, “Niu
will protect this proud empress.” She pointed at the empress.
The empress swept a proud glance at her, but did not speak.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Let’s go.”
The three people and one dog also soared into the abyss.
As they flew, Ling Han discovered that the empress and Hu Niu had disappeared at some point
in time.
At different cultivation levels, they would enter the corresponding area, and definitely would
not be together.
Though Ling Han was a little worried, he was still filled with confidence in the strength of the
empress and Hu Niu. He pulled himself together, and using the Imminent Skyline, he sped up
with the large black dog.
This was a dark space, a complete void, and nothing could be seen.
Flying like this, flying for a whole half month’s time, light finally appeared ahead of them.
Yi!
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged looks, and saw that they had actually flown above
a great ocean. There was a sun hanging high in the skies, and it was unknown whether it was
the one that had been swallowed by the abyss previously. “Not good!” The man and dog both exclaimed in shock, their figures rapidly falling.

chapters.title: Chapter 4108: Apologize
paragraphs: Chapter 4108: Apologize
Tong! Tong!
Two splashes of water spread out, and Ling Han and the large black dog were seen to have both fallen into the great ocean.
“What’s going on?” the large black dog shouted. He was presently doing a dog paddle, floating in the sea.
Ling Han frowned and said, “The Regulations of heaven and earth here suddenly changed, preventing us from flying.”

They were still unable to cultivate the Regulations, but used the Regulations of heaven and earth at all times, but now that the Regulations of heaven and earth here had suddenly changed, they could no longer fly.
“Then if you want to fly, you would first have to get used to the Regulations of heaven and earth of this place,” the large black dog said.
Ling Han nodded, “But it is also possible that the Regulations here cannot allow flight at all.”
The large black dog was slightly gloomy, and he said, “After becoming accustomed to flying, it’s truly awkward to walk on two legs now.”
“Er, don’t you use four legs?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Woof, I’ll bite you to death!” The large black dog opened its mouth to bite Ling Han.
Ling Han clapped his hands on the surface of the water, and his whole person flew up. Then, his feet stepped on the surface of the sea, as he rapidly raced forwards.
The large black dog also jumped onto the water’s surface, continuing to chase after Ling Han.
Though they could not fly, the slight tension on the surface of the water was enough to support their running.
In this manner, after running for more than an hour, mainland appeared ahead of them.
No, this was a very large island.
Ling Han let out a sharp hiss. He had just returned from that strange sea of blood not too long ago, so why had he come to a similar place?
Thankfully, this was not the sea of blood. Otherwise, he would really be traumatized.
Speaking of which, why was there no follow-up to that matter?
Had the great Imperial Clans teamed up to venture into that sea of blood? Who was that mysterious red-haired beauty? And which Ancestral King had created this place?
He was slightly anticipating meeting Chi Menghan. She was the Imperial Daughter, so she should know a lot of secrets.
“Little Han, are you thinking about some woman?” the large black dog asked. “Hehe.”

“Don’t deny it. Just look at the expression on your face. If you’re thinking about a man now, Grandpa Dog will have to worry.” The largeblack dog paused, and said with a mischievous smile, “Is it that little girl from the Chi Clan?”
‘Fine, you’re smart.’
Ling Han ignored him. Otherwise, the large black dog would pursue him relentlessly, and there would be no end to it.
It wasn’t long before they reached the island.
“Let’s see if there are any natives here first,” Ling Han said.

As they spoke, a considerable number of people arrived on the island. Previously, when the True Dragon Abyss had opened, thousands of people had entered. Furthermore, there was no crossroads here. This island was the only destination.
Some people nodded at each other, while others revealed vicious expressions, their killing intent faintly discernible.

It should be known that after leaving this place, everyone’s memories would be erased, and they would not remember their encounters here. Thus, no matter what they did here, there was no need for them to have any reservations.
To say nothing of the fact that no one would remember, even they themselves would forget, and it would not leave behind any internal demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 4109: Killed with a Single Punch
paragraphs: Chapter 4109: Killed with a Single Punch
Yi, what was going on here?
The large black dog looked towards Ling Han, and communicated briefly through divine
sense.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. This hadn’t appeared during their previous tests.
“If it’s targeted at one person, there should be a time limit,” Ling Han said slowly after some thought.
The large black dog nodded in agreement. The clay figurine wasn’t a deadly weapon, and this was clear from the fact that it couldn’t control people to commit suicide. It was more like a toy.
“Sigh, this isn’t fun enough!” It couldn’t help but feel disappointed.
“That’s about enough. Can’t you see that he’s almost about to be killed by you?” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog snickered, looking extremely despicable.

On the other side, Liu Fang also discovered that the other’s control over himself had disappeared. This was very difficult to explain, but he knew that this kind of control would not appear again on him in the short term.
Instantly, his killing intent surged madly.

It should be known that he had originally come to seek out Ling Han and the large black dog for an accounting, but he had been tricked before he had even made a move. That was why he had the thought of fleeing.
But now that the control had disappeared, what was the point of running!
Revenge.

Furthermore, he still had to snatch that controlling treasure. That was a treasure, and with such a thing in hand, how could he possibly still be in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network? Instead, he would be the number one elite of the Core Formation Tier.
“The two of you!” Liu Fang walked over step by step, his expression cold, “How do you want to die?”
The large black dog shook his head, “Grandpa Dog is still alive and well, and has no intention of dying. What about you, Little Han?”
“Neither do I,” Ling Han said with a smile.

Seeing that this man and dog still dared to tease him at this moment, Liu Fang was naturally even more enraged. Boom, a terrifying aura surged out of his body. Vaguely, one could see divine light intertwining, flickering with multiple shattered seals.
He was at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and was just a sliver away from advancing into the True Self Tier.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖

For prodigies like this, after arriving at the end of the cultivation level of a major tier, they usually wouldn’t be in a rush to step out. Firstly, they wanted to stabilize themselves and cultivate their cultivation level to perfection. This was always easier than turning back later. Secondly, it was also for the sake of obtaining great opportunities, because there were too many ancient sites and Mystery Realms that had restrictions on cultivation level. Then, at the same cultivation level, such as the Core Formation Tier, how could early stage be compared with the consummate level?

Thus, Liu Fang actually could already advance into the True Self Tier. However, for the two reasons mentioned above, he stopped at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. After several decades of hard cultivation, his battle prowess was naturally tempered to an incredibly powerful level.
The large black dog immediately cowered, and said, “Little Han, you go.”
It was the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, so it was completely no match.

Seeing it cower, Liu Fang laughed loudly. This was the scene that he was most familiar with. With the move of a supreme prodigy ranked in the top hundred of the Galaxy Network, who wouldn’t be scared out of their wits?
“It doesn’t matter who attacks. You both will die!” he said balefully.
Ling Han shrugged, and said with a smile, “I don’t believe it.”
“You will soon believe me!” Liu Fang moved. Boom, endless power exploded, charging towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was unperturbed. He was presently communicating with the ley lines, but he shockingly discovered that these ley lines seemed to be sleeping, and did not listen to his commands at all.
He could no longer use the ability of formations?

Forget it, it wasn’t a big deal. In any case, this place had restrictions on cultivation level, and only those at the Core Formation Tier could enter, and among those at the Core Formation Tier, it was possible that he still wouldn’t be able to defeat an Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter, who were limited in number, but it was also impossible to wound or even kill him. “Die!” Liu Fang had already charged over, and delivered a palm strike directly at the top of Ling Han’s head, intending to shatter his mind in a single stroke.

He didn’t hate Ling Han that much, so he only wanted to kill Ling Han. However, it was a completely different story for the large black dog. He would capture this despicable dog first, then slowly torture him to death.
Only then did Ling Han move, aiming for Liu Fang’s throat.

It was clear that his attack was going to be slow, but this attack had started later, yet reached first. Under Liu Fang’s incredibly stunned gaze, he felt his throat tighten. He had already been detained by Ling Han.
This, what kind of gap in strength was this?
No, no, no. He must still be under the control of that mysterious treasure. Otherwise, how could he possibly be so fragile, that he could not even withstand a single move from the
other?

Ling Han did not hesitate at all. He directly exerted force with his five fingers, and then with a twist, Liu Fang’s neck was forcefully broken, and under the barrage of Destructive Energy, Liu Fang’s mind was also forcefully destroyed. He did not even have the chance to burn the Celestial Core to extend his life.
Pa, Liu Fang collapsed onto the ground. His eyes were still wide open, completely in disbelief.
He was the Dao Child of the Azure Snow Holy Land, a supreme prodigy ranked in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network, so how had he died in such an unclear manner?
However, he was already dead, and everything had become meaningless.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned. Putting aside the fact that this was one of the top hundred on the Galaxy Network, he had even killed a Buddha Son, so how could he possibly be
concerned?
“Old Black, let’s go.”
“All right.”
The large black dog first searched Liu Fang’s body, and after taking away the Spatial Spirit Tool, he giggled and followed in Ling Han’s footsteps.
The people in the surroundings watched, all stunned and solemn.
Ling Han was indeed as powerful as the legends said. He had killed Liu Fang, who was ranked
in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network, with a single move, and he had killed him just like that. This was also a reminder to everyone that this was the True Dragon Abyss, which was
incredibly cruel.
In any case, everyone’s memories would be erased after they left. No matter how outstanding
a prodigy was, they would only be able to vaguely remember a little bit of things. Thus, in this place, everyone could release the desires in their hearts, and do things that they would not
dare to do normally.
There were no moral restrictions here, nor were there any threats from clansmen or masters. It was completely dependent on one’s abilities. If one was strong enough, he could do as he
liked.

Ling Han and the large black dog walked for a while, and they discovered a town. It was not very big, and only had over a thousand houses. The number of townspeople could not possibly exceed ten thousand, at most.
They asked around, but they didn’t expect the townspeople here to be so cordial, not rejecting outsiders like them at all. They said whatever they wanted, not hiding anything at all.
This place was called the Start Point Town.
From here, after passing through nine islands, one would be able to reach the Finishing Point
Town.

However, this wasn’t something that could be accomplished just by running from the Start Point Town to the Finishing Point Town. One definitely had to pass through the nine islands, and they also had to take a legendary fragment from each island. The nine fragments could be combined into a key to open the door to the Finishing Point Town.
Moreover, if one wanted to cross the sea, they would have to use a ship. The crew of each ship could form a team, and this was a team-based way of traversing the sea.
In other words, a team could share a key.
This was not a benefit, but rather a rigid rule. Furthermore, the size of the team had to be as

many as five people, and at most, it could not exceed ten people. If this requirement was not met, the residents of the Nine Islands would not give up the legendary fragment. Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged looks. Which guy had come up with this? He was
really too good at torturing people, wasn’t he?
“Then, the first step is to first form a team?” the large black dog asked.
“We can only do that,” Ling Han said with a nod.
“Who are we looking for?”
“Let’s wait and see. I’m sure everyone will come to this town.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4110: Finding Team Members
paragraphs: Chapter 4110: Finding Team Members
Sure enough, this was the only town on the island. Thus, most people would treat this place as their first stop.
Of course, there were also some impatient people who directly crossed the sea.

According to the people of Start Point Town, this wouldn’t work. There were incredibly terrifying wild beasts in the sea, and they could easily capsize large ships. Eating humans would be a piece of cake.
Not long after, Ling Han saw one of the team members that he was looking for.
“Sister-in-law!” The large black dog was the first to call out, and charged out enthusiastically.
Chi Menghan arrived.
This Imperial Daughter wasn’t alone. There was another man beside her, and just standing there, it was as if the space itself couldn’t bear his strength and was trembling.
Baili Che!
Of course, there was also a silver-haired little lolita. It was Chi Mengshan.

This little girl’s natural talent in martial arts was really amazing. She was obviously only in her teens, but she was already in the early stage of Core Formation Tier. As expected of the Imperial Clan’s bloodline.
Aside from that, the two servants of Baili Che were also present.

“Grandpa Dog is talking to sister-in-law, so why are you interrupting?” The large black dog didn’t back down in the slightest.

“How dare you!” The two servants immediately charged out, pouncing towards the large black dog.

Peng, peng, peng! The two servants began fighting with each other, one would throw a punch and the other would counter with a kick, and the battle was incredibly intense.

How could the large black dog be willing to do that? He was the type to screw others over. If a treasure fell into his hands, there would basically be no returning the treasure. How could he be willing to lend a treasure to another?
It hurriedly put away the clay figure, looking very careful, fearing that Chi Mengshan would snatch it from it.
With this control gone, the two servants instantly fell to the ground, panting endlessly.
“Stingy!” Chi Mengshan humphed, and pouted.

Peng!

Boom!

Next, were they going to compete with this kind of prodigy?
A great many people shook their heads. How could there possibly be any hope of victory?
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Thus, though the battle was fierce, it was actually very boring. It was a situation wherein neither one could hurt the other.
