good idea.
He stood still, his eyes slightly dark. As the Imperial Son, there was actually someone that he could not kill, which made him extremely displeased.
“Little girl, are you interested in forming a team with us?” The large black dog was already
trying to bewitch her. His target was Chi Mengshan. As long as the little girl agreed, would Chi
Menghan be able to escape?
This was the Imperial Daughter, and her battle prowess was incredibly terrifying. It was definitely best for her to be a teammate.
“You let me play with the clay figurine!” The silver-haired little lolita took the chance to
bargain.
A pained expression instantly appeared on the large black dog’s face. He was afraid that if it would be like throwing a meat bun at a dog, er, pei, he had spoken wrongly.
Ling Han smiled, and said to Chi Menghan, “There’s a need to form teams to compete here. One team needs at least five people. How about it? If we form a team, we need only one more
person to have a full team.”
W-what?
Baili Che’s eyes involuntarily turned cold. One more person?
‘You actually didn’t take me into account?’
Humph, but would Chi Menghan agree?
You are only an unorthodox cultivator, so how could the Imperial Daughter possibly fall for
you!
Baili Che was filled with confidence. Though Ling Han was indeed freakish, his background was too poor, and no matter how hard he tried, he could not compare to him.
Chi Menghan pondered for a moment before replying, “Sure.”
Pu!
Baili Che instantly spluttered. Hey, hey, hey, you are the Imperial Daughter, and you actually
teamed up with such lowly commoners?
“Sister, you’re too unfriendly!” Chi Mengshan was extremely displeased, and said, “I was just
about to scam them out of the clay figurine, yet now that you’ve agreed, this damn dog is
acting shameless again.”
Meanwhile, the large black dog was greatly shocked. This little loli was indeed trying to cheat him out of his treasure. He really couldn’t underestimate her. She was clearly so innocent and
cute.
“Menghan!” Baili Che hurriedly spoke up, “Let’s form a team, and there just happen to be five
of us.”
Chi Menghan smiled faintly at him, and said, “Brother Baili, please refer to me by my full name. I’m not that familiar with you!”
With these words, Baili Che’s expression instantly darkened. In fact, a hint of malevolence
even appeared on his face.

paragraphs: Chapter 4111: Team Completed
Chi Menghan would give Baili Che some face. After all, Baili Che was from the Ziwei Imperial Clan
However, she didn’t have any desires for Baili Che, so if she didn’t have any desires, she was naturally firm. There was absolutely no need for her to feel aggrieved for his sake.

From her point of view, the help that Ling Han could give her was superior to Baili Che. Furthermore, they had fought side by side before, so how could the friendship that they had cultivated in battle be something that Baili Che could catch up to with just a few words of flattery from him?

Baili Che’s expression was livid. He very much wanted to step out and fight, but just Ling Han alone was enough to give him a headache, what more when there was Chi Menghan whose battle prowess was superior to his?
That would really be seeking his own humiliation.
Fine, there was still a chance anyways. He would definitely kill Ling Han.

After leaving this place, everyone’s memories would be erased. Even top-notch prodigies would only retain a vague memory. Thus, he had absolutely no need to worry about offending Chi Menghan. After leaving this place, he would just have to come back again.
“Celestial maiden Chi, I hope you won’t regret this!” he said with a humph. With a wave of his hand, he left with his two servants.

It would take at least five people to form a team here, so he had to recruit people first. Moreover, since they were participating in the competition as a team, there was definitely a need to be particular. Thus, the team members had to be carefully selected. They could not be careless.
“All right. Find another person, and we can set out.”
Ling Han had the large black dog go buy a ship, while he and Chi Menghan and her sister stayed behind to continue recruiting people.
“Senior Brother Ling!” A voice filled with pleasant surprise rang out, and a dazzling beauty was presently walking towards them.
This woman was truly beautiful. Grace filled her every step, and could drive anyone crazy.
Song Lan, the seductive beauty ranked ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard.
Ling Han smiled and said, “You also came.”
“That’s right.” Song Lan nodded, her smile blossoming like a flower.

With how exquisitely beautiful she was, how could she possibly be alone? For example, Lu Qi had always been by her side, as well as some other suitors. She was the ninth most beautiful woman in the galaxy, and even an Imperial Son would be moved by her.
However, seeing their beloved goddess show such a dazzling smile to another man, this caused everyone to feel incredibly hurt.
Damn it!

Lu Qi clenched his fists tightly, wanting nothing more than to move and kill Ling Han. However, he naturally knew that he was no match for Ling Han. That guy was a freak. To say nothing of him, even an Imperial Son could not possibly deal with him.
Needless to say, he was still very self-aware. Just now, there was an Imperial Son that had been forced to retreat.
Chi Mengshan leaned close to her sister’s ear, and said, “Sister, you have a rival now. Hurry up and sleep with Brother-in-law, or else Brother-in-law will be snatched away!”
This little lolita simply wished for the whole world to be in chaos. These words were not lowered in the slightest, so everyone in the surroundings could hear them clearly.

Chi Menghan was indeed so furious that she wanted to beat someone up. Song Lan’s pretty face was also flushed red, and Lu Qi and the others were all glaring at her in anger. Who was this little girl? Did she know how to talk properly?
Chi Mengshan wasn’t afraid of anyone, and she glared back at them, asking, “What’s wrong? Do you want to fight?”

Seeing that a few people had taken a step forwards, the little loli immediately pounced towards Ling Han, “Brother-in-law, save me. Someone is trying to harm the cute, beautiful and enchanting Mengshan!”
Everyone was speechless. You call yourself cute? Little devil!
“Senior Brother Ling, are you still short of people in your team?” Song Lan asked.

Ling Han didn’t mind this. Combined with Chi Menghan, he should be able to sweep aside all opposition, right? He nodded, then looked at Chi Menghan, and said, “I have no objections. What do you think?”
“Sister, don’t agree. This is a love rival!” Chi Mengshan hurriedly said from the sidelines.

Chi Menghan didn’t know Song Lan very well. At first, she could have refused, but after hearing her sister’s words, it wasn’t appropriate for her to refuse. Otherwise, wouldn’t this really become the rejection towards a love rival?
“Sure,” Chi Menghan said with a smile. “I’ve also admired Little Sister Song for a long time.”
Speaking of which, the two women were both ranked in the top ten of the Exquisite Leaderboard, though they had never met before.
‘F*ck! It was settled!’
When Lu Qiand the others saw this, it was as if a bottle of mixed feelings had been knocked over in their hearts. They were all feeling very depressed.
Ling Han looked towards Lu Qi and showed a hint of killing intent, “Were you the one who hired the assassin from Battle God Palace?”

“How could that be!” Lu Qi immediately shook his head. “Ling Han, I’m not afraid of you. However, as the disciple of a Holy Land, how could I possibly be related to the notorious assassin organization?”
Ling Han’s expression became serious, “You dare to insult me?”
Yi, what are you talking about? Why don’t I understand?
Lu Qi’s mouth was half-gaping. ‘Where did this come from? You’re taking things a bit too far, aren’t you?’
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I forgot to mention that I’m also a seed of the Battle God Palace.”
‘Go!’
Lu Qi was stupefied. What was going on here? Was Ling Han Ling Han a seed of the Battle God Palace? Then why did the Battle God Palace insist on killing him? No, Ling Han was definitely
lying to him!
“You don’t believe me?” Ling Han took a step forwards, yet suddenly disappeared.
Strange Shadow Steps!

Chi Menghan clearly knew what was what, and immediately looked stunned. At the same time, she also felt a sense of foreboding. Could it be that Ling Han was really a disciple of the Battle God Palace?
That would be terrifying. Ling Han was too freakish. Once he became the Killing Saint, in an era when there were no Emperors in the world, would there still be anyone that he could not
assassinate?
At that time, all of the Saints would probably be unable to sleep well.
“Yi, why has Brother-in-law suddenly disappeared?” Chi Mengshan’s expression was filled
with curiosity.
Xiu! Ling Han suddenly appeared, throwing a punch at Lu Qi’s face.
He had disappeared without a trace just now, but this punch had been delivered upfront, and there was no intention of being secretive.

From the moment Ling Han suddenly disappeared, Lu Qi was already prepared. However, he still hadn’t realized and expected that Ling Han would actually attack him directly from the front. F***, since you want to attack head-on, why use that strange movement technique? That would be too much of a waste.
As he mocked in his mind, he hurriedly threw a punch to greet Ling Han’s attack.
However, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han now?
Peng, his hand was forcefully broken, and the power of Ling Han’s punch did not decrease at
all. His punch landed solidly, and his head directly exploded.
Ling Han withdrew his fist. Wrapped in mystical power, there wasn’t a single trace of blood on
his hand.
Lu Qi wanted to kill him time and time again, and he had long since become impatient. It was just that he had never had the chance to do so. He couldn’t kill someone in the Nine Suns Holy
Land, right?
Thus, since he had encountered him here, Ling Han had no intention of leaving this bringer of
calamity alive.

Seeing how decisive Ling Han was, the people in the surroundings were all shocked. They did not know that there was already a grudge between Ling Han and Lu Qi, and thought that it was Ling Han that wanted to eliminate Song Lan’s courters. Immediately, they all fled in a panic. Though a beauty was good, in the end, she could not compare to one’s own life.
Right at this moment, the large black dog returned.
“Little Han, forming a team requires everyone to go together, and only after forming a team
can you buy a ship.”
Yi, there was actually such a setting?
Ling Han nodded, “All right, then let’s go.”
The four people and one dog set out, heading towards the harbor.

They were all feeling very depressed.
Ling Han looked towards Lu Qi and showed a hint of killing intent, “Were you the one who hired the assassin from Battle God Palace?”
“How could that be!” Lu Qi immediately shook his head.
“Ling Han, I’m not afraid of you.
However, as the disciple of a Holy Land, how could I possibly be related to the notorious assassin organization?”
Ling Han’s expression became serious, “You dare to insult me?”
Yi, what are you talking about?
Why don’t I understand?
Lu Qi’s mouth was half-gaping. ‘Where did this come from?
You’re taking things a bit too far, aren’t you?’
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I forgot to mention that I’m also a seed of the Battle God Palace.”
‘Go!’
Lu Qi was stupefied.
What was going on here?
Was Ling Han Ling Han a seed of the Battle God Palace?
Then why did the Battle God Palace insist on killing him?
No, Ling Han was definitely
lying to him!
“You don’t believe me?” Ling Han took a step forwards, yet suddenly disappeared.
Strange Shadow Steps!
Chi Menghan clearly knew what was what, and immediately looked stunned.
At the same time, she also felt a sense of foreboding.
Could it be that Ling Han was really a disciple of the Battle God Palace?
That would be terrifying.
Ling Han was too freakish.
Once he became the Killing Saint, in an era when there were no Emperors in the world, would there still be anyone that he could not
assassinate?
At that time, all of the Saints would probably be unable to sleep well.
“Yi, why has Brother-in-law suddenly disappeared?” Chi Mengshan’s expression was filled
with curiosity.
Xiu!
Ling Han suddenly appeared, throwing a punch at Lu Qi’s face.
He had disappeared without a trace just now, but this punch had been delivered upfront, and there was no intention of being secretive.
From the moment Ling Han suddenly disappeared, Lu Qi was already prepared.
However, he still hadn’t realized and expected that Ling Han would actually attack him directly from the front.
F***, since you want to attack head-on, why use that strange movement technique?
That would be too much of a waste.
As he mocked in his mind, he hurriedly threw a punch to greet Ling Han’s attack.
However, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han now?
Peng, his hand was forcefully broken, and the power of Ling Han’s punch did not decrease at
all.
His punch landed solidly, and his head directly exploded.
Ling Han withdrew his fist.
Wrapped in mystical power, there wasn’t a single trace of blood on
his hand.
Lu Qi wanted to kill him time and time again, and he had long since become impatient.
It was just that he had never had the chance to do so.
He couldn’t kill someone in the Nine Suns Holy
Land, right?
Thus, since he had encountered him here, Ling Han had no intention of leaving this bringer of
calamity alive.
Seeing how decisive Ling Han was, the people in the surroundings were all shocked.
They did not know that there was already a grudge between Ling Han and Lu Qi, and thought that it was Ling Han that wanted to eliminate Song Lan’s courters.
Immediately, they all fled in a panic.
Though a beauty was good, in the end, she could not compare to one’s own life.
Right at this moment, the large black dog returned.
“Little Han, forming a team requires everyone to go together, and only after forming a team
can you buy a ship.”
Yi, there was actually such a setting?
Ling Han nodded, “All right, then let’s go.”
The four people and one dog set out, heading towards the harbor.

chapters.title: Chapter 4112: Setting out to sea
paragraphs: Chapter 4112: Setting out to sea
The four people and one dog arrived at the harbor. There was a special place here that was responsible for establishing teams and selling ships.
If one wanted to disobey the rules and forcibly mess around?

Hehe, there was no shortage of True Self Tier elites here, and there were presently a few bloody corpses hanging at the entrance. Obviously, they wanted to seize a ship by force, and in the end, were killed on the spot.

“You guys want to form a team?” an old geezer asked, coughing as if he had a serious illness. However, Ling Han and the others didn’t dare to underestimate the old geezer at all. He was a True Self Tier elite.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
“One, two, three, four.” The old geezer counted, “There’s one less person.”
“Hey, hey, Grandpa Dog is here too!” The large black dog stood up on his hind legs, his expression filled with anger.
He was bullying a dog too much, to actually ignore him.
Ling Han and the others couldn’t help but smile. Chi Mengshan laughed loudly.

“Oh, and there’s also a dog.” The old geezer nodded, and tapped his finger on each of the five of them. Then, he took out a piece of paper, pressed on it, and handed it to Ling Han. “All right, the team is established.”
“Take good care of this piece of paper. This is the proof for your team. Every time you reach an island, you have to show it. Otherwise, you will not be able to dock at the island.”
“Alright.” Ling Han put the piece of paper away.

“You guys can go buy a ship. Remember to show your proof.” The old geezer waved his hand, indicating that they could leave. There were already teams coming to get their certificates. He was very busy.
Ling Han and the others left. What a coincidence. The moment they left, they encountered Baili Che… as well as Lin Lang!
Lin Lang was the Imperial Son of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan. He had once been defeated by Ling Han.
Seeing Ling Han, Lin Lang immediately revealed a baleful expression, his killing intent blazing.
However, no one dared to make a move here. There was a True Self Tier elite standing guard on the sidelines.
Thus, whether it was Baili Che and Lin Lang, they both watched as Ling Han and the others left.
“Brother Lin, do you have a grudge against Ling Han?” Baili Che asked.
This was a sore point for Lin Lang. He was an Imperial Son, and he had actually lost. No matter what, he was unwilling to speak of this. Thus, he only humphed, killing intent circulating in his eyes.
“Hehe, then Brother Lin, we can be considered to be of the same mind,” Baili Che said with a smile.

Lin Lang’s eyes lit up. Though he was already in the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han was also growing. He did not have the slightest confidence that he could defeat Ling Han, but added with Baili Che… with the combined forces of two Imperial Sons, how could it be that there was an opponent that they could not kill?
“All right!” He too broke into a smile.
Ling Han and the others went to buy a ship. This cost them a hundred Dao Stones, but this ship… could this even be called a ship? It was practically a small boat, all right?

“Young man, this is only Start Point Town, so we will only give you this kind of ship. However, you can get better ships on the island ahead of you, and that will depend on your abilities.” The person-in-charge here laughed loudly.
“However, don’t underestimate this ship either. It’s made of special wood that can conceal your aura and prevent the sea beasts from discovering you.”
“So, as long as you don’t seek death and insist on swimming in the sea, I guarantee that you can safely reach the next island.”
Ling Han and the others were speechless. ‘You’re in the True Self Tier, so whatever you say.’
They boarded the small boat. Ling Han and the large black dog were in charge of steering the oars, and began their journey.

The sea was completely calm. In fact, even the surface of the sea was like a mirror, without the slightest ripple. Only the two oars that Ling Han and the large black dog had raised would cause ripples.
“It’s so quiet!” Song Lan stretched lazily. Her perfect figure revealed her captivating curves in this action, causing one’s heart to beat wildly.
“Sister, this opponent of yours is very powerful. This kind of careless little action is the most attractive to men,” Chi Mengshan said in an experienced manner.

Chi Menghan’s expression darkened, and Song Lan’s pretty face also flushed red. She could swear on the heaven and earth, she really hadn’t been deliberately seducing Ling Han. Indeed, she had only been touched by the scene.
“Shut up. If you don’t speak, no one will think you’re mute.” Chi Menghan couldn’t help but want to violently suppress this mischievous brat. She kept saying embarrassing things.
“Oh, that’s right. Did you guys go to that sea of blood again?” Ling Han asked. He had always been very curious about the rest of this matter.

Chi Menghan nodded, “Yes, but no matter how many Saints and Imperial Weapons enter, it would be useless. It is like a Mystery Realm in the heaven and earth, and even Imperial Weapons can’t suppress it.”
Ling Han inhaled sharply. Even the Imperial Weapon couldn’t suppress it?

The awakening of the Imperial Weapon was equivalent to the awakening of an Ancestral King. Was there anything in the world that the Ancestral King couldn’t deal with? This was especially the case since a great many Imperial Clans had brought the Imperial Weapon with
them this time.
Hiss.

He suddenly recalled Brother Monkey’s ancestor, the Battle Saint Emperor and Ancestral King Lingtian. They had all gone to the edge of the universe to search for the secret of immortality. It was said that it was also extremely dangerous. Even the Ancestral King brought the Imperial Weapon with him.
Could it be that this sea of blood was a similar desolate land?
However, in such a dangerous place, there was also a red-haired beauty, who seemed to be sleeping. This was too strange.
Ling Han was extremely curious, and really wanted to investigate further.
“Brother Ling, can I take a look at that clay figurine?” Chi Menghan asked.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, then looked towards the large black dog.
The large black dog was instantly reluctant, but he still took out the clay figurine and handed
it to Chi Menghan as he said, “You definitely have to return it!”
Chi Menghan was rendered speechless. Just how stingy was this damn dog?
Chi Mengshan made a face, and said, “We’re not returning it!”
“You haven’t even married yet, and you’re already asking for a dowry,” the large black dog
mumbled.
“What did you say?” Chi Menghan asked with a smile. However, everyone could clearly hear the killing intent in her voice.
The large black dog hurriedly smiled, and did not continue to act despicable.
Chi Menghan began to fiddle with the clay figurine with a focused expression. Of course, her
face was now covered by a white veil, so no one could see her.
“How is it? Can you tell where it comes from?” Ling Han asked.

“This must have been created by the Ancestral King,” Chi Menghan said. “Only when one has reached the level of the Ancestral King, would they be able to change the Regulations of heaven and earth. Thus, controlling the clay figurine allows one to control others.”
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged a look, and both of them broke into a smile. They had really picked up this bargain too easily.
“According to Baili Che, Imperial Sons all have protective treasures that can resist all negative effects?” Ling Han asked.

“That’s right.” Chi Menghuan nodded, “This is all created by the Ancestral King. In truth, it is used to resist the invasion on the level of the soul, but there is a limited number, so it can only be armed on Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters. When Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters mature, it will be passed down.”
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’. So that was how it was.
In that case, wouldn’t the murderous aura attack be ineffective when he faced off against Baili Che? And then there was the suppression effects of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. He would
also be immune to this?
How would he know if he didn’t try?
Ling Han smiled, and said to Chi Menghan, “Beauty Chi, can you do a test for me?”
Chi Menghan rolled her eyes. This guy was really shooting his mouth off, but she just couldn’t
get angry. Strange!

chapters.title: Chapter 4113: Giant Island
paragraphs: Chapter 4113: Giant Island
Ling Han used Chi Menghan as a test, naturally to see if the murderous aura attack and the Primal Chaos Celestial Core were effective.
First, the murderous aura attacked.
In the end… it was ineffective.
Though this was within Ling Han’s expectations, after confirming it, he was still slightly disappointed.
Sigh, he had lost a powerful ultimate move.
Thankfully, he had tested it in advance. Otherwise, if he had made an error in estimation in actual battle, that would be fatal.
Secondly, the suppresion from the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
This, was effective!
What? This could actually take effect through a Great Emperor Tier-level treasure?
Neither Ling Han nor Chi Menghan had expected this, and they both looked surprised.
“Brother Ling, what kind of ability is this?” Chi Menghan asked in surprise. “Is this a Mystical Power that you were born with?”

Ling Han hesitated slightly. However, since she hadn’t lied to him, he couldn’t bring himself to deliberately deceive her. Moreover, even if he revealed all his secrets now, so what? After they left, their relevant memories would be erased.
“This is the ability of the only Celestial Cauldron after creating the Fusion Cauldron,” he said. “After advancing into the Core Formation Tier, the Celestial Core also inherited this trait.”
“Yi?” Chi Menghan looked surprised.

“Brother-in-law, I’m also a Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, so why can’t I?” Chi Mengshan said from the sidelines. This kind of ability was exciting just thinking about it. It could directly reduce your opponent’s battle prowess by three Heavens, and make others die of depression.
Because she was too curious, Chi Menghan didn’t snipe her sister this time. Instead, she simply stared at Ling Han.
On the sidelines, Song Lan was also very curious, and watched very closely.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate. Since he had already decided to say it, there was nothing for him to hesitate about. “I’m not a Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, but Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron!”
Instantly, a dead silence fell over the small raft.
“I’m rolling, rolling! I don’t need an oar to row my boat, I’m completely relying on waves!” the large black dog sang in a gong-like voice.
The three women all came back to their senses, their faces filled with disbelief.
“How is that possible!” Chi Menghan was the first to speak, “Nine Cauldrons is the limit. How did you manage to reach Ten Cauldrons?”
She was a member of the Imperial Clan, so she knew many secrets. It was because of this that she couldn’t believe it.
Ten Cauldrons, how was this possible!
“That’s right. Nine is the pinnacle of heaven and earth. How can one surpass Nine Cauldrons?” Chi Mengshan also said.
Ling Han smiled, “Perhaps it is precisely because of this that the Celestial Cauldron has gained a special ability after shattering the extreme number of heaven and earth.”
This time, Chi Menghan and her sister were rendered speechless.
That’s right. They were all Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, so why couldn’t they be like Ling Han?

Casting one’s gaze around the world, though there were very few Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, as long as one was an Imperial Son onImperial Daughter, Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron was basically standard, but Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron?
This was unheard of!
Chi Menghan looked at Ling Han. She raised her evaluation of this young prodigy who she had initially thought highly of.

This guy would at least be a saint in future, and an incredibly powerful Saint at that. If there was still no Emperor in this world, then he would be enough to sweep aside all opposition in this world.

Of course, becoming Emperor was too difficult. Not only did it require great intelligence, great opportunities, great comprehension, it also required great fortune. Throughout history, how many Ancestral Kings had appeared in total?

Meanwhile, Song Lan’s eyes were shining. She knew that Ling Han was very impressive, but he had actually managed to achieve Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, which naturally filled her with even more admiration. She had completely become Ling Han’s fangirl.
“Sister, you saw it, didn’t you!” Chi Mengshan said in a serious tone. “Hurry up and make your move! Settle things once and for all! Otherwise, you’ll regret it in the future.”
This damn girl.
Chi Menghan’s pretty face was flushed red. Finally, she could no longer be trifled with. She picked up this mischievous brat and gave her a few knocks on the head.
“Wa!” Chi Mengshan grabbed her head and wailed, “You can’t hit my head. If I become stupid, can you afford the compensation?”
Amidst this banter, time passed very quickly. Two days later, an island appeared ahead of them.

It was very strange. They clearly didn’t know the location, and there was no wind on the sea. They were just rowing around randomly, yet they still found the first island. If this was a coincidence, en, they were really bursting with luck.
“Strange!”
They steered the ship to reach the coast, but there were cliffs everywhere. Thus, they circled around the island, and soon discovered a harbor.
Heavens, this harbor was really too big, wasn’t it?

Ling Han and the others all looked stunned. This kind of size wasn’t in terms of capacity. For example, a small harbor could only hold 20 ships, while a hundred ships could be docked here. Instead, it was in terms of size.
A colossal ship, a colossal house, and… a colossal person!
This was a nation of giants, and each person was at least 30 meters tall. In front of such an existence, Ling Han and the others might not be as insignificant as ants, but they were really
too unnoticeable.

They found a spot to dock their ship, but tragically discovered that their ship was too small, and even the ropes were not long enough. Wrapping the rope around that thick pole, the rope could only be wrapped half around it, and could not be tied at all.
Er, this was very awkward.
“Haha, here comes another dwarf.”
Peng, peng, peng! Heavy footsteps were heard, and a giant walked over. However, his face was all smiles, and he did not look fierce, and this “dwarf” obviously did not have any derogatory meaning.
“Where is your proof?” He stretched out a hand, and directly grabbed the small boat from the
sea, placing it on the covered bridge.
Fine then.
Ling Han and the others all jumped down from the ship. Meanwhile, Ling Han handed over his
proof.
“All of you, each of you stretch out your hand and press down on the piece of paper,” the giant said, using the tips of his finger to pinch the piece of paper.
Ling Han, the others, and the dog all stretched out their hands and paw, and touched the paper. With every touch, there would be a flicker of light on the paper, as if it was proving
their identities.
“It’s done.” The giant returned the proof to Ling Han, “Follow me.”
He walked forwards, and every step he took covered a few meters. Ling Han and the others hurriedly followed. Thankfully, though they were small in stature,
their abilities were extremely strong. It was completely no problem for them to keep up with
the other’s pace.
They continued to walk. After exiting the harbor, the giant started to speed up. Peng, peng, peng! The ground trembled violently.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Ling Han and the others also used movement techniques to catch up. In terms of speed, they
were not inferior at all.
“This giant didn’t cultivate any cultivation techniques. Instead, he simply relied on his physical power to run,” Chi Menghan said through divine sense.

This was terrifying. It was only brute force, yet it could reach such a level, and for brute force to be so powerful, it must be accompanied by another effect, and that was the physique of this giant must be incredibly strong. Otherwise, it would not be able to withstand that kind of power. With a single punch, it would directly cause bones to break, flesh to explode.
After following the giant for a while, a massive fortress was already in sight ahead of them.
The castle that the giants lived in was naturally a fortress of giants. It was probably more than ten times larger than the normal size.
They entered into the fortress, and the giant that had brought them here turned around and left. He had absolutely no intention of giving them an explanation, and was not the slightest
bit responsible.
Alright, then they’ll go and find out the situation themselves.
Ling Han and the others roamed around the fortress, and soon found out about the situation.

I don’t need an oar to row my boat, I’m completely relying on waves!” the large black dog sang in a gong-like voice.
The three women all came back to their senses, their faces filled with disbelief.
“How is that possible!” Chi Menghan was the first to speak, “Nine Cauldrons is the limit.
How did you manage to reach Ten Cauldrons?”
She was a member of the Imperial Clan, so she knew many secrets.
It was because of this that she couldn’t believe it.
Ten Cauldrons, how was this possible!
“That’s right.
Nine is the pinnacle of heaven and earth.
How can one surpass Nine Cauldrons?” Chi Mengshan also said.
Ling Han smiled, “Perhaps it is precisely because of this that the Celestial Cauldron has gained a special ability after shattering the extreme number of heaven and earth.”
This time, Chi Menghan and her sister were rendered speechless.
That’s right.
They were all Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, so why couldn’t they be like Ling Han?

Casting one’s gaze around the world, though there were very few Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, as long as one was an Imperial Son onImperial Daughter, Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron was basically standard, but Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron?
This was unheard of!
Chi Menghan looked at Ling Han.
She raised her evaluation of this young prodigy who she had initially thought highly of.
This guy would at least be a saint in future, and an incredibly powerful Saint at that.
If there was still no Emperor in this world, then he would be enough to sweep aside all opposition in this world.
Of course, becoming Emperor was too difficult.
Not only did it require great intelligence, great opportunities, great comprehension, it also required great fortune.
Throughout history, how many Ancestral Kings had appeared in total?
Meanwhile, Song Lan’s eyes were shining.
She knew that Ling Han was very impressive, but he had actually managed to achieve Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron, which naturally filled her with even more admiration.
She had completely become Ling Han’s fangirl.
“Sister, you saw it, didn’t you!” Chi Mengshan said in a serious tone.
“Hurry up and make your move!
Settle things once and for all!
Otherwise, you’ll regret it in the future.”
This damn girl.
Chi Menghan’s pretty face was flushed red.
Finally, she could no longer be trifled with.
She picked up this mischievous brat and gave her a few knocks on the head.
“Wa!” Chi Mengshan grabbed her head and wailed, “You can’t hit my head.
If I become stupid, can you afford the compensation?”
Amidst this banter, time passed very quickly.
Two days later, an island appeared ahead of them.
It was very strange.
They clearly didn’t know the location, and there was no wind on the sea.
They were just rowing around randomly, yet they still found the first island.
If this was a coincidence, en, they were really bursting with luck.
“Strange!”
They steered the ship to reach the coast, but there were cliffs everywhere.
Thus, they circled around the island, and soon discovered a harbor.
Heavens, this harbor was really too big, wasn’t it?
Ling Han and the others all looked stunned.
This kind of size wasn’t in terms of capacity.
For example, a small harbor could only hold 20 ships, while a hundred ships could be docked here.
Instead, it was in terms of size.
A colossal ship, a colossal house, and… a colossal person!
This was a nation of giants, and each person was at least 30 meters tall.
In front of such an existence, Ling Han and the others might not be as insignificant as ants, but they were really
too unnoticeable.
They found a spot to dock their ship, but tragically discovered that their ship was too small, and even the ropes were not long enough.
Wrapping the rope around that thick pole, the rope could only be wrapped half around it, and could not be tied at all.
Er, this was very awkward.
“Haha, here comes another dwarf.”
Peng, peng, peng!
Heavy footsteps were heard, and a giant walked over.
However, his face was all smiles, and he did not look fierce, and this “dwarf” obviously did not have any derogatory meaning.
“Where is your proof?” He stretched out a hand, and directly grabbed the small boat from the
sea, placing it on the covered bridge.
Fine then.
Ling Han and the others all jumped down from the ship.
Meanwhile, Ling Han handed over his
proof.
“All of you, each of you stretch out your hand and press down on the piece of paper,” the giant said, using the tips of his finger to pinch the piece of paper.
Ling Han, the others, and the dog all stretched out their hands and paw, and touched the paper.
With every touch, there would be a flicker of light on the paper, as if it was proving
their identities.
“It’s done.” The giant returned the proof to Ling Han, “Follow me.”
He walked forwards, and every step he took covered a few meters.
Ling Han and the others hurriedly followed.
Thankfully, though they were small in stature,
their abilities were extremely strong.
It was completely no problem for them to keep up with
the other’s pace.
They continued to walk.
After exiting the harbor, the giant started to speed up.
Peng, peng, peng!
The ground trembled violently.𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Ling Han and the others also used movement techniques to catch up.
In terms of speed, they
were not inferior at all.
“This giant didn’t cultivate any cultivation techniques.
Instead, he simply relied on his physical power to run,” Chi Menghan said through divine sense.
This was terrifying.

It was only brute force, yet it could reach such a level, and for brute force to be so powerful, it must be accompanied by another effect, and that was the physique of this giant must be incredibly strong.
Otherwise, it would not be able to withstand that kind of power.
With a single punch, it would directly cause bones to break, flesh to explode.
After following the giant for a while, a massive fortress was already in sight ahead of them.
The castle that the giants lived in was naturally a fortress of giants.
It was probably more than ten times larger than the normal size.
They entered into the fortress, and the giant that had brought them here turned around and left.
He had absolutely no intention of giving them an explanation, and was not the slightest
bit responsible.
Alright, then they’ll go and find out the situation themselves.
Ling Han and the others roamed around the fortress, and soon found out about the situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 4114: Eating Buns
paragraphs: Chapter 4114: Eating Buns
If he wanted to obtain the first piece of the legendary fragment on this island of giants, it was simple. He only had to defeat the giants in the competition.
Ling Han took a look. There were a total of three rounds of competition.
The first was the steamed bun competition.

Consuming all the steamed buns within the specified time, and being faster than their opponents, would win the competition. Furthermore, not only would they be able to obtain the legendary fragment, they would also be able to obtain a large ship built by the giants, which could withstand violent winds and massive waves.
Previously, the sea was calm, but from the Giant Island onwards, it was a different story.

Thus, switching to a larger ship was extremely necessary. Moreover, if they didn’t win the bun-eating contest, they wouldn’t be able to obtain the legendary fragment, so there was no meaning in heading to the next island.
Furthermore, only if they won the tournament, would the giants stamp their proof of identity. Otherwise, it would be impossible for them to land on the next island.
Thus, no matter what, they definitely had to win this steamed bun competition.

The second competition was the wrestling competition, which was also a competition with the giants. If one won, they could win a prize. The giants would install an Azure Dragon Shield on the large ship, which could resist powerful attacks.
-There were Demonic Beasts in the sea, and their abilities were incredibly terrifying. Thus, if they had the Azure Dragon Shield, it would greatly increase their safety.
The third was the Origin Dragon Elephant Tournament, competing in speed with the giant riding on the Origin Dragon Elephant. The first to cross the finish line would win.
And this would also get a reward of having the Golden Dragon Cannon installed on the large ship.
The Azure Dragon Shield was defensive, while the Golden Dragon Cannon was offensive. It posed a great threat to the sea beasts.

Chi Menghan and Song Lan directly shook their heads, giving up on the bun-eating competition. To say nothing of the fact that they weren’t gluttons, even if they could eat, as exquisite beauties of the galaxy, as precious daughters of the Imperial Clan, how could they bring themselves to eat buns like crazy in public without any care for their image?
Thus, this heavy responsibility naturally fell on Ling Han and the large black dog.
“Captain, we’re counting on you!” the three women all said to Ling Han.
“When did I become Captain?” Ling Han scratched his head.
“You won’t shirk your responsibility!”
It was clear that they were shifting the responsibility.
Ling Han didn’t mind. After all, he was a man, so it wasn’t a big deal for him to eat like crazy. “Come, Old Black, let’s go eat buns.”
“All right!” The large black dog licked his lips, “Grandpa Dog will eat so much that they will be driven to poverty!”
The man and dog went to register, but there were already a great many outsiders here. There were a great many people registering, so they had to line up and wait for a while.

For example, Baili Che and Lin Lang had also arrived. When they saw Ling Han, both of them looked baleful. If it was not for the fact that this was the territory of the giants, they would definitely have made their move already – what did an Imperial Son have to be afraid of? Even if they killed the Dao Child of the Holy Land, would the Holy Land dare to go to the Imperial Clan to capture the culprit?
This was what an Imperial Clan was like; only they could be overbearing.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t back down, and he returned their cold gazes.
There were still a great many people who kept a low profile. Ling Han discovered three people whose abilities were definitely not beneath Baili Che, but no one recognized them.
It was probably other Imperial Sons.
After a while, a giant came out to inform them that the first group’s competition could begin.

In this group, there were a total of ten people. Nine of them were outsiders, and only one of them was a giant. However, only the person who won first place could be considered to have won the competition. Merely defeating the giant was useless.
Of course, three people from each team came, but as long as one of them got the first place, the entire team would pass.

Ling Han and the large black dog had not come here to register at the first moment. Thus, it was not their turn to be in the first group. They began watching from the sidelines, so that they could first look at the “battle prowess” of the giant.
Hiss!
When the giant carried out basin after basin of buns, everyone exclaimed in shock. F***, this was called a basin? It was even bigger than a bathtub, all right!
Those buns were also the size of manhole covers. To an ordinary person, to say nothing of a whole basin, just one was enough to fill them up.
A participating giant also walked out. He was very sturdy, and his stomach was even rounder. With a single look, one could tell that he was a standard glutton.
“Begin!”
With a command, everyone began to wolf down their food. There were also giants watching the competition on the sidelines, cheering for their companions.
That giant was really eating very fast, swallowing a massive bun in two to three bites.
However, there were also many outsiders, each showing their Mystical Power.

Some Demon Race members transformed into their original form, and their size naturally increased greatly. Their mouths also became bigger, and this greatly increased the speed at which they ate buns. However, there was no need for humans to be afraid. With the stimulation of mystical power, their whole person could also enlarge several times, or even in fact, dozens of times over in a short period of time.
In this way, the colossal creatures were all eating buns madly.
The large black dog couldn’t help but burst into laughter. This scene was far too hilarious.
Meanwhile, the Imperial Sons like Baili Che Che and Lin Lang had slightly ugly expressions. This was really too disheveled, seriously affecting their glorious image.
Thankfully, after leaving this place, everyone’s memories would basically be completely erased. No one would remember such a sorry state.

However, since the giants had used this kind of competition, they were naturally all big eaters, especially the giants participating in the competition. They were definitely even greater gluttons. With a whirlwind, he practically swept away all the buns in an instant. It was too fast. When he was done, the second fastest person still had two buns left. Fine, no one from the first group had succeeded.
“Come, come, come. The second group begins.” The giants laughed loudly, treating this as an interesting matter.
In truth, it was indeed very hilarious. This was the first time they had come across a competition that did not involve fighting and killing, nor did he need to use his brain. All one
needed to do was eat.
The nine people from the second group went up, and there was still only one member from
the giants.
Ling Han and the large black dog continued to watch the battle, but Lin Lang and Baili Che were in the second group, and they entered into the “match” area together.
After a while, large bowls of steamed buns were brought out.
The giant this time was not from the last tournament, but he was also massive in size, with a rounded belly. His battle prowess definitely astonishingly strong.
“Begin.”
With a command, everyone immediately wolfed down the food.

Ling Han looked towards Lin Lang and Baili Che, and couldn’t help but feel surprised. Imperial Sons were really extraordinary. Even this kind of competition wouldn’t be a problem for them. Each of them had been enlarged dozens of times, and their height was not inferior
to the giant.

Saints, for example, were completely capable of turning their bodies into something larger than planets. With a single palm strike, planets would be obliterated. However, the Core Formation Tier was naturally not as powerful as this. One could only be

enlarged several times to dozens of times over. As for the exact number, that would depend on one’s own strength and natural talent, and for the likes of the Imperial Son, he was obviously much stronger than any ordinary person.
In the end, Lin Lang and Baili Che finished their buns at practically the same time, even faster
than the giant.
Right, they had become the first team to win a legendary fragment.
The two of them smiled, then swept an eye over Ling Han, revealing an expression of disdain.

Your abilities are indeed out of the ordinary, but in a competition like eating buns, it would depend on how many times you can enlarge your body. The larger your size, the faster you would be able to eat. Thus, this has something to do with bloodline.
How could a mediocre mortal compare to the Imperial Clan?

chapters.title: Chapter 4115: Consecutive Victory
paragraphs: Chapter 4115: Consecutive Victory
After making some preparations, the third group’s competition immediately began.

This time, it was finally the large black dog’s turn. Coincidentally, though he and Ling Han had registered together, he just happened to be stuck at the last place of the third group. Thus, Ling Han had to go to the fourth group.
It didn’t matter. No matter who won in the team, the entire team would pass.
The third giant came up, and the battle was about to begin at any moment.
“Wait!” The large black dog suddenly raised his paw, and when everyone, including the giant, looked towards him, he continued, “What filling is this bun?”
‘Fall!’
Everyone almost fell over. This was a tournament, not an invitation to be a guest. Why do you care about the stuffing of the buns? Just close your eyes and eat.
The giants were all very simple and honest. One of them scratched his head, and said, “Dog meat filling.”
The large black dog’s expression immediately turned livid, “Grandpa Dog protests, this is blatant persecution!”
Everyone laughed loudly. Though a dog demon had completely surpassed the level of a wild dog, it was indeed a little inexcusable for a dog demon to eat dog meat.
“Then let’s trade for another,” a giant said. He was quite humane.
“What stuffing is it this time?” the large black dog asked.
“Wolf meat.”
Er, the large black dog bared his teeth. Wolves and dogs belonged to the same family. Forget it, there was still come difference. He could swallow this bite.
Not long after, a new pot of buns was served.
“Begin!”

With a command, everyone showed their Mystical Power, and began to wolf down. “Compared to Grandpa Dog, don’t you know that Grandpa Dog is a glutton?” The large black dog shook its body, and turned into a massive black dog. Its iron underwear was still dazzling, and enlarged along with its size. Clearly, it was a precious material.
Pu!𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
Someone was eating, but when they saw this scene, they spluttered.
This was too blinding, and had great destructive power.

This spitting immediately caused a chain reaction. Pu, pu, pu, pu, was this still a bun-eating contest? It was practically a bun-spitting contest. Even that giant’s throat was moving, and he couldn’t swallow the bun that was in his mouth no matter what.
Only the large black dog was completely unaffected. He swallowed like crazy, and very soon, he had finished all the steamed buns in the basin.
He had won!
The large black dog leaped up and made a gesture of victory. Then, seeing that everyone was throwing up like crazy, he couldn’t help but feel shocked, “Oh no, this bun is poisonous!”
The spectators were both amused and speechless. Where had this guy popped out from? He was really screwing others over too much, wasn’t he?
But no matter what, the large black dog had indeed won first place. After taking out proof of identity, the giants very readily gifted Ling Han and the others a large ship.
Then, should they continue competing in the following two competitions?
They should, of course.

There were fierce beasts on the seas, and there was no shortage of True Self Tier elites. If they really encountered them, the odds would definitely be against them. Even if they managed to fortunately escape, if the ship was gone, the next island would not admit them at all, all right?
In other words, their journey to the True Dragon Abyss would end here.
To withdraw without reaping any benefits?
How could that be allowed?

Thus, they definitely had to participate in the next two competitions, and they also had to win them. The Azure Dragon Shield and Golden Dragon Cannon would be available for the rest of the journey. Thus, spending more time here would allow the subsequent journey to be even smoother.
It was worth it.
Because the other two competitions could only be challenged by the winning team of the bun-eating competition, there were naturally fewer people.
The second round was the wrestling competition.
Chi Menghan and the others naturally refused again. It was clearly impossible for them to fight the giants head-on.
—Even if it was an ordinary woman, she could not possibly embrace another like this, what more when it was an exquisite beauty like them.
Ling Han and the large black dog could only continue their battle.
This time, Ling Han was lined up in front of the large black dog.
On a grassy plain, a wrestling competition was taking place. Baili Che and Lin Lang’s team had already won. When they passed by, they gave Ling Han a cold, murderous look, and then strode off.
Obviously, they were going to challenge the third Origin Dragon Elephant Tournament.
There were a great many giants watching, as if they were very, very free. There was absolutely no need for them to do anything serious.
The tournament had a rule, and no celestial technique, or precious tool could be used. One could only rely on one’s own power.

Ling Han was unafraid. His raw power was already as high as 28 Heavens, and among those in the Core Formation Tier, only an Imperial Son, who was in the consummate level, could suppress him. And this was still because he was only in the late stage of Core Formation Tier. Once he advanced into the consummate level, so what if the Imperial Son was in the consummate level? He could suppress him with a single hand.
The competition began, and his opponent was a sturdy giant. From the very beginning, he
pounced fiercely.
Ling Han also enlarged his body. Otherwise, how could he wrestle?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Their bodies collided, and pure power reverberated. Wrestling required technique, but if the power gap was too wide, techniques would be completely useless.
Ling Han threw the giant over his shoulder, one-handedly, and both-handedly time and time again. After a few times, his opponent had no choice but to admit defeat and surrender. He
was completely no match for him.
He took out his credentials, and after verifying his identity, the giants set up the Azure
Dragon Shield for their ship.
Very good, he was still missing one.
The third tournament, Origin Dragon Elephant Riding Tournament.
This competition was suitable for both men and women.
Thus, not only were Ling Han and the large black dog participating, but even Chi Menghan
and the others were extremely enthusiastic.
“We can’t always let you guys work, right?” Chi Menghan said.
“Hehe, isn’t it because you guys also want to play?” Ling Han poked the nail on the head.
“Brother-in-law, if you speak like this, you’re destined to be lonely for the rest of your life,” Chi Mengshan said in an experienced manner.
“Haha, I’m really sorry. I already have a wife.”
No matter what, in the third round of the competition, the four people and one dog had all
registered.
There were five of them, and added with Baili Che, Lin Lang, and three giants, there were a total of ten people. This was the lineup for the competition.

However, it was already quite late, and the tournament would be held tomorrow afternoon. After a night, many more people passed through the “Glutton” competition, but those that could pass through the second round were relatively few. Though Ling Han could completely thrash the giants, that did not mean that the giants were not powerful. Their raw power was as high as 20 Heavens, and added with their wrestling techniques, their abilities were very
strong.

On the second day, everyone was busy with their own competitions. Though there were some that had passed the second round, and were about to join the third round of competition, the schedule for the competition had already been decided, so they would have to wait for the
second group to begin.
“Celestial maiden Chi, though I admire you very much, a competition is a competition. I won’t go easy on you!” Baili Che said to Chi Menghan.
If it was not because of Ling Han, he actually would not mind stepping aside, to win the favour of his goddess. In any case, after this failure, he could just do it again.
However, with Ling Han’s presence, there was naturally no way he would yield. Meanwhile, Lin Lang turned his gaze to Song Lan. This was the ninth most beautiful woman

in the galaxy, and her beauty and bearing was not the slightest bit inferior to Chi Menghan. Furthermore, an Imperial Daughter was too difficult to court, so it was still this kind of beauty that was more practical.
However, the two women were both cold, and had no intention of responding at all.

sentences.text: Chapter 4115: Consecutive Victory
After making some preparations, the third group’s competition immediately began.
This time, it was finally the large black dog’s turn.
Coincidentally, though he and Ling Han had registered together, he just happened to be stuck at the last place of the third group.
Thus, Ling Han had to go to the fourth group.
It didn’t matter.
No matter who won in the team, the entire team would pass.
The third giant came up, and the battle was about to begin at any moment.
“Wait!” The large black dog suddenly raised his paw, and when everyone, including the giant, looked towards him, he continued, “What filling is this bun?”
‘Fall!’
Everyone almost fell over.
This was a tournament, not an invitation to be a guest.
Why do you care about the stuffing of the buns?
Just close your eyes and eat.
The giants were all very simple and honest.
One of them scratched his head, and said, “Dog meat filling.”
The large black dog’s expression immediately turned livid, “Grandpa Dog protests, this is blatant persecution!”
Everyone laughed loudly.
Though a dog demon had completely surpassed the level of a wild dog, it was indeed a little inexcusable for a dog demon to eat dog meat.
“Then let’s trade for another,” a giant said.
He was quite humane.
“What stuffing is it this time?” the large black dog asked.
“Wolf meat.”
Er, the large black dog bared his teeth.
Wolves and dogs belonged to the same family.
Forget it, there was still come difference.
He could swallow this bite.
Not long after, a new pot of buns was served.
“Begin!”
With a command, everyone showed their Mystical Power, and began to wolf down.
“Compared to Grandpa Dog, don’t you know that Grandpa Dog is a glutton?” The large black dog shook its body, and turned into a massive black dog.
Its iron underwear was still dazzling, and enlarged along with its size.
Clearly, it was a precious material.
Pu!𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
Someone was eating, but when they saw this scene, they spluttered.
This was too blinding, and had great destructive power.
This spitting immediately caused a chain reaction.
Pu, pu, pu, pu, was this still a bun-eating contest?
It was practically a bun-spitting contest.
Even that giant’s throat was moving, and he couldn’t swallow the bun that was in his mouth no matter what.
Only the large black dog was completely unaffected.
He swallowed like crazy, and very soon, he had finished all the steamed buns in the basin.
He had won!
The large black dog leaped up and made a gesture of victory.
Then, seeing that everyone was throwing up like crazy, he couldn’t help but feel shocked, “Oh no, this bun is poisonous!”
The spectators were both amused and speechless.
Where had this guy popped out from?
He was really screwing others over too much, wasn’t he?
But no matter what, the large black dog had indeed won first place.
After taking out proof of identity, the giants very readily gifted Ling Han and the others a large ship.
Then, should they continue competing in the following two competitions?
They should, of course.
There were fierce beasts on the seas, and there was no shortage of True Self Tier elites.
If they really encountered them, the odds would definitely be against them.
Even if they managed to fortunately escape, if the ship was gone, the next island would not admit them at all, all right?
In other words, their journey to the True Dragon Abyss would end here.
To withdraw without reaping any benefits?
How could that be allowed?
Thus, they definitely had to participate in the next two competitions, and they also had to win them.
The Azure Dragon Shield and Golden Dragon Cannon would be available for the rest of the journey.
Thus, spending more time here would allow the subsequent journey to be even smoother.
It was worth it.
Because the other two competitions could only be challenged by the winning team of the bun-eating competition, there were naturally fewer people.
The second round was the wrestling competition.
Chi Menghan and the others naturally refused again.
It was clearly impossible for them to fight the giants head-on.
—Even if it was an ordinary woman, she could not possibly embrace another like this, what more when it was an exquisite beauty like them.
Ling Han and the large black dog could only continue their battle.
This time, Ling Han was lined up in front of the large black dog.
On a grassy plain, a wrestling competition was taking place.
Baili Che and Lin Lang’s team had already won.
When they passed by, they gave Ling Han a cold, murderous look, and then strode off.
Obviously, they were going to challenge the third Origin Dragon Elephant Tournament.
There were a great many giants watching, as if they were very, very free.
There was absolutely no need for them to do anything serious.
The tournament had a rule, and no celestial technique, or precious tool could be used.
One could only rely on one’s own power.
Ling Han was unafraid.
His raw power was already as high as 28 Heavens, and among those in the Core Formation Tier, only an Imperial Son, who was in the consummate level, could suppress him.
And this was still because he was only in the late stage of Core Formation Tier.
Once he advanced into the consummate level, so what if the Imperial Son was in the consummate level?
He could suppress him with a single hand.
The competition began, and his opponent was a sturdy giant.
From the very beginning, he
pounced fiercely.
Ling Han also enlarged his body.
Otherwise, how could he wrestle?
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Their bodies collided, and pure power reverberated.
Wrestling required technique, but if the power gap was too wide, techniques would be completely useless.
Ling Han threw the giant over his shoulder, one-handedly, and both-handedly time and time again.
After a few times, his opponent had no choice but to admit defeat and surrender.
He
was completely no match for him.
He took out his credentials, and after verifying his identity, the giants set up the Azure
Dragon Shield for their ship.
Very good, he was still missing one.
The third tournament, Origin Dragon Elephant Riding Tournament.
This competition was suitable for both men and women.
Thus, not only were Ling Han and the large black dog participating, but even Chi Menghan
and the others were extremely enthusiastic.
“We can’t always let you guys work, right?” Chi Menghan said.
“Hehe, isn’t it because you guys also want to play?” Ling Han poked the nail on the head.
“Brother-in-law, if you speak like this, you’re destined to be lonely for the rest of your life,” Chi Mengshan said in an experienced manner.
“Haha, I’m really sorry.
I already have a wife.”
No matter what, in the third round of the competition, the four people and one dog had all
registered.
There were five of them, and added with Baili Che, Lin Lang, and three giants, there were a total of ten people.
This was the lineup for the competition.
However, it was already quite late, and the tournament would be held tomorrow afternoon.
After a night, many more people passed through the “Glutton” competition, but those that could pass through the second round were relatively few.
Though Ling Han could completely thrash the giants, that did not mean that the giants were not powerful.
Their raw power was as high as 20 Heavens, and added with their wrestling techniques, their abilities were very
strong.
On the second day, everyone was busy with their own competitions.

Though there were some that had passed the second round, and were about to join the third round of competition, the schedule for the competition had already been decided, so they would have to wait for the
second group to begin.
“Celestial maiden Chi, though I admire you very much, a competition is a competition.
I won’t go easy on you!” Baili Che said to Chi Menghan.
If it was not because of Ling Han, he actually would not mind stepping aside, to win the favour of his goddess.
In any case, after this failure, he could just do it again.
However, with Ling Han’s presence, there was naturally no way he would yield.
Meanwhile, Lin Lang turned his gaze to Song Lan.
This was the ninth most beautiful woman
in the galaxy, and her beauty and bearing was not the slightest bit inferior to Chi Menghan.
Furthermore, an Imperial Daughter was too difficult to court, so it was still this kind of beauty that was more practical.
However, the two women were both cold, and had no intention of responding at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 4116: Origin Dragon Elephant Tournament
paragraphs: Chapter 4116: Origin Dragon Elephant Tournament
After being given a cold shoulder, Baili Che and Lin Lang both vented their anger on Ling Han, and thought that it was because of Ling Han that the two women ignored them in disdain.
Humph, he was just a lowly commoner. What was so good about him?
However, they quickly withdrew their attention, and focused on their mounts.

Origin Dragon Elephant, this was a kind of massive Demonic Beast, and was a mount that was specially provided for giants. For people with normal physiques like them, it was practically overwhelmingly huge. Sitting on it was like sitting on a small hill.
Thus, when riding on the Origin Dragon Elephant, one also needed to enlarge their body size. Otherwise, it would be completely difficult to control.
Ling Han was also observing. This Origin Dragon Elephant’s whole body was covered with scales, and at first glance, it really did look a bit like dragon scales. Sitting on it… was a little painful.
Because the tournament had not begun, the ten Origin Dragon Elephants were all standing, waving their long trunks in boredom, and occasionally using their thick and long tusks to dig at the ground.
Finally, the competition began.
The ten of them patted the Origin Dragon Elephants’ bodies. Teng, teng, teng, and the Origin Dragon Elephants instantly charged out.
Previously, these big guys were quite docile, but once they started to run, they were practically lunatics, completely letting themselves go.

Peng, peng, peng! They ran madly wherever there was a path, but there was no path, their speed did not slow down either. Instead, they crashed into whatever they saw. One after another, trees fell, and rocks shattered.

This was still fine, but the key was that when these Origin Dragon Elephants encountered a mountain, they wouldn’t dodge or retreat. They stubbornly crashed into it, and couldn’t be pulled back at all..
What was the result?
Of course, it would directly pass out, and the rider would have to wait for it to regain consciousness on its own.
This was incredible.
At this time, it would really have to depend on skill and brute force.

The Origin Dragon Elephant that Ling Han was sitting on was also letting itself loose. It would crash into whatever it saw, but it was no match for Ling Han’s great strength. When it encountered trees, rocks or whatnot, Ling Han was unconcerned, but if it was seeking death by crashing towards mountains, that would definitely not do.
Under Ling Han’s powerful restraints, the Origin Dragon Elephant could only obediently continue its journey.

However, the large black dog, Song Lan and Chi Mengshan couldn’t do the same. They couldn’t control the crazed Origin Dragon Elephant at all, and they were all thrown off. They had no choice but to wait for those seeking death Origin Dragon Elephants to awaken.
To say nothing of them, even two of the three giants couldn’t control their mounts and fell solidly together with the Origin Dragon Elephants.

At present, the only people still competing were Ling Han, Chi Menghan, Baili Che, Lin Lang and a giant. The five of them had clearly surpassed the rest by a large margin, and the champion would definitely emerge among them.

To prodigies like Ling Han and the others, they had already familiarized themselves with how to control the Origin Dragon Elephant in this little bit of time. Thus, they became more and more proficient, and gradually, they slowly pulled away from the remaining giant.

The competition between the five of them became a four-person battle. The four Origin Dragon Elephants were now racing neck to neck, and there was practically no one in the lead. “Humph!” Lin Lang sneered, and moved resolutely. He delivered a palm strike at the Origin Dragon Elephant that Chi Menghan was sitting on, and Baili Che also moved at the same time. The target of his attack was the Origin Dragon Elephant that Ling Han was sitting on.
In the rules of the tournament, it was only said that one could not attack one’s opponent, but there was no mention that one could not target the mount of another.
Ling Han and Chi Menghan naturally wouldn’t let them succeed. They both moved, intercepting their respective opponents.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The four prodigies started a fierce battle. This was a different kind of competition. The four of them did not attack each other, but rather targeted each other’s steeds. In any case, as long as they injured the other’s steed, they would naturally be able to force the other party out of the competition.
Ling Han smiled faintly. ‘You guys are indeed going to do this?’
Good!

He activated the black light of illusion, and blasted it towards the Origin Dragon Elephant that Lin Lang and Baili Che were sitting on. However, he immediately discovered that these two fierce beasts were actually completely unaffected.
What the heck!

Ling Han was slightly astonished. It wasn’t strange for Imperial Son-level beings to be able to withstand his black light of illusion. After all, they had the treasure created by the Great Emperor to defend against soul-level attacks. However, were mere wild beasts this freakish? Could it be that it could be that this kind of treasure could even protect a mount that they were riding on?
Ling Han didn’t believe it. He shot out another black light of illusion at his own mount, but the result was the same.
The Origin Dragon Elephant was still running madly on its own, completely unaffected.
Hiss!

This time, Ling Han was so shocked that he was slightly dazed. The Origin Dragon Elephant was indeed simple and reckless, but no matter how simple it was, it did not mean that it could not be affected by the illusion.
Strange, strange!

“Ling Han!” Chi Menghan shouted in a soft voice. Ling Han’s distraction was far too exaggerated. If she hadn’t stepped forward to help, his Origin Dragon Elephant would have definitely suffered several attacks already.
Realization dawned on Ling Han, and he hurriedly continued to attack.
However, going on like this was not a good idea. It would be very difficult to decide the victor.
Ling Han communicated through divine sense, and said to Chi Menghan, “You just focus on charging forward. I’ll hold them back.”

This Origin Dragon Elephant was too wild, and controlling them required a great amount of energy. Thus, it was too distracting to both battle and control the elephant. If one could concentrate on controlling the elephant to advance, the speed would naturally be greatly
increased.
“Can you do it?” Chi Menghan frowned. In terms of battle prowess, she was much stronger than Ling Han, so it would be more appropriate for her to hold them back.
“Haha, never ask a man if he can!” Ling Han laughed loudly.
Chi Menghan rolled her eyes madly at this, and almost couldn’t help but charge down from
the Origin Dragon Elephant.
‘The overall situation is more important,’ she thought to herself.

Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, unleashing a barrage of attacks at Lin Lang and Baili Che’s steeds. Meanwhile, Chi Menghan took advantage of the opening to control the steed with all her might, instantly leaving them in the dust.

“Brother Lin, you go and give chase. Leave this brat to me,” Baili Che said proudly. Ling Han’s strength was that he had a treasure that could absorb and attack power. In terms of true battle prowess, Ling Han was not just a little bit inferior to him.
“All right.” Lin Lang did not hold back, and immediately went all out to steer the elephant.
Ling Han smiled and said, “What’s the hurry? Let’s have a nice chat.”
He shot out a Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, which was incredibly fast, and it landed on Lin Lang’s steed. Instantly, that Origin Dragon Elephant roared in pain, and almost stumbled and
fell.
“Damn it!” Lin Lang roared loudly, and immediately charged back.
Baili Che had no choice but to begrudging. He could only ride the elephant forwards on his
own, in pursuit of Chi Menghan.

Ling Han was already powerless to stop him. After all, they could not target riders, and could only attack mounts. However, Chi Menghan had already gained a lead, and with her strength, she should be able to last until the end.
It was done.
He laughed loudly, and exchanged blows with Lin Lang’s steed.
In this way, the two of them had actually withdrawn from the battle for the champion.

Now, it was up to Baili Che to see if he could catch up to Chi Menghan. However, the chances of this were pitifully small. Otherwise, Chi Menghan, the strongest Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Imperial Clan, would really be underserving of her name.
After a while, the giants sent out a signal that the Origin Dragon Elephant Tournament had
ended.
The champion was indeed Chi Menghan.
All right, they had passed all three rounds of the competition, so they could set out towards
the second island.
The Azure Dragon Shield and Golden Dragon Cannon were already installed, and they had also obtained the legendary fragment. The four people and one dog boarded the ship and set off
for the next island.
This large ship was indeed different. There was also a compass on the ship that pointed at a
target.
“No wonder we have to switch to a bigger ship. Without this compass to guide us, we don’t know where we would be going,” the large black dog said.
“Yi, Little Han, why aren’t you saying anything?” It turned to look at Ling Han.
“You guys turn around,” Ling Han said.

chapters.title: Chapter 4117: Sea Beasts
paragraphs: Chapter 4117: Sea Beasts
The three people and one dog all turned around, looking towards the Giant Island.
Immediately, their expressions changed drastically.
How was this possible!
What they saw now was an expanse of lifelessness. The whole island did not have the slightest
bit of green, nor did it have the slightest bit of life. There were only dilapidated houses,
enshrouded in a hazy grey.
But in their impression of the Giant Island, it was covered with green trees, birdsong and fragrance of flowers. It was filled with vitality.
“What’s going on?” Song Lan murmured.
Ling Han exhaled sharply, and said, “We’ve seen ghosts.”
This wasn’t expressing his emotions of feeling as if he had seen a ghost. He was truly stating a fact.

Hearing these words, even Chi Menghan couldn’t help but shiver. She frowned, and said, “You’re saying that those giants and Origin Dragon Elephants are all Yin souls? No, I don’t sense any Yin soul aura at all.”
She was no stranger to Yin souls. In the past, she had even charged into the Netherworld.
Ling Han shook his head, “Those are not Yin souls. Instead, it should have been created by the will of an elite.”
Hiss!
“Could it be… that True Dragon?” Chi Menghan and the others all exclaimed in shock.
The True Dragon Abyss’s appearance on the Heavenly Dragon Planet made it really hard to believe that this had nothing to do with that True Dragon.

The first dragon in the world, and the only True Dragon, was equivalent to the existence of a Great Emperor. Even after countless years, it would not be strange for the power left behind to still be effective.
“Pu!” The large black dog’s expression was ugly, “Then what the hell is up with the buns that Grandpa Dog ate?”
Just thinking about it was disgusting. It was something created by a ghost.

The reason why Ling Han had such a judgement was because the black light of illusion was ineffective against the Origin Dragon Elephant, which made him suspect that all the living creatures here were actually not real, and that was why they were not affected by the black light of illusion.
Otherwise, he would definitely have been kept in the dark as well. Now, he would not even think of turning around to take a look.
He took out the so-called legendary fragment. That was a broken scale.
“Dragon scale,” Chi Menghan immediately said. She took the scale, then shook her head. “Unfortunately, the divine essence inside has all been lost. Otherwise, this would be of boundless value.”
“Forget it, let’s take a look at the might and restrictions of the Azure Dragon Shield and Golden Dragon Cannon first,” Ling Han said.
They went to take a look at these two items.

After the Azure Dragon Shield was unfurled, it could withstand attacks on the level of True Self Tier, and could last for ten minutes at most, but this was under the condition that it would not be attacked. After being attacked, the duration of the shield would be shortened, and as for how long it could last, that would depend on the strength of the attack.

Opening the Azure Dragon Shield required a cooldown period of as long as thirty minutes. In other words, there was an empty window of at least twenty minutes in this period of time. Looking at the Golden Dragon Cannon again, it could fire True Self Tier-level attacks, which were divided into two modes. One was a single shot, and every shot would have a cooldown period of ten seconds, and the other was a series of ten shots, but the cooldown period was as high as five minutes.

Whether it was the Azure Dragon Shield or the Golden Dragon Cannon, they both needed energy. Now, there were only two energy crystals on the ship, and once they were used up, they would be gone. However, according to the information obtained from the Giant Island, energy crystals could be bought from every subsequent island.
Boom, the huge waves crashed onto the ship, causing the ship to tremble violently from time to time. It was extremely uncomfortable.
Thankfully, the four people and one dog were all in the Core Formation Tier, so it did not have much effect on them.

True enough, from the Giant Island onwards, the situation on the seas had become worse. If they had still been on a small ship, such winds and waves could easily overturn the ship, and send them into the water.
In the distance, there were sea beasts tossing and turning, and occasionally, they would appear on the surface of the sea. In fact, they were even larger than their ship.

Ling Han and the large black dog controlled the Azure Dragon Shield, while the other controlled the Golden Dragon Cannon. Once they encountered this sea beast, they would immediately have to spread out a shield, and at the same time, use the Golden Dragon Cannon to chase it off.
Their luck wasn’t bad. The sea beasts didn’t seem to have discovered them, or they weren’t interested, and they didn’t attack.

Two days passed, and the winds and waves finally stopped. The sea returned to its usual calm, like a massive blue agate. Its colour was intoxicating, and as the warm sunlight shone down, it made one feel warm all over, and incredibly comfortable.

Ling Han and the large black dog lay on the deck to bask in the sun. Meanwhile, Chi Menghan and Song Lan were extremely reserved. However, they also drew out a chair and sat at the bow of the ship. The sunlight and scenery were truly refreshing.

What was going on? Wasn’t it completely peaceful?

They immediately turned the ship around, heading in the direction away from the sea beast.
However, this sea beast must have discovered them, and seemed to be very interested in
them. It was actually chasing after them.
This sea beast was extremely strange. It looked like a fish, yet it had six legs. Its tail was incredibly long, and there were even spikes growing from its tail.
It broke through the seawater at an astonishing speed.

“Prepare to attack!”

Xiu, a golden light blasted out, shooting towards that sea beast.

the large ship.

turn around and dive into the deep sea to recuperate.
Hu, the four people and one dog all breathed a sigh of relief.

What they saw now was an expanse of lifelessness.

bit of green, nor did it have the slightest bit of life.
There were only dilapidated houses,
enshrouded in a hazy grey.

It was filled with vitality.
“What’s going on?” Song Lan murmured.
Ling Han exhaled sharply, and said, “We’ve seen ghosts.”
This wasn’t expressing his emotions of feeling as if he had seen a ghost.
He was truly stating a fact.

She frowned, and said, “You’re saying that those giants and Origin Dragon Elephants are all Yin souls?

In the past, she had even charged into the Netherworld.
