Even after countless years, it would not be strange for the power left behind to still be effective.
“Pu!” The large black dog’s expression was ugly, “Then what the hell is up with the buns that Grandpa Dog ate?”
Just thinking about it was disgusting.
It was something created by a ghost.

The reason why Ling Han had such a judgement was because the black light of illusion was ineffective against the Origin Dragon Elephant, which made him suspect that all the living creatures here were actually not real, and that was why they were not affected by the black light of illusion.
Otherwise, he would definitely have been kept in the dark as well.
Now, he would not even think of turning around to take a look.

chapters.title: Chapter 4118: Multiple-Headed Tribe
paragraphs: Chapter 4118: Multiple-Headed Tribe
After throwing off that sea beast, the second island was finally within sight.
After making a small circle, they saw the harbor, and immediately approached.
In terms of size, this island was very normal. Thus, the residents on this island were definitely not giants.
However, when Ling Han and the others discovered the residents here, none of them thought that this island was much more normal than the Giant Island.
That was because the residents here actually had quite a number of heads. There were at least two of them, and there were some with even five, six, or over a dozen of them.
This… was there a Multiple-Headed Tribe in this world?

“Yes,” Chi Menghan said with a nod. “In the ancient era, there was indeed a Multiple-Headed Tribe. They were extremely talented, and they were able to form several minds. Just think, just how terrifying would their battle prowess be?”
Hiss, in other words, it could form a considerable number of Celestial Cores; one of them was equivalent to a whole group.
“Then why would this race have died out?” The large black dog was puzzled. Logically speaking, this race should be incredibly powerful.

Chi Menghan shook her head, “It is said that at that time, there were a great many powerful great clans that wanted to obtain the secret of the Multiple-Headed Tribe, and how they formed multiple minds. Thus, large numbers of the Multiple-Headed Tribe were captured for research, which led to the extermination of this race.”
Sigh, this caused Ling Han and the others to shake their heads. It was a crime to possess a treasure. They were really too innocent.

“At that time, though a considerable number of Saints had emerged from the Multiple- Headed Tribe, and their battle prowess was all earth-shattering, it was an era when True Dragons, True Phoenixes and other Divine Beasts coexisted. What was the use of having a great many Saints?” Chi Menghan sighed ruefully, “A powerful tribe died just like that. What a pity.”

“Combined with the situation on the Giant Island, it is probable that the Multiple-Headed Tribe here is not real either, but rather born from the intent of an elite. Essentially, it is only a sliver of divine sense,” Ling Han said.

“However, we can’t underestimate them just because of this. For beings like the Great Emperor, a single thought can come true. Thus, this isn’t much different from the true Multiple-Headed Tribe. Moreover, because it’s born from willpower, it instead has a greater advantage,” Chi Menghan said solemnly.
Ling Han nodded in agreement. Merely the fact that the black light of illusion couldn’t take effect was already very impressive.
“Thus, everyone should still act according to the rules.”
“En!”
The four people and one dog landed on the shore, and immediately, a two-headed person came over to check their proof. After confirming the identities of the five of them, he allowed them to pass.

They arrived at the residential area of the Multiple-Headed Tribe. There were more than ten thousand tribesmen residing here, and most of them were at the Core Formation Tier. There were also quite a number of True Self Tiers, so if they wanted to use force to suppress this place and obtain the legendary fragment, this was a very foolish idea.
How was he supposed to obtain legendary fragment, or in other words, the shard of dragon scale?
This wasn’t a competition of big eaters or wrestling, but a competition of true strength. A bloody battle!
The Multiple-Headed Tribe was bellicose and bloodthirsty, so if he wanted to win their respect and obtain the pass, he had to rely on killing.

The Arena of Death was a place where the Multiple-Headed Tribe would hold martial arts competitions, and with how bloody this tribe was, a martial arts competition was actually a battle to the death. It had to end with the collapse of one side.
If he wanted to win the legendary fragment, he would have to win ten battles in the Arena of Death.

Because the battles here were all life-or-death battles, winning ten battles was equivalent to winning ten battles in a row, and killing ten opponents in a row. Whichever battle they lost in the middle would mean death.
However, the Arena of Death was still yet to open, so it was necessary to wait for more outsiders to join the tournament. Only then would a bloody battle officially begin.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Ling Han first went to find out how he was going to buy the energy crystals.
There was no need for Dao Stones here. If one wanted to buy something from the Multiple- Headed Tribe, they could only do so through winning in the Arena of Death.
Every three victories, he would be able to obtain an energy crystal.

If they wanted to obtain a large number of energy crystals, it would be best for everyone to take part in the tournament. However, once they battled, one of the fighters would have to die, and it would be too cruel and dangerous. Thus, everyone discussed for a while, and only Ling Han would participate.

Though Chi Menghan’s strength was superior to Ling Han’s, firstly, her defense was not as high as Ling Han’s, and her ability to preserve her life was slightly weaker. Secondly, she was a woman, and an exquisite beauty at that. If she were to kill ten people in a row, that would be too damaging to her image.
Most importantly, in these ten battles, the majority of their opponents should be outsiders, so they still had to worry about whether Chi Menghan’s heart was tough enough.
After waiting for several days, the Arena of Death finally opened.
There were enough people.
Ling Han went over to register, and very soon, he was assigned a number. In the arena, everyone only had a code name.
From the afternoon onwards, the battles began.

Ling Han’s opponent was a young man from the Demon Race. He looked very ordinary, but when he occasionally swept an eye over him, he would explode with an astonishing coldness. “Hehe, so my opponent is you,” the young man from the Demon Race said calmly. He obviously recognized Ling Han, but he actually wasn’t afraid at all. It was clear that he had a high opinion of himself, “Ling Han, there are no ley lines here to borrow power from. Today will be the day of your death!”

Ling Han shook his head. Originally, he was still a little conflicted about killing a stranger, but since he had entered here, he had to be prepared for life and death. However, hearing these words from the other party, the slightest bit of conflict in his heart naturally disappeared
completely.

“People always like to deceive themselves.” He smiled, “You would rather believe that my strength comes from formations. That way, you would feel superior. Unfortunately, this would only cause you to lose your life!”
“Bullsh*t!” the Demon Race youth roared. He then charged at Ling Han at an incredible speed, transforming into a streak of golden light that vaguely revealed the shape of a rabbit.
Yi, was this guy’s original form a rabbit?
No wonder he had run so quickly.
Ling Han chuckled, and threw a punch.
Peng!

The air shattered layer by layer like glass, and then the young man from the Demon Race was seen stumbling backwards. His whole body was covered with blood, and there were traces of blood at the corner of his lips. His face was filled with shock, as if he could not believe or accept that the gap in strength between himself and Ling Han was actually so wide. He hurriedly raised his hands, and shouted loudly, “I forfeit! I forfeit!”
This gap in strength was too wide. He did not even have the chance to go all out, so naturally,
he could only raise his hands in surrender.
“Humph, in the Arena of Death, there are only warriors who die standing, and there are no cowards who live on their knees!” A three-headed man declared coldly, his three faces filled
with disdain.
The young man from the Demon Race didn’t dare to attack Ling Han. Instead, he immediately
turned around to flee. It didn’t matter that he had lost. There were still other people in the team. As long as one of them could win ten battles, he would also be able to pass the trial
smoothly.
“You’re seeking death!”
A multi-headed person moved. Pa, a golden light shot out, penetrating through the head of
that young man from the Demon Race.
The young man from the Demon Race instantly collapsed, completely dead.
Instantly, the cheers of innumerable clansmen rang out from the spectators’ seats, and the
outsiders fell silent.

In the outside world, if one couldn’t defeat their opponent, they could surrender. This was normal, but in this place, even if they surrendered, they would still die, which made those who had enlisted in a moment of hot-bloodedness begin to regret it.
Had they really prepared themselves for this?

chapters.title: Chapter 4119: Ten Victories
paragraphs: Chapter 4119: Ten Victories
After a few battles, a large number of people immediately chose to withdraw from the competition.

This was too cruel. It was either life or death, which made a great many young sprouts that had grown up in protective environments completely unable to bear it. However, once they withdrew from the tournament, they would no longer be able to participate in the tournament inside the Arena of Death.

Thankfully, everyone was presently in teams, and as long as one person in the team managed to pass, the whole team would be able to obtain the entry permit. Thus, there was still hope for these people who had withdrawn from the competition.
The majority of the teams chose to wait. After all, there were too many elites presently, and if they forced themselves, they would only die young.
The result was that there was a serious shortage in the number of participants.
Ling Han waited for two days, and only then did a new opponent appear. However, it was not an outsider, but rather a multi-headed person.

Actually, Ling Han was still a little conflicted about fighting outsiders. After all, too many people were complete strangers to him, yet they still had to fight to the death. However, it was a different story for the multi-headed people. Ling Han believed that these beings had long since been annihilated in history. Now, they had only manifested because of a single thought of an elite.
Thus, there was naturally no burden on his mind. He could kill them however he liked.
This was a two-headed person, and his battle prowess was… very strong!

Multiple-headed people were a race where the number of heads determined one’s natural talent. The more heads one had, the higher one’s natural talent would naturally be. This was very simple. One more head meant one more mind. To a Core Formation Tier cultivator, that was one more Celestial Core.
This naturally had a great impact.
Then was the two-headed person equivalent to two cultivators at the same cultivation level of the Core Formation Tier?

Not really, because though there were two Celestial Cores, the amount of power one could deliver at the same time was still limited by the physique. However, with another Celestial Core, he would be able to inscribe a few more Mystical Powers, and this naturally would greatly increase his battle prowess.
Thus, the more heads there were, the stronger one would be in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
Of course, how could a mere two-headed person be a match for Ling Han?

If it was not for the fact that Ling Han wanted to familiarize himself with the unique traits of the multi-headed people, he was completely capable of insta-killing his opponent with a single move. Now, however, he had dragged on the battle for over a dozen moves before he finally blasted his opponent into dust with a single punch.

It was clearly just the manifestation of thought from an elite, but this multi-headed person was incredibly real. With a punch, blood spurted in all directions. In fact, one could even sense the unwillingly departed soul of his opponent.

Subsequently, Ling Han’s opponents were still multiple-headed people, from two heads to three heads, and the number was endlessly increasing. Though they were both in the consummate level of Core Formation Tier, the battle prowess was also rising steadily, and had even increased exponentially.
But in front of a super freak like Ling Han, so what if he was strong? He would be able to kill him with a single hand.
After battling for a long time, Ling Han’s understanding of the Multiple-Headed Tribe also increased. This also made him very envious of the abilities of the Multiple-Headed Tribe.
If he could also have one more mind, or even three or four in fact, just how much would his battle prowess increase by?

No wonder the great clans of the ancient times would be interested in the Multiple-Headed Tribe, and capture them for research in order to obtain the secret of cultivating multiple minds. This was indeed tempting.

However, these people of the Multiple-Headed Tribe were only illusions created by the thought of an elite. To say nothing of the fact that Ling Han couldn’t do anything to investigate them, even if he wanted to, there was nothing he could do.
Unknowingly, Ling Han had already obtained nine consecutive wins. He was only one battle away from passing the stage.

Chi Menghan, Song Lan, and the others were all very relaxed, thinking that this final battle was still very easy for Ling Han. It was only going through the motions. They were already thinking about what they would be able to see on the third island.
Very quickly, the night passed.
Ling Han arrived at the arena, and it wasn’t long before he saw his final opponent.
Lin Lang!
He had never thought that this final opponent would actually be him.
Ling Han smiled faintly. When he had been in the Cauldron Forging Tier, he had already thrashed this Imperial Son. Now, he was sure that it would be the same.
“Ling Han!” Lin Lang said through gritted teeth. Even his hair was standing on end, revealing endless killing intent. “I’ve finally waited for this chance!”
“Oh, I remember that you were the one who was defeated last time, right? What is it? Have you found your confidence from somewhere?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Lin Lang gradually withdrew his killing intent, and revealed a proud expression, “I have to admit, your strength in a battle of equals is indeed amazing, capable of matching me—”
“How shameless,” Ling Han mumbled.
Lin Lang’s face flushed red. In the previous battle, he had indeed lost to Ling Han, and it was not a so-called equal match as he had said, but how could he possibly admit it?
“This time, I’m one minor level above you, so you’re definitely going to die!” he said.
“Since you’re so confident, come.” Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
Lin Lang raised his hand, and the Jade Water Sword appeared once more.

This naturally wasn’t the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan’s Imperial Weapon. It was only a replica, a standard weapon that every clansman of the Lin Clan could possess. However, Lin Lang was the Imperial Son, after all. The Jade Water Sword in his hand was much stronger than the standard Spirit Tool. Moreover, as he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, the standard weapon he used naturally also rose to a higher level.
This Jade Water Sword could be said to be the strongest level of the Core Formation Tier.
With sword in hand, coupled with his incomparably powerful strength, Lin Lang’s confidence
exploded.
Ling Han didn’t summon the Primal Chaos Lightning Tower. As he saw it, it wasn’t to the point that he had to use this precious tool yet.

“Surrender your life!” Lin Lang shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. He slashed out with his sword, which turned into an ice dragon that bared its fangs and brandished its claws. In fact, it really was exuding a sliver of dragon’s might.
This was very interesting. Since the Ancestral King Fire Clouds was called Fire Clouds, he should be skilled in fire-element cultivation techniques, but the Imperial Weapon he used
was ice-element.
Ling Han mocked internally, while his figure charged out, greeting Lin Lang’s attack.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two young prodigies exchanged blows. Lin Lang was the Imperial Son, and he had also cultivated to the consummate level of Core Formation Tier. His battle prowess was naturally not inferior to Baili Che, and with the addition of the replica of the Imperial Weapon, his strength was further boosted.

Ling Han’s raw power was inferior to that of Lin Lang’s. Thus, in this clash, he was naturally sent flying repeatedly, but it could not hold up to the fact that he had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, which allowed him to dissolve the power that he had been hit with ease.
Lin Lang gritted his teeth. Was he still unable to defeat Ling Han?

It was understandable that he had lost to Ling Han the first time. After all, Ling Han was more powerful than him, but now? He clearly had an advantage in power, yet he only had an advantage and couldn’t gain the upper hand. This drove him crazy.
As the Imperial Son, was it so difficult for him to defeat a lowly commoner?
He was dissatisfied. Furthermore, this was a mortal duel, and one of the two of them would
definitely die.
He didn’t want to die!
Lin Lang roared loudly, and began to burn the Imperial Blood. His whole person immediately
exuded a terrifying aura.
Uncontrollably, his body had already enlarged greatly. This was the side effect of burning the
Imperial Blood. If his cultivation level was high enough, he would be able to control it as he willed it, and whether his size would change or not would be completely up to a single
thought.
However, it could not be denied that he was presently inconceivably strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 4120: Battling Lin Lang again
paragraphs: Chapter 4120: Battling Lin Lang again
After combusting the Imperial Blood, it was practically equivalent to being possessed by a young Great Emperor, and just how powerful was a young Great Emperor?
Boom!
Lin Lang’s sword swept over, and endless divine light surged. It was indescribably terrifying.
Ling Han also frowned, and retreated.

Lin Lang’s raw power looked to be at 31 Heavens, and was even stronger than a Buddha Son like Shi Yongming. Of course, it was highly possible that Shi Yongming wasn’t a real Buddha Son, so it was normal for his battle prowess to be weak.
Now, after combusting his Imperial Blood, his power had suddenly risen to the height of 40 Heavens. This was too terrifying. Even with Ling Han’s strength, he did not dare to take it head-on.
Shua, the sword swept past, yet missed its target.

Lin Lang laughed loudly. At present, he had an absolute advantage. The Jade Water Sword swept out again, while his left hand formed into a claw, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han. A fiery flame surged out, turning into tens of thousands of flaming spears.
Ling Han retreated again. The present Lin Lang was too terrifying. Taking him head-on was definitely not a good idea.
“Brat, continue being arrogant!” Lin Lang said with a smile.
‘F*ck! You are igniting the Imperial Blood for a burst of power! What’s there to be proud of?’

“By the way, the speed at which your Imperial Blood recovers is really fast.” Ling Han was puzzled. The last time he had exchanged blows with Lin Lang Lang was only a few years ago. In such a short period of time, how could Lin Lang be able to combust his Imperial Blood? Even for the Imperial Son, whose bloodline was pure, he could not have recovered so quickly. Lin Lang’s expression involuntarily changed slightly, appearing slightly ugly.

Under normal circumstances, even for him, he would need at least a few dozen years to recover his Imperial Blood. However, he was the Imperial Son, and in order to ensure his absolute strength in a battle of equal cultivation levels, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan used their Saint Blood as a catalyst, forcibly speeding up the recovery of his Imperial Blood. This was Saint Blood. Though it could not compare to the Imperial Blood, it was still indescribably precious. It could be said that the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan had expended a great deal. Furthermore, he himself was also experiencing great pain. This kind of method of forcibly speeding up the recovery of the Imperial Blood was too nature-defying, so he naturally would not be having a good time.
Now that Ling Han was talking about it, Lin Lang’s painful memories were naturally brought back to him, causing his expression to become ugly.

After losing to Ling Han, he had suffered quite a few rumors in the clan. In fact, some clan elders had even suggested that he be disqualified from the position of Imperial Son. In any case, there was not just one person in the clan that had natural talent like his.

“Die!” he roared in fury. As long as he killed Ling Han, this kind of humiliation would disappear without a trace, and he would also be able to stabilize his position as Imperial Son. Hong! Hong! Hong!

The Imperial Son combusted his Imperial Blood, and added with the replica Imperial Weapon, this battle prowess was really too terrifying. In the same cultivation level, was there anyone that could match him?
Of course there was!

Ling Han wasn’t afraid at all. If he was also at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, to say nothing of the fact that he was only burning his Imperial Blood, he was confident that he could defeat even a true young Great Emperor.
Of course, he was still only in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier at present. The gap in raw power was too wide, which led to a huge gap in battle prowess.
Ling Han humphed as he unleashed his murderous aura.
Weng, the attack landed, but it was completely ineffective.
“Haha, after using this kind of attack on me once, you still want to use it again?” Lin Lang sneered, appearing extremely disdainful. “Too naive!”

Ling Han knew that this was not because Lin Lang had cultivated some kind of divine sense cultivation technique, but rather because he had the treasure that the Great Emperor had refined years ago, which could block all negative effects.
-Previously, when he had been fighting with Lin Lang, this move was very useful. Now, it was actually ineffective, which meant that Lin Lang had not worn this kind of treasure at that time.

Perhaps his cultivation level hadn’t been high enough at the time, or perhaps even the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan didn’t have so many treasures and it was finally his turn now, but no matter what, Lin Lang wouldn’t be affected by this murderous aura attack.

Regarding the barrage of murderous aura, Ling Han only had a slight sliver of hope. After this move was useless, he activated the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. This had already been experimented on Chi Menghan, and even a treasure personally concocted by the Great Emperor could not stop its might.
Weng, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core vibrated slightly, releasing a supreme aura.
“What?!” Lin Lang immediately exclaimed in astonishment. This was because his battle prowess had been forcefully suppressed by three Heavens.
How was this possible?
This time, he clearly had the precious treasure to protect himself. This had been personally refined by the Great Emperor.
Could it be that Ling Han also possessed a Great Emperor-level treasure?
It was absolutely impossible for him to believe that Ling Han had actually weakened his
battle prowess by three Heavens with his own abilities.
A Core Formation Tier was even more awesome than a Great Emperor?
Who was he kidding?
But among Great Emperors, who would be weaker than whom? Why was the Emperor Tier treasure in Ling Han’s possession able to overwhelm his own?
It was fine.

On second thought, he suppressed his shock. That was because even if his battle prowess was weakened by three Heavens, he would still be able to crush Ling Han. Then, after killing this opponent, the treasure in his hands would become his spoils of battle.
Very good, very good.
“Ling Han, I really have to thank you!” he said with a grin, as he brandished his sword in
pursuit.
“Oh?” Ling Han smiled faintly.
“I want to thank you for gifting me a treasure!” Lin Lang laughed loudly, as if he was already
stepping on Ling Han.

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh. “Usually, I’m the one saying this to others.” “Apologies, it is not up to you to decide today!” Lin Lang’s attacks were even stronger. The Imperial Blood was limited, and he had to kill Ling Han as soon as possible. Otherwise, when this wave of power had passed, he would no longer be able to do anything to Ling Han. Boom, the Jade Water Sword attacked, bringing with it supreme might, wanting to cut Ling Han in half.
‘Do you really think I’m afraid of you?’
Ling Han smirked coldly. The Primal Chaos Lightning Tower was finally unleashed.

All of a sudden, it was as if the air had turned into water, rolling out in waves. This was the future Imperial Weapon. Even if it was limited by Ling Han’s cultivation level and he could not bestow the might of the Imperial Weapon on it, the Origin Gold itself had great might.

The Jade Water Sword arrived, and struck the Primal Chaos Qi. However, it only managed to slice through it slightly, before being suppressed by the heavy Primal Chaos Qi. Lin Lang felt his wrist sink, and the longsword in his hand fell straight down.
He paled in shock, but he had not even finished the thought, when he saw the Primal Chaos Lightning Tower shake again, and send out a bolt of lightning.

At this moment, he was burning his Imperial Blood, which was practically equivalent to a young Great Emperor. His reaction speed was naturally fast, and he immediately shot out a punch, which landed on the lightning.
Zi, lightning blazed, and Lin Lang stumbled back. He felt an indescribable numbness in his
left hand.

“How could this be!” he exclaimed in shock, looking in shock at the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower that was floating above Ling Han’s head. It was presently emanating Primal Chaos Qi, causing a powerful feeling of helplessness to rise up in his heart.
This, this, this, was this an Imperial Weapon?
His pupils involuntarily dilated. As the Imperial Son, it was impossible that he had not seen

the Imperial Weapon before. In fact, he had even personally touched it before, because to fuse the Nine Cauldrons into one, he would have to use the power of the Imperial Weapon. Thus, he was no stranger to the Imperial Weapon. The nine-storey tower in front of him made him feel as if he had seen an Imperial Weapon.
No, no, no, the Imperial Weapon was far more powerful than this.
This wasn’t an Imperial Weapon, but a precious tool forged from the Origin Gold!
Lin Lang’s breathing instantly quickened.

chapters.title: Chapter 4121: Surpassing Nine Stars
paragraphs: Chapter 4121: Surpassing Nine Stars
Origin Gold, what kind of concept was that?
The Imperial Weapon could only be forged using Origin Gold. Merely the words ‘Emperor Tier-level ingredients’ were enough to explain everything.
Who would not want such a precious tool?

However, Origin Gold was really too hard to obtain. Even the Ancestral King could only, after attaining great dao, enter certain incredibly dangerous places and obtain the Origin Gold with supreme might.
Thus, it was unheard of for a Great Emperor to possess a Spirit Tool that was forged from Origin Gold when he was young. He would be able to sweep through all opposition.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to, but that it was simply impossible.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂

Moreover, if this kind of treasure was exposed, even Saints would be tempted, and snatch it from him, disregarding their pride. Thus, before they were strong enough, if others found out that they had obtained the Origin Gold, they would not be far from death.

Hiss, this brat really hid it very well. He had the precious tool forged from the Origin Gold, yet he had never used it until this moment. Because this was the True Dragon Abyss, all memories would practically be erased once they left, so there was naturally no need for him to hide it.
“Good, very good. I have to thank you even more.” Lin Lang couldn’t hide his greed. If he could obtain the Origin Gold, just how much would his battle prowess increase?
Unlike Ling Han, he was a member of the Imperial Clan. Even if he barged around with the precious tool refined from Origin Gold, how many people would dare to make a move on him?
Moreover, obtaining Origin Gold was equivalent to having attained the great fortune of heaven and earth.
This was a precious material that could only be obtained by a Great Emperor. He was the only one in history who had obtained it when he was in the Core Formation Tier.
What else could it be but great fortune?
With this kind of great fortune, he may be able to break the curse of the Imperial Clan being unable to produce another Great Emperor, and create another record.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Why are you stealing my words again? Since you know that this is a precious tool refined from Origin Gold, do you think you still have a chance of winning?”
“Why not?” Lin Lang countered. “This is only a tool, but the strength of cultivators lies in themselves!”

“That’s right. However, you, a guy that can only jump around in front of me by burning your Imperial Blood, actually talk to me about a cultivator’s own strength? Haha, I’m really about to die of laughter!” Ling Han shook his head, “If our cultivation levels were the same, even if you burned your Imperial Blood, I would still be able to crush you with a single punch!”
Faced with Ling Han’s confidence, Lin Lang’s aura was completely stolen, and he was rendered speechless.

That’s right. He had combusted the Imperial Blood and was still unable to do anything to Ling Han, who was merely in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier. Then what if Ling Han had reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier?
Could it be that it was Ling Han who was the Son of Destiny of this era, and the one favored by the heavens?
“No!”

He roared in fury, his confidence boosted. He was an Imperial Son, and had an incredibly noble background. Now, his battle prowess was overwhelming Ling Han in all aspects, allowing him to encounter Ling Han at this time, and encounter the Origin Gold. This was a fated opportunity bestowed on him by the heavens.
That must be the case.
Lin Lang no longer worried about personal gains or losses, and attacked with all his might. However, it was useless.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was limited by Ling Han’s cultivation level, so it couldn’t be called an Imperial Weapon. However, Origin Gold was what it was, and whatever cultivation level Ling Han was at, it was the most powerful precious tool of that cultivation level, and there was no other!
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Regardless of how Lin Lang attacked, the Primal Chaos Qi continued to emanate, enough to block all attacks. Meanwhile, the arcs of lightning continued to pulsate, causing Lin Lang to feel immense pressure.

If it weren’t for Ling Han, the battle prowess of an Imperial Son that had combusted his Imperial Blood would definitely not be inferior to the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. However, now that Ling Han had weakened his battle prowess by three Heavens, how could Lin Lang be as powerful as this?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower unleashed its might, unleashing barrage after barrage of lightning, leaving Lin Lang with only the ability to parry.
This caused Lin Lang’s expression to change drastically. This was because there was a time limit to the burning of Imperial Blood.

On the other hand, Ling Han was extremely powerful right now, yet there was a limit to his explosive power. Thus, if he stalled for time, he would naturally have a high chance of victory. However, the problem was that he was the one with a time limit to his explosive power.
What was he to do now?
Lin Lang couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. This was a mortal duel, and one of them had to die. If this continued, the one who would die would definitely be him.
What could he do? What could he do?
As an Imperial Son, Lin Lang had never imagined that he would die one day, but now, this was
about to become a reality.
He didn’t want to die.
Lin Lang roared loudly, and used all his ultimate moves.

He was an Imperial Son, and not only had he mastered a great many Saint Techniques, he had also learnt a considerable number of Imperial Techniques. With the support of the burning of Imperial Blood, there was no restriction on use at all. Like massive waves, they crashed towards Ling Han in waves.

This was indeed awesome. Though it could not cause the slightest bit of damage to the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower itself, there were a few Heavens of power that shattered the Primal Chaos Qi, and landed on Ling Han.
However, after being weakened by the Primal Chaos Qi, how much might would this kind of attack still have? They were easily dispersed with a light punch from Ling Han.
“Lin Lang, I’ll send you on your way!” Ling Han said balefully. He leaped up, and as he shot out a punch, Destructive Energy blazed.
Lin Lang was shocked. What kind of high-level energy was this? How could it be so terrifying?
Why was there the saying of high-level energy?

This was because mystical power belonged to the lowest level of energy. When encountering high-level energy, one would need to expend ten times or even more power to dissipate it. It was like using fabric to defend against the attack of an embroidery needle.
The embroidery needle was clearly just a little bit, but without a dozen over layers of fabric, how could it be blocked?

And in the case of high-level energy, it was equivalent to switching fabric into leather. In this way, the power of defense would naturally be greatly increased, and it was the same for attack. The higher the grade of the high-level energy, the more terrifying its penetrating power would be.
The Imperial Clans all had complete information about the hierarchy of high-level energy. These were the research insights of the Great Emperors, and were incredibly valuable.

In the eyes of the Great Emperor, there were a total of nine levels for high-level energy. For example, the Heavenly Dao Flames that could refine the Origin Gold was the highest level of high-level energy, and it was called Nine Star Energy.
As the Imperial Son, Lin Lang had naturally learnt a few nine-star Spirit Diagrams as well. It was precisely because of this that he was so stunned when he saw the Destructive Energy.
This… had surpassed Nine Star Energy!
How was this possible?
Nine stars was the highest level of energy. This was the understanding of the Great Emperor.
How could it be that it was wrong?
Lin Lang was both stunned and confused. Seeing was believing. His eyes wouldn’t deceive
him, but would a Great Emperor make a mistake?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han didn’t care what he was thinking. He swung his fists repeatedly, and Destructive
Energy surged.
Right now, he could kill anyone in his way.
“What kind of high-level energy is this?” Lin Langxing couldn’t help but ask. This was too
shocking.
“Hehe.” Ling Han naturally wouldn’t answer. In truth, he didn’t know the origins of
Destructive Energy either. What exactly was its name? He was the one who had given the
name “Destruction”.
“What’s the point of a dead person knowing so much?”
“Humph, your high-level energy is incomplete, and is only as much as can only wrap around a
fist. The destructive power it can release will definitely be limited.” Lin Lang sneered, “This can’t hurt me at all!”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “That’s true, but how long can your burning of Imperial Blood
last?”
Lin Lang was instantly rendered speechless. This was an incredibly fatal weakness.

chapters.title: Chapter 4122: New Challenge
paragraphs: Chapter 4122: New Challenge
No matter how defiant Lin Lang was, after battling for half an hour, his aura began to decline. It was not just a little bit, but had rather seeped out to a great degree.
The burning of the Imperial Blood had ended, so he had no choice but to exit this state.
Ling Han put away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. He didn’t need to go through so much trouble to kill an Imperial Son.

Boom, he used the God Slaying Technique and coupled with the Nine Suns Divine Scroll, although this was not the strongest cultivation technique and celestial technique in the world, they had the same origin, and had been constantly deduced and studied by Ling Han. It could be claimed to be the celestial technique that suited him the most.

Furthermore, at the level of the Core Formation Tier, cultivators were unable to come into contact with the Regulations of heaven and earth, and the might of the Imperial Technique could not be fully unleashed either. It was not much stronger than a Saint Technique.
Thus, the might of the God Slaying Technique was naturally terrifying. It was not the slightest bit inferior to the Imperial Technique, and may even surpass that.
Lin Lang gritted his teeth. His expression was twisted, as if he wanted to devour someone.
Damn it, he even disdained from using the precious tool refined from Origin Gold. Just how much are you looking down on me?
I am the Imperial Son, the Imperial Son!

However, no matter how furious he was, it was useless. Ling Han had weakened his battle prowess by three Heavens, and his battle prowess was not much different from Ling Han’s. However, Ling Han had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, while Lin Lang did not.

In just a few dozen moves, Lin Lang had already fallen into a disadvantage, and what struck him even harder was the fact that this was not Ling Han’s strongest battle prowess. He had even hidden a precious tool that he had yet to use.
On the spectators’ seats, Baili Che’s expression was as dark as could be when he saw that Lin Lang’s defeat was already assured.
They were both Imperial Sons, so even if he thought that he was stronger than Lin Lang, his advantage in strength was limited. Then, what would happen when he confronted Ling Han head-on?
-If Ling Han didn’t have that precious tool, he would still have a chance of winning. However, added with that precious tool, no matter how arrogant he was, he did not dare say that he could win.
This brat actually obtained the Origin Gold!

Baili Che was incredibly envious and jealous. It was clear that he was the Imperial Son, and logically speaking, the fortune of heaven and earth should be on his side, but why had Ling Han obtained the Origin Gold?
With the precious tool refined from Origin Gold, how was he supposed to kill Ling Han?
Unless… he won with his superior cultivation level, not an advantage in minor level, but an advantage of a major tier.
No matter how awesome you were, what if you encountered a True Self Tier?
There were no ley lines here for you to use. Any True Self Tier elite would be enough to crush Ling Han into dust.
That’s right. This was the only way.
Baili Che began to consider whether he should break through to the True Self Tier or not. Otherwise, against Ling Han, he really didn’t have the slightest chance of winning.
If he could think of this, so could Lin Lang.
“Ling Han, you forced me to do this!” Lin Lang roared as he started to break through.
Breaking through in battle was indeed dangerous, and for normal people, it was even more impossible. However, with how prodigious the Imperial Son was, how could he be like normal people?

Of course, he hadn’t accumulated enough cultivation on the level of the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier yet. If he broke through now, there would definitely be some aftereffects. However, for the sake of his life and the precious tool forged from the Origin Gold, this was completely worth it.
However, in the next instant, Lin Lang immediately looked surprised, and felt a sense of despair.
He was unable to break through.
Why?
It was as if there was a power suppressing him in this heaven and earth, firmly suppressing him to the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
Was this the doing of a Great Emperor?
He could blot out the skies with a single hand. He couldn’t even break through.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦
In order to ensure fairness? What cultivation level did you have when you entered, and you could only stay at this cultivation level?
Lin Lang wanted to cry. This was his only way to turn the tables, but reality had slapped him across the face, making him dizzy.
Ling Han charged over. As the God Slaying Technique channelled, he also stimulated the Destructive Energy, allowing the might of his attacks to rise to another level.
Lin Lang couldn’t block it, and was killed.

However, as the Imperial Son, he naturally possessed treasures like the Substitution Seal. His head had clearly been obliterated with a single punch, yet it immediately recovered, as if time had been reversed.
The Substitution Seal was the doing of a Saint.
However, so what?
Ling Han was cold and heartless, and once again killed Lin Lang. However, there was actually more than one Substitution Seal on this guy, and he had once again come back to life.

If this was in the outside world, then Lin Lang could use his revival to flee – actually, it could not be called revival. With the Substitution Seal, he had not truly died. Otherwise, even the Ancestral King would probably not be able to revive him.
But here, every time he came back to life, he would still be trapped in the arena. This was awkward, and the result was that he would only be killed time and time again.
However, Lin Lang did not beg for mercy.
As the Imperial Son, he did not lose control even in this kind of situation, and he was also very clear that under the rules of the arena, one of the two of them was destined to die.
What could be more important than one’s life in this world?
Thus, Lin Lang had absolutely no intention of begging for his life. He merely stared venomously at Ling Han, as if he wanted to completely remember this guy who had caused him to lose his life.

“Once you leave this place, you’re destined to die as well!” he said balefully. “Although I’m the Imperial Son, my talent and cultivation level can’t compare to Lin Xuan. If I die, he’ll definitely guess that you’re the murderer. At that time, when Lin Xuan makes a move, no one will be able to save you!”

Lin Xuan was the most outstanding Imperial Son of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan. He had long since become an elite of the Sect Master level, and added with the might of the Imperial Son, who in the world could stop him?
Ling Han humphed, and once again blasted Lin Lang into bits, “You don’t have to worry about
that!”
Peng, with this punch, Lin Lang was really killed, and there was no second chance for him to
start over.
The Substitution Seal had already been used up.
This battle ended, and Ling Han had already achieved ten victories. He was the first to obtain the right to leave the Multiple Headed Island.
“Young warrior, you are the first person to win ten victories, so you have a chance to choose whether to accept the last challenge.” A person from the Multiple-Headed Tribe called Ling
Han over.
“What challenge?” Ling Han asked.
“Challenging one’s own limits,” the multi-headed person said.
“What’s the reward for winning?” Ling Han asked again. Merely a battle would be too boring.
The multi-headed person said calmly, “It can allow you to cultivate a technique that allows you to have multiple minds.”
What! Ling Han said this soundlessly, unable to conceal the excitement in his heart.

During the ancient times, there were a great many large clans that wanted to obtain the profound secrets of the Multiple-Headed Tribe of cultivating multiple minds, but it was said that none of them had succeeded. Now, the Multiple-Headed Tribe had taken the initiative to say that they wanted to teach this kind of secret technique, so how couldhe not be tempted?
“All right!” Ling Han nodded, his face full of smiles. He was naturally unafraid of any -challenge.
He began the final challenge, but when he entered into the arena, he did not discover who else
had entered.
What about his opponent?
Yi!
Ling Han felt his body shudder, as if something had brushed past him. Then, he saw a human
figure forming in front of him.
In a short while, this person was completely revealed.
It was actually another Ling Han !
Ling Han finally understood. His final opponent was himself.

This was awkward, and the result was that he would only be killed time and time again.
However, Lin Lang did not beg for mercy.
As the Imperial Son, he did not lose control even in this kind of situation, and he was also very clear that under the rules of the arena, one of the two of them was destined to die.
What could be more important than one’s life in this world?
Thus, Lin Lang had absolutely no intention of begging for his life.
He merely stared venomously at Ling Han, as if he wanted to completely remember this guy who had caused him to lose his life.
“Once you leave this place, you’re destined to die as well!” he said balefully.
“Although I’m the Imperial Son, my talent and cultivation level can’t compare to Lin Xuan.
If I die, he’ll definitely guess that you’re the murderer.
At that time, when Lin Xuan makes a move, no one will be able to save you!”
Lin Xuan was the most outstanding Imperial Son of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan.
He had long since become an elite of the Sect Master level, and added with the might of the Imperial Son, who in the world could stop him?
Ling Han humphed, and once again blasted Lin Lang into bits, “You don’t have to worry about
that!”
Peng, with this punch, Lin Lang was really killed, and there was no second chance for him to
start over.
The Substitution Seal had already been used up.
This battle ended, and Ling Han had already achieved ten victories.
He was the first to obtain the right to leave the Multiple Headed Island.
“Young warrior, you are the first person to win ten victories, so you have a chance to choose whether to accept the last challenge.” A person from the Multiple-Headed Tribe called Ling
Han over.
“What challenge?” Ling Han asked.
“Challenging one’s own limits,” the multi-headed person said.
“What’s the reward for winning?” Ling Han asked again.
Merely a battle would be too boring.
The multi-headed person said calmly, “It can allow you to cultivate a technique that allows you to have multiple minds.”
What!
Ling Han said this soundlessly, unable to conceal the excitement in his heart.

During the ancient times, there were a great many large clans that wanted to obtain the profound secrets of the Multiple-Headed Tribe of cultivating multiple minds, but it was said that none of them had succeeded.
Now, the Multiple-Headed Tribe had taken the initiative to say that they wanted to teach this kind of secret technique, so how couldhe not be tempted?
“All right!” Ling Han nodded, his face full of smiles.
He was naturally unafraid of any -challenge.
He began the final challenge, but when he entered into the arena, he did not discover who else
had entered.
What about his opponent?
Yi!
Ling Han felt his body shudder, as if something had brushed past him.
Then, he saw a human
figure forming in front of him.
In a short while, this person was completely revealed.
It was actually another Ling Han !
Ling Han finally understood.
His final opponent was himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 4123: Multiple minds
paragraphs: Chapter 4123: Multiple minds
Ling Han smiled faintly. Was he going to defeat himself?
Come on then.
He was the first to move, launching an attack at his opponent.
Peng!
The manifested Ling Han also threw a punch in reply.
The fists of the two “people” crashed into each other, and as a massive power surged, teng, teng, teng, the two of them retreated thirteen steps at the same time. Not one step more, or one step less.
Yi, it really was the same.

Ling Han was astounded. Not only did this opponent that was manifested have the same appearance as him, but his power was also completely the same. They were both at 28 Heavens. Thus, the two of them exchanged a blow, and the outcome of the battle was completely undecided.
Interesting.
With equal power, would battle prowess be completely the same?
Ling Han charged over again. He activated the God Slaying Technique and launched an attack at his opponent.

What surprised him was that this opponent was actually also using the God Slaying Technique to counterattack. Furthermore, in terms of mastery of the God Slaying Technique, his opponent was not inferior to him at all.
Was he completely a mirror image?

Ling Han revealed a smile. He did not believe that this was only an illusion. Even if he possessed the same power, the same celestial technique, and the same battle experience as himself, would it be exactly the same?
‘Come!’

Ling Han continued to attack, using the Imminent Skyline. His movements were incredibly strange, seemingly ahead and suddenly appearing behind. However, this opponent was not outdone either. He similarly used the Imminent Skyline, and his speed was not the slightest bit inferior to Ling Han.
This was completely another Ling Han.
Was that really the case?
Ling Han channeled the Heavenly Dao Flames. This was a high-level energy that he had comprehended himself.
However, his opponent had also ignited the Heavenly Dao Flames, which were not inferior at all.

Ling Han knew that this “himself” was most likely formed from the thought of a Great Emperor. It was extremely likely that this was the True Dragon from before. To a Great Emperor, stimulating the Heavenly Dao Flames was naturally no big deal.
He used the Imperial Technique, and his opponent did the same. As long as he knew the Imperial Technique, his opponent would be able to manifest it.
En, it was a little different.

Ling Han couldn’t say what was different, but he had this feeling. On the surface, his opponent’s attack was exactly the same as his, and the might was also completely equal, but it was completely different from the inside.

After all, it was too easy for a Great Emperor to simulate the battle prowess of a Core Formation Tier cultivator. However, it was a completely different story if he wanted to completely imitate the Imperial Technique.
But no matter what, this opponent’s battle prowess was completely the same as his, so how was he supposed to defeat him?
Ling Han was in no hurry. Being able to exchange blows with himself was actually a rare experience.
He used all his ultimate moves, and confronted his opponent head-on, and his opponent did not cower at all, taking each move head-on.
If it was another person, they would definitely be at a disadvantage if they did this.
Why?

That was because his opponent was formed from the will of an elite, and would not be injured, but the original was different. It was a body of flesh and blood, and under such high- intensity resistance, it would definitely be at a great disadvantage.

Ling Han, on the other hand, was different. He had the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, which could disperse all attacks within a gap of six Heavens. Thus, he was also completely unharmed. Furthermore, his reserves of mystical power were close to unlimited, so it was completely unafraid for him to fight a drawn-out battle.

‘Fight, fight, fight. Ling Han was fighting to his heart’s content. This kind of opponent was evenly matched with him, and there was absolutely no need for him to worry about killing his opponent with too much power. He could go all out. This feeling was really too amazing.
As he saw it, this was not a challenge at all, but rather a reward, so that he could better understand himself, and find out his shortcomings.
This battle lasted for a day and a night. Ling Han had already gained a further understanding of “himself”, and there was no further need for him to use this kind of opponent to temper
himself.
All right, it was time to call it a day.

Ling Han blasted out a barrage of murderous aura, but his opponent was completely unaffected. En, this was not a living being at all, but rather the manifestation of a Great Emperor Tier-level intent. Naturally, he would not be affected by the barrage of murderous
aura.
Where was the Primal Chaos Celestial Core?
It was useless. The reason was the same. His opponent was not a cultivator at all, all right?
Ling Han channeled Destructive Energy, and this time, his opponent was completely
stupefied.
It could not be simulated.

If Lin Lang was still alive, he would know why. That was because the Destructive Energy had surpassed nine stars, and could not be touched by even a Great Emperor. Then, even if this was the handiwork of the True Dragon, how could it possibly be simulated?
Ling Han used Destructive Energy as an attack technique, and the effect was instantaneous. His opponent couldn’t simulate it and was instantly at a disadvantage.
It was being consumed bit by bit, and in less than half an hour, it was completely destroyed.
He had won!

A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had really gained too much this time. With himself as his opponent, he corrected some minor details of his battle prowess, and he would soon be able to obtain the means to cultivate multiple minds, which would undoubtedly elevate his battle prowess to another level.
“Congratulations, young man.” The multi-headed person from before appeared. He chuckled, and stretched out a hand to point at Ling Han’s forehead. Instantly, a series of seals
rose up in Ling Han’s mind.
Was this the secret of developing multiple minds?
Ling Han felt like his head was about to explode. This was too complicated. For the moment,
he could not understand at all.
However, it didn’t matter. He had all the time in the world.
Ling Han obtained a permit to travel to the next island, and redeemed some energy crystals.
Then, their team set out, heading towards the third island.
“What, you obtained the method to cultivate multiple minds?” When the large black dog
heard this, he immediately howled. This was too exciting.
Chi Menghan and Song Lan’s eyes also lit up. Even they were tempted by this kind of
technique.

Most importantly, if one cultivated multiple minds, not only could they increase their battle prowess, they could also save their lives. For example, if one burned the Celestial Core, their cultivation level would directly drop. However, if one cultivated multiple minds, then having one less Celestial Core would still be fine.
Ling Han smiled and said, “We’re all comrades in the same boat. We’ll share our hardships, and we’ll also share our fortunes. I’ll teach you this secret technique.”
When these words fell, even Chi Menghan was slightly shocked. Just how generous was this?
If it was her, would she be willing to share this kind of precious technique?
She didn’t know.
Ling Han took out the seals in his mind and shared them with everyone. All of a sudden, the entire ship became quiet. Everyone was studying these seals. The secret of forming multiple
minds was hidden within.
Time slowly passed, and the ship was still silent. Everyone was assembling these seals.

High-level celestial techniques were not directly taught in the form of words, but rather the profound mysteries of heaven and earth were displayed in the form of seals, because great dao was soundless, and great dao was invisible. It could only be understood, but could not be
described.

Ling Han cleared his mind, and only focused on these seals, wanting to sort out the clues. Three days later, he combined these seals, turning them into an incomplete seal. This was the profound mystery that formed multiple minds. However, this was not complete.

There was a seal that turned into a stretch of language, telling Ling Han that this was a very casual deduction that “he” had made about the multiple minds of the Multiple-Headed Tribe. He had not put too much effort into it, so it was not definite whether this could form
multiple minds.
F***, wasn’t this just playing around with him?
Ling Han believed that this should be the study of that True Dragon.
The first batch of Divine Beasts of the ancient era were comparable to the existence of a Great
Emperor. Even if it was just a casual deduction, it should be very awesome.
Ling Han could only think that way.

chapters.title: Chapter 4124: Third Island
paragraphs: Chapter 4124: Third Island
The True Dragon, just assume that all this was set up by the first True Dragon in the universe. He had deduced the secret of the Multiple-Headed Tribe, which could form multiple minds.

Ling Han cultivated accordingly. Then, he discovered that this was really something that the True Dragon had casually deduced. It had all kinds of flaws. In many places, when he was cultivating accordingly, it suddenly broke off, and he could not continue.

Thankfully, his comprehension ability was high enough. Furthermore, the True Dragon had already constructed the large framework for this secret technique. Even if there was a slight gap in the minor details, he could resolve it with his own comprehension ability.

Another ten days passed, and Ling Han finally stopped. A faint smile appeared at the corners of his lips. He had a comprehensive understanding of the True Dragon’s train of thought. The Multiple-Headed Tribe was a blessed creation of the heaven and earth. They were born with multiple minds, and this was something that no race could compensate for. Thus, no matter what method they used, they could not truly create multiple minds.
-Unless you were even more awesome than the heaven and earth, and could defy the heavens and change your fate.

It was not that this kind of elite did not exist in the world, and that was the Ancestral King. But for the Ancestral King, he was already standing at the peak of heaven and earth, crushing the Regulations, so what need was there for him to have another mind?
It was completely meaningless!
Thus, the True Dragon had only done so on a whim, going to deduce the profound secrets of the Multiple-Headed Tribe. He had not put in any effort at all.
His solution was to temporarily replicate a mind. This could increase both battle prowess and life-saving abilities, because the true and false mind could be switched.
Of course, it was easier said than done. Only people like the Ancestral King, who had penetrated the profound secrets of heaven and earth, could come up with unique ideas and create solutions.
This could indeed increase battle prowess by a little, but definitely not to the extent of defying the heavens.
Ling Han sighed. It couldn’t be helped. This was only a random deduction from the True Dragon, so it couldn’t possibly be incredibly awesome.
All right, at least he had learnt an amazing technique. Most importantly, this replicated mind had a considerable confusion effect. Who knows, it may have extraordinary effects.
Why was the head a vital point?
That was because the mind existed. However, if the mind could be transferred to another place, then there was actually no difference between the head and the hands and feet.

This secret technique created by the True Dragon could not only replicate a mind, but also allow two minds to temporarily exchange. Thus, as long as the replicated mind was placed in the chest, abdomen, and other positions, the head naturally would not be a vital point for the moment.
Interesting, truly interesting. This was deceiving the heaven and earth.
He roughly knew the general idea, but it would not be so easy to carry it out. He would have to consider it carefully.

Ling Han began to steer the large ship, heading towards the third island. The ship had the coordinates of the next destination. As long as they advanced towards this destination, they would only need about five days’ time, and they would be able to reach the third island.

Chi Menghan, the large black dog, and Chi Mengshan were all cultivating hard the Mind Replication Technique. Meanwhile, Ling Han controlled the ship by himself. In any case, as long as they didn’t encounter any sea beasts, it naturally wouldn’t be a problem. He could control it perfectly by himself.

This time, their journey was extraordinarily smooth. They did not encounter any strong winds, nor did they encounter any powerful sea beasts – they did encounter some sea beasts, but they were only at the level of the Core Formation Tier, and were easily killed by him.
Five days later, the third island was within sight.
Ling Han was extremely curious. What kind of island was this?
After making a small circle, Ling Han finally found the harbor, and steered the ship there.
His eyes swept over the island, and he had already spotted the residents of the island.
It was not a giant, nor was it the Multiple-Headed Tribe, but rather… a member of the Demon Race.

The Demon Race was a very large tribe. As long as they were Demonic Beasts, they could be categorized as the Demon Race. However, when the entire Demon Race was added together, their population was only equal to that of humans, and added together, they occupied 80% of the population of the entire universe.
The remaining members of the Giant Tribe, Dwarf Tribe, Elven Tribe, Stone Golem Tribe, and so on occupied the remaining 20% of the population.

Ling Han saw the Wolf Tribe, Tiger Tribe, and Goat Tribe. In the primitive world, a goat was naturally no match for a tiger, but once they had stepped onto the path of cultivation, the Goat Tribe would no longer have any disadvantage against the Tiger Tribe.

The ship docked at the coast, and Ling Han handed over his credentials. They were examined by a Wolf Tribe member, and after he passed, he was told what kind of competition he had to win on this island to be able to pass.

This time, it was not as bloody as the Multiple Headed Island, where many people had to die to be able to pass. Of course, it was not as harmonious as the Giant Island, where they only had to wolf down the food, and they would be able to pass the test. Instead, they had to participate in a hunting competition.
The first place would pass, and as for the second place, hoho, they could only wait for the next chance.

In a hunting tournament, it was naturally a competition to see who could kill more prey, and this tournament would be conducted in the form of a competition between teams. In the end, the results would also be calculated in terms of teams, and the strongest team would win. Because only Ling Han’s team had arrived at the Demon Race Island, they needed to wait for a while longer. At least eight more teams had to come, before the hunting competition would
begin.
Coincidentally, the large black dog and the others were also in the process of comprehending, so he might as well give them some more time.
After a few days, more and more ships arrived.
What surprised Ling Han was that the second to arrive was actually not Baili Che’s team.

This was not strange, because Ling Han had previously seen a few extremely powerful young people, and every one of them had an aura that was not inferior to Baili Che. Presumably, they were also Imperial Sons. Thus, it was a little strange that the team they led could surpass Baili
Che.
At this time, Chi Menghan and the others had more or less grasped the preliminary level of the mind cloning technique. They didn’t need to spend all day studying it.
When they found out about the tournament events on this island, they were all eager to give it
a try.
They didn’t need to meaninglessly kill people they didn’t even know. This feeling was really
not bad.
After waiting for a few more days, the number of teams that had arrived had reached as many as nine. This meant that the first hunting competition could begin.
The Demon Race gathered the nine teams and informed them that the competition would begin tomorrow morning.

On the second day, the nine teams gathered. In total, there would be ten teams participating in the tournament, and the tenth team was made up of the Demon Race on the island. “The rules are very simple. In total, there will be three days’ time to hunt fierce beasts on the island, and in the end, the number of points will be calculated according to the number and level of Demonic Beasts killed by each team. The team that gets the first place in total will win the right to travel to the next island, and will also win three energy crystals,” a Demon Race
member said.
“The tournament… has no restrictions,” he continued.
This caused the expressions of the nine teams of outsiders to change. That was because this meant that the teams could also kill each other.

“Hehe, everyone came in from the outside, so there’s no need to kill each other, right?” a purple-haired young man said with a smile. “Furthermore, though the first place can set out first, even if you’re the first to reach the fourth island, you’ll probably still have to wait for the others to come later. For the sake of three energy crystals, there’s no need to risk your life.”
“That’s right. We will compete fairly, and only kill wild beasts,” someone continued, expressing their agreement.
The Demon Race member from before smiled, and said, “As far as I know, the first team to reach the fourth island can obtain a nine-star Spirit Diagram!”

They did not encounter any strong winds, nor did they encounter any powerful sea beasts – they did encounter some sea beasts, but they were only at the level of the Core Formation Tier, and were easily killed by him.
Five days later, the third island was within sight.
Ling Han was extremely curious.
What kind of island was this?
After making a small circle, Ling Han finally found the harbor, and steered the ship there.
His eyes swept over the island, and he had already spotted the residents of the island.
It was not a giant, nor was it the Multiple-Headed Tribe, but rather… a member of the Demon Race.
The Demon Race was a very large tribe.
As long as they were Demonic Beasts, they could be categorized as the Demon Race.
However, when the entire Demon Race was added together, their population was only equal to that of humans, and added together, they occupied 80% of the population of the entire universe.
The remaining members of the Giant Tribe, Dwarf Tribe, Elven Tribe, Stone Golem Tribe, and so on occupied the remaining 20% of the population.
Ling Han saw the Wolf Tribe, Tiger Tribe, and Goat Tribe.

In the primitive world, a goat was naturally no match for a tiger, but once they had stepped onto the path of cultivation, the Goat Tribe would no longer have any disadvantage against the Tiger Tribe.
The ship docked at the coast, and Ling Han handed over his credentials.
They were examined by a Wolf Tribe member, and after he passed, he was told what kind of competition he had to win on this island to be able to pass.
This time, it was not as bloody as the Multiple Headed Island, where many people had to die to be able to pass.
Of course, it was not as harmonious as the Giant Island, where they only had to wolf down the food, and they would be able to pass the test.
Instead, they had to participate in a hunting competition.
The first place would pass, and as for the second place, hoho, they could only wait for the next chance.
In a hunting tournament, it was naturally a competition to see who could kill more prey, and this tournament would be conducted in the form of a competition between teams.
In the end, the results would also be calculated in terms of teams, and the strongest team would win.
Because only Ling Han’s team had arrived at the Demon Race Island, they needed to wait for a while longer.
At least eight more teams had to come, before the hunting competition would
begin.
Coincidentally, the large black dog and the others were also in the process of comprehending, so he might as well give them some more time.
After a few days, more and more ships arrived.
What surprised Ling Han was that the second to arrive was actually not Baili Che’s team.
This was not strange, because Ling Han had previously seen a few extremely powerful young people, and every one of them had an aura that was not inferior to Baili Che.
Presumably, they were also Imperial Sons.
Thus, it was a little strange that the team they led could surpass Baili
Che.
At this time, Chi Menghan and the others had more or less grasped the preliminary level of the mind cloning technique.
They didn’t need to spend all day studying it.
When they found out about the tournament events on this island, they were all eager to give it
a try.
They didn’t need to meaninglessly kill people they didn’t even know.
This feeling was really
not bad.
After waiting for a few more days, the number of teams that had arrived had reached as many as nine.
This meant that the first hunting competition could begin.
The Demon Race gathered the nine teams and informed them that the competition would begin tomorrow morning.
On the second day, the nine teams gathered.
In total, there would be ten teams participating in the tournament, and the tenth team was made up of the Demon Race on the island.
“The rules are very simple.

In total, there will be three days’ time to hunt fierce beasts on the island, and in the end, the number of points will be calculated according to the number and level of Demonic Beasts killed by each team.
The team that gets the first place in total will win the right to travel to the next island, and will also win three energy crystals,” a Demon Race
member said.
“The tournament… has no restrictions,” he continued.
This caused the expressions of the nine teams of outsiders to change.
That was because this meant that the teams could also kill each other.
“Hehe, everyone came in from the outside, so there’s no need to kill each other, right?” a purple-haired young man said with a smile.
“Furthermore, though the first place can set out first, even if you’re the first to reach the fourth island, you’ll probably still have to wait for the others to come later.
For the sake of three energy crystals, there’s no need to risk your life.”
“That’s right.
We will compete fairly, and only kill wild beasts,” someone continued, expressing their agreement.
The Demon Race member from before smiled, and said, “As far as I know, the first team to reach the fourth island can obtain a nine-star Spirit Diagram!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4125: Poisonous Fruit
paragraphs: Chapter 4125: Poisonous Fruit
Spirit Diagram, and it was a nine-star one at that!
When these words fell, quite a number of people’s eyes immediately lit up, but those Imperial Sons were completely unmoved, and did not look excited.
How could it be that the Imperial Clan would be short of top grade Spirit Diagrams?
But it should be known that Imperial Sons were only a minority, after all. This kind of reward was enough to move the majority.

Meanwhile, Ling Han desired it the most. His Celestial Core was only marked with five Regulations, and he was in desperate need of even more top-grade Spirit Diagrams. Wasn’t this all prepared for him?

Hopefully, there would still be top grade Spirit Diagrams on the subsequent islands, which would allow him to mark all the space of the Celestial Core, and he would be able to break through to the fourth level of the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han asked Chi Menghuan some simple questions. This Imperial Daughter didn’t hide anything from Ling Han, telling him what he wanted to know.

Every Imperial Clan had nine top grade Spirit Diagrams. Why were there only nine? It was clear that there were far more than nine types of Nine Star Energy. Very simple, even Ancestral Kings could only communicate with nine top grade high-level energies, and there was an upper limit.

Thus, every Imperial Clan only had nine top grade Spirit Diagrams, but this was already enough. Only those at the level of Imperial Son would be able to combine the Nine Cauldrons, and only those at the level of Imperial Son would be able to inscribe the nine top grade Regulations.
In battle, grasping too much high-level energy did not have much meaning. Ordinarily, two to three types would be enough.
This was also one of the reasons why the Great Emperor hadn’t plundered the inheritances of other Imperial Clans after achieving dao.

Ling Han could only feel rueful about the deep roots of the Imperial Clans. The clansmen really only needed to cultivate. As long as their natural talent was high enough, they could completely cultivate to Saint Tier in the Imperial Clan before coming out. If they could bring the Imperial Weapon with them, they would completely be able to sweep aside all opposition in the world.
“Then let the competition begin!” With a command from the Demon Race member from before, this hunting competition began.
Instantly, teams set out one after another, entering into the boundless mountains.
The mountains were extremely primitive, and the roars of dragons and tigers could be heard everywhere, making one panic just from hearing them.
The teams gradually dispersed. At present, it had not reached the point where they would be fighting each other.
Ling Han took the lead, and after walking for a while, the first prey appeared ahead of them.
“F***, retreat!” Ling Han swept an eye over, and hurriedly stopped the large black dog that was about to make a move.

“Motherf*cker, True Self Tier?” The large black dog inhaled sharply as well. There was a panther-shaped vicious beast lying in front of him. It had probably just had its fill and was in a state of rest.
Thankfully, Ling Han managed to stop it in time. Otherwise, if it had just boldly rushed forwards, it would definitely have been killed with a single palm strike.
“Retreat.”
They circled around. Thankfully, this fierce beast had not been awakened, so it naturally did not attack them.
The team travelled further, and not too long later, they discovered a second fierce beast.
However, this was still the level of the True Self Tier.
Another turn… they encountered a third True Self Tier great beast. Furthermore, this time, the fierce beast had also discovered them, and began its pursuit. It was a complete mess.

Thankfully, both Ling Han and Chi Menghan had grasped movement techniques that were at least Saint-level. Their speed was astonishingly fast, and was not inferior to that great beast at all. Only then did they, together with the other two people and one dog, manage to escape from the clutches of its paws.

“No way, all the fierce beasts here are True Self Tier?” the large black dog said with its tongue sticking out. If that was the case, then what was the point of hunting? They were the ones being hunted, all right?
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, “We’ll try to find that team from the Demon Race.”
“That’s right!” Chi Menghan nodded. “They won’t assign us an impossible mission, so let’s see what the Demon Race will do.”
They stopped hunting, and instead went to find that team from the Demon Race. After spending half a day’s time, they successfully found it.

At this time, this team of Demon Race just happened to encounter a fierce beast. Of course, it was a True Self Tier-level beast, but this team that was completely made up of Core Formation Tiers did not retreat. Instead, they drew out their spears and bows. With a command, the ten of them moved to attack at the same time.
Shua, shua, shua! All of a sudden, spears and arrows rained down on that fierce beast.
With the strength of a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier, wouldn’t it be a piece of cake for him to throw over a dozen spears and shoot several arrows at once?

Once the attack was launched, the fierce beast was naturally alerted, but at this moment, it was already too late for it to dodge. It raised its claws and swatted at those spears and arrows. With the strength of the True Self Tier, swatting these things aside was naturally a piece of
cake.
However, this was not the case.

These spears and arrows didn’t seem to have been fired by Core Formation Tiers. They possessed a terrifying penetrating ability, and they easily tore through the force of the fierce beast’s attacks and continued to pierce through it.
Pu!

The vicious beast was hit, and it was as if it were in extreme pain, causing it to jump around madly. And at this time, those Demon Race members all retreated, making the vicious beast completely unable to find a target to vent its anger on.
After jumping around madly for a while, that fierce beast lost all signs of life, and fell heavily onto the ground, no longer able to move.
He was dead.
He died just like that?

“F***, cheating, how shameless!” The large black dog gritted his teeth. This was too ridiculous, wasn’t it? Ten Core Formation Tiers launched a volley of attacks at the same time, and they actually killed a True Self Tier-level fierce beast?
Who would believe that? Who was he kidding!
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he began to recall all the details of the Demon Race’s attack just now. After a while, he said, “If the islanders didn’t cheat, then the problem
lies with their weapons.”

“That’s right,” Chi Menghan said with a nod. She pointed at the Demon Race members who were retrieving their weapons, and said, “These should be special weapons that can penetrate the defenses of True Self Tier.”
“So that’s how it is!” The large black dog was infuriated. They actually dared to trick him?
“Let’s go and snatch it!” it shouted.

“All right, we’ll go snatch it!” Ling Han laughed loudly. The rule of this hunting competition was that there were no rules. Thus, it was completely possible to snatch the weapons of the Demon Race. Perhaps, this was the only way to pass.
The team of five charged out. Since they knew how powerful this team of Demon Race was, what need was there for them to be wary?

Sure enough, the group of five only managed to dodge a volley of attacks from the Demon Race team before charging right up to them. The strength of both sides were on two completely different levels, and these Demon Race members were instantly defeated. Ling Han did not kill anyone. This was only a tournament, and even these Demon Race beings were only manifestations of a single thought from an elite. However, precisely because he had not killed anyone, those Demon Race members actually took the initiative to reveal their secrets. As it turned out, the reason why these weapons could kill a True Self Tier great beast was only because the spears and arrows were stained with the liquid of a fruit.
This kind of fruit grew on the island. It was not common, but it was not rare either. If one searched carefully, they would definitely be able to discover it.
Those Demon Race cultivators described the appearance of the fruit in detail, and Ling Han and the others left. Of course, they still confiscated the weapons. There was no reason to
return them.

The group of five searched for a while in the mountains and forests, and sure enough, they discovered the fruit that the Demon Race had mentioned. They followed the method of the Demon Race, and stabbed the tip of spears and arrows into the fruit. It was enough to dip it in some fruit juice, and this would become a deadly weapon.
