chapters.title: Chapter 4126: Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram
paragraphs: Chapter 4126: Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram

Ling Han and his group brought this kind of weapons with them, and soon discovered a True Self Tier fierce beast. They launched a sneak attack on it, and this was naturally discovered by the fierce beast. However, the weapons that had been stained with the special fruit fluid were incredibly powerful, and easily killed the beast.
“This… do such fruits really exist in this world?” Ling Han asked Chi Menghan. This was an Imperial Daughter, so she was definitely more knowledgeable than him.
Chi Menghan shook her head at first, and after a while, she said, “Unless it’s a Saint Fruit, which has complete Regulations, and only would that be able to produce such an effect.”
Previously, what they had found was a Saint Fruit?
Of course not.
In any case, this was a world that had been formed from the thought of a Great Emperor elite. What miracle was not decided with a single thought of this elite? Logic? Was there any need?
“Whatever, let’s continue hunting.”

On their way, they searched for that kind of special fruit, and continuously soaked the spears and arrows that they had used in the fruit juice. In this way, True Self Tier-level fierce beasts were completely no match for them.
Three days quickly passed, and they had also reaped many rewards.

The hunt ended, and everyone reunited. A considerable number of teams had already lost members, and all of them looked crestfallen. However, there were also teams that had ensured the completeness of their team, appearing to be filled with confidence.
Obviously, some teams still hadn’t figured out how to kill the True Self Tier fierce beasts, while some teams found the trick and produced completely different results.
“This is absolutely impossible to pass!”
“How can Core Formation Tiers defeat True Self Tier?”
The teams that had not found the trick began to complain, but there was a True Self Tier Demon Race elite standing here. They only dared to whisper quietly, not daring to raise their voices.
After a while, the members of the Demon Race came over. The results of the various teams had already been calculated.
“First place goes to Ling Han’s team,” the Demon Race member said.

“What!” A few teams that had been confident in themselves immediately jumped up. They had initially been certain that their team would win, but they had not thought that the reality would be so unexpected.
The Imperial Sons’ eyes immediately swept over, focusing on Ling Han.
For three consecutive times, Ling Han’s team was the first to pass. This was not only a matter of strength, but also luck.
Could it be that this guy was the one who was blessed by the fortune of heaven and earth?
When they thought of this, these Imperial Sons all showed animosity.

That’s right. They could afford to overlook the nine-star Spirit Diagram, but the True Dragon of Fortune was something that they could not give up. This concerned them, as well as the prosperity of the entire clan for many years to come.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned. In this ancient site, who did he need to fear?
“We doubt the authenticity of this result, and request to check the kill records,” a very assertive young man said.
“Hoho, you all are not qualified.” That Demon Race member directly refused.
This was a manifestation of a thought from the True Dragon. Naturally, it was incredibly proud, and there was no need for it to be wary of anyone.
Bringing three energy crystals and a dragon scale fragment, Ling Han and the others boarded the large ship again, heading towards the fourth island.
This time, they encountered powerful wild beasts on the sea again. Those spears, bows and arrows were completely ineffective against these wild beasts.
True enough, this was only a game created by the True Dragon. Regulations and whatnot were completely up to him, and he could change them however he liked.

Thankfully, they did not lack energy crystals now. After activating the Azure Dragon Shield and blasting the Golden Dragon Cannon, they had forcefully carved out a path of blood. After a seven-day journey, they had found the fourth island.

Mist filled the air, enshrouding the entire island. To say nothing of the fact that the residents on the island could not be seen clearly, they did not even know where the harbor was. Forget about it. If they got a little closer, they could just open the Azure Dragon Armor in the worst case scenario. They wouldn’t be afraid even if they crashed into the reef.

When Ling Han steered the ship and barged into the fog, he shockingly discovered that the dragon scale shards on him were beginning to light up. This dispelled the fog, allowing him to see the scenery ahead of him.
Not long after, he found the harbor, but there was no one here.
“Strange, is this a ghost city?” The large black dog scratched his head.
“Strictly speaking, we are in a ghost realm in the first place,” Ling Han said.
“That’s right.” The large black dog nodded.
Chi Menghan and Song Lan were both rendered speechless. Should they be discussing ghosts with a serious expression at this moment?
They went ashore, and sure enough, they discovered a Spirit Diagram in a house at the end of the harbor.
“Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram.” Chi Menghan glanced at it, then immediately nodded and said, “A Nine Star Spirit Diagram that can communicate with high-level water-element energy.”

She and Chi Mengshan didn’t need to learn this Spirit Diagram anymore. However, this didn’t stop them from making another copy. After all, even with the Chi Clan’s bloodline, not all of them were completely suitable for cultivating the nine top-grade Spirit Diagrams passed down by Ancestral King Donglin.
Wasn’t it good to have another option?
Ling Han took the original diagram, while Chi Mengshan and Song Lan made copies respectively. The large black dog could ask Ling Han for it, but Chi Menghan didn’t need it for
herself. She only needed to leave a copy for her clan.
They weren’t in a rush to cultivate the Spirit Diagram. Instead, they mulled over how they
were going to obtain the dragon scale shard on this island.
Most importantly, this was really a ghost city. There were no living creatures here, so how
would they know what to do?
Then let’s walk around first.
They set out on the island. However, the fog did not disperse, and they could not even see
their own fingers.
The dragon scales were useless now.
“In other words, the dragon scales can only help us reach the island.”
“If we don’t pass through the third island, we won’t be able to come to the fourth island, but that’s all. How we pass through the test of the fourth island will still have to depend on our
own abilities.”
“Then… let’s search!”

The five of them didn’t separate. The fog in this place was really too thick, bringing with it some kind of power of Regulation, affecting divine sense and even memory. Otherwise, with these people’s abilities, even if they couldn’t see their own fingers, as long as they walked over and over again, they would be able to construct the terrain of this place in their minds. However, they were truly at a loss now. They had absolutely no idea how to search. They barged around randomly, walking around in this confusing formation. It was completely
based on luck.
Chi Menghan and her sister didn’t need to cultivate the Spirit Diagram, so they led the team. Ling Han, the large black dog, and Song Lan just started cultivating the Spirit Diagram.
This was a top grade Spirit Diagram, and a complete one at that, so it was naturally extremely complex and difficult to grasp.
They weren’t in a hurry either. They would take things slowly.

Although Chi Mengshan sometimes showed her astonishingly early maturity, she was still a child, after all. She found this fog formation extremely interesting, and continuously giggled, not caring at all that they would be trapped here.

Time passed very quickly, yet they continued to wander around aimlessly on the island. However, Ling Han’s grasp of the Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram was gradually deepening, and he had already reached the level of wanting to put it into practice.
He stretched out his right hand, and communicated with the high-level energy. There was a seal flickering in his mind. Then, a layer of moon-white brilliance gradually appeared on his
hand, which was incredibly cold.
Mysterious Moon Energy!
Success.
Of course, he hadn’t grasped it too deeply yet, so there was only a single lump of energy. If he
reached the consummate level, it could wrap around his entire body. Furthermore, as his cultivation level increased, the amount of Mysterious Moon Energy he could communicate
with would also increase.
According to legends, the Saint from the Water Moon Race could easily pierce through a great planet with a single strike of the Mysterious Moon Energy.

The results of the various teams had already been calculated.
“First place goes to Ling Han’s team,” the Demon Race member said.
“What!” A few teams that had been confident in themselves immediately jumped up.
They had initially been certain that their team would win, but they had not thought that the reality would be so unexpected.
The Imperial Sons’ eyes immediately swept over, focusing on Ling Han.
For three consecutive times, Ling Han’s team was the first to pass.
This was not only a matter of strength, but also luck.
Could it be that this guy was the one who was blessed by the fortune of heaven and earth?
When they thought of this, these Imperial Sons all showed animosity.
That’s right.
They could afford to overlook the nine-star Spirit Diagram, but the True Dragon of Fortune was something that they could not give up.
This concerned them, as well as the prosperity of the entire clan for many years to come.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
In this ancient site, who did he need to fear?
“We doubt the authenticity of this result, and request to check the kill records,” a very assertive young man said.
“Hoho, you all are not qualified.” That Demon Race member directly refused.
This was a manifestation of a thought from the True Dragon.
Naturally, it was incredibly proud, and there was no need for it to be wary of anyone.
Bringing three energy crystals and a dragon scale fragment, Ling Han and the others boarded the large ship again, heading towards the fourth island.
This time, they encountered powerful wild beasts on the sea again.
Those spears, bows and arrows were completely ineffective against these wild beasts.
True enough, this was only a game created by the True Dragon.
Regulations and whatnot were completely up to him, and he could change them however he liked.
Thankfully, they did not lack energy crystals now.
After activating the Azure Dragon Shield and blasting the Golden Dragon Cannon, they had forcefully carved out a path of blood.
After a seven-day journey, they had found the fourth island.
Mist filled the air, enshrouding the entire island.
To say nothing of the fact that the residents on the island could not be seen clearly, they did not even know where the harbor was.
Forget about it.
If they got a little closer, they could just open the Azure Dragon Armor in the worst case scenario.
They wouldn’t be afraid even if they crashed into the reef.
When Ling Han steered the ship and barged into the fog, he shockingly discovered that the dragon scale shards on him were beginning to light up.
This dispelled the fog, allowing him to see the scenery ahead of him.
Not long after, he found the harbor, but there was no one here.
“Strange, is this a ghost city?” The large black dog scratched his head.
“Strictly speaking, we are in a ghost realm in the first place,” Ling Han said.
“That’s right.” The large black dog nodded.
Chi Menghan and Song Lan were both rendered speechless.
Should they be discussing ghosts with a serious expression at this moment?
They went ashore, and sure enough, they discovered a Spirit Diagram in a house at the end of the harbor.
“Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram.” Chi Menghan glanced at it, then immediately nodded and said, “A Nine Star Spirit Diagram that can communicate with high-level water-element energy.”
She and Chi Mengshan didn’t need to learn this Spirit Diagram anymore.
However, this didn’t stop them from making another copy.
After all, even with the Chi Clan’s bloodline, not all of them were completely suitable for cultivating the nine top-grade Spirit Diagrams passed down by Ancestral King Donglin.
Wasn’t it good to have another option?
Ling Han took the original diagram, while Chi Mengshan and Song Lan made copies respectively.
The large black dog could ask Ling Han for it, but Chi Menghan didn’t need it for
herself.
She only needed to leave a copy for her clan.
They weren’t in a rush to cultivate the Spirit Diagram.
Instead, they mulled over how they
were going to obtain the dragon scale shard on this island.
Most importantly, this was really a ghost city.
There were no living creatures here, so how
would they know what to do?
Then let’s walk around first.
They set out on the island.
However, the fog did not disperse, and they could not even see
their own fingers.
The dragon scales were useless now.
“In other words, the dragon scales can only help us reach the island.”
“If we don’t pass through the third island, we won’t be able to come to the fourth island, but that’s all.
How we pass through the test of the fourth island will still have to depend on our
own abilities.”
“Then… let’s search!”
The five of them didn’t separate.
The fog in this place was really too thick, bringing with it some kind of power of Regulation, affecting divine sense and even memory.

Otherwise, with these people’s abilities, even if they couldn’t see their own fingers, as long as they walked over and over again, they would be able to construct the terrain of this place in their minds.
However, they were truly at a loss now.
They had absolutely no idea how to search.
They barged around randomly, walking around in this confusing formation.
It was completely
based on luck.
Chi Menghan and her sister didn’t need to cultivate the Spirit Diagram, so they led the team.
Ling Han, the large black dog, and Song Lan just started cultivating the Spirit Diagram.
This was a top grade Spirit Diagram, and a complete one at that, so it was naturally extremely complex and difficult to grasp.
They weren’t in a hurry either.
They would take things slowly.
Although Chi Mengshan sometimes showed her astonishingly early maturity, she was still a child, after all.
She found this fog formation extremely interesting, and continuously giggled, not caring at all that they would be trapped here.
Time passed very quickly, yet they continued to wander around aimlessly on the island.
However, Ling Han’s grasp of the Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram was gradually deepening, and he had already reached the level of wanting to put it into practice.
He stretched out his right hand, and communicated with the high-level energy.
There was a seal flickering in his mind.
Then, a layer of moon-white brilliance gradually appeared on his
hand, which was incredibly cold.
Mysterious Moon Energy!
Success.
Of course, he hadn’t grasped it too deeply yet, so there was only a single lump of energy.
If he
reached the consummate level, it could wrap around his entire body.
Furthermore, as his cultivation level increased, the amount of Mysterious Moon Energy he could communicate
with would also increase.
According to legends, the Saint from the Water Moon Race could easily pierce through a great planet with a single strike of the Mysterious Moon Energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 4127: Gambling Island
paragraphs: Chapter 4127: Gambling Island
The team continued to wander around the Misty Island. Meanwhile, Ling Han worked hard on cultivating the Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram, hoping to reach the level of great
accomplishment in his grasp of it as soon as possible.
Another seven days later, Ling Han had completely mastered the Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram.

With a thought, his whole body was enshrouded in Mysterious Moon Energy. It was clear that every single bit of energy possessed boundless destructive power, yet there was a cool and elegant feeling about it, which was very contradictory.
Next, it was naturally extracting the Regulations of heaven and earth from the Mysterious Moon Energy, and branding them onto the Celestial Core.
Ling Han continued to work hard, and began to inscribe the sixth inscription.
This was fast. In a mere three days, he had succeeded, and was one step closer to the end of the late stage of the Core Formation Tier.
“Haha, I’ve found it!” Chi Mengshan’s laughter suddenly traveled over.
Yi!

Ling Han was astonished as he watched Chi Mengshan lead them into a stone house. There was only a stone table inside, and there was a piece of dragon scale on top of it. In other words, this was the so-called legendary fragment.
Success.
“Quick, quick, all of you come and praise me!” Chi Mengshan said proudly, her smile blossoming like a flower.
“Even a blind cat can come across a dead rat?” the large black dog teased.
“Stupid dog, you’re the blind cat here!” Chi Mengshan wasn’t one to suffer losses either.
Ling Han picked up the piece of the dragon scale, and said with a smile, “Alright, we can go to the next island.”

They continued onwards with the dragon scale shard in hand. This time was different. This fourth dragon scale fragment was exuding light, driving away the fog in the surrounding area, making them feel as if they had lit a candle in the darkness. Though it could not illuminate very far, it was enough for them to leave successfully.
In less than half an hour, they arrived at the harbor.
At this time, there were already many ships at the harbor. Clearly, other teams had passed through the hunting competition and arrived here.

“Little Han, should we sink all their ships?” the large black dog suggested. Unlike the other islands, which had elites keeping watch, there was not even a shadow here. They could completely cause great damage.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before shaking his head and saying, “No need. We’re powerful enough, so what’s there to be afraid of?”
“Well said!” Chi Menghan nodded, filled with praise for Ling Han.

Meanwhile, the large black dog thought for a moment, “That’s true. If we sink the ships, if there is still a need for ten teams to compete at the same time in the consecutive islands, we would also be trapped.”
This… the despicable dog’s way of thinking was indeed different from the rest. He was gauging the heart of gentlemen with his own mean measure.
They boarded the ship, then set out to sea.

When their ship had just sailed out of the harbor, a ship just happened to approach them. A man stood at the bow of the ship, and with the sea breeze blowing, his black locks fluttered, appearing to be wild and unrestrained.
Baili Che!
When he also discovered Ling Han, his expression immediately darkened.
This lowly person had repeatedly opposed him. In fact, even his goddess was on his ship. After so many days, who knew what kind of shady business he had done!

However, he didn’t dare to attack. Not only did Ling Han have a precious treasure, but he also didn’t dare to attack Chi Menghan. Chi Menghan was the strongest member of the Donglin Imperial Clan in the past tens of thousands of years. It was extremely likely that her battle prowess was above his.
Right now, he was the only Imperial Son on the ship. In a one-on-two battle, there was absolutely no chance for him to win.
Thus, he chose to endure, and merely stared coldly at Ling Han.

Ling Han didn’t take it to heart at all. His full attention was on the nine-star Spirit Diagram. As long as he obtained three more, he would be able to cultivate until the end of the late stage of the Core Formation Tier and break through to the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
As the ship sailed, they rode the winds and waves. After encountering a few more sea beasts, an incredibly strange scene appeared ahead of them.
“Come and take a look!”
The four people and one dog arrived at the bow of the ship, and looked ahead in disbelief. -The sea should be flat, but in this place, it was as if someone had bent it, forming a right angle!
In other words, in front of them, the sea was erected like a wall, and it was not just a short stretch, but rather an endless stretch.
“The Great Emperor’s handiwork is truly astonishing!”
This “wall” was too high. Thus, though they could see it now, they still travelled for a few more hours before finally arriving at the foot of the “wall”.
“What should we do? Should we just crash into it like this?” the large black dog asked.
“Crash, crash, crash!” Chi Mengshan was in high spirits. In her eyes, it didn’t matter even if the ship capsized. Worse come to worst, she could just swim back.
“Let’s give it a try,” Ling Han said in a deep voice. He slowed down the speed of the ship.

No matter how slow it was, it was only a few meters away. The large ship crashed into the wall of seawater, and with a huge tremor, the bow of the ship was raised. Then, the entire ship was also raised upwards.
Thankfully, they were all elites. A clash of this level was naturally not taken seriously, and they were all standing steadily.
Boom, the large ship completely sailed onto the “wall”, which was the ocean on the other
side.
Ling Han and the others were shocked to discover that their current sea level was the normal one, and the previous stretch had turned into a right angle, like a wall.
Interesting.
They gradually sailed away, but the sea wall behind them was still astonishingly high. After a
whole few hours, it finally disappeared from sight.
“What a strange place.”
“I’ve never seen such a scene before.”
“This is an eye-opener.”
Chi Mengshan sighed, “If I had known, I would have played for a while longer.”
They continued to advance, and not long after, a fifth island appeared ahead of them.
Ling Han steered the ship closer, searched for a harbor, and then docked there.
This time, it wasn’t a ghost island. There were people at the harbor.
They showed their proof of identity, and after verifying everyone’s identity, they were allowed to dock the ship and go ashore.
Ling Han asked around about how to pass through this island, and the result was… a gamble.
This was a large casino. As long as one won enough chips, they would be able to obtain the shard of the dragon scale and leave this island. Furthermore, it was fine as long as only one
person in the team passed.
However, if the entire team was wiped out, the entire team would have to work on the island for a year, earn enough chips, and begin a new gambling competition.
“Just how bored was this True Dragon Emperor?” Ling Han couldn’t help but mock.

Chi Menghan and the others were also rendered speechless. The Great Glutton Tournament on the Giant Island, as well as the game of hide-and-seek on the Misty Island that could only be won through luck, and the competition among the “Kings of Gamble” here… There were indeed too many things to criticize.
They landed on the island. There was a massive casino in the center of the island, and there
were many residences surrounding this casino.
The rules were very simple. At the beginning, everyone would have 1000 chips, and then the first person to win 100,000 would be able to pass.
Moreover, the first person to pass would also receive a Spirit Diagram as a reward!
A nine-star Spirit Diagram.
From the fourth island onwards, there would be great benefits.
Ling Han was instantly filled with fighting spirit. Furthermore, once they lost all their chips,
they would have to work here for a year, and that naturally was definitely not allowed.
Thus, they could only win, and could not lose.

Since this was an island of gamblers, they naturally couldn’t just randomly find a gambling table to sit down at. Otherwise, they would easily lose all their chips. Just look at Chi Mengshan, who had placed all her chips on the gambling table the moment she sat down. In the end, she had lost all her chips.

chapters.title: Chapter 4128: Ice Spirit Diagram
paragraphs: Chapter 4128: Ice Spirit Diagram
Since it was a gambling island, there were naturally many different ways to play.

There were the simplest gambles on dice rolls, and there were also complicated card games. In any case, any gamble was possible. If one won the bet of a hundred thousand, he would be able to win and pass.
Because Chi Mengshan had already lost all her chips, the remaining three people and one dog all became cautious.
“Little Han, what should we play?” the large black dog asked.
“Let’s take a look first,” Ling Han said.

He and the large black dog arrived at the gambling table. There were many gamblers around them, and all of them were betting with bloodshot eyes. The shouts of “big” and “small” were so loud that even their eardrums hurt.

Ling Han watched from the sidelines. Since he was going to use a small stake to obtain large wins, and use 1000 chips to win 100,000, he definitely couldn’t rely on luck all the way. Thus, he wanted to see if he could increase his chances of winning with his strength.
He listened to the dealer shake the dice, place them, and then place his bets.
After observing for a while, he said mentally, “Big.”
Open, it was Small.
Again.
It was another bet. Ling Han guessed that it would be Big, but in the end, it was Small.
Time after time, Ling Han shockingly discovered that he had actually guessed wrongly every time.
This was too strange. No matter how bad their luck was, they would still be able to guess correctly once, right?
Ling Han simply chose not to listen to the movement of the dice, and simply guessed casually. However, he still made ten wrong guesses, and did not guess correctly even once.
‘Heh, strange.’
He asked the large black dog about this, and sure enough, the large black dog also lost ten times in a row. He hadn’t guessed correctly even once.
“That’s easy now. As long as you bet on Small, I’ll bet on Big,” the large black dog said.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “In that case, only one person can win to 2000. The other person will lose everything. What’s the difference between this and you directly handing your chips over to me?”
That’s right.

The large black dog pondered for a moment. This was indeed the case. After all, they only had 1000 chips each, so they could only send one person to obtain 2000 chips. If they lost all of their chips, they would definitely be screwed over again.
Even if a team had ten people, it was useless. They would only be able to get 10,000 chips, which was still far from 100,000 chips.
“That won’t do.”
“Change tables.”
Both man and dog were cunning, and it had always been them screwing others over. How could they be screwed over by others?
Thus, they roamed around, examining one gambling table after another, summarizing the patterns. This was the way to win.
However, they couldn’t keep observing either. They would also make small bets. In any case, the lowest bet here was a chip, which was enough for them to try many times.

If they placed their bets separately, the only result would be a loss, and if they placed their bets on the same gambling table, and it was something that was either win or loss, such as betting on Big or small, whoever placed the lesser bet would win more times.
There was definitely a pattern to this as well.

Ling Han and the large black dog continued to experiment, and gradually gained some understanding. However, if it was just the two of them, even if they called Chi Menghan and Song Lan over, they would only be able to win 3000 chips, at most.
“Thus, we can only wait for others to come.”
“Thankfully, we didn’t sink their ships.” The large black dog broke out in a cold sweat.
“So, don’t keep trying to harm others. If you’re not careful, you might end up trapping yourself as well,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog could only remain silent in embarrassment.
They weren’t in a hurry either. In any case, they weren’t in a hurry, so they cultivated the Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram while waiting for others.

A few days later, people began to arrive, one after another, but the teams that had an Imperial Son were not among them. Clearly, this stage of the Misty Island did not depend on natural talent, comprehension ability, strength, or the like at all. It was all a gamble of luck. Thus, even with an Imperial Son standing guard, there was nothing they could do.

A great many people believed in their own luck, and did not observe too much either. Immediately, they began to place their bets. Ling Han and the large black dog also took advantage of the opening to begin, and sat at the same table as these people.
They had observed for a good few days, and concluded that there was a pattern. Was this something that a hothead could compare to?

Very soon, these people paid the price for their rashness. They had lost all of their wealth, and were forced to work in the casino to earn new chips. Of course, they could also choose not to do so, and wait for their own teammates to win, or steer their ships and return the way they
came.

Meanwhile, Ling Han and the large black dog gradually had more chips in their hands. From 1000, they slowly increased to 2000, 3000, and as more and more people came, the speed of their winning also increased without decrease.

Seeing that the two of them, one man and one dog, were gradually entering an optimal state, Chi Menghan and Song Lan couldn’t be bothered to scheme anymore. They placed their hopes of victory on them.

10,000, 20,000, 30,000… Ling Han and the large black dog were resolutely advancing towards victory. Upon calculation, the chips in their hands were actually supplied by other outsiders. If it was 30,000 chips, that meant that at least 30 people had already lost completely.
Forty thousand, fifty thousand!

After reaching 50,000, Ling Han and the large black dog didn’t need to trick others anymore. The two of them made a bet, transferring the stakes of one person to the other person, and naturally gathered 100,000 chips.
“Congratulations! Congratulations!” The people from the casino came out and gifted Ling Han a dragon scale fragment, as well as a Spirit Diagram. This was the reward for the first
team to win.
“Ice Spirit Diagram.”
Ling Han couldn’t contain his joy. This was another nine-star Spirit Diagram, which made him extremely satisfied.
They left, and boarded the large ship, heading towards the sixth island.

Ling Han still allowed Chi Menghan and Song Lan to copy the Ice Spirit Diagram. He was extremely calm about cultivation techniques, because he was always confident in his own strength. Even if they all cultivated the same cultivation technique, he believed that he would definitely be the strongest.
He had once stood at the pinnacle of the Genesis World, invincible in the world, so he naturally had this kind of confidence.

“Yi, Blackie, what are you doing?” Ling Han couldn’t help but ask curiously when he saw the large black dog writing non-stop on a piece of paper. ‘You don’t have to make a copy anyway.’ “It’s said that after leaving this place, one’s memories would be erased. Grandpa Dog doesn’t believe in such nonsense, so I’ll write down all my experiences during this period of time. When I get out, won’t I know everything with a single look?” the large black dog said proudly.

Ling Han laughed loudly, “If it was really so simple, then the secret of the True Dragon Abyss would have long since been revealed to the world. How could it be possible that innumerable batches of people would enter, yet no one knew the exact details of the test?” “Why?” the large black dog countered. He picked up the small notebook that he had written, and flipped to the very front. “Look, the truth is all here – yi!”
It cried out in surprise, because the words on the paper had disappeared, as if it had always been a blank piece of paper.
Ling Han sighed, and said, “The world we are in is completely under the control of the True Dragon’s intent. Do you think you can match the power of a Great Emperor?”
The large black dog sighed dejectedly. He thought that he had come up with a good idea, but

since he could think of this, there had been no shortage of prodigies in history, so how could they not have thought of it? Thus, even if there were other means that could record experiences during this period of time, such as the recording of the Galaxy Network connection device. This had all the functions of the optical computer.
However, it was clear that even if it was recorded, it would be erased, or even destroyed.
In the world created by the Great Emperor, they naturally could only act according to the rules set by the Great Emperor.
Hold on, if that was the case, Chi Menghan’s replicated Spirit Diagrams would also be unable
to be brought out.

sentences.text: Chapter 4128: Ice Spirit Diagram
Since it was a gambling island, there were naturally many different ways to play.
There were the simplest gambles on dice rolls, and there were also complicated card games.
In any case, any gamble was possible.
If one won the bet of a hundred thousand, he would be able to win and pass.
Because Chi Mengshan had already lost all her chips, the remaining three people and one dog all became cautious.
“Little Han, what should we play?” the large black dog asked.
“Let’s take a look first,” Ling Han said.
He and the large black dog arrived at the gambling table.
There were many gamblers around them, and all of them were betting with bloodshot eyes.
The shouts of “big” and “small” were so loud that even their eardrums hurt.
Ling Han watched from the sidelines.
Since he was going to use a small stake to obtain large wins, and use 1000 chips to win 100,000, he definitely couldn’t rely on luck all the way.
Thus, he wanted to see if he could increase his chances of winning with his strength.
He listened to the dealer shake the dice, place them, and then place his bets.
After observing for a while, he said mentally, “Big.”
Open, it was Small.
Again.
It was another bet.
Ling Han guessed that it would be Big, but in the end, it was Small.
Time after time, Ling Han shockingly discovered that he had actually guessed wrongly every time.
This was too strange.
No matter how bad their luck was, they would still be able to guess correctly once, right?
Ling Han simply chose not to listen to the movement of the dice, and simply guessed casually.
However, he still made ten wrong guesses, and did not guess correctly even once.
‘Heh, strange.’
He asked the large black dog about this, and sure enough, the large black dog also lost ten times in a row.
He hadn’t guessed correctly even once.
“That’s easy now.
As long as you bet on Small, I’ll bet on Big,” the large black dog said.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “In that case, only one person can win to 2000.
The other person will lose everything.
What’s the difference between this and you directly handing your chips over to me?”
That’s right.
The large black dog pondered for a moment.
This was indeed the case.
After all, they only had 1000 chips each, so they could only send one person to obtain 2000 chips.
If they lost all of their chips, they would definitely be screwed over again.
Even if a team had ten people, it was useless.
They would only be able to get 10,000 chips, which was still far from 100,000 chips.
“That won’t do.”
“Change tables.”
Both man and dog were cunning, and it had always been them screwing others over.
How could they be screwed over by others?
Thus, they roamed around, examining one gambling table after another, summarizing the patterns.
This was the way to win.
However, they couldn’t keep observing either.
They would also make small bets.
In any case, the lowest bet here was a chip, which was enough for them to try many times.

If they placed their bets separately, the only result would be a loss, and if they placed their bets on the same gambling table, and it was something that was either win or loss, such as betting on Big or small, whoever placed the lesser bet would win more times.
There was definitely a pattern to this as well.
Ling Han and the large black dog continued to experiment, and gradually gained some understanding.
However, if it was just the two of them, even if they called Chi Menghan and Song Lan over, they would only be able to win 3000 chips, at most.
“Thus, we can only wait for others to come.”
“Thankfully, we didn’t sink their ships.” The large black dog broke out in a cold sweat.
“So, don’t keep trying to harm others.
If you’re not careful, you might end up trapping yourself as well,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog could only remain silent in embarrassment.
They weren’t in a hurry either.
In any case, they weren’t in a hurry, so they cultivated the Mysterious Moon Spirit Diagram while waiting for others.
A few days later, people began to arrive, one after another, but the teams that had an Imperial Son were not among them.
Clearly, this stage of the Misty Island did not depend on natural talent, comprehension ability, strength, or the like at all.
It was all a gamble of luck.
Thus, even with an Imperial Son standing guard, there was nothing they could do.
A great many people believed in their own luck, and did not observe too much either.
Immediately, they began to place their bets.
Ling Han and the large black dog also took advantage of the opening to begin, and sat at the same table as these people.
They had observed for a good few days, and concluded that there was a pattern.
Was this something that a hothead could compare to?
Very soon, these people paid the price for their rashness.
They had lost all of their wealth, and were forced to work in the casino to earn new chips.
Of course, they could also choose not to do so, and wait for their own teammates to win, or steer their ships and return the way they
came.
Meanwhile, Ling Han and the large black dog gradually had more chips in their hands.
From 1000, they slowly increased to 2000, 3000, and as more and more people came, the speed of their winning also increased without decrease.
Seeing that the two of them, one man and one dog, were gradually entering an optimal state, Chi Menghan and Song Lan couldn’t be bothered to scheme anymore.
They placed their hopes of victory on them.
Ling Han and the large black dog were resolutely advancing towards victory.
Upon calculation, the chips in their hands were actually supplied by other outsiders.
If it was 30,000 chips, that meant that at least 30 people had already lost completely.
Forty thousand, fifty thousand!
After reaching 50,000, Ling Han and the large black dog didn’t need to trick others anymore.
The two of them made a bet, transferring the stakes of one person to the other person, and naturally gathered 100,000 chips.
“Congratulations!
Congratulations!” The people from the casino came out and gifted Ling Han a dragon scale fragment, as well as a Spirit Diagram.
This was the reward for the first
team to win.
“Ice Spirit Diagram.”
Ling Han couldn’t contain his joy.
This was another nine-star Spirit Diagram, which made him extremely satisfied.
They left, and boarded the large ship, heading towards the sixth island.
Ling Han still allowed Chi Menghan and Song Lan to copy the Ice Spirit Diagram.
He was extremely calm about cultivation techniques, because he was always confident in his own strength.
Even if they all cultivated the same cultivation technique, he believed that he would definitely be the strongest.
He had once stood at the pinnacle of the Genesis World, invincible in the world, so he naturally had this kind of confidence.

“Yi, Blackie, what are you doing?” Ling Han couldn’t help but ask curiously when he saw the large black dog writing non-stop on a piece of paper. ‘You don’t have to make a copy anyway.’ “It’s said that after leaving this place, one’s memories would be erased.
Grandpa Dog doesn’t believe in such nonsense, so I’ll write down all my experiences during this period of time.
When I get out, won’t I know everything with a single look?” the large black dog said proudly.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “If it was really so simple, then the secret of the True Dragon Abyss would have long since been revealed to the world.
How could it be possible that innumerable batches of people would enter, yet no one knew the exact details of the test?” “Why?” the large black dog countered.
He picked up the small notebook that he had written, and flipped to the very front.
“Look, the truth is all here – yi!”
It cried out in surprise, because the words on the paper had disappeared, as if it had always been a blank piece of paper.
Ling Han sighed, and said, “The world we are in is completely under the control of the True Dragon’s intent.
Do you think you can match the power of a Great Emperor?”
The large black dog sighed dejectedly.
He thought that he had come up with a good idea, but
since he could think of this, there had been no shortage of prodigies in history, so how could they not have thought of it?
Thus, even if there were other means that could record experiences during this period of time, such as the recording of the Galaxy Network connection device.
This had all the functions of the optical computer.
However, it was clear that even if it was recorded, it would be erased, or even destroyed.
In the world created by the Great Emperor, they naturally could only act according to the rules set by the Great Emperor.
Hold on, if that was the case, Chi Menghan’s replicated Spirit Diagrams would also be unable
to be brought out.

chapters.title: Chapter 4129: Stargazing
paragraphs: Chapter 4129: Stargazing
Ling Han found Chi Menghan and told her about the situation.

Only after learning the Spirit Diagram could one truly grasp this kind of high-level energy and turn it into an instinct, and would not be unable to use it just because one’s memories had been erased.

This made things difficult. This was because Chi Menghan and her sister had already cultivated nine types of nine-star high-level energy, so they couldn’t cultivate any more top- grade Spirit Diagrams. This was the restriction of heaven and earth, and even the Ancestral King was no exception.
It could not be helped. They could only enter into the treasure mountain and return empty- handed.
Ling Han began to study the Ice Spirit Diagram. This was also a nine-star Spirit Diagram, and it was what he needed the most at this moment.

As expected, even if it was just for these two Spirit Diagrams, this trip was worth it. Ling Han, the large black dog, Song Lan all started to cultivate the Ice Spirit Diagram. Meanwhile, Chi Menghan and her sister were responsible for steering the ship.

At the beginning, Chi Mengshan had been tasked with this mission. However, who would’ve thought that this rascal was such a troublemaker? After discovering a True Self Tier sea beast, she actually took the initiative to steer the ship to battle it.

Of course, they were no match. Chi Menghan hurriedly pushed the girl aside, and went to control the ship herself. With the price of wasting two energy crystals, they finally broke free from this sea beast.
“Wa, it hurts!” Chi Mengshan covered her head with her hands. She had been struck by her sister again just then, and it was so painful that she gritted her teeth.
“If you continue to cause trouble, I’ll tie you up and use you as a seat cushion!” Chi Menghan said viciously. If she allowed this brat to continue causing trouble, they would really die.
“Chi Mengshan, now that you have Brother-in-law, you don’t even have me in your heart anymore!” Chi Mengshan sighed as she spread her hands, looking very helpless.
Pa, she resolutely received another slap.
“Chi Menghan, you’ve changed. Where’s the sisterly affection that we talked about?” The silver-haired little lolita was still stubborn, so she was naturally beaten up violently again.
Ling Han smiled faintly, then closed his eyes again.
When they encountered the sea beasts just now, he naturally woke up from his seclusion. Now that the danger had passed, he had to start cultivating earnestly again.
His comprehension ability was too high. When the large ship arrived at the sixth island, he had also tentatively grasped this Spirit Diagram, and entered into a substantive state of cultivation.
This was truly astonishingly fast.
“What island is this?” Sensing that the large ship had docked, Ling Han walked out.
“Starry Island,” Chi Menghan replied.
“What?” Ling Han was startled. Orangutan Island? Was this island filled with orangutans?
Seeing Ling Han’s confused expression, Chi Menghan couldn’t help but smile. She knew that Ling Han had misunderstood.
However, when Ling Han walked out of the cabin door, he knew that he had been wrong. This island was filled with stars.
It was very strange. In other places, there was actually not even a single star. Only here, the stars shone brilliantly.
Forget about it. He would not investigate this kind of strange matter. In any case, it was all due to the handiwork of a Great Emperor.
The four people and one dog went ashore, and they went to investigate how they could obtain the legendary fragment.
“It’s simple. Just knock down one of the stars in the sky,” the island residents said.
Yi, striking down the stars in the skies, was that possible?

One had to realize that even though Saints could obliterate planets, they could only do so at close range. However, looking at the stars in the sky, even Saints wouldn’t be able to strike them down. How could minor characters like them do this?

“How is this possible?” Chi Menghan immediately shook her head as well. She had come from the Imperial Clan, so she was naturally even more familiar with the abilities of Saints. This was definitely an impossible task, unless the Ancestral King personally arrived. Only then would he be able to destroy a star with a single strike from an endless distance.
“That’s not right,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. “Pay attention to what that person has to say. He said to strike them down, not shatter them!”
What was the difference?
Chi Menghan faltered for a moment before coming to a realization.
How colossal were planets? Moreover, they were floating in the universe, so how could they be struck down? Thus, planets could only be destroyed, and couldn’t be struck down.
“Hence, this must not be a real star.” She nodded, expressing her agreement.
But the problem was, even if those weren’t real stars, with such a far distance, the force couldn’t possibly touch them, so how could it possibly hit them?
They went to ask the people on the island, but no matter who they asked, they were told to look at the stars.

“Look at the stars, look at the stars, what’s so interesting about the stars?” the large black dog mumbled. He felt that these people were really too funny. What could they understand from looking at the stars?
Yet Ling Han really found a comfortable position, and lay among the flowers, beginning to look at the stars in the skies.
“Little Han, have you gone stupid?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “Looking at the stars is the only clue right now, so we really have to understand something from looking at the stars.”
“Then Grandpa Dog should come and take a look as well.” The large black dog also lay down next to Ling Han, pretending to look at the stars.
“Sister, let’s go too.” Chi Mengshan pulled her sister over and lay down on the grass. However, she didn’t care about her image, but how could Chi Menghan not care? She only sat
down, but didn’t lie down.
Song Lan was also very reserved, and sat down on the grass.
All of a sudden, the four people and one dog were completely silent.
After ten minutes.
The large black dog couldn’t hold himself back any longer, and asked Ling Han, “Little Han,
did you see anything?”
“No.” Ling Han shook his head.
Another ten minutes passed.
“Little Han, did you see any anything?” the large black dog asked.
“No.”
Another ten minutes later, the large black dog had just opened its mouth, when Ling Han answered first, “No.”
“Che, Grandpa Dog hasn’t even asked yet, so how do you know what Grandpa Dog wants to
say?” the large black dog asked in boredom.
Ling Han chuckled, “That’s all you’ve got.”
The large black dog shut his mouth, and began to look at the stars again. However, after a short while, he couldn’t hold on any longer, and released a loud snoring sound.
Ling Han was unmoved. He merely looked at the starry skies. Since the islanders told them to look at the stars, these stars would definitely provide clues.
In a short while, Chi Mengshan had also fallen asleep. The little loli’s sleeping posture was extremely inelegant, as she continued to drool. Ling Han swept an eye over her, and couldn’t
help but smile.
Time passed slowly, and even Chi Menghan and Song Lan felt that they couldn’t see anything out of the ordinary. They both withdrew their gazes, and only Ling Han was still looking at
the sky.
With his personality, he would not turn back even if he had hit a wall. Since he was sure that there was some kind of profound mystery hidden in the stars in the skies, he would definitely
find out this profound mystery.
After one day and one night, even Ling Han’s vision was slightly blurred. He had just straightened his body and was about to move around, when he was startled.
Hold on, the positions of these stars had changed.
Ling Han tried to recall carefully. His memory was extremely terrifying, and he instantly
recalled all the details.
The stars had indeed been shifted, but the range was extremely small. Furthermore, only a
few of them had changed.
This kind of discovery caused Ling Han to feel energized. Though he did not know whether this would be of any use at present, it was still a good thing to have discovered something.
He lay down again, and carefully observed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4130: Ice Killing Celestial Finger
paragraphs: Chapter 4130: Ice Killing Celestial Finger

Those like Song Lan and the large black dog had long since lost interest, and though Chi Menghan was the Imperial Daughter, and did not lack patience, after so long, she also felt that the secret of striking down stars was not something that could be done just by looking up at the sky.
Could it be that if one looked at it for too long, those stars would be touched by their determination, and one of them would drop down on its own volition?
Er, if that was really the case, then the True Dragon from back then was really too mischievous.
Only Ling Han was watching extremely seriously and carefully. He was recording any subtle changes in those stars in the sky.

This place was indeed strange. There were no stars on the other islands. Not only were there stars here, but even in daytime, these stars could still be clearly seen, and were still dazzling. One day, two days, three days… Time slowly crept by. It was as if Ling Han had entered a meditative state. He continued to gaze at the stars without blinking.
“Little Han… hasn’t gone mad, has he?” the large black dog asked in confusion.
Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “This person’s willpower is as strong as iron, so how can he possibly go mad?”
“It’s not right to keep looking like this!” The large black dog said, “Beauty Chi, go and persuade this brat not to be so stubborn.”
“Why me?” Chi Menghan asked.
“Huh? Aren’t you two a couple?” the large black dog asked. However, he immediately started to run after saying this, afraid that he would be beaten to death.
As expected, Chi Menghan’s killing intent soared, but she didn’t chase after him.
She withdrew her gaze, and turned back to look at Ling Han. With her understanding of Ling Han, she was sure that Ling Han should have already figured out something.
Then they would just have to trust him and wait.
She looked towards Song Lan, and saw that Song Lan had long since turned into a fangirl. The gaze she directed at Ling Han was extremely gentle.
Oh no, the ninth greatest beauty of the galaxy had completely fallen.
Chi Menghan shook her head internally, and warned herself. She was determined to break through to the Imperial Path, and definitely could not be involved in romantic affairs.

In the blink of an eye, more than ten days had passed, and there were gradually more and more outsiders on the island. After all, it was not difficult to pass through the gambling island. As long as one was willing to bear with it and observe carefully, as long as one was not stupid, he would definitely be able to see the pattern.

A great many people were like Ling Han, lying on the ground and looking at the stars, but even more people gave up after watching for a while. Instead, they switched to dealing with the residents of the island. What if the key lay with these people?

This was also one of the ideas. Thus, Song Lan and the large black dog went to develop relations with these islanders, and see if they could obtain a breakthrough from these people. However, regardless of whether one had a good or shallow relationship with the islanders, there was only one way to leave the island, and that was to strike down the stars, and how one would strike down the stars would still be found from looking at the stars.
Twenty, thirty days, a month later, Ling Han finally came back to his senses from looking at the stars.

He got to his feet and exercised his muscles and bones. He felt as if his whole body had rusted. “Little Han, have you really become stupid?” The large black dog shook his shoulder, looking like he pitied him.
“Go.” Ling Han sent its paws flying. This damn dog was mocking him again, “I have some ideas now.”
“Oh, what?” The large black dog was instantly energized.
Chi Menghan, who was beside him, was just about to speak, but when she heard Ling Han’s words, she suppressed her urge.
“These stars are constantly moving, and formed into seals,” Ling Han said.
“What?!” Chi Menghan and the large black dog both exclaimed in shock. This was because they had also looked at the stars before. What part of them looked like a seal?

“Some stars are misleading. They haven’t changed for an entire month. After removing these stars, you’ll be able to see one seal after another,” Ling Han said. Of course, he had only come to this conclusion after looking at them for an entire month. This was a complete cycle.

He explained his insights in detail to Chi Menghan and the large black dog. All the star movements were already stored in his mind, but he couldn’t show them directly. Thus, they could only take these hints with them for their own observation.
Not long after, Chi Mengshan and Song Lan also returned. When they heard Ling Han tell them the clues, they began to look at the stars again.
Meanwhile, Ling Han entered the second step, extracting information from these seals. Merely the seals alone couldn’t explain anything.
Three days later, his eyes suddenly snapped open.
This was an Imperial Technique!
Ice Killing Celestial Finger.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited. This True Dragon really knew how to play. He actually passed on the inheritance of the Imperial Technique in this manner; who would have
thought?
He immediately began to cultivate. If he did not grasp it, then after he left, the relevant memories would be erased, and he would never remember that he had once obtained this Imperial Technique.
Day after day passed, and Ling Han also slowly digested this Imperial Technique, entering into the stage of practice.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He continued to attack, yet he was still unable to grasp the technique. He was unable to unleash its full might.
There was no need to rush. This was the Imperial Technique, so it naturally could not be so easily mastered.

Ling Han controlled his temper. What he lacked the least was patience. In seclusion in the Genesis World, cultivators would spend billions of years, or even epochs, at the drop of a hat. What did a few days or a few months count as?
Another dozen over days passed, and Ling Han gradually gained some insight. When he raised his finger, a cold light flickered at the tip of his finger, and broken seals could vaguely be seen
surging, causing one’s heart to palpitate.
He had finally learnt the basics.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and once again began to cultivate.

Another 10 days later, Chi Menghan and the others also watched a full cycle of star shifting, ending the stage of watching the stars. They began to extract the seals from within. This speed would vary from person to person. Furthermore, if one’s comprehension ability wasn’t enough, it was possible that they wouldn’t be able to complete it in their entire lives.

The cold light on Ling Han’s finger became larger and larger. At the beginning, it was only the size of a rice grain, but now, it had reached the size of a fist. However, this Imperial Technique was meant to shoot out the cold light and turn it into a colossal attack, but Ling Han was still unable to shoot out this cold light no matter how hard he tried.
This meant that he still had to continue cultivating, and had not completely grasped the essence of this Imperial Technique.

Peng!

rock.

blasting a hole in the rock was really not easy.
As expected of the Imperial Technique, awesome.

was wrapped in ice.

naturally maximized.

the stars in the skies.

sentences.text: Chapter 4130: Ice Killing Celestial Finger

Those like Song Lan and the large black dog had long since lost interest, and though Chi Menghan was the Imperial Daughter, and did not lack patience, after so long, she also felt that the secret of striking down stars was not something that could be done just by looking up at the sky.
Could it be that if one looked at it for too long, those stars would be touched by their determination, and one of them would drop down on its own volition?
Er, if that was really the case, then the True Dragon from back then was really too mischievous.
Only Ling Han was watching extremely seriously and carefully.
He was recording any subtle changes in those stars in the sky.
This place was indeed strange.
There were no stars on the other islands.
Not only were there stars here, but even in daytime, these stars could still be clearly seen, and were still dazzling.
One day, two days, three days…
Time slowly crept by.
It was as if Ling Han had entered a meditative state.
He continued to gaze at the stars without blinking.
“Little Han… hasn’t gone mad, has he?” the large black dog asked in confusion.
Chi Menghan shook her head, and said, “This person’s willpower is as strong as iron, so how can he possibly go mad?”
“It’s not right to keep looking like this!” The large black dog said, “Beauty Chi, go and persuade this brat not to be so stubborn.”
“Why me?” Chi Menghan asked.
“Huh?
Aren’t you two a couple?” the large black dog asked.
However, he immediately started to run after saying this, afraid that he would be beaten to death.
As expected, Chi Menghan’s killing intent soared, but she didn’t chase after him.
She withdrew her gaze, and turned back to look at Ling Han.
With her understanding of Ling Han, she was sure that Ling Han should have already figured out something.
Then they would just have to trust him and wait.
She looked towards Song Lan, and saw that Song Lan had long since turned into a fangirl.
The gaze she directed at Ling Han was extremely gentle.
Oh no, the ninth greatest beauty of the galaxy had completely fallen.
Chi Menghan shook her head internally, and warned herself.
She was determined to break through to the Imperial Path, and definitely could not be involved in romantic affairs.
In the blink of an eye, more than ten days had passed, and there were gradually more and more outsiders on the island.
After all, it was not difficult to pass through the gambling island.
As long as one was willing to bear with it and observe carefully, as long as one was not stupid, he would definitely be able to see the pattern.
A great many people were like Ling Han, lying on the ground and looking at the stars, but even more people gave up after watching for a while.
Instead, they switched to dealing with the residents of the island.
What if the key lay with these people?
This was also one of the ideas.
Thus, Song Lan and the large black dog went to develop relations with these islanders, and see if they could obtain a breakthrough from these people.

However, regardless of whether one had a good or shallow relationship with the islanders, there was only one way to leave the island, and that was to strike down the stars, and how one would strike down the stars would still be found from looking at the stars.
Twenty, thirty days, a month later, Ling Han finally came back to his senses from looking at the stars.
He got to his feet and exercised his muscles and bones.
He felt as if his whole body had rusted.
“Little Han, have you really become stupid?” The large black dog shook his shoulder, looking like he pitied him.
“Go.” Ling Han sent its paws flying.
This damn dog was mocking him again, “I have some ideas now.”
“Oh, what?” The large black dog was instantly energized.
Chi Menghan, who was beside him, was just about to speak, but when she heard Ling Han’s words, she suppressed her urge.
“These stars are constantly moving, and formed into seals,” Ling Han said.
“What?!” Chi Menghan and the large black dog both exclaimed in shock.
This was because they had also looked at the stars before.
What part of them looked like a seal?
“Some stars are misleading.
They haven’t changed for an entire month.
After removing these stars, you’ll be able to see one seal after another,” Ling Han said.
Of course, he had only come to this conclusion after looking at them for an entire month.
This was a complete cycle.
He explained his insights in detail to Chi Menghan and the large black dog.
All the star movements were already stored in his mind, but he couldn’t show them directly.
Thus, they could only take these hints with them for their own observation.
Not long after, Chi Mengshan and Song Lan also returned.
When they heard Ling Han tell them the clues, they began to look at the stars again.
Meanwhile, Ling Han entered the second step, extracting information from these seals.
Merely the seals alone couldn’t explain anything.
Three days later, his eyes suddenly snapped open.
This was an Imperial Technique!
Ice Killing Celestial Finger.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited.
This True Dragon really knew how to play.
He actually passed on the inheritance of the Imperial Technique in this manner; who would have
thought?
He immediately began to cultivate.
If he did not grasp it, then after he left, the relevant memories would be erased, and he would never remember that he had once obtained this Imperial Technique.
Day after day passed, and Ling Han also slowly digested this Imperial Technique, entering into the stage of practice.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
He continued to attack, yet he was still unable to grasp the technique.
He was unable to unleash its full might.
There was no need to rush.
This was the Imperial Technique, so it naturally could not be so easily mastered.
Ling Han controlled his temper.
What he lacked the least was patience.
In seclusion in the Genesis World, cultivators would spend billions of years, or even epochs, at the drop of a hat.
What did a few days or a few months count as?
Another dozen over days passed, and Ling Han gradually gained some insight.
When he raised his finger, a cold light flickered at the tip of his finger, and broken seals could vaguely be seen
surging, causing one’s heart to palpitate.
He had finally learnt the basics.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and once again began to cultivate.

They began to extract the seals from within.
This speed would vary from person to person.
Furthermore, if one’s comprehension ability wasn’t enough, it was possible that they wouldn’t be able to complete it in their entire lives.
The cold light on Ling Han’s finger became larger and larger.
At the beginning, it was only the size of a rice grain, but now, it had reached the size of a fist.

chapters.title: Chapter 4131: Star drop
paragraphs: Chapter 4131: Star drop
Xiu, with a tap of his finger, an ice dragon instantly blasted towards the skies.

However, no matter how prodigious Ling Han was, he was only a Core Formation Tier cultivator, after all. The maximum range of his attacks was far from touching the stars in the sky, and very soon, that ice dragon had exhausted all its energy and dispersed on its own.
But right at this moment, a star in the sky suddenly swayed. Xiu, it dropped down from the skies, crashing down in the direction of Ling Han.
F***, you can’t play around like that.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He had really struck down a star, but could this not be done? It wsa actually crashing down on his head. Was this really appropriate?
However, this star continued to burn as it flew downwards. When it landed on the top of Ling Han’s head, it was only the size of a fist. With a bang, it crashed into the ground in front of Ling Han.
Ling Han looked down and saw that there was already a pit in the ground, from which light smoke was presently seeping out.
He hurriedly dug out the meteorite from the ground. With a light squeeze, the outer shell of this meteorite shattered, revealing a jade-like transparent rock. It had an indescribable charm to it.
At the same time, the stars in the sky seemed to have received some kind of command, and actually all stopped, disappearing into the skies.
Yi, then were the other teams unable to pass?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple figures flew over, and there was no shortage of Imperial Son-level elites among them. Everyone’s eyes were focused on Ling Han, or more precisely, the jade in his hand.
They had all seen the star fall, and they had also seen the stars disperse. Immediately, they followed the tracks, and discovered that the person who had obtained this “star” was Ling Han.
Had this guy really knocked down a star?
“Ling Han, hand over what you have!” A purple-haired young man shouted. He was the Imperial Son-to-be of the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan, Shi Yuanzhen.
Instinctively, he thought that there was a great opportunity hidden in this jade.
Ling Han immediately put the jade away. Now was not the time to study it. He smiled faintly, “Why should I?”

“Hand it over for a fair competition. At that time, if you have the ability to suppress the masses, this naturally would still be yours,” another young man said. His name was Xu Jie, and he too came from the Imperial Clan.

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “This is clearly mine, so why should I hand it over to contend with you guys? How about this, you guys hand over all the Imperial Techniques that you’ve learnt, and we’ll have a fair competition. If I win, it’s mine, and if you guys win, it’s naturally still yours.”
These words caused Xu Jie’s face to flush red with anger, because his previous words were indeed very brainless.

However, to the Imperial Clan, everything in the world belonged to them. Thus, it was already very good that Ling Han was allowed to participate in the competition. In Xu Jie’s eyes, he had already relaxed the restrictions considerably, but Ling Han actually dared to fire a retort to his words?
“Do you really think that just because you have killed Lin Lang, you can be arrogant and condescending, and not even take the Imperial Clan to heart?” Xu Jie asked menacingly.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Then just try it out, and see if I can kill you!”

Xu Jie was rendered speechless again. His strength was at most on par with Lin Lang’s, and while he was strong, there was a limit to his strength. Thus, since Ling Han could kill Lin Lang, killing him wouldn’t be too difficult.
Most importantly, Ling Han possessed a precious tool that had been forged from Origin Gold, allowing him to firmly be invincible among his peers.
-Unless the Imperial Blood of Imperial Sons like them could be eternally ignited, how were they supposed to stand against the precious tool forged from Origin Gold?

Moreover, the heaven and earth here was suppressed by the True Dragon. They couldn’t even break through to the True Self Tier, so without the suppression of a major tier in cultivation level, how could they kill Ling Han?

“Ling Han, you are too arrogant.” Baili Che suddenly appeared, “I have to admit, your luck is nature-defying. You have obtained Origin Gold, and have even refined it into a precious tool. This indeed can make you invincible among your peers, but if we Imperial Sons join forces, do you think that precious tool would be able to protect you?”

“That’s right.” With this reminder, Xu Jie’s confidence instantly soared. In a one-on-one battle, no one could do anything to the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. However, there were quite a number of Imperial Sons, Imperial Sons-to-be, and members of Imperial Clans here. With their combined forces, how could it be that they would not be able to break through the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?
“Hand over that jade!” Shi Yuanzhen also shouted harshly.
“And the precious tool refined from Origin Gold!” Baili Che added.

This caused the other Imperial Clan members to frown. Had they gone too far? No matter who had the Origin Gold, they would protect it with their lives. Wasn’t this equivalent to forcing Ling Han to fight all out?

What they didn’t know was that Baili Che hated Ling Han very much, and was deliberately saying this to force Ling Han into desperate straits, so that he could fight to the death with Imperial Clan members like them.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖

But upon further thought, that was Origin Gold. Throughout history, there had never been an Ancestral King that had obtained it when they were young. If they could obtain it, they may really be able to defy the heavens and change their fate, and become the first person in the
Imperial Clan to become an Emperor.
Thinking of this, they did not speak.
Ling Han glanced at Baili Che. He naturally could tell that this was Baili Che’s scheme.
But even if he had not said these words, he had no plans to hand over the jade.
What right did he have?
“Haha, it’s just a battle, who’s afraid of who!” Ling Han said proudly. He had so many trump cards, so it was definitely no problem for him to protect himself.
“Then you are seeking your own death!” Shi Yuanzhen stated calmly, his killing intent
circulating.
These people were either Imperial Sons or Imperial Clan elites. The might of their combined forces could be said to be boundlessly terrifying. Who could not be killed?

“Stop!” Chi Menghan stepped forward, standing in front of Ling Han. Her white dress billowed in the gentle breeze, and there was an indescribable charm to it. She swept an eye over them, and said, “If you people want a battle, I’ll oblige!”
At this moment, her decisiveness could be seen. Though she was a rare prodigy of the Donglin Imperial Clan, she was definitely no match for so many Imperial Clan elites.
They were teammates, so at this time, they naturally had to stand together.
“That’s right. If you want to bully Little Han, you have to go through Grandpa Dog first!” The large black dog also stepped out, standing next to Chi Menghan.
Song Lan did not speak, and merely walked out quietly.
Though her strength could not even withstand a single blow from an Imperial Son, this was a
kind of attitude, a kind of determination.
“Brother-in-law, I support you too!” Chi Mengshan said, but didn’t walk out. “I’ll cheer you
on from here.”

“Fairy Chi, are you really going to share life and death with a lowly commoner?” Baili Che asked balefully. Though he loved Chi Menghan, the feelings he had poured on her were not reciprocated. With his temperament, he was naturally capable of coldly waving his sword to
sever these feelings.
Chi Menghan didn’t reply. However, there was a flash of light on her slender body, and she was already in battle mode.
“Good! Good! Good!” Baili che laughed loudly. In this great battle of romance, he had completely lost to Ling Han.
Since that was the case, then whatever he could not obtain… no one would be allowed to
obtain it!
“Everyone, let’s attack together!” he said.

All the great Imperial Sons nodded. For the sake of the Origin Gold, they were all willing to take a gamble. Furthermore, after they left this place, their memories would be erased. Thus, it would be fine even if they killed an Imperial Daughter, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 4132: Gentle Land
paragraphs: Chapter 4132: Gentle Land

Weng! A terrifying aura suddenly swept over, and another person had already appeared there. This was a white-bearded old man. His eyes swept over them, and he said, “This island has already closed. Everyone, leave immediately!”
Yi?
Previously, there had not been any situation of shooing people away. Why had things changed now that they were here?
True, the stars in the skies had all dispersed, which also meant that no one would be able to obtain the Icy Killing Celestial Finger, so what was the point of staying on the island?
Everyone was dissatisfied. It wasn’t easy for elites like them to gather together and possess the possibility of killing Ling Han, yet now they had to be stopped? But what could they do?

This old geezer was a True Self Tier cultivator. With a gap of a major tier between them, he would definitely be able to suppress them absolutely. Even Imperial Sons like them wouldn’t be able to reverse this.
Thus, though they were unwilling, they could only turn around and leave.
This battle ended soundlessly.
The white-bearded old man waved his hand, and with a leap, he instantly disappeared.

“Little Han, you actually shot down a star?” the large black dog exclaimed in shock. Previously, he had been pondering over the star movements, and had not seen the scene of Ling Han shooting down a star.
However, now that the stars in the sky had disappeared, and they had been notified to leave the island, the large black dog immediately guessed that it was Ling Han who had struck down the star.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
“Hiss, you are awesome.”
Chi Menghan and the others were also stunned. It was actually really possible to strike down a star in the sky?

Ling Han explained the situation, and only then did realization dawn on the three people and one dog. It was not that Ling Han was so awesome that he could really strike down stars, but rather the setting that the Great Emperor had made. As long as one had cultivated the Icy Killing Celestial Finger, they would only have to shoot it into the skies, and there would be a star falling.

They left, and boarded the ship after arriving at the harbor. The islanders had already provided the coordinates of the seventh island, and they only had to advance in this direction. However, they had just left the island, when they saw a few large ships encircling them.
At the bow of the ship, Baili Che, Xu Jie, Shi Yuanzhen, and the others all revealed baleful killing intent.
Since they couldn’t kill him on the island, they would surround him on the sea.
For the sake of the Origin Gold, they were all going all out.
“Old Black, get ready for battle,” Ling Han said darkly.

“All right!” The large black dog was in high spirits. In terms of individual battle prowess, he was definitely no match for the Imperial Son, but now that it was a battle on a ship, it was a completely different story.
Boom!
The Golden Dragon Cannon on Baili Che’s ship was the first to fire, blasting towards Ling Han’s ship.

Weng, the Azure Dragon Shield was activated in the nick of time, blocking this attack. Ling Han immediately fired back at him, while the large black dog steered the large ship into an extremely ugly course of advance, yet this caused the Golden Dragon Cannons on the other ships were unable to lock onto it.
The sea battle began, and Ling Han and his ship were instantly at a disadvantage in a battle of one against six.

There was nothing that could be done. Everyone’s ship was the same, with the Azure Dragon Shield and Golden Dragon Cannon installed. Thus, it was equivalent to seven people having the same abilities, but one of them would have to be ganged up on by six people. How could that be withstood?
Thus, Ling Han and the others naturally retreated as they fought. If they fought head-on, their only fate would be to capsize and fall into the sea.

Baili Che and the others pursued them relentlessly. It was rare for them to gather such a lineup now. If they did not take advantage of this opportunity to kill Ling Han, they would definitely be defeated one by one in future.
However, a massive wave suddenly rose up on the sea, and a sea beast appeared. It was a True Self Tier-level sea beast, which instantly changed the battle situation.
This was a boss.

to his forehead. It was precisely the piece that had turned into a meteorite and landed after
the star had fallen.
This was shockingly another Spirit Diagram!
Nine-star level, called Cold Mist Energy.
In these few days, he had just gotten some ideas, but it had not reached the point of being
able to cultivate it.

The original enemies had also let go of their grudges. Even the Imperial Clan members were no longer high and mighty, and had become acquainted with everyone else.
Just like that, a few days passed in a daze. Ling Han suddenly shivered, and a powerful chill
rose up in his heart.
What was wrong with him?

He was actually so intoxicated, and became so laidback. To say nothing of finding a way to leave, he didn’t even study the Cold Mist Spirit Diagram that he had just obtained. This concerned when he could break through to the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. With his strong pursuit of martial arts, he would actually be so sloppy?
That’s not right!

for a peaceful and quiet life.

Ling Han stood up and started to search around the island. Theoretically speaking, there
should be clues to leave this island.

As expected, to call this stage difficult, it really wasn’t difficult at all, but to call it easy, even
Chi Menghan’s willpower had been worn away by now, and she was still enjoying a peaceful life. Was it really easy?

thought of the True Dragon.

Yi?

Why had things changed now that they were here?
True, the stars in the skies had all dispersed, which also meant that no one would be able to obtain the Icy Killing Celestial Finger, so what was the point of staying on the island?

This old geezer was a True Self Tier cultivator.

Even Imperial Sons like them wouldn’t be able to reverse this.
Thus, though they were unwilling, they could only turn around and leave.
This battle ended soundlessly.
The white-bearded old man waved his hand, and with a leap, he instantly disappeared.
“Little Han, you actually shot down a star?” the large black dog exclaimed in shock.
