chapters.title: Chapter 4133: Complete preparation
paragraphs: Chapter 4133: Complete preparation
Ling Han and the others steered the ship away, heading towards the eighth island.

Chi Menghun, the large black dog, and the others still had lingering fear in their hearts. They were almost lost in their own thoughts. This was too dangerous. It should be known that they all had their own lofty aspirations, so they naturally did not want to be buried in a land of tenderness.

Of course, what Chi Menghan wanted was to break through to the Imperial Path, and as for the large black dog… becoming stronger was naturally one of his goals, but the reason for becoming stronger was only so he was better able to steal women’s undergarments.
To the large black dog, this was also a sacred and noble dream.

Meanwhile, Ling Han immersed himself in his comprehension of the Cold Mist Spirit Diagram. After mastering this Spirit Diagram, he only needed another top-notch Spirit Diagram to reach the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
A few days later, they had already arrived at the eighth island.

Ling Han was at a critical moment in his cultivation, so he didn’t disembark. Instead, he remained on the ship. Meanwhile, Chi Menghan and the others went to investigate first. If they could deal with it, they naturally wouldn’t need to trouble Ling Han.

Ling Han continued to gain enlightenment. Another few days passed, and he had successfully cultivated Cold Mist Energy. As he delivered his attack, the surroundings were filled with an ice-cold fog. Not only could it block divine sense and vision, but the ice-cold fog itself had terrifying destructive ability.

He had finally obtained eight Regulations of heaven and earth. A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. Although he had only inscribed the Regulations of heaven and earth on the Celestial Core, once he advanced into the True Self Tier, he would be able to truly grasp these Regulations, and turn them into his understanding.
At that time, only would Nine Star Energy be albe to unleash their true might.
He was just about to disembark to look for Chi Menghan and the others. Unexpectedly, he had just walked to the bow of the ship when he saw Chi Menghan and the others heading towards the harbor.
“What is it? Do you need me to deal with it if you can’t?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Hehe, you had best continue to stay on the ship,” Chi Menghan said with a grin. “Yi?”
The large black dog laughed loudly, “I’ve already taken care of it!”
“You?” Ling Han was surprised. It was actually the large black dog that had dealt with it. It could be imagined just how unreliable this test was.
“That’s right. It is Grandpa Dog.” The large black dog was extremely proud of himself. Ling Han looked at Chi Menghan and asked, “What’s the competition on the island?”
“Boasting and insult,” Chi Menghan said, unable to hide her smile.

Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. They were actually competing in this? No wonder the large black dog had been able to win. In terms of boasting and insulting others, if the large black dog was ranked second, who else would dare claim to be first?
“Here.” The large black dog tossed a piece of leather over.
“What is it?” Ling Han asked.
“Hehe, the last Spirit Diagram you need,” the large black dog said.
Ling Han was overjoyed. He had not thought that the large black dog would be so capable, to actually obtain a nine-star Spirit Diagram for him.
“Is this your reward for passing the test?”

“That’s right. Grandpa Dog has defeated eighteen people in a row, and is the first to charge out. Thus, isn’t it only a matter of course for me to obtain the Spirit Diagram?” the large black dog said with a smile.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “All right, you are indeed the best in this stage. No one can compare to you.”

He handed the jade he had previously obtained to the large black dog. He had already cultivated the Cold Mist Energy, and could now enter into the next stage. He only had to take another step further, and he would be able to break through to the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. At that time, if he encountered Baili Che, Xu Jie, and the others, he would kill them all.
The large ship continued to advance, heading towards the last island.
“If we can still be the first to pass through the ninth island, then wouldn’t the True Dragon of Fortune belong to us?” the large black dog asked excitedly.

With the blessing of fortune, it was equivalent to being favoured by the heaven and earth. Everything one did would be twice the result with half the effort, and he could also seek fortune and avoid calamity.
Chi Menghan shook his head, “I’m afraid that’s impossible.”
The silver-haired lolita continued, “Stupid dog, there’s only one True Dragon of Fortune!”

“Who said that?” the large black dog mumbled, “Didn’t all those who went out have their memories erased? Then, who knows, a considerable number of people may have obtained the True Dragon of Fortune together.”
Was there such a possibility?
“Let’s reach the ninth island first.”
Ling Han didn’t care. He took the newly obtained top-grade Spirit Diagram and began to comprehend it.
This was called the Torrential Wave Spirit Diagram, which also belonged to the Water Element.
Did that True Dragon practice water-element cultivation techniques?
Thoughts streaked through Ling Han’s mind, but he immediately put aside this unnecessary conflict and focused his full attention.
The ninth island was not far, and they would arrive in two days’ time.
They went ashore, and soon found out the conditions for passing through.
There was a rock on the island that could be used to test aptitude. Only those who had reached
at least five stars could pass.
This was no longer a team competition, but rather an individual test.
After reaching five stars, one could enter a Transfer Formation and head to the True Dragon
Secret Cave.
That’s right, it was just called the True Dragon’s Secret Cave.
“Aptitude appraisal stone?” Ling Han looked at Chi Menghan, and asked, “Is it the same as
the one in your clan?”
Chi Menghan nodded, “That should be the case.”

They arrived at the center of the island, and sure enough, there was a rock here. It looked very ordinary, but according to the islanders, when an attack landed, there would be light flickering. The greater the power of the attack, the more light would be emitted.
As expected, it wasn’t much different from the stone that belonged to the Donglin Imperial
Clan.
“You can only use your own power and techniques. You can’t use the Spirit Tool, Talisman Weapon, or Battle Armor.” An elder walked over and announced the rules to them.

Ling Han and the others all nodded. As long as they shot out five stars, they would be able to pass. For them, it was completely no difficulty at all, and there was no need for them to use weapons like Spirit Tool or the like to help.
“Grandpa Dog will go first.” The large black dog was the first to jump out. After accumulating power slightly, it delivered a palm strike.
All of a sudden, six streaks of light shone brilliantly. In fact, there was even a seventh flash of light flickering faintly, but in the end, it returned to silence.
Pseudo-seven stars aptitude.

Chi Menghan was astonished. She only knew that the large black dog was always joking around, and there was absolutely no seriousness about it. She had never thought that his natural talent in cultivation would be so awesome.
“Yi, despicable dog, you are really awesome!” Chi Mengshan also exclaimed in surprise.

“That’s right. Grandpa Dog is just hiding his strength,” the large black dog said smugly. “Our Donglin Imperial Clan has a female wolf, and is only a step away from Saint Tier. If she is a match for you, the wolf-dog hybrid she gives birth to would definitely be able to become a Saint Tier!” Chi Mengshan continued.
The large black dog’s expression instantly became even darker. What? He had to be paired
with a wolf?
Putting aside the fact that it only liked beautiful women, even if it really wanted to be matched, it would have to be a dog which was the same race as it, right?
‘Pei, pei, pei!’
Chi Mengshan also stepped forward to take the test. She easily shot out six stars, similarly
showing her astonishing natural talent in cultivation. She had come from the Imperial Clan, and even if she only looked like a little loli, she was overwhelmingly powerful.
Song Lan was the third. She had only achieved three stars, and was still very far from reaching
five stars.
Not all of the stunning beauties in the galaxy were as beautiful and naturally talented as Chi
Menghan.

Song Lan couldn’t help but feel disappointed. Firstly, her journey could only stop here, and no longer have any great opportunities, and secondly, she would be separated from Ling Han from now onwards. After they left, all the memories that they had shared together would be erased, and she was reluctant to part with them.
Chi Menghan didn’t speak any nonsense. She casually threw a punch, and instantly, six streaks of light lit up in unison. Even the seventh flashed faintly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4134: Dragon Essence
paragraphs: Chapter 4134: Dragon Essence
Chi Menghan had a seven-star aptitude, so a casual strike from her could deliver a result close to seven stars.
In any case, she knew what aptitude she had, and it was fine as long as she could pass. It was meaningless even if her results were too good.
Ling Han, on the other hand, wanted to know his own limits. Thus, he did not immediately act, but rather prepared himself.
What should he use?

The God Slaying Technique combined with the Destructive Energy was one option. However, if the Icy Killing Celestial Finger was paired with Ice Energy, it was also a good choice. Mainly, Ling Han’s present cultivation level was not high enough, so the gap between Saint
Technique and Imperial Technique could not be revealed.
Then let’s try the Icy Killing Celestial Finger. After all, it was learnt here.
Ling Han channelled the Imperial Technique, extracted Ice Energy, and boosted his hand with
it.
“He!” he exclaimed lightly, and tapped out a finger.
Pa, the ice dragon hit the rock, and immediately, multiple flashes of light flickered.
Eight flashes, no, nine flashes!
Chi Menghan’s beautiful eyes lit up. There were now eight streaks of light flickering, but the ninth streak was flickering continuously.
Hiss, this guy, when he had been in the Donglin Imperial Clan, he had only been an eight-star aptitude elite. Now, he had advanced another step further.
No, when this guy was in the Donglin Imperial Clan, he hadn’t used his full strength. Thus, he had only displayed an eight-star aptitude.
“The four of you have passed.” The old man beside them waved his hand. Among the five of them, only Song Lan had not passed the test.

On their way here, they had naturally formed a friendship. Ling Han and the others comforted Song Lan, and then the three of them and one dog continued onwards, arriving at a heavily guarded place. The guards were all True Self Tiers.
In this manner, even if the Imperial Sons did not hesitate to use the Substitution Seal to force their way in, it was probably still impossible for them to charge in.
The Transfer Formation was located here.
After Ling Han and the others entered, the Transfer Formation activated. Xiu, they arrived at another place.
This place… was indescribably beautiful.

They were in a flat area at the foot of a mountain, surrounded by lush green grass. There were still water droplets on the leaves, like celestial dew, and in the distance, white mist was rising, and white cranes could be seen dancing gracefully.
Green mountains and clear waters were a scene of peace and tranquility.
“Is this the True Dragon’s Secret Cave?” the large black dog murmured.

Chi Mengshan leaned close to her sister’s ear, and said, “Sister, this is a good opportunity. Now that the Ninth Beauty is gone, cast your charms, and get Brother-in-law as soon as possible!” “You definitely can’t go easy on him. Brother-in-law has a pseudo-nine-star aptitude, and is even more powerful than you. In the future, to say nothing of becoming a Saint, it’s even possible for him to become a Great Emperor!”

This was unlike the Imperial Clans, which had a natural curse, where it had never been heard that a Great Emperor would emerge from the Imperial Bloodline. Thus, though Ling Han came from an ordinary background, it was very possible that he would walk further than an Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter.
However, her voice wasn’t low, so not only did Chi Menghan hear her, but even Ling Han and the large black dog heard her clearly.
The large black dog chuckled, and said, “That’s right. Grandpa Dog’s brother is definitely peerless in the world. Why don’t you offer ‘buy one and get one free’? The two of you can marry over.”

These words were naturally an act of courting death. It was immediately thrashed by Chi Menghan and her sister. So what if its aptitude was pseudo seven stars? It was at a disadvantage in terms of cultivation level, and was beaten beyond recognition.
Ling Han didn’t step in to help. Who asked the large black dog to have such a toxic mouth? “Let’s look around. If this is the True Dragon’s Secret Cave, there might be treasures.”

According to legends, a considerable number of top-grade Great Herbs were related to Divine Beasts, such as Dragon Grass and Phoenix Blood Fruit. It was unknown if there were any similar Great Herbs here.
They headed towards that mountain. They had not walked too far, when they saw a drizzle begin to fall from the skies.
With how strong they were, the rain had not even started to fall, and their protective shield was naturally already stretched out, not allowing the slightest drop of water to land on their bodies.
However, what was astonishing was that this rainwater actually had a powerful penetrating ability, easily penetrating through their shields.
Ling Han hurriedly summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This was Origin Gold, and if the rainwater could penetrate even Origin Gold, then Ling Han would really have to admit defeat.
“Little Han, this rainwater is good stuff!” The large black dog’s voice rang out.

Its defenses weren’t as strong as Ling Han’s, and it didn’t have the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower either. Thus, it had already been drenched by the rain, but it still wore an expression of enjoyment. Wisps of mist surged around its body, and it was as if it were about to ascend and become a deity.
Although the large black dog was unreliable, Ling Han naturally believed him when it came to such matters. Thus, he resolutely withdrew the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Rain poured down on him, and instantly, an indescribable energy surged into his body, nourishing his body. This was an improvement in all aspects, making him feel as if he was about to be reborn.
“Dragon Essence!” Chi Menghan exclaimed shakily, an indescribable joy on her face.
“What is Dragon Essence?” Ling Han asked, as he relaxed his body, absorbing the benefits of the rainwater as much as possible.

“The essence of the dragon, of course,” Chi Menghan said. “Even if it’s other Divine Beasts that were similarly born the earliest when heaven and earth was first created, the True Dragon still possesses a supreme status, and is called the leader of the Divine Beasts.”

“Dragon Essence is the aura that the True Dragon exhales. To the True Dragon, this is only a breath of air. However, as strong as the True Dragon is, the aura that it exhales has a sliver of the essence of the dragon’s power. To us cultivators, this is a precious treasure that can help us temper our physique.”

Chi Menghan paused for a moment before continuing, “Among all the Divine Beasts, the True Dragon is the most powerful. If we can continuously cleanse ourselves with Dragon Essence, then even if we don’t reach the level of True Dragon, we will still be the strongest even among
Saints.”𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Then let’s hope that the Dragon Essence Rain here will never
stop.”
The area covered by the Dragon Essence Rain was limited, so they naturally couldn’t waste it. Thus, they took out various containers to collect.
The strange thing was that this rainwater could easily penetrate through the mystical power shield, yet could be preserved inside a vessel, even if it was only a very ordinary vessel.
The time for the rain to fall was very short, only ten minutes, but Ling Han and the others had also gathered a considerable number of pots of Dragon Essence.
However, the Dragon Essence was extremely volatile, and in the blink of an eye, the water level in the basin had dropped by more than one third.
There was nothing else that could be done. The three people and one dog hurriedly used it with all their might. They definitely could not allow it to go to waste.

A day later, no outsiders entered. Clearly, it was not easy to boast or insult others. The large black dog was extraordinarily talented in this area, and no one could compare to him. “Look, it’s raining over there!” Ling Han’s eyes were sharp, and he pointed in a direction.
Xiu, they hurriedly broke into a run and ran over.
This Dragon Essence Rain would only last for ten minutes, so there definitely couldn’t be the
slightest delay.
Thankfully, though it was a little wasteful, they had only missed it for a short while.
After learning this lesson, the three people and one dog split out. When the Dragon Essence Rain started, those who discovered it all hollered loudly, calling for the others to head over.
After three days, they had also grasped a pattern. The time when the Dragon Essence Rain fell was fixed, but the location was random.

chapters.title: Chapter 4135: As if entering an uninhabited territory
paragraphs: Chapter 4135: As if entering an uninhabited territory

Ling Han and the others could clearly feel their physiques improving. This was in all aspects, including power and defense. This made them involuntarily imagine just how powerful the True Dragon was back then. No wonder it could be called the leader of the Divine Beasts.

Every day, aside from refining the Dragon Essence, they would also cultivate the Spirit Diagrams and Imperial Technique obtained here. These were originally of the line of the True Dragon, and together with the Dragon Essence, the effects were naturally even better.

Meanwhile, Ling Han focused on cultivating Torrential Wave Energy. This was the last piece of the puzzle for Regulations on his Celestial Core. Once he completed the extraction of the Regulations, he would be able to take the next step.
At that time, who would be a match for him in this Mystery Realm?
F***, Baili Che, Xu Jie, Shi Yuanzhen, you people just wait.
Day after day, time passed very quickly. When the thirteenth day had come, nine people had entered into this space all at once.
“Haha, Ling Han!” Amidst loud laughter, these nine people all revealed powerful auras.
Baili Che, Shi Yuanzhen, Xu Jie, and the others were either Imperial Sons or members of Imperial Clans. They were far more powerful than the normal Core Formation Tier cultivators.

“You haven’t left here, is it because you want to take advantage of the fact that we have come out of the Transfer Formation to ambush us?” Xu Jie sneered, “How could such a small trick possibly not be seen through by us! Thus, after we met up, we entered into this space together.”
“You, accept your death!”
These people all smirked coldly, their expressions saying, ‘I’ve already seen through your scheme.’
This… Ling Han was slightly speechless.
He didn’t want to wait for these people at all, but because the Dragon Essence was here, he didn’t want to miss it.
En, as long as you guys are happy.

“Charge!” Baili Che and the others charged over. After passing through the nine islands, they had already entered True Dragon’s Secret Cave. It could be imagined that this Mystery Realm was about to reach its end. Thus, they had to make the most of their time. After killing Ling Han, they would snatch the Origin Gold Spirit Tool from him.
Otherwise, once they left, their memories would be erased, and it would be impossible for them to remember that Ling Han still had such a rare treasure on him.
The nine of them joined forces and charged over, their might soaring to the heavens.

Ling Han did not say another word, and directly broke into a run. At the same time, he communicated a message through divine sense to Chi Menghan, telling her to take care of the large black dog, and that she needed to keep him under control.

After so many days, he had more or less digested the Torrential Wave Energy. As long as he stabilized it a bit, he would be able to break through to the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. Thus, there was absolutely no need for him to fight head-on now. He only had to drag out the battle for a while, allowing him to break through. Then, even if the nine of them joined forces, so what? He was completely capable of smashing them into mush.
Chi Menghan was already filled with confidence in him. Similarly, she also sent a message via divine sense to him, telling him not to worry.

She was one of the few supreme prodigies of the Donglin Imperial Clan in the last few million years. It would be a piece of cake for her to protect the large black dog. She was sure that Baili Che and the others would definitely not become hostile with her because of this.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and his figure spread out, like a puff of smoke.

“Chase!” Baili Che and the others first glanced at Chi Menghan, and when they saw that she had no intention of attacking, they immediately broke out into a run to chase after Ling Han. However, after chasing for a short while, they discovered that they had already lost Ling Han. F***, this guy ran so fast?
“Come, let’s go back and catch that demonic dog. It’s with Ling Han, and we can use it to threaten Ling Han into appearing,” Baili Che immediately said.
“En!” The others all nodded.

However, just as they were about to turn around and leave, it was as if space had suddenly shattered. A figure suddenly charged out, pointing a finger at one of them. Instantly, a cold air rose abruptly.

“What!” Everyone was unable to react in time. This attack had come too suddenly and too close. Furthermore, the person that had been ambushed was not the Imperial Son, but merely a prodigy from the Imperial Clan.
With a tap of his finger, it turned into a white ice dragon that shot towards that person’s back.

That person only had time to look stunned before he was struck by the ice dragon. Pa, a transparent hole immediately appeared in his heart, and his whole person was instantly frozen. With a shake from the subsequent power, pa, he turned into countless pieces, but not the slightest bit of blood gushed out, because every bit of blood and flesh in his body had frozen into ice.
However, in the next instant, it was as if time had been reversed. His whole person immediately reformed, and recovered.
Substitution Seal.

The Holy Land already had Substitution Seals, what more when it was the Imperial Clan. Ling Han was also aware of this fact. Thus, after launching his attack, he didn’t linger in battle at all. He activated the Strange Shadow Steps again, concealing himself in the darkness.
“Ah!” All the great Imperial Sons flew into a thunderous rage. They all moved, launching a barrage of attacks at the place where Ling Han had disappeared, but they did not manage to
hit anything.
Ling Han had already rapidly fled from this area.
“Damn it!” There were a total of four Imperial Sons here, and all of them looked extremely livid.

In terms of cultivation level, which of them wasn’t higher than Ling Han? In terms of battle prowess, which of them was weaker than Ling Han? However, right in front of their eyes, Ling Han had “killed” one of them with a single strike.
Though it was not the Imperial Son, though because of the existence of the Substitution Seal, there were no real deaths, it was still a heavy blow to their morale.
Were they just a bunch of trash? Their enemy could easily charge into their midst and escape unscathed, as if he had entered into an uninhabited land!
“Let’s go, go back and catch the demonic dog, and force that brat to appear!” Baili Che said balefully, clenching his teeth so hard that they crackled.
This was too despicable. This was equivalent to mocking them directly.
The nine of them returned to look for the large black dog, but this time, Chi Menghan didn’t just sit by and watch. Instead, she stepped out and blocked their path.

“Fairy Chi, there is no need for you to protect a demonic dog, right?” Xu Jie spoke up, “We are all from the Imperial Clans, and are the the same group of people. This kind of demonic dog, ho, is not even worthy of cleaning our shoes!”

“Pei, you all are so depraved, even if you willingly become human cushions for Grandpa Dog, Grandpa Dog finds it hard to bear!” How could the large black dog be willing to suffer a loss? He immediately counterattacked.
Chi Menghan, meanwhile, drew out a flag, and waved it lightly, “If you want a battle, bring it
on!”

Baili Che and the others all frowned. If the nine of them joined forces, they naturally could take down Chi Menghan, but they would definitely have to pay a certain price. Most importantly, there was still Ling Han lying in ambush on the sidelines. What if he assassinated them just when they were embroiled in a fierce battle?
This guy was still a seed of the Battle God Palace, and was proficient in all kinds of assassination techniques. It was impossible to guard against him.
The nine of them exchanged looks, and decided not to start a fight with Chi Menghan.
Otherwise, they would become very passive.
‘How detestable! Why has Ling Han become a seed of the Battle God Palace? Isn’t he already
on the list of people to be killed by the Battle God Palace?’
Was this a scheme of the Battle God Palace to deliberately conceal Ling Han’s identity as a
seed, or had they made a huge mistake, and taken the person they were determined to kill as a
seed?
If it was the latter, then when Ling Han was strong enough to reveal this identity, the Battle
God Palace would be completely humiliated.
-In future, who would still hire the Battle God Palace for assassination?
‘See, I told you to kill a target, yet you’re actually nurturing him as a seed. F*ck.’

Most importantly, there was still Ling Han lying in ambush on the sidelines.
What if he assassinated them just when they were embroiled in a fierce battle?
This guy was still a seed of the Battle God Palace, and was proficient in all kinds of assassination techniques.
It was impossible to guard against him.
The nine of them exchanged looks, and decided not to start a fight with Chi Menghan.
Otherwise, they would become very passive.
‘How detestable!
Why has Ling Han become a seed of the Battle God Palace?
Isn’t he already
on the list of people to be killed by the Battle God Palace?’
Was this a scheme of the Battle God Palace to deliberately conceal Ling Han’s identity as a
seed, or had they made a huge mistake, and taken the person they were determined to kill as a
seed?
If it was the latter, then when Ling Han was strong enough to reveal this identity, the Battle
God Palace would be completely humiliated.
-In future, who would still hire the Battle God Palace for assassination?
‘See, I told you to kill a target, yet you’re actually nurturing him as a seed.
F*ck.’

chapters.title: Chapter 4136: Winner takes all
paragraphs: Chapter 4136: Winner takes all
Right at this moment, a drizzle began to fall from the skies.
It was time for the Dragon Essence Rain again.

Chi Menghan and the others didn’t say another word, and they immediately dashed toward where the rain was falling. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s figure also appeared in the distance. With the Dragon Essence pouring down on him, this could even resolve the Strange Shadow Steps. “Charge!” When Baili Che and the others saw this, they hurriedly charged towards Ling Han.

However, when they rushed into the rain area, they immediately looked terrified. What was going on with this rainwater? It could actually penetrate through their mystical power shield! However, what followed was an expression of pleasant surprise.
This was… Dragon Essence!

As members of the Imperial Clans, they naturally knew about the Dragon Essence. In truth, every Imperial Clan still retained some Dragon Essence, though some did not originate from the True Dragon, but rather the descendants of the True Dragon.
However, as long as it was Dragon Essence, it would have great benefits, what more when this Dragon Essence was very likely left behind by the True Dragon.
An extremely nutritious item!
All of a sudden, they hesitated. Should they continue to hunt down Ling Han, or stay in the rain area to absorb the Dragon Essence?
What a difficult choice.
Some people decided to continue the pursuit, while others said that they might as well hold off for a while. After all, all the Dragon Essence was extremely valuable.
There were only three supporters of continuing the pursuit, and Baili Che was their leader. Though two of the three were Imperial Sons, how could they possibly capture Ling Han?
To say nothing of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, once Ling Han activated that strange movement technique, how would they be able to find him?
The Battle God Palace dared to assassinate even Imperial Clan elites, so they naturally had some ability.
Thus, if they continued to hunt down Ling Han, they would only be able to chase Ling Han out of the rain area at most. However, they would also miss out on the Dragon Essence.
It was disadvantageous to others, but also to oneself.
“Forget it, let’s take the opportunity first.” Baili Che and the other two pro-pursuit parties had no choice but to give up.
However, not long after, the rain stopped. Now, Baili Che and the others had nothing to hesitate about, and immediately set off in pursuit of Ling Han.

Ling Han fled into the darkness, but he wasn’t the type to take a beating passively. Occasionally, he would jump out and launch a sneak attack on Baili Che and the others. Even if Baili Che and the others were already prepared, and once Ling Han appeared, they would fall into a siege position, Ling Han unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and forcibly charged out a path of survival.
-If the Imperial Son did not combust his Imperial Bloodline, how would he be able to block the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?

But the problem was, unless one had the absolute certainty of being able to kill Ling Han, once the Imperial Blood combusted, he would not be able to recover in a short period of time. Furthermore, if he combusted the Imperial Blood, then wouldn’t it be extremely disadvantageous when he contended for the True Dragon of Fortune in future?
None of the Imperial Sons dared to rashly use the Imperial Blood. This was their greatest trump card.

And just like that, the atmosphere was very lively. The members of the nine great Imperial Clans had been hunting down Ling Han all this while, but not only had they not succeeded, Ling Han would always counterattack from time to time, causing them to be battered and exhausted.
If this was known to others, they would definitely laugh themselves to death.
Imperial Son?
Shouldn’t the Imperial Son be invincible among his peers? However, even with four Imperial Sons working together, they were still unable to defeat Ling Han. Wasn’t this the biggest joke in the world?

After a few more days, other people finally entered. From this moment onwards, the rate of people entering began to increase greatly. It had only been five days, and there were already about a hundred people here.
However, Ling Han and the others were shocked to discover that at a specific time, the Dragon Essence Rain didn’t fall again.
Was it at a place that they had not discovered?
The second day… there was similarly no rain, and the same was true for the third day.
In this way, everyone knew that this great opportunity had ended.
It should be the limit of numbers. When they reached about a hundred people, the Dragon Essence Rain would not rain anymore, and they would be entering into the next stage.
Peng!

A giant pillar suddenly descended from the skies, stabbing deeply into the ground, and there was a piece of cloth tied to the top of the giant pillar. There were three words written on it: Winner Takes All!
This was not a giant pillar, but rather a flag.
Winner takes all? What did that mean?
“Probably, they want us to fight, and only one person would be left, and the last person would be the winner!” someone guessed.
The contest in Mystery Realms would eventually return to the simplest and most primitive stage, and that would be a contest of abilities.

Those that could come here had all experienced many trials. Whether it was natural talent or luck, they would definitely be the best choice. Thus, it was now time to choose the best among the best. The person last standing would be the winner, and win the True Dragon of Fortune.
“That’s easy!” Xu Jie moved, launching an attack at one of them.

“What are you doing?!” the person who had been attacked shouted. He hurriedly went into defensive mode, but just how powerful was the Imperial Son? His abilities far surpassed Galaxy Network’s number one, all right?

Peng! With a single strike, that person was blasted to the point of throwing up blood, and lost the ability to continue fighting. Furthermore, his figure also swayed slightly, as if it was formed from light and shadow. With a tremor, he suddenly turned into bits and disappeared.
Had he been kicked out of the Mystery Realm?

Everyone thought, but no matter what, the understanding of “the last person standing is the winner” was correct. As long as they were beaten to the point of losing their ability to fight, they would be sent flying from here.
Ling Han’s figure surfaced from the shadows, and revealed an astounded expression, as he said, “I am now suspecting whether it is our real selves have come in with, or we have come in
merely in soul state.”
“How could it possibly be soul state?” The large black dog immediately pointed at his behind, “Look, Grandpa Dog’s iron underwear can’t possibly be fake?”𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
These words instantly made Chi Menghan and her sister reveal expressions of disgust. This despicable dog really didn’t hold back when he spoke.

Ling Han shook his head, “The Great Emperor’s methods are unfathomable. Previously, on the Giant Island, if we had not turned around to take a look when we left, how could we have possibly discovered that it was actually a ghost island?”

The large black dog was instantly rendered speechless. The Ancestral King was too powerful, and could control all Regulations. Furthermore, Regulations was the foundation that formed all living things in this world. Thus, even if they were in soul form, the Ancestral King was completely capable of making them completely unaware.
“If we are in soul form, then it can perfectly explain why no one has retained their memories after leaving this place,” Chi Menghan said. Cutting off the relevant memories in the soul was
the simplest thing.
Going by that theory, had the person who had died previously died or not?
Er, he should have died. From the records of the past eras, every time people entered the True Dragon Abyss, the number of deaths actually reached 90%. This definitely could not be
misreported every time.
Ling Han was relieved upon seeing this. Otherwise, if he couldn’t remember after he left, and Baili Che, Lin Lang, and the others were still alive, that would really be too worrisome.
“I have to break through to the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. You guys be careful,” he said, and once again entered into the darkness.

It was clear that Baili Che and the others wouldn’t kill each other. In other words, before they “killed” him, it would be impossible for them to damage their alliance. Thus, he had to reach the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier to be able to defeat these people.

It wouldn’t take too long. In the last few days, Ling Han had continuously been hunted down, counterattacked his pursuers, and nurtured himself through battle. Ling Han had completely stabilized his cultivation level at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, and could now
advance to the next step.
He found a secluded place and began to break through to the consummate level of the Core
Formation Tier.
He was really looking forward to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4137: Core Formation Tier consummate level
paragraphs: Chapter 4137: Core Formation Tier consummate level
This was the fourth level of the Core Formation Tier, Core Formation.

The so-called core formation was the liquefying of the Celestial Core.. This was a very long process, and could not possibly be accomplished overnight. However, he only had to take the first small step, and his strength would soar greatly.
Come on then.
Ling Han used his mystical power to grind the Celestial Core, trying his best to liquefy it.

However, the Celestial Core was the sturdiest existence in a cultivator’s body in the first place. If it really came to it, it could still be thrown out as a Spiritual Power Celestial Tool, and Ling Han’s Celestial Core was formed based on the primitive Celestial Gate, so it was even sturdier. The Celestial Cauldrons could still crash into each other and have them self-destruct each other, but there was only one Celestial Core, so what could he do?
The level of mystical power was too low, so attacking it would have no effect at all.
Then, using high-level energy?

Ling Han carefully used the Heavenly Dao Flames. In fact, he even used Destructive Energy. However, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core was already branded with Regulations of these high-level energies, so it was completely immune to attacks.
Er, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core was really too awesome and this, instead, was stopping him from taking the next step?
Why had this scene appeared again?

When he had been in the Foundation Building Tier, it was also because the Celestial Foundation was too hard and too perfect, and could not undergo any kind of transformation at all, forcing Ling Han to make another move, and directly form a second Celestial Foundation, and only then did he manage to form the Heavenly Dao Foundation.
Now… could it be that he had to retain the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, and created an alchemy pool?

Most importantly, if he wanted to create an alchemy pool, he would have to first create the Celestial Foundation, then the Celestial Cauldron, and then turn it into a pool. How was this possible? He had long since taken these two steps.
He still had to liquefy the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
Ling Han mulled over this in his mind. How could such a sturdy Primal Chaos Celestial Core be liquidized?
A thought flashed in his mind. The Regulations of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
Since this could be inscribed on the Celestial Core, it meant that they had destructive power against the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. That’s right.
Ling Han started from the Primal Chaos Celestial Core itself. To destroy this incomparably sturdy Celestial Core… it had to be shattered first, before it could slowly liquefy.
On the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, the nine great inscribed patterns all lit up, beginning to slowly corrode this Celestial Core.

Theoretically speaking, unless he ignited the Celestial Core, it would be impossible for him to damage his own Celestial Core. In the first place, this was the strongest part of a cultivator’s body. However, the nine great Regulations had already been branded on the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, which was equivalent to opening a back door. This was a different story.

It should be known that those in the Core Formation Tier could only use Regulations, but could not truly understand Regulations. This was something that could only be touched by those in the True Self Tier. It also meant that the level of Regulations was higher than the level of Core Formation Tier.
Thus, using Regulations that were higher in level than the Core Formation Tier to grind the Celestial Core was naturally possible.

Very soon, the marks left by the nine great Regulations on the Celestial Core became deeper and deeper. These Regulations were in the process of corroding the inside of the Celestial Core. When they had completely penetrated the Celestial Core, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core was naturally shattered.

This process continued for a very long time. After a whole four days, pa, the Primal Chaos Celestial Core shattered into pieces, turning into innumerable pieces. However, the nine great Regulations did not disappear because they had lost their host, but rather vibrated in his mind.
All right, the first step was complete, and the second step was about to begin.

Ling Han began to liquefy the shards of Celestial Core. This was much easier to do, because they were much, much smaller, and the difficulty level was not reduced just by a little bit. With his continuous efforts, the Celestial Core fragments finally managed to turn into a sliver of liquid.
With this opening, it was instantly like a hot knife through butter, and even more Celestial Core shards began to liquefy.
But this was still not enough. He had to first form an alchemy pool. Otherwise, if the “water level” was too low, it would very easily dry up.

Ling Han continued to use the shards of Celestial Core to form a pool, causing it to slowly liquefy. Finally, the shards were completely dissolved, forming a complete alchemy pool. Then, the Core Formation Tier would come to an end.
The nine great Regulations all sank into the alchemy pool. They were catalysts, and could speed up the disintegration of the shards of Celestial Core.
Another two days later, one tenth of the spiritual liquid had already accumulated in the alchemy pool, and the melting speed of the shards of Celestial Core had clearly decreased.
Core Formation Tier consummate level!
Ling Han stood up. He had finally advanced into the fourth level of the Core Formation Tier.
Boom!
He threw a punch, and the force of it reverberated, which was incredibly terrifying.
“35 Heavens!” Ling Han laughed loudly. From the look of things, his limit should be the raw power of 40 Heavens.
In history, had anyone ever reached this kind of height?

Battle prowess of 40 Heavens… The Great Emperor had probably touched this level before when he was young. In fact, he might have even surpassed it. However, his pure power had already reached 40 Heavens. He was probably the only one who had reached this level. After all, merely a Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron had surpassed the majority of Ancestral𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
Kings.

Of course, when one had reached the height of the Ancestral King, power was actually already secondary. They were competing in their comprehension of Regulations, but at Ling Han’s present level, whoever had the greater power naturally had an advantage.
Otherwise, why had Baili Che, Xu Jie, and the others been able to act arrogantly in front of Ling Han previously? Wasn’t it because their raw power was stronger?
Let’s go and get revenge.
Ling Han activated his movement technique and charged toward the gigantic flag.
He soon arrived at his destination, but did not appear directly. Instead, he used the Strange Shadow Steps to conceal himself.

With a sweep of his gaze, Ling Han discovered that the place that was originally very lively here had once again become deserted. Baili Che and his group were all seated under the giant flag, and he could no longer see anyone else in the vicinity.
Obviously, the others had all been blasted out of the Mystery Realm, so it was also possible that they had hidden themselves, just like he had previously.
He did not see Chi Menghan, her sister, and the large black dog. Could it be that they had already been beaten out of the Mystery Realm?

This wasn’t strange. After all, Baili Che and the others had four Imperial Sons. Even if Chi Menghan was a once-in-a-million-years prodigy, she couldn’t possibly match four Imperial Sons at the same time. Moreover, she still had Chi Mengshan and the large black dog as her
two burdens.
Fine, he would take revenge for this!

Ling Han quietly approached, then shot out a strike. Unsurprisingly, the person he had sneak attacked did not even manage to react in time, and was directly blasted into smithereens. However, the Substitution Seal took effect, and that person came back to life.
“Ling Han!” Baili Che and the others all shouted loudly. Their eyes were wide with anger, and they all moved, blasting towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was completely unafraid. He activated the Starlight Screen, then continued to attack
the person from before. This person was also the first to be sneak attacked by him, and he had already used the Substitution Seal twice. Thus, Ling Han targeted him and wanted to deal
with him first.
Boom!
Eight attacks shot over, and there was no shortage of Imperial Sons among them. Naturally, they immediately shattered the Starlight Screen.
When Baili Che and the others saw this, they immediately looked pleased. You are courting death, to actually dare to take their attacks head-on.
However, in the next instant, they all gaped, because Ling Han was completely unscathed.
What, was this a dream?
Four Imperial Sons had joined forces to attack a person of the same cultivation level, yet they
were actually unable to cause any damage?
On the other hand, Ling Han’s punch caused that person to explode again.
And after this time, that person did not “revive” again. He directly turned into a shadow and
disappeared.
The Substitution Seal had been used up.
All of a sudden, Baili Che and the others felt chills all over their bodies.

He had to first form an alchemy pool.
Otherwise, if the “water level” was too low, it would very easily dry up.
Ling Han continued to use the shards of Celestial Core to form a pool, causing it to slowly liquefy.
Finally, the shards were completely dissolved, forming a complete alchemy pool.
Then, the Core Formation Tier would come to an end.
The nine great Regulations all sank into the alchemy pool.
They were catalysts, and could speed up the disintegration of the shards of Celestial Core.
Another two days later, one tenth of the spiritual liquid had already accumulated in the alchemy pool, and the melting speed of the shards of Celestial Core had clearly decreased.
Core Formation Tier consummate level!
Ling Han stood up.
He had finally advanced into the fourth level of the Core Formation Tier.
Boom!
He threw a punch, and the force of it reverberated, which was incredibly terrifying.
“35 Heavens!” Ling Han laughed loudly.
From the look of things, his limit should be the raw power of 40 Heavens.
In history, had anyone ever reached this kind of height?
Battle prowess of 40 Heavens…
The Great Emperor had probably touched this level before when he was young.
In fact, he might have even surpassed it.
However, his pure power had already reached 40 Heavens.
He was probably the only one who had reached this level.
After all, merely a Ten Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron had surpassed the majority of Ancestral𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
Kings.
Of course, when one had reached the height of the Ancestral King, power was actually already secondary.
They were competing in their comprehension of Regulations, but at Ling Han’s present level, whoever had the greater power naturally had an advantage.
Otherwise, why had Baili Che, Xu Jie, and the others been able to act arrogantly in front of Ling Han previously?
Wasn’t it because their raw power was stronger?
Let’s go and get revenge.
Ling Han activated his movement technique and charged toward the gigantic flag.
He soon arrived at his destination, but did not appear directly.
Instead, he used the Strange Shadow Steps to conceal himself.
With a sweep of his gaze, Ling Han discovered that the place that was originally very lively here had once again become deserted.
Baili Che and his group were all seated under the giant flag, and he could no longer see anyone else in the vicinity.
Obviously, the others had all been blasted out of the Mystery Realm, so it was also possible that they had hidden themselves, just like he had previously.
He did not see Chi Menghan, her sister, and the large black dog.
Could it be that they had already been beaten out of the Mystery Realm?
This wasn’t strange.
After all, Baili Che and the others had four Imperial Sons.
Even if Chi Menghan was a once-in-a-million-years prodigy, she couldn’t possibly match four Imperial Sons at the same time.
Moreover, she still had Chi Mengshan and the large black dog as her
two burdens.
Fine, he would take revenge for this!
Ling Han quietly approached, then shot out a strike.
Unsurprisingly, the person he had sneak attacked did not even manage to react in time, and was directly blasted into smithereens.
However, the Substitution Seal took effect, and that person came back to life.
“Ling Han!” Baili Che and the others all shouted loudly.
Their eyes were wide with anger, and they all moved, blasting towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was completely unafraid.
He activated the Starlight Screen, then continued to attack
the person from before.
This person was also the first to be sneak attacked by him, and he had already used the Substitution Seal twice.
Thus, Ling Han targeted him and wanted to deal
with him first.
Boom!
Eight attacks shot over, and there was no shortage of Imperial Sons among them.
Naturally, they immediately shattered the Starlight Screen.
When Baili Che and the others saw this, they immediately looked pleased.
You are courting death, to actually dare to take their attacks head-on.
However, in the next instant, they all gaped, because Ling Han was completely unscathed.
What, was this a dream?
Four Imperial Sons had joined forces to attack a person of the same cultivation level, yet they
were actually unable to cause any damage?
On the other hand, Ling Han’s punch caused that person to explode again.
And after this time, that person did not “revive” again.
He directly turned into a shadow and
disappeared.
The Substitution Seal had been used up.
All of a sudden, Baili Che and the others felt chills all over their bodies.

chapters.title: Chapter 4138: Invincible
paragraphs: Chapter 4138: Invincible
Ling Han cracked a smile, withdrew his fist, and looked towards Baili Che and the others.

That’s right. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core had already been shattered into pieces, and was developing in the direction of completely liquefying. However, this did not mean that his ability to absorb attacks had also disappeared along with it.
This was still present, and had become an instinct of his, fusing with his body, no longer relying on the existence of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
“Aren’t you guys very arrogant?” Ling Han asked calmly. “Didn’t you guys want to kill me? Now, I’m standing right here. Who wants to fight me?”
Baili Che and the others were all dazed. For a moment, no one answered.
Why had this guy become terrifying again? The combined attacks of eight people actually did not injure him in the slightest. How were they supposed to deal with him?
Ling Han smiled again, and brandished his fists at Baili Che.
Peng, with this strike, Baili Che was instantly sent backwards. He was completely outmatched.
Witnessing this scene, everyone was so shocked that they were gaping.

The person who had been “killed” previously was not an Imperial Son. Though his battle prowess was extraordinary, it was only in the top ten of Galaxy Network. However, it was a different story for Baili Che. This was someone that the Imperial Clan had focused on nurturing.

The Imperial Sons had naturally sparred with each other before. Baili Che’s raw power was around 31 Heavens, and added with the celestial techniques, his battle prowess had reached at least 34 Heavens.

And even with this, he was still being pushed back by a single punch. Furthermore, from the looks of it, Ling Han had not used any kind of celestial technique at all. It was an explosion of raw power… hiss, this meant that Ling Han’s raw power had surpassed 34 Heavens.
Heavens, his raw power was at least 35 Heavens?
Baili Che finally steadied his footing. He gritted his teeth and said, “You’ve broken through!” Otherwise, there was no way to explain Ling Han’s sudden increase in strength.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “This is a real battle of equals. Come, see how I will beat you all up.” Although Baili Che and the others were all furious, none of them could refute him.

The gap in strength could not be any more obvious. Even for Imperial Sons like them, they only possessed raw power that was around 31 Heavens, which was at least four Heavens weaker than Ling Han. Furthermore, this was when Ling Han had just stepped into the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier.
“Everyone, now that we’re here, no one wants to give up, right?” Baili Che said in a deep voice. “I suggest that we all combust the Imperial Bloodline and take a gamble.”
“That’s right. Everyone, ignite your Imperial Blood, so after we chase this brat out, we would still have a fair competition,” Xu Jie immediately added.
“All right!”
“Let’s unite against the enemy. We’ll get rid of this brat first!”

The four Imperial Sons reached a concensus. If they didn’t combust their Imperial Bloodline now, they would only be easily dealt with by Ling Han. Moreover, as long as they all combusted their Imperial Bloodline at the same time, they would still have a chance of victory.

Boom! All of a sudden, the eight Imperial Clan elites all started to combust their Imperial Bloodlines. A devastating aura surged into the surroundings, and it was as if they were Ancestral Kings that had returned to their youth.
Ling Han closed his eyes slightly, then suddenly snapped them open, releasing two astonishing streaks of divine light.

So what if they were Great Emperors returned to their youth? He had the confidence to achieve dao. Thus, even if he was faced with young Ancestral Kings, he was still confident that he could crush them.

Moreover, even though their battle prowess had soared after combusting their Imperial Bloodline, there was still a difference between them and the Great Emperor in his youth. It was just that their battle prowess was too powerful, and no one could match them at all. Naturally, there was no way to distinguish the difference in detail.
Come on, this was a true battle of equal cultivation levels. Who would he be afraid of?
“Die!”
Baili Che and the others all roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. The Imperial Blood boiled, and their battle prowess was inconceivably strong.
40 Heavens!
This was a limit that could not be surpassed no matter what.

Ling Han humphed. With a thought, a supreme primal aura surged out, instantly reducing the battle prowess of Baili Che and the others directly by three Heavens. This super strong ability naturally would not disappear either.
In this way, the battle prowess of these Imperial Sons was instantly weakened to 37 Heavens. Ling Han let out a battle cry, and used the God Slaying Technique, which counterattacked these people.

He had the raw power of 35 Heavens, and the God Slaying Technique could also increase his battle prowess by a further three Heavens, allowing him to soar to the height of 38 Heavens all of a sudden. He was slightly stronger than these Imperial Sons.

The combined forces of the four Imperial Sons was just enough to compensate for the gap of one Heaven in battle prowess between them. Meanwhile, the other four people were only there to help. Their attacks couldn’t pose any threat at all, and were easily dispersed.

Ling Han was like a tiger that had entered a flock of sheep. With a kick, one of the Imperial Sons was sent flying. He shot out a punch, and another Imperial Son was sent backwards, showing an invincible stance.
He first targeted those four non-Imperial Sons, and after “killing” those people several times, he used up all of their Substitution Seals, and they were blasted out of the Mystery
Realm.
In this manner, there were only four people left, and they were all Imperial Sons.
Baili Che, Xu Jie, Shi Yuanzhen, and Guan Yuanming.

Now, even if the four Imperial Sons joined forces, they would still be able to stand against Ling Han. However, the Imperial Blood would only be burning for a limited amount of time. Once this burst of power had passed, how would they still be able to stand against Ling Han?

“Everyone, use your ultimate moves. If we don’t blast this brat out, we’ll all be eliminated!” Baili Che said. He took out a piece of animal hide first. It looked extremely ancient, and was even a little tattered.
However, Ling Han felt a sense of danger, and felt that this beast hide would pose a great
threat to him.
“All right!”
Xu Jiejie and the other Imperial Sons also took out their trump cards. This was an ultimate move that was only inferior to burning the Imperial Blood.
Baili Che shook his hand, and shua, the beast hide unfurled, floating in midair on its own volition. It was erected like a flag, but also like a decree.
“This is handwritten by a Saint. Though there are restrictions on cultivation level in this
place, and treasures that are too strong cannot be brought in, it is enough to suppress you!” He gave a loud shout, and three golden words shot out from the beast hide, pressing down on
Ling Han.

At the same time, Guan Yuanming and the others also used the trump card in their hands. One was a Talisman Weapon, which summoned thirty-six silver swords to form a sword formation, while another was a jade pendant. After it was crushed, a fire bull rushed out, its whole body made up of complicated seals.
The four Imperial Sons unleashed their might at the same time. This was a deadly situation.
The four of them all smirked coldly, but at the same time, they also felt some regret. If they killed Ling Han here, there was a 90% chance that they would only expel him, and not truly
kill him.
Otherwise, among those who had entered the True Dragon Abyss through the generations, wouldn’t only one supreme prodigy be able to survive at each cultivation level?
They all felt heartache. This was really their trump card.

Ling Han humphed as he unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hovered above his head and unleashed wisps of Primal Chaos Qi that transformed into the highest level of defense.

Peng! The defense of the Primal Chaos Qi was indeed strong, but it could not hold up to the combined attacks of the four Imperial Sons. The Primal Chaos Qi was also blasted through. The four Imperial Sons controlled their fierce attacks, which blasted towards Ling Han
himself.

However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn’t just for show. After being weakened through expending power to blast through the defenses, the attacks of the four Imperial Sons were greatly weakened.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fists repeatedly, instantly throwing four
punches.

chapters.title: Chapter 4139: Great Emperor Killing Formation
paragraphs: Chapter 4139: Great Emperor Killing Formation

Peng, peng, peng, peng! After four punches, Ling Han’s figure shook violently, and he was forced backwards repeatedly. The attacks of the four Imperial Sons were too terrifying. With the use of their trump card, the Imperial Sons were attacking him together.

But so what? After being weakened by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, the might of their attacks had decreased drastically, and added with the fact that Ling Han could disperse attacks within a gap of six Heavens, they naturally could not pose a threat to him.
Such a terrifying round of attacks was actually easily dispersed just like that.
The four Imperial Sons were all dumbfounded, completely unable to believe this.
Are you even human?

In the first place, the Imperial Son should have been able to sweep aside all opponents of the same cultivation level. Now that the four Imperial Sons had joined forces, and had even combusted their Imperial Blood, and used their trump cards, they actually only managed to force Ling Han to take a few steps back. This was practically like a dream.
Could it be that aside from relying on the suppression of a major tier in cultivation level, there was nothing else that could be done to this guy?
This kind of realization caused even the four Imperial Sons to feel despair. Such a terrifying guy, was he going to suppress an era all by himself?

Even if no one was able to become a Great Emperor in this era, if this guy became a Saint, he would definitely be the number one Saint. Add to that the precious tool of the Origin Gold, and even if it couldn’t be upgraded to the level of Imperial Weapon, perhaps even an Imperial Weapon wouldn’t be able to suppress him.

The four of them exchanged looks, and all thought that they had to get rid of Ling Han before the situation developed. Otherwise, when this brat really became a Saint, there would really be no one in this world that could deal with him.

However, the problem was that the memories here couldn’t be brought out. After leaving, their relevant memories would be severed, and they wouldn’t remember that Ling Han had a precious tool of Origin Gold in his possession at all.

This was awkward. If they couldn’t get rid of Ling Han here, and even allowed this guy to obtain the True Dragon of Fortune, wouldn’t this guy have endless good luck, endless great opportunities, and grow even faster?
Ling Han didn’t care how sullen they felt, and immediately launched a counterattack.
-After he had advanced into the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, he was here to beat up these people.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The attacks he delivered were incredibly frightening. He didn’t need to use any celestial techniques to possess great might, and when he used the Icy Killing Celestial Finger, the ice dragon added with the Ice Energy instantly gave the four Imperial Sons an extreme headache. This attack was too terrifying. Furthermore, it was a long-distance attack. After the ice dragon had locked onto them, if they did not shatter it, it would continue to pursue them, forcing these Imperial Sons to have no choice but to use the Imperial Technique to disperse it. The four Imperial Sons were all complaining endlessly. The burning of their Imperial Blood could not last for too long, and now they were still being suppressed by Ling Han. How could they possibly see any hope of victory?

The more they fought, the more hopeless they became. Though they could still maintain their invincibility now, everyone knew that this was only drinking poison to quench their thirst. Once their burst of power had passed, the only thing left would naturally be Ling Han beating them out of the Mystery Realm.
In the future, Ling Han would take the lead and charge to the peak. It was very possible that he would be the sole leader of an era, and would be branded in history.
The four Imperial Sons were all putting their lives on the line, but in front of absolute strength, what was the point of putting their lives on the line?
In just over ten minutes, their auras began to drop like a cliff, no longer as courageous as before.
The Imperial Bloodline had finished burning, and they had recovered their normal battle prowess.
How could they withstand Ling Han’s battle prowess?
Peng, peng, peng! With three punches and two kicks, Ling Han easily killed three of them, and Baili Che was the only one left of the four Imperial Sons.
Ling Han unleashed his divine might again, capturing Baili Che.
“What are you trying to do?!” Baili Che roared in fury. Although he knew that his life wasn’t in danger, falling into the hands of his opponent made him feel extremely humiliated.

Peng! Ling Han’s fist smashed down, and he said, “Naturally, I’m going to give you a good beating. I’m going to traumatize you. In the future, whenever you see me, or even think of me, you’ll feel a chill run down your spine!”
“Ah!” Baili Che screamed in agony. Whether this was a spiritual body or a real physical body, the pain was bone-deep.
Ling Han didn’t care, beating Baili Che to death. Then, Substitution Seal took effect, allowing Baili Che to come back to life.
So what? He would just continue to pummel him.
After he had beaten Baili Che to death seven times, this guy’s Substitution Seal was finally used up, turning into a streak of shattered light and disappearing.
With such a profound lesson, even if his memories were severed, he should still be able to plant an instinctive fear in him, right?
Ling Han smiled. He was anticipating when he met Baili Che again, whether the latter would shiver in fear.
And now, all his opponents had been wiped out, right?
Weng, that large flag fluttered in the wind, and the flag suddenly descended, wrapping around him all of a sudden. Then, it flew towards the great green mountain.
By the looks of it, he was most likely the only remaining person. Thus, he was naturally the
winner.
Ling Han was still in the mood to mull over this.
Xiu, the flag wrapped around him, and his speed was very fast. Very soon, he had arrived at a spot halfway up the great green mountain. He could see that the inside of the mountain here
had caved in, forming a massive cave.
The True Dragon’s Secret Cave.
Had the True Dragon lived there all those years ago?

He had not even finished the thought, when Ling Han had already landed on the ground, wrapped in the flag. He had just stood up, when he saw a dragon-shaped white light fly out of the cave. It was extremely fast, and with a xiu, it had entered into his body.
This was… the True Dragon of Fortune?
Ling Han smacked his lips. He didn’t seem to feel anything at all. He didn’t feel like he had been reborn, nor did he feel any lingering fragrance on his lips.
After complaining for a while, he walked towards the cave ahead of him, but he had only taken two steps, when he felt a chill run down his spine. He felt that it was extremely dangerous.
One more step and he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
He activated his eye technique, and with a single glance, he understood.
There was a formation in front of him, perfectly and naturally blended into the heaven and earth, as if it was naturally formed, and this might… was indescribably terrifying.
Imperial Weapon!
This was Ling Han’s first feeling. Previously, in the Blood Sea Mystery Realm, he had seen the Imperial Weapon unleash its might. It was really that terrifying without bounds.
However, this was clearly just a formation.
Hiss, a Great Emperor killing formation!

Ling Han finally understood. This formation had definitely been set up by the True Dragon. Such a large formation could easily kill even Saints. Even if the Saint wielded the Imperial Weapon, he would most likely only be able to ensure temporary safety. Once the Imperial Weapon was unable to unleash its might, he would definitely be killed by the formation.

He couldn’t help but feel curious. In the midst of such a Great Emperor killing formation, could it be that there was a rare treasure left behind by the True Dragon? Otherwise, what need was there for the Great Emperor killing formation to protect it?
If he could break through the formation… Ling Han’s heart couldn’t help but beat wildly. That would naturally be a great profit.

However, he was only a Formation Grandmaster, and only the level above that was Formation Saint, but Formation Saints were only comparable to Saints, and could not possibly unravel the Great Emperor killing formation. This was a Great Emperor formation, and only the Ancestral King could set it up, and only the Ancestral King could unravel it.
Sigh, there was nothing else he could do.
But the problem was, the True Dragon of Fortune was already in his hands, so why didn’t he
let him leave?
Could it be that the dragon-shaped white light previously wasn’t the True Dragon of Fortune?
Since he had nothing else to do, Ling Han began to study the Great Emperor killing formation. If he could learn just a little bit, it would also increase his strength by an astonishing amount.
