Add to that the precious tool of the Origin Gold, and even if it couldn’t be upgraded to the level of Imperial Weapon, perhaps even an Imperial Weapon wouldn’t be able to suppress him.
The four of them exchanged looks, and all thought that they had to get rid of Ling Han before the situation developed.
Otherwise, when this brat really became a Saint, there would really be no one in this world that could deal with him.
However, the problem was that the memories here couldn’t be brought out.
After leaving, their relevant memories would be severed, and they wouldn’t remember that Ling Han had a precious tool of Origin Gold in his possession at all.
This was awkward.
If they couldn’t get rid of Ling Han here, and even allowed this guy to obtain the True Dragon of Fortune, wouldn’t this guy have endless good luck, endless great opportunities, and grow even faster?
Ling Han didn’t care how sullen they felt, and immediately launched a counterattack.
-After he had advanced into the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, he was here to beat up these people.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The attacks he delivered were incredibly frightening.

He didn’t need to use any celestial techniques to possess great might, and when he used the Icy Killing Celestial Finger, the ice dragon added with the Ice Energy instantly gave the four Imperial Sons an extreme headache.
This attack was too terrifying.
Furthermore, it was a long-distance attack.

After the ice dragon had locked onto them, if they did not shatter it, it would continue to pursue them, forcing these Imperial Sons to have no choice but to use the Imperial Technique to disperse it.
The four Imperial Sons were all complaining endlessly.
The burning of their Imperial Blood could not last for too long, and now they were still being suppressed by Ling Han.
How could they possibly see any hope of victory?
The more they fought, the more hopeless they became.
Though they could still maintain their invincibility now, everyone knew that this was only drinking poison to quench their thirst.
Once their burst of power had passed, the only thing left would naturally be Ling Han beating them out of the Mystery Realm.
In the future, Ling Han would take the lead and charge to the peak.
It was very possible that he would be the sole leader of an era, and would be branded in history.
The four Imperial Sons were all putting their lives on the line, but in front of absolute strength, what was the point of putting their lives on the line?
In just over ten minutes, their auras began to drop like a cliff, no longer as courageous as before.
The Imperial Bloodline had finished burning, and they had recovered their normal battle prowess.
How could they withstand Ling Han’s battle prowess?
Peng, peng, peng!
With three punches and two kicks, Ling Han easily killed three of them, and Baili Che was the only one left of the four Imperial Sons.
Ling Han unleashed his divine might again, capturing Baili Che.
“What are you trying to do?!” Baili Che roared in fury.
Although he knew that his life wasn’t in danger, falling into the hands of his opponent made him feel extremely humiliated.
Peng!
Ling Han’s fist smashed down, and he said, “Naturally, I’m going to give you a good beating.
I’m going to traumatize you.
In the future, whenever you see me, or even think of me, you’ll feel a chill run down your spine!”
“Ah!” Baili Che screamed in agony.
Whether this was a spiritual body or a real physical body, the pain was bone-deep.
Ling Han didn’t care, beating Baili Che to death.
Then, Substitution Seal took effect, allowing Baili Che to come back to life.
So what?
He would just continue to pummel him.
After he had beaten Baili Che to death seven times, this guy’s Substitution Seal was finally used up, turning into a streak of shattered light and disappearing.
With such a profound lesson, even if his memories were severed, he should still be able to plant an instinctive fear in him, right?
Ling Han smiled.
He was anticipating when he met Baili Che again, whether the latter would shiver in fear.
And now, all his opponents had been wiped out, right?
Weng, that large flag fluttered in the wind, and the flag suddenly descended, wrapping around him all of a sudden.
Then, it flew towards the great green mountain.
By the looks of it, he was most likely the only remaining person.
Thus, he was naturally the
winner.
Ling Han was still in the mood to mull over this.
Xiu, the flag wrapped around him, and his speed was very fast.
Very soon, he had arrived at a spot halfway up the great green mountain.
He could see that the inside of the mountain here
had caved in, forming a massive cave.
The True Dragon’s Secret Cave.
Had the True Dragon lived there all those years ago?
He had not even finished the thought, when Ling Han had already landed on the ground, wrapped in the flag.
He had just stood up, when he saw a dragon-shaped white light fly out of the cave.
It was extremely fast, and with a xiu, it had entered into his body.
This was… the True Dragon of Fortune?
Ling Han smacked his lips.
He didn’t seem to feel anything at all.
He didn’t feel like he had been reborn, nor did he feel any lingering fragrance on his lips.
After complaining for a while, he walked towards the cave ahead of him, but he had only taken two steps, when he felt a chill run down his spine.
He felt that it was extremely dangerous.
One more step and he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
He activated his eye technique, and with a single glance, he understood.
There was a formation in front of him, perfectly and naturally blended into the heaven and earth, as if it was naturally formed, and this might… was indescribably terrifying.
Imperial Weapon!
This was Ling Han’s first feeling.
Previously, in the Blood Sea Mystery Realm, he had seen the Imperial Weapon unleash its might.
It was really that terrifying without bounds.
However, this was clearly just a formation.
Hiss, a Great Emperor killing formation!
Ling Han finally understood.
This formation had definitely been set up by the True Dragon.
Such a large formation could easily kill even Saints.
Even if the Saint wielded the Imperial Weapon, he would most likely only be able to ensure temporary safety.
Once the Imperial Weapon was unable to unleash its might, he would definitely be killed by the formation.
He couldn’t help but feel curious.
In the midst of such a Great Emperor killing formation, could it be that there was a rare treasure left behind by the True Dragon?
Otherwise, what need was there for the Great Emperor killing formation to protect it?
If he could break through the formation…
Ling Han’s heart couldn’t help but beat wildly.
That would naturally be a great profit.

However, he was only a Formation Grandmaster, and only the level above that was Formation Saint, but Formation Saints were only comparable to Saints, and could not possibly unravel the Great Emperor killing formation.
This was a Great Emperor formation, and only the Ancestral King could set it up, and only the Ancestral King could unravel it.
Sigh, there was nothing else he could do.
But the problem was, the True Dragon of Fortune was already in his hands, so why didn’t he
let him leave?
Could it be that the dragon-shaped white light previously wasn’t the True Dragon of Fortune?
Since he had nothing else to do, Ling Han began to study the Great Emperor killing formation.
If he could learn just a little bit, it would also increase his strength by an astonishing amount.

chapters.title: Chapter 4140: Golden Generation
paragraphs: Chapter 4140: Golden Generation
Ling Han tried his best, but he couldn’t figure out anything.
The Great Emperor killing formation was far beyond his current cultivation level, because even Saints could only stare at it helplessly.

Ling Han felt that it was a pity. He did not insist to learn the complete Great Emperor killing formation, but only needed to learn a corner of it. That would be enough to kill Venerate Tier elites and threaten Saints, right? Just like the Heavenly Dao Flames in his Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

So be it if he couldn’t learn it. As he worked hard on liquefying the alchemy pool, he cultivated the four newly obtained nine-star high-level energies, as well as the Icy Killing Celestial Finger. This was the Imperial Technique, and when he advanced into the True Self Tier, it could unleash a great might.

However, he couldn’t advance or retreat now, so what was the point of him being stuck here? In these few days, Ling Han had already visited all the places that he could set foot in, but this place was not very big. Furthermore, aside from this large cave, the other places were actually very ordinary. It was just that the grass and trees here were especially flourishing.
Another few days later, something flew over from the foot of the mountain.
Not one, but two, one in front and one behind. The distance between them was extremely small, so it was a visual misconception.
Similar to when he had come up, these were two people wrapped in flags.
Xiu, xiu! The flying speed of the flag was too fast. In the blink of an eye, they had already arrived here. Then, these two people also revealed their true appearances.

These two people were both male, and looked very young, but judging from the aura they exuded, it was really terrifying, especially that young man in yellow robes. His whole body was covered with black Demonic Qi that was boiling, as if with a slight tremor, he could tear apart the dome of heaven, which was terrifying to the extreme.

Though the other green-robed young man was not as domineering and peerless as the yellow-robed young man, he was similarly mighty and handsome. However, the gap in cultivation level was too wide. Instantly, he was like a firefly, his brilliance completely concealed.

One was a True Self Tier elite, while the other was… a Spirit Transformation Tier elite! Ling Han finally understood. These two people were the victors of the True Self Tier and Spirit Transformation Tier, just like how he was a representative of the Core Formation Tier.
Xiu, xiu! Two streaks of dragon-shaped white light surged past, and sank into the bodies of these two young men respectively.
The True Dragon of Fortune.

“Yi, Imperial Son Kui!” The green-robed young man clearly did not know who the person that had been with him previously was either, but when he saw the appearance of the yellow- robed young man, he immediately clasped his hands in greeting, showing a hint of respect. Imperial Son Kui?

Ling Han did not find his identity of the Imperial Son strange. He was sure that as long as there was an Imperial Son participating in the battle, unless they encountered a freakishly strong contender like him, they would usually be able to charge out and emerge victorious. But this was the first time he had heard the Imperial Son address himself as ‘Sunflower’.
Imperial Son Kui looked at the green-robed young man, and nodded, “You are Cheng Qing, right?”
“Precisely.” The green-robed young man was very polite. This was not just the respect due to a gap of a major tier between them, but also a reverence that came from deep within his bones.
Imperial Son Kui did not speak further. Instead, he looked ahead. As his eyes swept over, divine light intertwined, flickering with endless shards of seals.
Hiss, what a terrifying guy.
Ling Han had a feeling that if the other wanted to make a move on him, he would be able to kill him with a single thought.
It couldn’t be helped. The gap in cultivation level was too wide.

What was going on here? There was actually a Core Formation Tier, a True Self Tier and a Spirit Transformation Tier put together. Then wouldn’t the Spirit Transformation Tier be able to do as they pleased?
Imperial Son Kui didn’t cast a second look at Ling Han. Instead, he focused on the Great Emperor killing formation, and began to observe it with incredible concentration.

Ling Han shook his head internally. This was a Great Emperor killing formation. Putting aside the fact that you are only in Spiritual Transformation Tier, even if you had become a Saint, you would only be able to construct a corner of the damaged formation, at most, and even an Imperial Son could do nothing.

“Hehe, how did you emerge victorious from the ranks of the Core Formation Tier?” Cheng Qing was slightly curious about Ling Han. “We of the great Imperial Clans have already divided ourselves in private. The Donglin Clan, Fire Clouds Clan, Golden Cauldron Clan, and the other Imperial Clans sent out the Imperial Sons of the Core Formation Tier, but the one who appeared in the end was actually you!”
F***, the Imperial Clans would do such a thing?

In this way, the fortune of the True Dragon would be monopolized by the Imperial Clans. Furthermore, the competition among the Imperial Clans was also limited to a limited number of clans, so every Imperial Clan could see hope of winning.

Of course, they would consider themselves unlucky if they encountered Ling Han. This guy was even more freakish than the Imperial Son. Even Baili Che and the other Imperial Sons were no match for him.

Thoughts flashed through Ling Han’s mind like lightning. He was sure that the True Dragon would not be so unfair, leaving him here to be bullied by a True Self Tier and Spirit Transformation Tier. There should be some kind of restriction here. If they really came to blows, everyone’s cultivation level would be pulled to the same level.
Or perhaps… they couldn’t fight at all?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “A bunch of weaklings, I easily swept aside all opposition.”

“Hahahaha!” Cheng Qing laughed loudly, then shook his head, “This generation’s Imperial Sons are really useless! Brat, you are very lucky that you were not born a hundred years ago. Otherwise, you would know the terror of the Golden Generation.”
What golden generation?
Ling Han thought to himself, but did not ask.

However, this Cheng Qing seemed to have some potential as a chatterer, and took the initiative to say, “A hundred years ago, martial arts welcomed an unprecedented prosperity. Not only did a great many excellent clansmen that could match the Great Emperor in their youth appear among the Imperial Clans, even ordinary clans produced a great many
prodigies.”
“Do you see him?”

He pointed at Imperial Son Kui and said, “This is a member of the Golden Generation. He’s only 100 years old, yet he’s already at the Spiritual Transformation Tier. I’m sure that he’ll become a Sect Master before 200 years old. He’ll become a Venerate at 300 years old, and he’ll become a Saint at 500 years old!”
“Becoming a Saint at five hundred years old. Throughout history, this kind of aptitude is enough to be ranked in the top ten, but in this world, there are as many as a hundred such
prodigies!”
“Thus, if you were born in that era, brat, you would definitely feel endless despair!”
Cheng Qing was extremely rueful, as if he was also annoyed at himself for not having been born a few years earlier, and become a member of the Golden Generation.

In truth, since he could charge out of the ranks of True Self Tier, he was definitely one of the strongest in this cultivation level, yet still revered the Golden Generation so much. It could be imagined just how freakish a prodigy like Imperial Son Kui was.
They could only look up to him, and were not even qualified to compete.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he asked, “Is Lin Xuan from the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan also from the Golden Generation?”

“Imperial Son Xuan? Of course.” Cheng Qing nodded. This guy really didn’t have any airs. He paused, then said quietly, “Imperial Son Xuan is one of the top few in the Golden Generation, and has long since advanced into Sect Master level.”
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He had killed Lin Lang, so he was definitely going to clash with the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, and face an awesome character like Imperial Son Xuan.
But it was only an instant, and his heroic spirit soared. So what if it was Imperial Son Xuan? He
would defeat him!
“Are the people of that generation all addressed as Imperial Son Xuan and Imperial Son Kui?”
he asked again.
“That’s right. Only the Golden Generation has that kind of qualification.” Cheng Qing nodded, then gave an ‘oh’, and asked Ling Han, “Oh, that’s right, what was your name again?”
“Ling Han,” Ling Han replied with a smile.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
“Yi, you are that Ling Han?” Cheng Qing was slightly surprised, then laughed, “No wonder
you managed to stand out from the rest. I heard that you are called the Imperial Son killer,
which really seems like it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4141: All five assembled
paragraphs: Chapter 4141: All five assembled
Imperial Son killer?

Ling Han chuckled upon hearing this. He had only killed one Imperial Son, and no one in the outside world knew about this either. Thus, the name of Imperial Son killer most likely didn’t mean that he had truly killed an Imperial Son. Rather, he was powerful enough to snipe an Imperial Son.

“Yi?” Cheng Qing looked confused again. “Wasn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan distributed into the Core Formation Tier? Their Imperial Daughter is claimed to have aptitude that is not inferior to the Golden Generation, yet she was actually defeated by you?”

This was terrifying. The Imperial Son was incredibly awesome in the first place, and the numer one of the Galaxy Network was practically trash in front of them, and the Golden Generation was even more people who would render despair to all the prodigies of the world. And now, an Imperial Daughter that was comparable to the Golden Generation had actually been eliminated. This was a little inexcusable, wasn’t it?
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I wasn’t the one who defeated Chi Menghan. She was most likely defeated by Baili Che, Xu Jie, and the others.”

“No wonder.” Cheng Qing nodded. Though the Golden Generation was awesome, at the level of the Core Formation Tier, the Golden Generation was still unable to truly grasp the Regulations of heaven and earth. The gap with other prodigies was not completely widened. Moreover, Chi Menghan was only comparable to the Golden Generation, and not the real Golden Generation.
“That’s not right!” Cheng Qing found it strange again, “Then how did you come out victorious, brat?”
“Me?” Ling Han smiled, “I hid first, then took advantage of the situation.”

These words were more or less correct. He had indeed gone into hiding first, but it was not because he feared the enemy, but rather because he was charging towards the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and the so-called taking advantage of others was only self- effacing.
But in Cheng Qing’s eyes, this was only to be expected.

-Ling Han must have gone into hiding first, and waited for Baili Che and the others to battle Chi Menghan to the point that both sides were severely wounded. Only then did he come out to take advantage of the situation, and win in a single stroke.
Of course, a starving camel was still bigger than a horse. Ordinary people would not be able to take this kind of advantage at all, which also showed how strong Ling Han was.
Asking Cheng Qing to believe that Ling Han had defeated Baili Che and the other Imperial Sons by himself?
Hehe, what a joke.
Xiu, right at this moment, another streak of light shot over from below.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
This was either the winner from Foundation Building Tier or Cauldron Forging Tier.
With a flash, a delicate and enchanting young girl appeared.
“Niu is here!” This young girl was very mischievous. The moment she landed, she waved her arms and called out loudly, looking very childish.
Xiu, a dragon-shaped white light surged past, and sank into the young girl’s body.
The True Dragon of Fortune!

Cheng Qing’s eyes immediately lit up. This young girl was really indescribably beautiful. Furthermore, she was delicate and naive, filled with an innocent temperament, that made even his heart beat wildly.

It should be known that she had won out in the contest with Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters. Thus, this young girl was not only beautiful, but her natural talent in cultivation was also unbelievably strong.
Which Imperial Daughter was this?
“Er, it’s best that you don’t think too much about it,” Ling Han said.
“Yi, how do you know what I’m thinking?” Cheng Qing was surprised, then shook his head abruptly, “No, no, no, what I’m thinking, what can you control?”
F***, how could it be that he would need Ling Han’s approval to pursue a woman?
“Ling Han!” Hu Niu had already spotted Ling Han, and instantly pounced over like a tiger, jumping directly into Ling Han’s arms.
Meanwhile, Ling Han laughed loudly and hugged Hu Niu. “Is Luan Xing all right?”

“She’s all right, she’s all right. The two of us worked together, and beat up those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters until they were completely and utterly defeated. In the end, we played a game of rock-paper-scissors, and she lost, so Niu came over,” Hu Niu said in a stuttering voice. Though she was rushing and fast, she was extremely clear.
Ling Han nodded, “That’s good.”

On the sidelines, Cheng Qing was watching dumbfounded. What was going on here? The little beauty that he had just taken a fancy to was actually embracing Ling Han. Obviously, they were already a couple.

Cheng Qing couldn’t help but feel gloomy. It was very difficult for an Imperial Son like him to fall in love with a woman. It was not just her looks, but more importantly, her bearing. Furthermore, Hu Niu was innocent, and as pure as a blank piece of paper, causing his heart to throb wildly with a single look. However, he had not thought that she was already taken.
However, on second thought, he couldn’t help but feel shocked.

This couple was too freakish, weren’t they? They were the champions of two cultivation levels, Cauldron Forging Tier and Core Formation Tier, so when they matured and joined forces, would they be able to match even the Golden Generation?
Regardless of how friendly prodigies were with other prodigies, they still couldn’t stay together all day. However, lovers could.

“The Cauldron Forging Tier has also arrived, and there’s one more Foundation Building Tier we’re waiting for, before we are all assembled,” Ling Han murmured. The True Dragon put the victors together; it couldn’t be that it was bored, right?

“Sigh!” Cheng Qing sighed from the sidelines, but Hu Niu was only focused on chattering about her experiences on the way here, and Ling Han was also listening with interest. Neither of them had any intention of paying attention to him.
This made Cheng Qing feel even more depressed. He couldn’t help but ask, “Can the two of you have some sympathy?”
“You’re not injured, so what’s the point of pitying you?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“Who said I didn’t? My heart is hurt.” Cheng Qing made a gesture of holding his heart. “It wasn’t easy for me to fall in love with someone, but who would’ve thought that she was already taken? What’s more infuriating is that you people are actually showing off your love in front of me. Isn’t that a little too cruel?”

F***, believe it or not, I really will hit someone?
Cheng Qing sighed in despair. Was this the first couple in history to appear here?

She was astonishingly beautiful, but in front of Hu Niu, she had no choice but to pale in comparison. After all, though she was a beauty, she had not reached the level of top ten on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard yet.

This made the Imperial Daughter of the Peacock Imperial Clan very displeased. However, the gap in cultivation level was too wide. She was completely no match for Hu Niu, and could only hate her a few times in her heart.
Of course, she had also obtained the True Dragon of Fortune, and all five of them were
together.
At this time, Imperial Son Kui also walked back, a hint of regret on his face. Unfortunately, after seeing the Great Emperor killing formation, he didn’t gain anything at
all.

Imperial Son killer?
Ling Han chuckled upon hearing this.
He had only killed one Imperial Son, and no one in the outside world knew about this either.
Thus, the name of Imperial Son killer most likely didn’t mean that he had truly killed an Imperial Son.
Rather, he was powerful enough to snipe an Imperial Son.
“Yi?” Cheng Qing looked confused again.
“Wasn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan distributed into the Core Formation Tier?
Their Imperial Daughter is claimed to have aptitude that is not inferior to the Golden Generation, yet she was actually defeated by you?”
This was terrifying.

The Imperial Son was incredibly awesome in the first place, and the numer one of the Galaxy Network was practically trash in front of them, and the Golden Generation was even more people who would render despair to all the prodigies of the world.
And now, an Imperial Daughter that was comparable to the Golden Generation had actually been eliminated.
This was a little inexcusable, wasn’t it?
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I wasn’t the one who defeated Chi Menghan.
She was most likely defeated by Baili Che, Xu Jie, and the others.”
“No wonder.” Cheng Qing nodded.
Though the Golden Generation was awesome, at the level of the Core Formation Tier, the Golden Generation was still unable to truly grasp the Regulations of heaven and earth.
The gap with other prodigies was not completely widened.
Moreover, Chi Menghan was only comparable to the Golden Generation, and not the real Golden Generation.
“That’s not right!” Cheng Qing found it strange again, “Then how did you come out victorious, brat?”
“Me?” Ling Han smiled, “I hid first, then took advantage of the situation.”
These words were more or less correct.

He had indeed gone into hiding first, but it was not because he feared the enemy, but rather because he was charging towards the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and the so-called taking advantage of others was only self- effacing.

-Ling Han must have gone into hiding first, and waited for Baili Che and the others to battle Chi Menghan to the point that both sides were severely wounded.

Of course, a starving camel was still bigger than a horse.
Ordinary people would not be able to take this kind of advantage at all, which also showed how strong Ling Han was.
Asking Cheng Qing to believe that Ling Han had defeated Baili Che and the other Imperial Sons by himself?
Hehe, what a joke.

F***, how could it be that he would need Ling Han’s approval to pursue a woman?

chapters.title: Chapter 4142: Entering the Cave
paragraphs: Chapter 4142: Entering the Cave
Now that they were here, no one doubted that this must be the handiwork of the True Dragon. Thus, this light must also be the handiwork of the True Dragon.

This was the True Dragon, an existence on the level of a Great Emperor. Furthermore, it was in an era when even Divine Beasts had appeared, but it was still an Emperor among Emperors. It was indescribably terrifying.
Who wouldn’t feel uneasy when they were struck by this kind of light?

Even Imperial Son Kui’s expression was solemn. Though he was from the Golden Generation, and had already advanced into Spirit Transformation Tier now, an elite that was only one step away from achieving Sect Master level, in front of the handiwork of the True Dragon, he was weak to the point that he could not withstand a single blow.

Emperors stood high above the Nine Heavens, looking down on all life. Even if they had died millions and millions of years ago, the methods they had laid out could still easily kill Saints. Only another Emperor could match an Emperor.

Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower vibrated lightly in Ling Han’s mind. This was forged from the Origin Gold, a future Imperial Weapon. Sensing the Emperor-level power, it was as if it had been pumped full of adrenaline, and was so excited that it wanted to rush out and fight.
In the past, it was the same. Three Imperial Weapons were contending for glory, and this guy was also itching to give it a try.
Sigh, it clearly hadn’t become an Imperial Weapon yet, so it was really worrisome.
Not only that, but the alchemy pool in Ling Han’s body was also boiling, exuding an indestructible aura, ancient and supreme.
This aura spread out uncontrollably, and involuntarily, Imperial Son Kui, Cheng Qing, and the Peacock Imperial Clan’s Imperial Daughter all looked stunned.
To Imperial Son Kui and Cheng Qing, this aura couldn’t be considered powerful at all. However, in terms of quality, it was extremely noble, as if they had seen a Great Emperor.
This was far too astounding. This aura was actually exuding from the body of a non-Imperial Clan elite!

Imperial Son Kui couldn’t help but show a hint of killing intent in his expression. Although the Golden Generation had appeared, and it was extremely possible that it could shatter the eternal “curse” and end the history of the Imperial Clan being unable to produce an Ancestral King, throughout history, those who became Emperors were all not members of the Imperial Clan.
From this aspect, the possibility of Ling Han becoming an Emperor was far higher than that of the Imperial Clan, especially when he showed this kind of aura.
Imperial Son Kui naturally wanted to break through to the Imperial Path as well. Thus, Ling Han naturally became an obstacle.
Hu Niu was extremely sensitive to killing intent, and she immediately glared at Imperial Son Kui. She bared her teeth, revealing her snow-white teeth. She looked much like a little tiger.
She couldn’t care less. If anyone dared to harm Ling Han, they would be her enemy!
What Golden Generation!
‘Die!’
Hu Niu pounced out without any fear, charging towards Imperial Son Kui.
This was like a moth flying into a flame. Imperial Son Kui humphed, and with a thought, it turned into a war hammer that smashed towards Hu Niu.
A mere thought was enough for a Spirit Transformation Tier elite to kill a Cauldron Forging Tier.
However, when the battle hammer smashed down, it completely missed its target.
It wasn’t that Hu Niu’s movement technique was very agile, but rather that they seemed to be transparent and couldn’t come into contact at all.
Thus, the battle hammer missed its target, and Hu Niu’s attack was also ineffective. It directly passed through Imperial Son Kui.
Obviously, a fight couldn’t break out here.
The True Dragon had gathered them together, not for them to fight. Otherwise, even if it was just an ordinary Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator, Cheng Qing was still completely no match for him.

Imperial Son Kui couldn’t help but frown. He couldn’t make a move here, so he wouldn’t be able to kill Ling Han. Once he left, his relevant memories would be severed, and he would no longer remember Ling Han, his future rival on the Imperial Path.
Boom, the aura around him boiled, and with a thought from him, multiple Regulations of heaven and earth materialized, like divine chains, interweaving into a net.

Cheng Qing couldn’t help but feel his eyes light up. An ordinary Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator wouldn’t be able to do this. A Golden Generation cultivator was really too awesome, capable of making even the prodigies of the current generation submit.
Ling Han also set his eyes on Imperial Son Kui, as if he wanted to carve him deeply into the depths of his mind, and would never forget him in future.
He was going to kill this person!

Imperial Son Kui did not take Ling Han’s gaze seriously at all. In his eyes, even if Ling Han advanced into Spiritual Transformation Tier, there was still no way that Ling Han could be a match for him. What did the words ‘Golden Generation’ mean?
That was a generation that had suppressed the prodigies of all eternity, a generation that had never been seen before, and would never be seen again.

If it was not for the fact that he had come from the Imperial Clan, and Ling Han had come from a common background, so the possibility of him becoming an Emperor was inferior to Ling Han, he would not have taken Ling Han seriously at all.
Right at this moment, the green light that shot out from the cave suddenly stopped. Then, Hu Niu, Imperial Son Kui and the others all began to shatter.
They were about to be teleported away.
However, Ling Han shockingly discovered that he hadn’t changed in the slightest.
What was going on?
He had been left here alone?
“Ling Han!” Hu Niu called out loudly, transmitting a wave of divine sense.

She stretched out a hand, wanting to grab Ling Han, resisting and unwilling to disappear, but how could she possibly match the power of the True Dragon? With a shake of her figure, she had already disappeared without a trace.
Imperial Son Kui, Cheng Qing, and the Imperial Daughter of the Peacock Imperial Clan also looked surprised. What did leaving Ling Han alone here mean?
However, they did not have the chance to continue observing, and were similarly thrown out
of this space.
In this place, Ling Han was the only one left.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. What the hell was going on here?

This place was like a prison, and there was no way out in all directions. Furthermore, the cave was sealed off by the Great Emperor killing formation, so it could be said that he could not advance or retreat. Was he being retained and imprisoned?
Yi?
Ling Han shockingly discovered that his body was glowing.
This was not something that he had activated on his own volition, and did not belong to any
means that he possessed either.
‘What was the meaning of this?’

The True Dragon naturally wouldn’t do something meaningless-however, judging from the situation on the Giant Island, the gambling island, and the boasting island, this True Dragon actually didn’t lack bad taste-then, he wouldn’t light up for no reason.
Could it be?
Ling Han tried to walk forwards, very slowly. Then, he used his eye technique, and as he approached, the Great Emperor killing formation at the forefront was dimming, its might not
apparent.
Ha, haha!
Ling Han finally understood why he was left alone here, and why he was glowing. As it turned out, the True Dragon had chosen him, allowing him to enter into the cave.
This caused Ling Han to rub his hands together in excitement. This was the True Dragon’s
Secret Cave, a Great Emperor’s treasure chamber!
He was rich, he was rich.
Ling Han slowly walked forwards. Ahead of him, the Great Emperor killing formation dimmed, one area after another, while behind him, they lit up, one after another, as if they
had deliberately opened up a passageway for him.
Not long after, Ling Han arrived at the entrance of the cave.
Previously, this formation was surrounded by the great killing formation. Not only was it impassable, but Ling Han couldn’t even see the exact details of the situation clearly. It was
only after he arrived that Ling Han could see clearly.
Hiss!
He couldn’t help but inhale sharply, looking endlessly pleasantly surprised. That was because there was shockingly a tree growing at the cave entrance. It was not very
tall, only nine meters tall, but its trunk was sturdy like a dragon. Furthermore, it was covered with scales. It really looked like a great dragon that was about to furiously dance into the
skies.
This was the Heavenly Dragon Tree!

Mother Tree, the highest grade of Mother Tree. According to legends, it was originally Saintly medicine-level, but after being nurtured by the Dragon Qi for a long time, it finally took another step further, and became Emperor-level.
There was only one mother tree in the world, and the other Heavenly Dragon Trees were all its
descendants.
Ling Han hurriedly ran over. However, the light on his body dimmed, and was no longer able
to suppress the Great Emperor killing formation.
He had no choice but to stop in his tracks. It was extremely unfortunate.

chapters.title: Chapter 4143: Dragon egg?
paragraphs: Chapter 4143: Dragon egg?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel gloomy. He had already been allowed to come here, but why couldn’t he be allowed to harvest the Great Herb?
This Heavenly Dragon Tree bore seven fruits, and they were all ripe, exuding an intoxicating fragrance. There were multiple seals on their surface, representing the highest level of
Regulations.
Initially, this was Saint-level, but under the influence of the aura of the True Dragon, it possessed Emperor-level veined patterns.
These were Emperor-level celestial fruits! They could be seen from afar, yet they couldn’t be harvested. This was truly infuriating.

Ling Han smelt the fruity fragrance. The Great Herb truly lived up to its name. Even a mere sniff was enough to make all the pores on his body open up, as if a mysterious energy was surging into his body, causing him to undergo a complete transformation.

This effect was very similar to the Dragon Essence, but the effects far surpassed that. After all, the Dragon Essence was only the breath of the True Dragon, while the Heavenly Dragon Tree had been nurtured and grown by the True Dragon.

Ling Han wasn’t willing to leave. He simply stood there to absorb the scent of the Heavenly Dragon Fruit. He could clearly feel that his body had changed. His physical power and physique had both improved considerably.
However, by the third day, there was no further improvement when he smelled the fruity fragrance again.
After all, it was only fruity fragrance, so its effects were limited.
Ling Han sighed, and could only continue onwards.

He entered into the True Dragon’s Cave. The True Dragon had sent off everyone else, leaving him alone. It was definitely not for him to smell the fruity fragrance to play around with him. What was hidden in this cave?
Ling Han was extremely careful as he slowly advanced.
Inside the cave, treasures were scattered all over the ground.

Precious Divine Metal could be seen everywhere, and even Seven Star-level ones were not rare, but there was no Saintly Material or Origin Gold. Material of this level was really too rare, especially Origin Gold. Even a Great Emperor would have to take a certain risk to be able to obtain it. After all, there were some places in the world that even a Great Emperor would consider a danger zone.
There was no Great Emperor killing formation here. Ling Han picked up a few pieces of Seven Star Divine Metal.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to pick up a few more pieces, but rather that he discovered that the Spatial Tool had lost its effect.
The stingy True Dragon, he could only smell the Heavenly Dragon Fruit, and he could not pick up these precious materials as he liked.
Sigh, how many years has it been since your death? What is the point of having so many things?
As Ling Han mocked, he continued to walk deeper into the cave.
This cave was really huge, and there were no winding passages. The entire mountainside had been hollowed out, and it was completely empty.

The True Dragon seemed to be very interested in collecting Divine Metal. There were Divine Metal above Five Stars everywhere in this place, many of them. They were all colourful, and all of them were exuding brilliant light. However, some of them had already decayed.

It was said that even Saint-level materials could not match the power of time, and only the Origin Gold could exist eternally. Thus, it would not be strange even if the Seven Star Divine Metal had decayed.
Ling Han became numb after staring at it for a while. He withdrew his gaze, and focused on walking forwards.
After a while, he finally arrived at the end of the cave.

Compared to the extravagance of other places, this place could only be described as filthy and disorderly, because the other places were all filled with shimmering Divine Metal, all colourful and bright, but this place was a nest made of tree branches, and most of it had already rotted.
However, Ling Han didn’t underestimate these broken branches at all. In fact, he even revealed a pained expression.
This was a top grade mother tree, which had been severed by a profligate True Dragon, and made into a habitat!
Why was this the same as Pseudo-Emperor Doga? Could it be that anyone with the word Emperor in their title simply loved cutting down mother trees?

Ling Han mocked. There were only a few top grade mother trees in the world, and even the Imperial Clans may not all possess them, but here, the True Dragon had severed the mother tree and made it into a bed. Just how extravagant was that?
You are awesome.

He surveyed the surroundings. This bed of the True Dragon was incredibly colossal, measuring about thirty meters in diameter. It was circular in shape, and Ling Han believed that this shouldn’t be the True Dragon’s true size. According to legends, these Divine Beasts were all larger than planets.
Why did he only make such a small bed?
That was simple. To build a bed that was larger than a planet… did he have so many mother trees that he could squander?
Thus, even the True Dragon could only make do with it, and create such a “small bed”. He channelled the mystical power and made his body smaller, so he could still lie down.
Ling Han looked towards the bed of the True Dragon, and saw that it was not empty, but rather an egg was placed there.
However, there seemed to be a layer of something like amber condensed on the outside of this egg, which wrapped around the whole egg. It was very all-encompassing, with no spots
missed.
Ling Han immediately had an instinctive feeling. This was the most precious item of the True Dragon’s Secret Cave. Putting everything else aside, being laid on the bed of the True Dragon
was enough to explain everything.
Was it delicious? Very nutritious?

Ling Han thought internally. However, this egg had experienced who knew how much time. Since it had been left behind by the True Dragon, it could be traced back to the time when the heaven and earth first created, and was as ancient as could be.
You see, even the Divine Metal had decayed, so could this egg still be eaten?
The shelf life shouldn’t be that long, right?

Ling Han looked at this True Dragon’s bed again. The remaining wood that had not rotted were all branches from the mother tree, and every single one of them was incredibly precious. Combined together, they could completely be made into a bed that was suitable for him.
Right at this moment, a ray of light flashed past, and landed on that egg.
It was light again!
Ling Han mocked. What changes would there be this time?

He looked, and saw that the layer that had wrapped around the egg was actually slowly melting, but it was not turning into liquid. Instead, it had directly turned into gas, which naturally blended with the heaven and earth, and very soon, disappeared completely. In this way, this egg was completely displayed in front of Ling Han. Previously, with this amber-like object blocking it, Ling Han could not see clearly. He only knew that this was an egg, but now, he could finally see clearly. The surface of the egg was covered with green veined patterns, exuding an incredibly ancient aura.
In fact, Ling Han even felt a sliver of life fluctuation.
Yi, this egg was still alive?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel shocked. This was really a joke. How many years had it been?
Even the Divine Metal had mostly rotted, and in this period of time, who knew how many Ancestral Kings had experienced the rise and fall of power, but this egg was actually still
alive?
How could he believe this?
However, Ling Han trusted his instincts. This egg was definitely exuding the fluctuations of
life, and there was nothing false about it.
Ka, a crisp sound rang out, which seemed to be ear-piercing in this quiet space.
No way?
Ka, ka, ka, ka! A series of crisp sounds rang out.
Ling Han couldn’t help but widen his eyes in shock. He looked at the egg in front of him, and
there were already multiple cracks on it.
The life inside the egg was about to hatch.
This was too fast, wasn’t it?
What was inside?
It can’t be… the descendant of the True Dragon, right?
Ling Han suddenly recalled that there was an egg in the True Dragon’s nest, and it was very
likely that it was a dragon egg.
Would a small dragon hatch from within?
Going by the age, it was very likely that this was the son or daughter of the True Dragon, and that was the Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter in the true meaning of the word.
If that was really the case, Ling Han couldn’t help but feel curious. Compared to the Golden Generation, who would be stronger?
Ka, ka, ka! Just as he was lost in thought, the veined patterns on the egg increased further, and with a pa, it shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 4144: Entrusting me with your child
paragraphs: Chapter 4144: Entrusting me with your child
Ling Han was filled with anticipation. What would be hatched from this?
Er, it was fine as long as it wasn’t the Calabash Brothers.
The answer was soon revealed. The egg shell shattered, revealing a green creature. It looked like a snake, but had four small feet.
“What an ugly guy!” Ling Han gritted his teeth. Was this really the child of a True Dragon? Why did it look more like a four-legged snake?
At this moment, the four-legged snake suddenly opened its mouth and started chewing on the egg shell.
Crack, crack, the sound was crisp and clear.
As a glutton, Ling Han actually couldn’t help but swallow. Seeing how this little guy was eating so happily, and crunching each bite, this thing should be very delicious, right?
As if sensing Ling Han’s craving, the four-legged snake actually stopped and looked at Ling Han with disdain.
F***, he was being looked down on by a four-legged snake!
Ling Han flew into a humiliated rage. Since he had been seen through, then he would not be reserved.

He jumped onto the True Dragon’s nest and prepared to have a taste of the egg shell as well. However, before he had even set foot on the branch of the mother tree, he was rebounded back by a massive force.
Peng, like a cannonball, he crashed heavily into the pile of Divine Metal at the back.
“Hahahaha!” The four-legged snake laughed loudly, and even pressed its two front paws on its body, as if it was holding its stomach in laughter.
Ling Han was extremely depressed. At first, he had wanted to throw away his pride and also have a taste of the egg shell. He had not thought that after failing, he would be mocked again.
Speaking of which, was this four-legged snake a little Azure Dragon?

“One from the future era!” A mighty voice rang out, and the image of a True Dragon appeared, exuding a supreme aura. This was the austere aura of a Great Emperor, and no existence could possibly simulate it. This True Dragon danced in midair just like that, its copper bell-sized eyes staring at Ling Han, “This is my youngest son, who has been left until today to emerge and fight for that sliver of fated opportunity. I hope you can take care of him.”

The little green dragon immediately showed an expression of defiance. It was about to speak up in objection, but then it seemed to have recalled something, and shut its mouth, continuing to chew on the egg shell.
Crack, crack. It was as if he was angering Ling Han, and deliberately chewed loudly.

Ling Han really wanted to rush up and beat him up, but firstly, he couldn’t, and secondly, his old man was staring at him. Even if he had long since died for who knew how many billions of years, and only a sliver of thought was left, killing him would still be as easy as the turn of a palm.
Fine, I’ll bear with it.

“One from the future era, you are the only person that I have chosen through tens of thousands of generations, and your future accomplishments are limitless!” The True Dragon continued, “Of course, I will not ask you to help me for nothing either.”
He moved his claws, and xiu, seven fruits flew over.
Heavenly Dragon Fruit!

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his eyes light up. This was Emperor-level celestial fruits, the most awesome Great Herb. Previously, he had wanted to harvest it, but had been restricted by the Great Emperor killing formation. He had not thought that the True Dragon would take the initiative to put it right in front of him.
All right, he would help him with this. As for taking care of a little green dragon, it was no big deal.
Hey, wait, what is the meaning of this?

Ling Han was surprised, because when the seven Heavenly Dragon Fruits flew in front of him, six of them actually turned around and continued to fly towards that little green dragon, and only one of them landed.
‘Oh, so I only have one?’

In truth, this was an Emperor-level Great Herb. Even one was enough to make Saints bleed, and make all the Imperial Clans move for it. But who asked the True Dragon to take seven at once, yet only give him one?
Are you trying to tempt me?
The six Heavenly Dragon Fruits landed on the True Dragon’s nest, and lined up in front of the little azure dragon.
What a waste. It was so small, so shouldn’t it be drinking milk? What need was there for the Heavenly Dragon Fruits!
Then, Ling Han discovered that this little green dragon… was very despicable.

He actually bared his teeth in a grin at Ling Han, as he fiddled with the Heavenly Dragon Fruits in front of him. His intention to attract animosity could not be more obvious. F***, have you really just hatched? Your expressions are a little too rich, aren’t they? Meanwhile, the True Dragon cast a doting look at his youngest son, then said to Ling Han, “My youngest son has been envied by the heavens before he was even born, and has an internal injury. Thus, I have no choice but to seal him within the Celestial Source, sealing off the loss of his life essence, and use time to slowly remove the internal injury, so that he would be born at a suitable time in the future.”
“Though time can heal internal injuries, it still hurts the foundations. I nurtured the Heavenly Dragon Tree for the sake of forming the Heavenly Dragon Fruit to heal the foundations of my
son.”
Oh, so that was the case.

This time, Ling Han felt much better. The Heavenly Dragon Tree had been forcibly upgraded from Saint Tier to Emperor Tier in order to heal the little azure dragon. It was already very good that he could get a share of the fruits.
Moreover, what kind of existence was the True Dragon? Was there any need to explain anything to him?
From this aspect, the True Dragon indeed thought very highly of him.

However, Ling Han was also filled with curiosity. Since the Divine Beast was created by the heaven and earth, it should have been favoured by the heavens, so why would a descendant of the True Dragon be envied by the heaven and earth? Furthermore, even the Great Emperor couldn’t heal its internal injuries, and it had to use the Celestial Source to seal it away, using endless time to expel its internal injuries, what exactly had this little azure dragon suffered? However, the True Dragon had absolutely no intention of explaining further. His figure floated slightly, and continued, “I have created a cultivation technique of my own called Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and I am teaching it to you now. In future, you will be responsible for teaching my son how to cultivate it. If he can successfully cultivate it, he would be able to possess the power of the True Dragon, and would have no fear of anyone in
this era.”
The True Dragon stretched out a massive claw, and lightly tapped Ling Han’s forehead. Instantly, a ball of light surged into Ling Han’s mind.
Boom, this amount of information was too colossal, and Ling Han couldn’t accept it for a
moment, directly passing out.
The True Dragon didn’t care. In any case, this wasn’t harmful.
He looked at his youngest son, his eyes flickering with affection.

If it was not for the sake of this youngest son, what need was there for him to painstakingly leave behind a sliver of consciousness? This sliver of consciousness was trapped here, and had experienced millions and millions of years of loneliness, which was enough to drive anyone
crazy.

However, he still endured it. Firstly, it was because he was a Great Emperor, and had this kind of temperament and cultivation level. Secondly, it was also because of his love for his youngest son, that he was willing to endure this kind of loneliness. He was only willing to entrust his youngest son to someone who he could trust and was also strong.

The little azure dragon no longer looked despicable. He stopped eating the egg shell, raised his head, and looked into the eyes of the True Dragon. His eyes were slightly wet. Although he had just been born, he still had a vague consciousness inside the egg shell. His intelligence had long since developed.
“In the future, you need to walk on your own,” the True Dragon said, its voice vast and mighty, possessing supreme authority.
The little azure dragon nodded, finally tearing up. That was because it knew that this sliver of divine sense of the True Dragon had completed its mission, and was about to completely
disperse.
This was not death, but rather a release.
“This boy has great fortune and great future prospects. If you follow him, you may be able to avoid the future calamity of death,” the True Dragon continued.
The little azure dragon continued to nod, its eyes filled with tears, appearing very adorable.
“I’m going now.” The figure of the True Dragon began to dissipate, but his eyes were fixed on his child. That was a kind of deep longing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4145: Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique
paragraphs: Chapter 4145: Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique
Ling Han’s head was practically about to explode.

He had obtained a true Great Emperor Tier-level cultivation technique, and it was all stuffed into his mind. Multiple seals were glowing, brighter than even the sun, so Ling Han couldn’t touch them at all, nor could he see them clearly.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower unleashed its might, releasing waves of power. Finally, these seals dimmed and sank into his mind.
He could finally study it.
All of a sudden, Ling Han experienced endless enlightenment.

He had completely forgotten the passing of time. Perhaps a year had passed, or perhaps ten years had passed, and he was immersed in the cultivation technique of the Great Emperor, turning it into his own.
Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was a Body Arts technique.
Why could the True Dragon become the leader of the Divine Beasts?

This was because his Body Art was also Emperor Tier. He didn’t need to use high-level energy to exchange blows with the other Divine Beasts. In terms of defense, only the Black Tortoise was slightly superior to the True Dragon.
However, this kind of strength was an instinct that he had been born with. It originated from the good fortune of heaven and earth, and not something that the True Dragon had learned on its own.
Dragons had nine sons, and each had their own unique traits. However, none of them had inherited his abilities.

Thus, the True Dragon began to extract its own power for research, and finally created a cultivation technique like the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. As long as one successfully cultivated it, one would be able to leap over the Dragon’s Gate and transform into the True Dragon.

Theoretically speaking, this was purely a Body Art. Thus, even if there was already an Ancestral King existing in this era, or even if the era did not allow the birth of Ancestral Kings, one could still become a Great Emperor in a different manner, and reach the level of Great Emperor in terms of Body Art. He was completely capable of crushing Saints and contending against the Imperial Weapon.
Of course, becoming an Emperor in a different manner was ultimately not the right path. He would not be recognized by the heaven and earth, so he was still no match for the true Ancestral King.
But in the eyes of the True Dragon, even if he was outmatched, he would be more than capable of protecting himself.

This stunned Ling Han. This was an Emperor, the strongest existence in the world. Only one could appear in an era, and he could rule the world on his own. Killing anyone he wanted could be done with a single thought.

But as long as he had successfully cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, he would be able to contend against a Great Emperor, which was enough to protect himself. Just how terrifying would that have to be?

However, it was not a simple matter to cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. First, one had to possess the bloodline of the True Dragon, and lastly, complete the leap over the Dragon’s Gate and transform into the body of the True Dragon.
Then what about Ling Han?

It was fine. Previously, he had been nurtured by the Dragon Essence, which improved his physique, so he had already possessed a sliver of the True Dragon bloodline. However, this amount was pitifully small. However, if he ingested another Heavenly Dragon Fruit, it would be enough to strengthen this amount, allowing him to cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique.

No wonder the True Dragon gave him a Heavenly Dragon Fruit. Otherwise, so what if he was bestowed with the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique? He would not be able to cultivate it at all, so there was naturally no kindness to speak of.
Right now, Ling Han was indebted to the True Dragon, a great favour to an existence from several eras ago. How was he supposed to repay this debt? So he should pay it back to the little green dragon.
However, when Ling Han thought of how despicable the little azure dragon was, he felt depressed and displeased.
Forget it. In future, he would just leave it to the large black dog, and see who was more despicable.

He digested this cultivation technique, and there were no verbal chants or whatnot at all. In truth, it was still a kind of understanding of the Dao of heaven and earth. It was just that this had taken an unconventional path, and did not cultivate the mystical power of heaven and earth, nor did it cultivate the Regulations of heaven and earth. It had purely become physical power.
This was not something that could be accomplished just by obtaining the cultivation technique. Instead, one had to fully comprehend and understand it.
It was completely dependent on comprehension. No one could help him. If he understood, he understood. If he didn’t, he didn’t.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮

Thus, when the True Dragon told Ling Han to teach the little azure dragon, it was completely the True Dragon being polite. He couldn’t teach it at all. Furthermore, the azure dragon had completely inherited the True Dragon bloodline. If he wanted to cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, the difficulty level would definitely be much lower than Ling
Han.
Thus, the only possibility was that Ling Han would not be able to fully comprehend the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and it would absolutely not be the case for the little
azure dragon.

-That was because this cultivation technique had been created by the True Dragon for the sake of its descendants. It itself naturally had this kind of ability, so what need was there for it to cultivate this?

Ling Han couldn’t help but think of a problem. At that time, the True Dragon had nine sons, and if all of them had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, wouldn’t they be able to contend with the Great Emperor? Why couldn’t he see any True Dragon at all now?
There were indeed some races that were known as the Dragon Tribe, but they were all flood dragons, and were quite far away from the real True Dragon.

An Imperial Clan should have existed for all eternity, especially the Dragon Tribe. They had established their clan through the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and could even somewhat resist a Great Emperor, so why had they been annihilated in history?
Strange.
Ling Han pondered for a moment. He decided to put this aside for the moment. Right now, he had best focus on comprehending the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique.
Time passed quickly, yet he did not feel it at all.
Endless enlightenment exploded in his mind, as bright as the birth of a star, its brilliance
eternal and indestructible.
The True Dragon was the True Dragon; it was too awesome.

Ling Han sighed endlessly. This Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was indeed breathtaking. He temporarily could not understand the cultivation techniques above the True Self Tier, but after he had comprehended the parts of Foundation Building Tier, Cauldron Forging Tier, and so on, he was extremely impressed.
So this was how it could be done.
However, from a certain aspect, this wasn’t because the True Dragon was awesome, but
rather because the heaven and earth was vast.
That was because the is was a cultivation technique that had the True Dragon had deduced from itself, and the True Dragon… had been created by the heaven and earth.
Ultimately, heaven and earth were awesome, and everything was Regulations.
Dao was natural, and that was what was truly invincible.
Ling Han had to start from the beginning again. He had to start from the Foundation Building

Tier part, and after completing it, he would be able to cultivate the Cauldron Forging Tier part, then the Core Formation Tier part. As he advanced, after he became a Saint, he would be able to cultivate the ultimate part. Once he succeeded, he would be able to stand against the Ancestral King for a while. At least, when faced with a Saint that had the Imperial Weapon in hand, he was no longer afraid.
However, this was something that would happen in the very, very long future.

Ling Han was excited. The gains from this trip to the True Dragon Abyss could be said to have exceeded his expectations. The four Nine Star Spirit Diagrams alone made it worthwhile, what more when there was also the True Dragon of Fortune, the Heavenly Dragon Fruit and the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique.
After digesting the three parts of the cultivation technique roughly, Ling Han suddenly woke
up.
He opened his eyes, and saw a small green snake coiled around his chest. Seeing him open his eyes, it immediately cast a disdainful look at him.
F***, this four-legged snake!
Ling Han suddenly got to his feet, asking, “Four-legged snake, why are you crawling on me?”
“To sh*t,” the Azure Dragon said.
‘F*ck!’ Ling Han couldn’t help but grimace. ‘Aren’t you the son of a True Dragon? Your status is
incredibly noble, so why can you speak so vulgarly?’
Was there anyone who would destroy their own image like this?
He knew that this little Azure Dragon was a little despicable, but he had never imagined that
it could be despicable to this extent.
You said that you are the descendant of a Divine Beast, so you must have been born powerful.
How could it be that you still need to poop?
Thus, it was definitely impossible for the little azure dragon to sh*t on him. It was only
saying this on purpose to disgust him.
-To disgust others, yet at the same time, drag down his own tastes. If this was not
despicable, what was it?
“Four-legged snake, don’t think that just because I promised your father that I would take
care of you, you can ride on top of me!”
“To sh*t?” the little Azure Dragon asked calmly.
Ling Han rolled up his sleeves. Whatever the case, he was going to give this sh*t a beating
first, and let him know who was boss here.
“Want to fight?” When the little azure dragon saw this, it also became excited.
“Not a fight, but beating you,” Ling Han said.

chapters.title: Chapter 4146: Little Azure Dragon
paragraphs: Chapter 4146: Little Azure Dragon
The little azure dragon laughed loudly, and actually took the initiative to charge towards Ling Han.
“Beat me up?”
“You’ve got to be joking!”
“The person who can beat me up hasn’t even been born yet!”
“Brat, in terms of seniority, I’m the ancestor of your ancestors. Hurry up and call me Grandpa!”
This little azure dragon was indeed very despicable. As it attacked, its mouth didn’t stop at all.

Even though he had just been born, he was shockingly in the Core Formation Tier. His battle prowess was formidable, and was even stronger than the average Imperial Son. More importantly, it seemed like he was born specialized in the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and his Body Art was incredibly formidable. Otherwise, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
It should be known that he was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier!

Ling Han, who was at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, was already able to rival him, who was in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Just how inconceivable was this? This was naturally because he had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. Merely his Body Art had reached the height of 34 Heavens, and added with his negligible mystical power, he had reached a level where he could rival Ling Han.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
On the other hand, Ling Han hadn’t started to cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique yet. If he had also mastered it, the situation would be completely different.

Of course, the little azure dragon was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. When he reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, just how powerful would his battle prowess be?
From this, it could be seen just how overbearing the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was.

“Yi, I couldn’t tell that a mere human like you would have such skill.” The little azure dragon let out a surprised sound. As he saw it, though his cultivation level was inferior to Ling Han’s, he had been cultivating the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique while he was in the egg, and had already cultivated the Core Formation Tier to the consummate level. Yet, he was still unable to suppress Ling Han?
It should be known that when the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique had been cultivated to the highest cultivation level, one would be capable of exchanging blows with the Ancestral King.
Ling Han was also surprised. “A four-legged snake is also so powerful. It’s really overturned my worldview!”

“Pei, I’m a True Dragon! A True Dragon!” the little azure dragon roared. What Four-legged Snake? He was the descendant of a True Dragon, the leader of the Divine Beasts. In fact, even the heavens envied him, and he had internal injuries before he was even born. This was enough to prove how extraordinary he was.
“Even if you are a dragon, you’d still have to submit to me!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fists repeatedly, every move domineering.

“I am the True Dragon. When I soar into the Nine Heavens, mortals, you can only look up at me from below!” The little azure dragon’s self-esteem soared. However, though his power was strong, he had really just been born and had not grasped any celestial technique. He was purely fighting based on his instincts.
Could this compare to Ling Han?
After a long battle, he had fallen into a disadvantage.
“Tsk, tsk, tsk. Looks like I have to subdue a dragon to become my steed,” Ling Han said with a smile.

The little azure dragon howled in anger. Though it had been entrusted to Ling Han by the True Dragon, and was certain that Ling Han’s future prospects were extraordinary, it was even more confident that Ling Han was just an ordinary human, so how could he possibly be stronger than it? Thus, it chose to provoke Ling Han right off the bat, wanting to beat Ling Han to the ground. In the future, he would be the boss, while Ling Han would be inferior to him.
However, who knew that this battle would cause him to feel stifled?
How could he not be a match?
His power had reached 34 Heavens, and he could suppress all Imperial Sons and whatnot, but why was he completely helpless against Ling Han?
“Human, I’ll definitely make you kneel down and proclaim you have been conquered!” the little azure dragon roared in fury.
Ling Han shook his head, “After sleeping in the egg for so many years, your ability of fantasizing has been cultivated to a very strong level.”
“Human brat, don’t force me to use my ultimate move!” the little azure dragon shouted loudly.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you?” Ling Han asked calmly.
The little azure dragon suddenly opened its mouth, and with a ‘wa’, spat out a mouthful of
water, which poured down on Ling Han.
F***, how did this guy learn this move?
Ling Han was rendered speechless. Was spitting a common trick used by despicable
characters?
However, the threat of this move was still quite big. Ling Han didn’t want to be spat on by the little azure dragon, so he hurriedly retreated.
The little azure dragon couldn’t help but say proudly, “What is it? Afraid of Grandpa
Dragon?”
Er, he really had the same character as the large black dog. They hadn’t even met face-to- face, and he already knew how to refer to himself as Grandpa.
Ling Han shook his head, and immediately charged back. Today, he would definitely teach this despicable dragon a good lesson, and let him know that he was the boss here.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

They battled fiercely. One won because his Body Art was strong, while the other cultivated the Core Formation Tier to the point that even an Imperial Son could only watch in dumbfounded shock. It could be said that they were evenly matched, and it was hard to decide who was stronger between them. However, because the little azure dragon did not know any celestial technique, it was at a disadvantage in this aspect. Thus, it was naturally at a disadvantage in
the battle.
The little azure dragon was very tenacious. He thought too highly of himself, and this was his first battle since birth. As the son of a dragon, how could he lose his first battle?
Thus, he resisted stubbornly, searching for a chance to turn defeat into victory.
He was still unwilling to admit defeat?
Ling Han activated the Icy Killing Celestial Finger and channeled the Ice Energy, instantly elevating his battle prowess to another level.

“F*ck!” The little azure dragon’s mouth instantly twisted in anger. This was the ultimate technique of the line of True Dragons, and now it was being cast in the hands of an outsider, while he, the true heir, actually didn’t know it. How could he endure this?
This was a slap to his face!
This guy must have grasped a great many secret techniques, yet chose to use this move against him. It was clear that he was mocking him.
Damn it, he was really too despicable.

In this state, he was naturally even more outmatched. He howled in pain from Ling Han’s barrage, but the strength of Body Art was not limited to power alone. It was the same for defense, which allowed him to withstand Ling Han’s mad barrage of attacks.
The little azure dragon was beaten black and blue, yet it didn’t suffer any serious injuries, making it cry out in anger.
“Four-legged snake, do you admit defeat?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“Pei, don’t even think about it!” The little azure dragon gritted its teeth. “You’re the one who should admit defeat to Grandpa Dragon. Hurry up and obediently call me Big Brother!” “You’re really stubborn!” Ling Han shook his head, and cracked a smile. “But that’s good too.
I can beat you to my heart’s content!”
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Under the continuous barrage of attacks, the little azure dragon was naturally in big trouble,
and could only take a beating.
However, he was indeed very unyielding. No matter how much he was beaten, he refused to
admit defeat.

“You’re quite ambitious. However, you’re only asking for your own suffering!” Ling Han channeled Destructive Energy, and black flames instantly entwined around his fists. There was an indescribably terrifying aura.
The little azure dragon was instantly shocked. This kind of energy caused a chill to rise up from the bottom of his heart, making him have an instinctive feeling that this was completely
capable of wounding him.
“Are you still continuing?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
The little azure dragon thought for a moment before retracting its move. “I’ve just been born,
so I’m still young. I won’t lower myself to your level.”
Ha!
As expected, he was despicable. If he couldn’t beat him, that was it. He still wanted to find an
excuse for himself.
Ling Han didn’t argue with the little azure dragon. The task of bantering with the little azure
dragon would best be handed over to the large black dog. He was sure that the large black dog would let the little azure dragon know who was the more despicable one of the two of them.
“Now, how do we leave?” he asked the little azure dragon.

“That’s easy,” the little azure dragon said. It stretched out a claw and pressed down a few times on the empty space. Xiu, instantly, the scenery changed. They instantly left the True Dragon Cave and appeared on the Heavenly Dragon Planet.
Ling Han glanced at the little azure dragon, and couldn’t help but feel surprised. His memories were still there!
