However, though his power was strong, he had really just been born and had not grasped any celestial technique.
He was purely fighting based on his instincts.
Could this compare to Ling Han?
After a long battle, he had fallen into a disadvantage.
“Tsk, tsk, tsk.
Looks like I have to subdue a dragon to become my steed,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The little azure dragon howled in anger.

Though it had been entrusted to Ling Han by the True Dragon, and was certain that Ling Han’s future prospects were extraordinary, it was even more confident that Ling Han was just an ordinary human, so how could he possibly be stronger than it?
Thus, it chose to provoke Ling Han right off the bat, wanting to beat Ling Han to the ground.
In the future, he would be the boss, while Ling Han would be inferior to him.
However, who knew that this battle would cause him to feel stifled?
How could he not be a match?
His power had reached 34 Heavens, and he could suppress all Imperial Sons and whatnot, but why was he completely helpless against Ling Han?
“Human, I’ll definitely make you kneel down and proclaim you have been conquered!” the little azure dragon roared in fury.
Ling Han shook his head, “After sleeping in the egg for so many years, your ability of fantasizing has been cultivated to a very strong level.”
“Human brat, don’t force me to use my ultimate move!” the little azure dragon shouted loudly.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you?” Ling Han asked calmly.
The little azure dragon suddenly opened its mouth, and with a ‘wa’, spat out a mouthful of
water, which poured down on Ling Han.
F***, how did this guy learn this move?
Ling Han was rendered speechless.
Was spitting a common trick used by despicable
characters?
However, the threat of this move was still quite big.
Ling Han didn’t want to be spat on by the little azure dragon, so he hurriedly retreated.
The little azure dragon couldn’t help but say proudly, “What is it?
Afraid of Grandpa
Dragon?”
Er, he really had the same character as the large black dog.
They hadn’t even met face-to- face, and he already knew how to refer to himself as Grandpa.
Ling Han shook his head, and immediately charged back.
Today, he would definitely teach this despicable dragon a good lesson, and let him know that he was the boss here.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
They battled fiercely.
One won because his Body Art was strong, while the other cultivated the Core Formation Tier to the point that even an Imperial Son could only watch in dumbfounded shock.
It could be said that they were evenly matched, and it was hard to decide who was stronger between them.
However, because the little azure dragon did not know any celestial technique, it was at a disadvantage in this aspect.
Thus, it was naturally at a disadvantage in
the battle.
The little azure dragon was very tenacious.
He thought too highly of himself, and this was his first battle since birth.
As the son of a dragon, how could he lose his first battle?
Thus, he resisted stubbornly, searching for a chance to turn defeat into victory.
He was still unwilling to admit defeat?
Ling Han activated the Icy Killing Celestial Finger and channeled the Ice Energy, instantly elevating his battle prowess to another level.
“F*ck!” The little azure dragon’s mouth instantly twisted in anger.
This was the ultimate technique of the line of True Dragons, and now it was being cast in the hands of an outsider, while he, the true heir, actually didn’t know it.
How could he endure this?
This was a slap to his face!
This guy must have grasped a great many secret techniques, yet chose to use this move against him.
It was clear that he was mocking him.
Damn it, he was really too despicable.
In this state, he was naturally even more outmatched.
He howled in pain from Ling Han’s barrage, but the strength of Body Art was not limited to power alone.
It was the same for defense, which allowed him to withstand Ling Han’s mad barrage of attacks.
The little azure dragon was beaten black and blue, yet it didn’t suffer any serious injuries, making it cry out in anger.
“Four-legged snake, do you admit defeat?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“Pei, don’t even think about it!” The little azure dragon gritted its teeth.
“You’re the one who should admit defeat to Grandpa Dragon.
Hurry up and obediently call me Big Brother!” “You’re really stubborn!” Ling Han shook his head, and cracked a smile.
“But that’s good too.
I can beat you to my heart’s content!”
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Under the continuous barrage of attacks, the little azure dragon was naturally in big trouble,
and could only take a beating.
However, he was indeed very unyielding.
No matter how much he was beaten, he refused to
admit defeat.
“You’re quite ambitious.
However, you’re only asking for your own suffering!” Ling Han channeled Destructive Energy, and black flames instantly entwined around his fists.
There was an indescribably terrifying aura.
The little azure dragon was instantly shocked.
This kind of energy caused a chill to rise up from the bottom of his heart, making him have an instinctive feeling that this was completely
capable of wounding him.
“Are you still continuing?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
The little azure dragon thought for a moment before retracting its move.
“I’ve just been born,
so I’m still young.
I won’t lower myself to your level.”
Ha!
As expected, he was despicable.
If he couldn’t beat him, that was it.
He still wanted to find an
excuse for himself.
Ling Han didn’t argue with the little azure dragon.
The task of bantering with the little azure
dragon would best be handed over to the large black dog.
He was sure that the large black dog would let the little azure dragon know who was the more despicable one of the two of them.
“Now, how do we leave?” he asked the little azure dragon.
“That’s easy,” the little azure dragon said.
It stretched out a claw and pressed down a few times on the empty space.
Xiu, instantly, the scenery changed.
They instantly left the True Dragon Cave and appeared on the Heavenly Dragon Planet.
Ling Han glanced at the little azure dragon, and couldn’t help but feel surprised.
His memories were still there!

chapters.title: Chapter 4147: Cultivating the Imperial Technique
paragraphs: Chapter 4147: Cultivating the Imperial Technique
Editor: Henyee Translations

Theoretically speaking, when one came out of the True Dragon Abyss, their relevant memories would be erased. Even mighty figures like the Imperial Sons would not be an exception. At most, they would only retain a vague sliver of their memories.
Thus, after so many years, the information about the True Dragon Abyss was still blank.
However, Ling Han clearly remembered everything, every detail clear and distinct.
“Four-legged snake, did we really come out of the True Dragon Abyss?” Ling Han asked.
The little azure dragon gave him a disdainful look, not even bothering to answer.
To ask him this kind of question was practically an insult to him.
But why had his memories not been erased?

Ling Han thought for a moment. There were two possibilities. Firstly, no one’s memories had been erased this time, or secondly, he was special, because he had been entrusted by the True Dragon to take care of the little azure dragon. If his memories were erased, he wouldn’t remember this at all. Wouldn’t it be done for if he, due to him having forgotten the little azure dragon, just killed the little azure dragon and cooked it?𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
Whether it was true or not was immediately clear.
Ling Han connected the connection device to the Galaxy Network, then contacted the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the others.
“Ling Han, have you come out as well?”
“Niu seems to have obtained True Dragon of Fortune!”
“Little Han, how did Grandpa Dog learn a few high-level energies for no reason?”
From their feedback, it was clear that their relevant memories had been severed, and only Ling Han was an exception.

Ling Han wouldn’t hide this from the empress and the others, nor would he publicize the fact that he still had his memories. Thus, he agreed on a meeting location with the empress and the others. There were some things that were best said face-to-face.
None of the Imperial Clans used the Galaxy Network. This caused Ling Han to be slightly wary of the Galaxy Network. In the future, it was best to use it less.

Was the Galaxy Network very convenient? It was definitely convenient. One could easily communicate with others here, and spar with the prodigies of the galaxy. How could it be that the Imperial Clans were unaware of this?

However, none of them connected to the Galaxy Network, which meant that the Galaxy Network still had unknown disadvantages. In fact, the drawbacks of the Galaxy Network surpassed the benefits on the surface, and that was why the Imperial Clans would rather give up these benefits.
“Yi, what is this thing?” The little azure dragon was curious.

The Galaxy Network had been built by the Chang Clan’s Great Emperor, and counting from the moment that the little azure dragon had been sealed into the Celestial Source, this had already happened who knew how many millions and millions of years later. Thus, he naturally wouldn’t know what kind of place the Galaxy Network was.
Ling Han gave a brief explanation, and the little azure dragon was instantly extremely intrigued.

He had been in a sealed state all this while. Though his consciousness had been in a deep slumber, there would occasionally be times when he would regain consciousness. Thus, it could be said that he had already been lonely for eternity.
Could the Galaxy Network connect the entire world?
In his eyes, this was really too fun. How lively would that be?
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. At this moment, the little azure dragon truly looked like a child.
“Alright, after we leave here, I’ll buy one for you.”
“Do I need you to buy it for me?” Unexpectedly, the little azure dragon acted despicable again, slanting its eyes at Ling Han.
You f******, you don’t know what’s good for you, do you?
Ling Han raised his fists. Peng, peng, peng! He gave the little azure dragon a good beating.
The two great prodigies started fighting again, and it was complete chaos.
In the end, the little azure dragon was still beaten to the ground by Ling Han.
“Human, remember this. When my cultivation level increases, I’ll definitely beat you up,” the little azure dragon wailed. However, it was still stubborn.
“Hehe, you’re still talking tough. Looks like I didn’t beat you to satisfaction.”
After dealing with the little azure dragon, Ling Han dragged this guy to meet the empress and the others.

“Yi, what’s this four-legged snake?” When the large black dog saw the little azure dragon, his reaction was the same as Ling Han’s. He completely did not think of this guy as a member of the Dragon Tribe.
The little azure dragon was furious, and swatted out a paw, “Your Grandpa is the True Dragon!”

Peng, with a single strike, the large black dog was instantly sent flying. Thankfully, the little azure dragon did not deliver a fatal strike. Otherwise, with the burst of power of 34 Heavens, the large black dog would definitely have been smashed into mush. Of course, if the little azure dragon really wanted to deliver a fatal strike, Ling Han would not sit by and watch either.
After suffering such a blow, the large black dog was completely stupefied.
What was going on?
Wasn’t this four-legged snake only at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier? Why was it so illogically powerful?

“We’ll talk about the details later. Let’s retreat first,” Ling Han said. He had killed Lin Lang. With the death of an Imperial Son, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan would definitely fly into a thunderous rage. It was best to flee as soon as possible.

At present, the various great forces were still searching for their own disciples. After all, after the True Dragon Abyss closed, people were all randomly tossed out. It would be difficult to find their heir at the first instant!
Thus, the best option was to take advantage of this opportunity to flee.
Ling Han and the others set out, found a warship, and directly reserved it, so that the captain could immediately set out, instead of waiting until everyone was here.
To the rich and imposing Ling Han, this fee was no big deal, though he would often run out of money now.

The warship arrived at the next planet. Ling Han and the others activated the Transfer Formation, and continued to traverse through several galaxies. In a single breath, they reached the point where they could no longer withstand the tearing force of the Transfer Formation. Only then did Ling Han and the others stop, and find an inn to stay in.
He told the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog about his experiences in the True Dragon Abyss. He told them everything, leaving nothing out.
“What, this four-legged snake is the descendant of the True Dragon?” the large black dog called out.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon rubbed its paws together, “Damn dog, are you asking for a beating?”
The large black dog was a little scared. After all, the battle prowess of the little azure dragon was clear for all to see.
However, when Ling Han told them what the True Dragon had entrusted him with, they all looked excited.
If they could also cultivate the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, and endlessly strengthen their physical strength, then wouldn’t they also be freakish like the little azure dragon?
More importantly, did they have the bloodline of the True Dragon?
Ling Han asked the little azure dragon. The little azure dragon was very generous, allowing Ling Han to pass on the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to the empress and the others.

This Imperial Technique was not something that could be successfully cultivated just by learning it. Firstly, it required an astonishing comprehension ability, and secondly, it required the bloodline of the True Dragon. Those that fitted the criteria were practically rare. He did not believe that the empress and the others would be able to learn it. Additionally, though he acted arrogant with Ling Han, he also admired this human very much. Furthermore, Ling Han clearly could not have asked him.
Combined with these circumstances, he didn’t mind him teaching the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to others.
Ling Han and the others were in no rush to return. They first learnt the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique.
Under Ling Han’s teachings, the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog started from the most basic Foundation Building chapter.
They were learning, and Ling Han also began to cultivate this step.
In this aspect, Ling Han naturally had an advantage. He had been personally taught by the True Dragon, and he had also studied it before. He could directly advance into the stage of cultivation.

He did not sit down in a cross-legged position, but rather crouched down, like a prostrating True Dragon. With the channelling of the Imperial Technique, instantly, the energy of heaven and earth surged towards him.
This wasn’t mystical power.
Ling Han immediately thought. This kind of power was very mysterious. In terms of level, it far surpassed mystical power.
High-level energy, but its grade wasn’t very high. It should only be categorized as one star.

chapters.title: Chapter 4148: Strange Idea
paragraphs: Chapter 4148: Strange Idea
Editor: Henyee Translations
Why was there only one star?𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺

It was very simple. This was not to be used against enemies, but to temper one’s own body. If he used Nine Star Energy like Heavenly Dao Flames and Ice Energy to temper his body, wouldn’t that be courting death?
The path of cultivation was about gradual progress. If one relied on powerful medicines to succeed in a single step, there would basically be aftereffects.

Don’t think that this wasn’t awesome. It should be known that even if cultivators reached the Core Formation Tier, they would still harvest the power of heaven and earth, and cultivate mystical power, and mystical power was the lowest grade of all energy.
Thus, the first step of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was to absorb One Star high-level energy to temper one’s body. This was already very impressive.

Ling Han stimulated the Foundation Building Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique with his much higher cultivation level, so he naturally appeared to be at ease. More importantly, he had absorbed a considerable amount of Dragon Essence, and ingested the Heavenly Dragon Fruit. A considerable amount of True Dragon bloodline had been accumulated in his body, which had a great boosting effect.
It had only been a dozen over days, and he had already cultivated the Foundation Building chapter to the level of great accomplishment.

The Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique cultivated Body Art, so Ling Han didn’t need to use mystical power. He simply shook his fist, and a terrifying power surged. Of course, this terrifying power was only relative to the Foundation Building Tier. In the case of the Core Formation Tier, this kind of power was negligible.
He took the initiative to channel the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique again. Instantly, dense scales appeared on his skin, covering his entire body. Even his eyelids were not spared.
Dragon scales!

The Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique cultivated Body Art, and Body Art was divided into two parts. The first was used for offensive power, and the second was used for defensive physique. At present, Ling Han was channelling the power of defense.
“F***, at the end of this cultivation, it’s not going to turn me into a True Dragon, right?” Ling Han murmured.
He was very resistant to this.
Why did a perfectly fine person have to become a dragon?

Furthermore, this path had been walked by the True Dragon. He had been born as an Emperor, but it was not certain that he would be able to walk the same path and still become an Emperor. Even if he followed the True Dragon’s hypothesis, and cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to great accomplishment level, he could just barely contend with the Ancestral King. However, that was just barely, and he could not really be on par with the Ancestral King.
Thus, this naturally had its limitations.
“I still have to persist in walking my own path. This Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique can only be a supplementary technique, and cannot overtake my own path,” Ling Han said to himself.

He went to check on the empress and the others. In the end, because the True Dragon bloodline in their bodies was insufficient, the two people and one dog were unable to begin cultivation even after a long time. Their progress could be said to be pitifully slow.

However, theoretically speaking, as long as they possessed the True Dragon Bloodline, they could rely on the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to strengthen themselves. In the end, they would be able to leap over the Dragon’s Gate and transform into Divine Dragons. Thus, as long as their comprehension ability was adequate, they could still cultivate. It was just that their progress would be very, very slow.
Ling Han finally relaxed, and continued to cultivate.
He began to cultivate the the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, appearing very intrigued.

That’s right. In the battle with the little azure dragon, Ling Han had found out how terrifying the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was. As it turned out, Body Art could also be cultivated to such an awesome extent.
What if the little azure dragon advanced into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, late stage or even the consummate level of Core Formation Tier? Would he still be able to defeat him then?
Thus, Ling Han had to improve the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique as soon as possible. At that time, he was confident that he could still suppress the little azure dragon.
Your uncle would always be your uncle.
With how proud and arrogant Ling Han was, he should be invincible among his peers.

In the case of the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter, he connected with another kind of high-level energy, and Ling Han could clearly distinguish that this energy was much stronger. It should be Two Stars.

Similarly, the Core Formation Tier would be tempered with a Three Stars high-level energy, and finally, a Nine Star Energy would be used to temper their bodies. That was something that could burn even Saints to death. With this thing tempering his body, how could his Body Art not be terrifying?
This step was much slower, and after a whole month, Ling Han finally completed it.
“What? You’ve even mastered the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter?” The little azure dragon was astonished. “F*ck! Who’s the son of the True Dragon here?”
His face was filled with shock, because he had not spent just this much time.
Could it be that this human was a hybrid of the Dragon Race, and then a super awakening of his bloodline had appeared?
“Scram!” Ling Han shot out a kick.
“Ling Han, do you want to fight?” the little azure dragon howled.
Ling Han waved his hand, and said, “You want to fight me? No matter what, you have to advance to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier first. Otherwise, don’t ask for a beating.”

Upon hearing this, the little azure dragon was naturally rendered speechless. In just over a month, what improvement could he make? There was practically no change to his abilities. Fighting against Ling Han, he would definitely lose. However, he was born with a bad mouth, and was unwilling to admit defeat, so he kept talking about fighting at the drop of a hat.

The empress and the others finally had a noticeable improvement. They would need about a year’s time to completely cultivate the Foundation Building chapter. Though this could not compare to Ling Han, their progress was actually not too slow either, because cultivating the Foundation Building chapter itself was a slow process.
Ling Han immediately started to cultivate the Core Formation Tier chapter. Sure enough, this chapter stimulated Three Star Energy.
After several complete cycles, he suddenly had an idea. What if he used Four Star Energy as replacement?

Other people didn’t need to do this, because from the Foundation Building Tier to the Ancestral King Tier, there were exactly nine cultivation levels corresponding to nine levels of high-level energy. However, Ling Han had also mastered an energy that was higher than nine stars.
Destructive Energy!
Hence, he was completely capable of surpassing a level.
The problem was, could his body withstand being tempered with Four Star Energy?
In terms of making himself stronger, Ling Han was definitely a maniacal type of candidate. After a moment of hesitation, he began to put it into action.
Moreover, he liked to walk his own path, and did not want to be limited by the arrangements of others.

Boom, Four Star Energy entered his body, and Ling Han instantly spat out blood madly. He felt as if his internal organs had been crushed, and the blood he spat out contained bits of his internal organs.
It was too powerful; he couldn’t bear it.
No, he couldn’t skip this process.

With a thought from Ling Han, he could first use Three Star Energy to temper himself to Great Accomplishment level, then switch to Four Star Energy to do it again. Then, after advancing into True Self Tier, he would be able to directly use Five Star Energy to stimulate the True Self Tier chapter.
‘I’ll do that.’
Ling Han no longer wanted to leap forwards, but rather to advance steadily. He was still using Three Star Energy to temper himself.
That would be too slow.

There was nothing that could be done. By now, he had already cultivated the chapter of the Core Formation Tier, which was the same as his cultivation level. There was no further advantage to speak of, so his speed naturally slowed down.
A month passed, and Ling Han’s Body Art finally cultivated to three Heavens.
Then, could his present strength reach 38 Heavens?
No, he was still at 35 Heavens.

The Body Art and mystical power weren’t simply superimposed. The power of one of the two was too weak, so it couldn’t help at all. Otherwise, if the little azure dragon was at the early stage of the Core Formation Tier while the mystical power was at least at four or five Heavens, then wouldn’t the superimposed power reach the height of almost forty Heavens?
Ling Han made a rough estimation. Only when he had cultivated his Body Art to above 15 Heavens would the effects be obvious, such as increasing his power by one Heaven.

He opened the connection device, and instantly, a lot of important news jumped out.

Editor: Henyee Translations
Why was there only one star?𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
It was very simple.
This was not to be used against enemies, but to temper one’s own body.
If he used Nine Star Energy like Heavenly Dao Flames and Ice Energy to temper his body, wouldn’t that be courting death?
The path of cultivation was about gradual progress.
If one relied on powerful medicines to succeed in a single step, there would basically be aftereffects.
Don’t think that this wasn’t awesome.

It should be known that even if cultivators reached the Core Formation Tier, they would still harvest the power of heaven and earth, and cultivate mystical power, and mystical power was the lowest grade of all energy.
Thus, the first step of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was to absorb One Star high-level energy to temper one’s body.
This was already very impressive.
Ling Han stimulated the Foundation Building Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique with his much higher cultivation level, so he naturally appeared to be at ease.
More importantly, he had absorbed a considerable amount of Dragon Essence, and ingested the Heavenly Dragon Fruit.
A considerable amount of True Dragon bloodline had been accumulated in his body, which had a great boosting effect.
It had only been a dozen over days, and he had already cultivated the Foundation Building chapter to the level of great accomplishment.
The Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique cultivated Body Art, so Ling Han didn’t need to use mystical power.
He simply shook his fist, and a terrifying power surged.
Of course, this terrifying power was only relative to the Foundation Building Tier.
In the case of the Core Formation Tier, this kind of power was negligible.
He took the initiative to channel the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique again.
Instantly, dense scales appeared on his skin, covering his entire body.
Even his eyelids were not spared.
Dragon scales!
The Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique cultivated Body Art, and Body Art was divided into two parts.
The first was used for offensive power, and the second was used for defensive physique.
At present, Ling Han was channelling the power of defense.
“F***, at the end of this cultivation, it’s not going to turn me into a True Dragon, right?” Ling Han murmured.
He was very resistant to this.
Why did a perfectly fine person have to become a dragon?
Furthermore, this path had been walked by the True Dragon.
He had been born as an Emperor, but it was not certain that he would be able to walk the same path and still become an Emperor.
Even if he followed the True Dragon’s hypothesis, and cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to great accomplishment level, he could just barely contend with the Ancestral King.
However, that was just barely, and he could not really be on par with the Ancestral King.
Thus, this naturally had its limitations.
“I still have to persist in walking my own path.
This Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique can only be a supplementary technique, and cannot overtake my own path,” Ling Han said to himself.
He went to check on the empress and the others.
In the end, because the True Dragon bloodline in their bodies was insufficient, the two people and one dog were unable to begin cultivation even after a long time.
Their progress could be said to be pitifully slow.
However, theoretically speaking, as long as they possessed the True Dragon Bloodline, they could rely on the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique to strengthen themselves.
In the end, they would be able to leap over the Dragon’s Gate and transform into Divine Dragons.
Thus, as long as their comprehension ability was adequate, they could still cultivate.
It was just that their progress would be very, very slow.
Ling Han finally relaxed, and continued to cultivate.
He began to cultivate the the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, appearing very intrigued.
That’s right.
In the battle with the little azure dragon, Ling Han had found out how terrifying the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was.
As it turned out, Body Art could also be cultivated to such an awesome extent.
What if the little azure dragon advanced into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, late stage or even the consummate level of Core Formation Tier?
Would he still be able to defeat him then?
Thus, Ling Han had to improve the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique as soon as possible.
At that time, he was confident that he could still suppress the little azure dragon.
Your uncle would always be your uncle.
With how proud and arrogant Ling Han was, he should be invincible among his peers.
In the case of the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter, he connected with another kind of high-level energy, and Ling Han could clearly distinguish that this energy was much stronger.
It should be Two Stars.
Similarly, the Core Formation Tier would be tempered with a Three Stars high-level energy, and finally, a Nine Star Energy would be used to temper their bodies.
That was something that could burn even Saints to death.
With this thing tempering his body, how could his Body Art not be terrifying?
This step was much slower, and after a whole month, Ling Han finally completed it.
“What?
You’ve even mastered the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter?” The little azure dragon was astonished.
“F*ck!
Who’s the son of the True Dragon here?”
His face was filled with shock, because he had not spent just this much time.
Could it be that this human was a hybrid of the Dragon Race, and then a super awakening of his bloodline had appeared?
“Scram!” Ling Han shot out a kick.
“Ling Han, do you want to fight?” the little azure dragon howled.
Ling Han waved his hand, and said, “You want to fight me?
No matter what, you have to advance to the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier first.
Otherwise, don’t ask for a beating.”
Upon hearing this, the little azure dragon was naturally rendered speechless.
In just over a month, what improvement could he make?
There was practically no change to his abilities.
Fighting against Ling Han, he would definitely lose.
However, he was born with a bad mouth, and was unwilling to admit defeat, so he kept talking about fighting at the drop of a hat.

chapters.title: Chapter 4149: Invitation to battle
paragraphs: Chapter 4149: Invitation to battle
Editor: Henyee Translations
The most sensational event on the Galaxy Network was Lin Lang’s death.
That was an Imperial Son!

The majestic Imperial Son had actually been killed in the True Dragon Abyss. Though no corpse had been seen, anyone who was still alive would be sent out when the True Dragon Abyss closed. Thus, Lin Lang’s disappearance was equivalent to a declaration of death.

In history, though the True Dragon Abyss had also devoured countless lives, and there was no shortage of Imperial Clan members, but an Imperial Son had died inside. Throughout history, there had only been a rare few such cases.
Then who had killed Lin Lang?

No one knew. Those who entered had all had their relevant memories severed. Whether it was words or images, they had all been destroyed, and no clues could be brought out at all. Thus, there was only endless speculation.
Who exactly had done this?
Was this the case for other Imperial Sons?
The Fire Cloud Imperial Clan was naturally enraged as well, saying that they wanted to find the culprit and bring him to justice.
Hehe, so it seemed that deaths would not be allowed in your Lin Clan?

Ling Han humphed upon hearing this. If it weren’t for Lin Lang’s repeated threats, the two of them wouldn’t have become mortal enemies. Moreover, the death match had been set by the True Dragon. If anyone was to blame, it should be the True Dragon.
Aside from Lin Lang’s death, the other hot topic was who had obtained the True Dragon of Fortune.

Those who entered would have their relevant memories erased, but the scene of obtaining the True Dragon of Fortune would not be forgotten. Thus, it was very easy to piece together three people: Imperial Son Kui, Cheng Qing, the Peacock Imperial Clan’s Imperial Daughter, but among the remaining two cultivation levels of Core Formation Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier, it was a mystery who had obtained the True Dragon of Fortune.
But everyone believed that it was definitely not the Imperial Son or the Imperial Daughter.
Why?

What did the Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter have to be afraid of? They had the Imperial Clan as their backer, so even if they had supreme precious treasures in their hands, who would dare to snatch them from them?

Thus, Imperial Son Kui and Cheng Qing didn’t conceal the fact that they had obtained the True Dragon of Fortune in the slightest. In their eyes, this was a matter of course, so what need was there for them to be afraid of being hated?

Now, however, there were two people who kept their identities a secret. Thus, they definitely weren’t members of the Imperial Clans. They were afraid that if they revealed their identities, others would covet them and snatch away their True Dragon of Fortune.
—There were always some bizarre techniques in the world that could even plunder fortune.
Ling Han ignored this. ‘You guys can go ahead and guess. I’ll quietly make a fortune.’
The group set out again, heading towards the Nine Suns Planet.
As they cultivated, they continued their journey. When they returned to the Nine Suns Planet, it was already half a year later.
“Ling Han, I want to fight you!” The little azure dragon ran over again.
Ling Han looked over. Oh, so this guy had advanced into the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. No wonder he was so confident, and came to challenge him on his own volition.
“Alright, I’ll satisfy you.” He smiled, and with a stomp of his feet, he had already shot through the air.

“Grandson, don’t run so fast. Your Grandpa is coming to beat you up.” The little azure dragon laughed loudly, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han. “Grandpa Dragon is now in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his combined power has reached 36 Heavens, which is already enough to crush you!”
Boom, the battle began.
“Ah!”
“Yi?”
“F*** you, you actually managed to cultivate the Core Formation Tier chapter to at least thirteen layers of power, and your combined power has reached thirty seven Heavens!”
“Gods, you are too blind!”
“You must be jealous that Grandpa Dragon is too handsome, so you plotted against me while I was still in the egg. Now, you are helping this human!”
Peng, peng, peng! The little azure dragon screamed in pain as Ling Han continued to pummel it.
He had improved, but how could it be that Ling Han had not?
Thus, your uncle was still your uncle.
After a good beating, the little azure dragon admitted defeat gloomily, then ran off to cultivate again.
Though Ling Han had won, he also felt some pressure.

As expected of the son of the True Dragon, the little azure dragon’s natural talent and battle prowess were both top-notch. As long as his cultivation progression slowed down the slightest, it was possible that the little azure dragon would surpass him in battle prowess.
How could Ling Han possibly allow the little azure dragon to turn around and ravage him? Thus, his fighting spirit was incredibly high.

He continued to cultivate diligently, and bought all kinds of ingredients needed to cultivate his Body Art on the Galaxy Network. They were all incredibly valuable, but when used to improve his abilities, Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be stingy in the slightest. He spent money like water, and at the same time, he worked hard on concocting alchemical pills. Where there was income, there was expense, and only then could he ensure that the money would flow continuously and never dry up.

On the Galaxy Network, the news about the True Dragon of Fortune continued to spread. A great many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters of the Core Formation Tier and the Cauldron Forging Tier all jumped out, strongly inviting these two mysterious people of the two cultivation levels who had obtained the True Dragon of Fortune to come out for a battle to prove who was the king tier that was invincible among their peers.
If this could not be rectified, it would be a super blow to the reputation of the Imperial Clans.

Previously, it had been mentioned that Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter was synonymous with invincibility among their peers. The only one who could defeat them was another Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter.
But now? People would say that Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter were nothing special. You see, they couldn’t even win the True Dragon of Fortune.
Ling Han merely looked at this and smiled, completely ignoring it.

I am very busy. I have to concoct alchemical pills, and at the same time, have to cultivate. Only when I have nothing better to do would I go and accompany you in your efforts to prove your reputation.
Another half year passed, and Ling Han had more or less cultivated the Core Formation Tier chapter to consummate level.

The reason why his speed was so fast was firstly, because his cultivation level had already reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, so he had an advantage in cultivation level. Secondly, he spared no expense and ingested a large amount of Celestial medicines, all of which were beneficial to the cultivation of Body Art.

Not only him, but even the large black dog had already completed cultivating the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter. Meanwhile, the empress and Hu Niu were slightly slower, and they had just finished cultivating the Foundation Building Tier chapter.
Another month later, Ling Han finally completed cultivating the Core Formation Tier chapter.

His current stamina had reached an astonishing 36 Heavens, which was equivalent to his mystical power, and if the two were activated at the same time, the power he blasted out could reach as high as 40 Heavens.
Two factors worth 36 Heavens, and added together, he only reached 40 Heavens?
It looked very weak, but in truth, if you had two people with battle prowess of 36 Heavens join forces, would they be able to defeat someone with battle prowess of 40 Heavens?
And this was still because the two types of power originated from Ling Han himself, so they could be perfectly fused, and his power could soar to 40 Heavens.
Hence, this was already awesome enough.

It should be known that 40 Heavens was a threshold. In the past, even when the Great Emperor was young, he had not touched this threshold, and as for Ling Han, in truth, his mystical power had not reached peak stage yet!
Thus, if he cultivated the Core Formation Tier to the extreme, his power would definitely be able to break through 40 Heavens.

Even now, Ling Han was already capable of sweeping aside all other cultivators of the Core Formation Tier. Regardless of whether they burned their Imperial Blood, he would raze them all to the ground.
Ling Han did not relax. He began to use Four Star Energy to stimulate the Core Formation Tier chapter, wanting to recultivate again.
In this way, his physique would become even more terrifying, and in terms of power, could he reach the 40 Heavens?

At that time, both Body Art and mystical power at 40 Heavens, would his power burst be able to reach 45 Heavens, or perhaps even higher than that? Would he be able to fight even True Self Tier elites?
Ling Han couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation.

Right at this moment, another wave of commotion arose on the Galaxy Network. Those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters that had been clamoring previously had even hosted a tournament in the Galaxy Network, inviting the two mysterious people to participate. If they could win, they would be given valuable items.
For example, the Iron Bull Blood Fruit.
After seeing this thing, Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his heart jolt.

chapters.title: Chapter 4150: Wolf Mountain
paragraphs: Chapter 4150: Wolf Mountain
Editor: Henyee Translations
The Iron Bull Blood Fruit was a Seven Star Celestial medicine, and was usually used by Venerate Tier elites.

At present, Ling Han did not need this kind of precious medicine. However, he remembered that when Song Lan’s great-grandfather was cultivating, something had gone wrong, and he had gone mad. He needed to concoct an alchemical pill to remedy the situation, and the main ingredient needed was the Iron Bull Blood Fruit.
In the past, Ling Han had cooperated with Song Lan, and had promised the latter that if possible, he would help Song Lan save her great-grandfather.
At that time, he had only said it casually, but now, the Iron Bull Blood Fruit had actually appeared in front of Ling Han.

Ling Han could ignore this. He didn’t owe Song Lan anything, but he had promised her before. Even if it was just a casual remark, if he broke his promise, it would be equivalent to leaving behind an internal demon in his heart. Even though it was only a small matter, if his spirit was not complete, when he attempted to break through to Saint Tier, it could possibly become a great calamity.

“Sigh, who asked me to speak too much at that time!” Ling Han sighed, “Alright, I was already displeased when I saw these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, so I can take this chance to sweep them aside and teach them a lesson. In future, don’t be so arrogant anymore!”
“However, I can’t just run over by myself. Who knows what kind of underhanded tricks these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters might use if they can’t accept defeat.”

Ling Han personally went to see the Nine Mountains Venerate, and asked him to protect him. As long as the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters followed the rules, he would also be willing to have a fair battle, but if they wanted to use underhanded means, he would also have a Venerate Tier elite covering for him.
After learning of Ling Han’s request, the Nine Mountains Venerate agreed without a second word.

He was filled with anticipation for Ling Han. This young man had hopes of becoming an Emperor in future. Wasn’t defeating Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter a daily routine on the path to becoming an Emperor?

Unfortunately, his previous seclusion had not allowed him to break through to Saint Tier, but his abilities had still improved greatly. Among Venerate Tier elites, he could be considered one of the very best.

“Fight? I want to go too!” When the little azure dragon found out that Ling Han was going to fight with the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, it immediately called out excitedly, “I am the real Imperial Son, and my seniority is the highest. Now, I will go and give some pointers to these juniors.”
“Woof, woof, woof! Grandpa Dog will go with you,” the large black dog also shouted.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “All right, just the three of us will go.”
As for the empress and Hu Niu, it was best that they stayed behind to focus on cultivation. Their cultivation levels were indeed slightly weaker.

Their group was very strange. One person, one dog, and a little azure dragon. Of course, the current little azure dragon did not have the majesty of a True Dragon at all. At first glance, anyone would think that this was a four-legged snake.
For the moment, it could be said that there were three of them. Led by the Nine Mountains Venerate, they soon arrived at the Azure Wolf Planet.

The Nine Mountains Venerate hid himself. If it was just a spar between juniors, he naturally wouldn’t interfere, but if anyone dared to use their superior power to act as a bully, he naturally wouldn’t sit by and watch.
This Azure Wolf Planet was the place where the great Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters had challenged Ling Han to a battle. Of course, they did not know that the mysterious person was Ling Han.

Because this matter had already caused a great commotion, a great many well-known youngsters from the universe also ran over, wanting to catch a glimpse of this great battle. However, there was an opinion on the Galaxy Network that thought that it was impossible for that mysterious person to appear.
“Now that they’ve obtained the True Dragon of Fortune, they are naturally going to make a fortune in secret. If they are targeted, that won’t be a good thing.”

“I don’t believe that anyone can defeat the Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter, what more when there are two such freaks. Hence, this must be because the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters fought to the point that neither side was able to win, which allowed those two to take advantage of the situation. Thus, it is naturally impossible for them to step out, because once they do, their true colours would be revealed.”

“That’s right. The Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters are all supremely talented individuals. Furthermore, they also have the support of the Imperial Clans, and can burn the Imperial Blood to endlessly increase their battle prowess. No matter what, I can’t think of any possibility that they would lose in a battle of equal cultivation levels.”
“I advise everyone who is still on the way to return quickly, and not to waste time.”
“As for those who have already arrived at the Azure Wolf Planet, just treat it as a holiday.”
“Haha.”

This was a one-sided argument, and everyone thought that it was impossible for Ling Han to appear, because not only would he become a target, he would also possibly embarrass himself. After weighing the pros and cons, how could it be compensated with just a Seven Star Great Herb?

“Haha, Little Han, you’re completely looked down on!” The little azure dragon laughed loudly. He also imitated the large black dog and called Ling Han ‘Little Han’. However, as he laughed, he became furious. “F*ck, Grandpa Dragon can’t beat Little Han now, so looking down on Little Han means looking down on Grandpa Dragon? F*ck, these b*stards, Grandpa Dragon is going to beat them up!”
This guy was really emotional, and his temper came on a whim.
Ling Han swept his gaze over the information on the Galaxy Network again, and couldn’t help but reveal a strange expression.

As it turned out, there were actually a great many people who claimed to have obtained the True Dragon of Fortune, and challenged those Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, and the result was naturally a terrible defeat.
Why were there so many imposters?
Simple, because this was the best chance for them to become famous in a single stroke.

However, without the corresponding abilities, challenging the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters was a completely foolish idea. At the beginning, when their false identities were exposed, the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters only told them to get lost, but there were endless imposters, which enraged these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, and they began to commit murder.
After this, the impostors finally disappeared. After all, no matter how good it was to become famous, how could it compare to one’s own life?
The three of them set out, and soon arrived at the foot of Wolf Mountain.

The Wolf Mountain was the largest and tallest mountain on the Azure Wolf Planet. It was also where the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters had invited the mysterious person to battle. It was said that the Wolf Tribe had once produced a Great Emperor, and this was the Holy Land where the Great Emperor had completed his final leap. The mountain was wrapped by the Great Emperor’s Regulations, and was incredibly sturdy. It could completely withstand a great battle on the level of Venerate Tier.

However, the Wolf Tribe Great Emperor didn’t treat this place as the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan. Instead, he relocated to another planet. Thus, there were no elite guards of the Wolf Tribe here, where it was strictly forbidden to ascend the mountain.
Ling Han and the others began to climb the mountain.
After walking for a while, a platform appeared in front of them. A young man in black was sitting cross-legged there, a sword laid across his legs. His eyes were closed, as if he was a stone statue.
And around the platform, there were a great many people watching. There were at least five to six hundred of them.
“Hehe, are you here to watch the excitement or to issue a challenge?” Someone among these people asked Ling Han and the others.
“What about watching the excitement, and what about issuing a challenge?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“If you’re here to watch the excitement, come and stand with us. If you’re here to issue a challenge, there, that person has already been waiting for a long time,” the people in the surroundings said.
“Ha, Grandpa Dog is here to issue a challenge!” The large black dog was the first to jump out and stand on the platform, facing the person in green who was sitting cross-legged.
The young man opened his eyes, and when he swept an eye over the large black dog, a disdainful expression appeared on his face, “A mere wild dog is worthy of being my opponent?”
“Old Black, he looks down on you!” the little azure dragon said. He and the large black dog shared the same personality, and it could be said that they were already good friends.
